jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Recruiter to lead and execute full-cycle and strategic recruitment initiatives across a variety of roles within the organization.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Recruiter to lead and execute full-cycle and strategic recruitment initiatives across a variety of roles within the organization. This role demands not only excellent sourcing and assessment skills, but also a deep understanding of strategic talent acquisition practices—from workforce planning to pipeline development. The Senior Recruiter will partner closely with department heads and senior leadership to build recruitment strategies that align with business goals and support organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and oversee the strategic recruitment process, including proactive talent sourcing, candidate engagement, and workforce planning for both immediate and future hiring needs.
Serve as a consultative partner to department heads and executives, offering insights and solutions to hiring challenges and building long-term recruitment plans.
Conduct job intake meetings with hiring managers to define the ideal candidate profile, assess role criticality, and align on recruitment strategies.
Design and implement targeted sourcing campaigns on platforms like LinkedIn, OnlineJobs, Indeed, and other niche job boards.
Conduct behavioral and structured interviews; assess for both skillset and culture fit.
Review, update, and optimize job descriptions in alignment with market trends and company branding.
Administer hiring assessments and analyze candidate performance against role requirements.
Monitor and report recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, source effectiveness, conversion rates) to evaluate hiring performance and improve the process.
Mentor and support junior recruiters and recruitment assistants when needed.
Continuously explore and introduce new tools, methods, and channels to enhance recruitment effectiveness and employer branding.

Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Behavioral Science, or a related field.
At least 3- 5 years of proven experience in strategic and full-cycle recruitment, preferably in a remote or international setting.
Strong background in sourcing executive, specialist, and volume positions across various departments.


Demonstrated expertise in using ATS (e.g., BambooHR) and sourcing tools (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter,, Indeed).
Proficient in Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs) and digital collaboration tools.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; capable of influencing and negotiating with senior stakeholders.
High degree of initiative and autonomy; able to work independently in a fully remote environment.
Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive recruitment decisions
Strong sense of discretion and ability to handle sensitive hiring information with confidentiality.

jobs.excerpt: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year Position Requirement: Full-Time FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Woburn, Massachusetts Salary:135K - 160K+Work from Home!
jobs.description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Woburn, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $135,000 – $160,000 / year

jobs.title: Account Executive (Education)
jobs.excerpt: About UsCardinal Education is a dynamic and collaborative educational consulting company dedicated to providing students and families with superior academic support and admissions expertise.
jobs.description:
About Us

Cardinal Education is a dynamic and collaborative educational consulting company dedicated to providing students and families with superior academic support and admissions expertise. Our rapidly growing enterprise offers Educational Consultants the opportunity to make a significant impact from the start while prioritizing exceptional experiences for families and providing substantial growth opportunities within the company.

Culture at Cardinal Education

Collaboration is key to our culture at Cardinal Education, where open communication and diverse perspectives are valued and drive success. We foster innovation and learning through a supportive environment that encourages growth. Our team is passionate about education and creating a dynamic and inclusive workplace.

The Opportunity

We are hiring our first dedicated Educational Sales Consultant to take ownership of our high-volume, inbound pipeline. Historically, our senior Educational Consultants have managed the sales process. As our business scales, we need an experienced sales professional to close inbound leads so our experts can focus entirely on delivering world-class client results.

This is not a cold-calling role. The phone rings consistently, and during our peak season (August–December), we generate an overwhelming amount of inbound interest, ensuring a deep, continuous pipeline of warm leads for our team. We need a closer who can build immediate trust, navigate complex family dynamics, and effectively articulate the value of our high-ticket mentoring, test prep, tutoring, and admissions services.

What You Will Do

  • Manage Inbound Sales: Own the sales cycle for our primary services (Tutoring, Test Prep, and Private School and College Admissions) with ticket values typically ranging from $4,000 to $50,000+.
  • CRM and Pipeline Management: Execute the current sales process while bringing your expertise to refine and elevate our systems. Utilize Salesforce to mine existing leads and maximize our exceptional lifetime customer value (LTV).
  • Client Advising: Act as the initial guide for families, diagnosing their specific educational needs and recommending the appropriate level of service (from standard tutoring to elite coaching).
  • Cross-Selling & Expansion: Leverage our long-term client relationships to cross-sell multiple services across a family's 7-8 year journey with Cardinal Education.

Who You Are

  • An Educational Insider: You have strong experience in education sales, admissions counseling, EdTech, or any adjacent industry. You understand the nuances of the industry and don't need to be trained on the basics of high-stakes academic metrics.
  • A Consultative Closer: You excel at high-ticket sales and know how to build credibility and trust quickly with an affluent, demanding clientele.
  • A Team Player and a Relationship Builder: You are looking for a long-term home to build your career. You understand that in high-stakes education, long-term client success and team collaboration matter far more than just chasing the next quick close.
  • Systems Oriented: You are comfortable working within CRM systems (like Salesforce) to manage a heavy flow of leads and track pipeline velocity.

Why Join Us?

  • Zero Cold Calling: Step into a role with a massive, proven inbound lead pipeline.
  • High LTV: You aren't just selling one product; you are building a book of business with families that return year after year for new services.
  • Competitive Compensation: We offer a strong compensation package (OTE range $80k - $120k ) designed to provide stability without the constant "feast or famine" typical of a meat-grinder sales culture.
  • Remote Flexibility: Live and work where you want. You do not need to be based in the Bay Area.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to help us build, scale, and secure our multi-cloud infrastructure.

As part of a fast-moving engineering team, you’ll also play a key role in supporting internal IT operations, ensuring reliability across both platform and people.

  • Design and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure across Azure and GCP
  • Build and optimise CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows
  • Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Terraform or similar)
  • Deploy and operate machine learning pipelines in production environments
  • Manage and scale multi-cluster GPU environments for AI workloads
  • Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure reliability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve system, deployment, and performance issues
  • Provide hands-on IT support (user access, devices, internal systems) to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve scalability, performance, and automation

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines
  • Solid expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.)
  • Experience managing Kubernetes environments and GPU workloads
  • Proven experience deploying machine learning models or MLOps pipelines
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, networking, and system reliability
  • Comfortable handling IT support responsibilities alongside core DevOps work
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently

jobs.title: Directeur.trice de comptes
jobs.excerpt: Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.
jobs.description:
Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.

Chez Thirdbridge, nous créons des applications et des solutions logicielles sur mesure depuis plus d'une décennie. Au-delà du code, nous sommes fiers de réunir des passionné·es de technologie au cœur d'une culture inégalable avec qui nous imaginons des expériences numériques que les utilisateurs aiment pour de vrai.

Le·la directeur·rice de compte sera responsable de faire croître nos comptes existants tout en allant chercher de nouveaux clients. En travaillant conjointement avec les équipes de produit, de design et de développement, il·elle combinera ses compétences en développement des affaires et en gestion de la relation client pour faire avancer les comptes actifs et construire un pipeline de nouvelles opportunités.

Les principales responsabilités:

  • Gérer un portefeuille de comptes actifs et en assurer la croissance, en identifiant les occasions d'élargir les mandats;
  • Bâtir et maintenir un plan de compte pour chaque client clé en collaboration avec les PMPO, en définissant les objectifs d'affaires, les priorités de développement et la feuille de route à moyen terme, puis en assurant le suivi de son exécution.
  • Prendre en charge les occasions d'affaires qualifiées qui lui sont confiées et les mener jusqu'au contrat, en menant la découverte, la proposition et la négociation, sans imputabilité sur la génération de ces occasions;
  • Contribuer aux réponses aux appels d'offres en apportant l'expertise sectorielle, en participant à la construction de la proposition et en présentant devant le client;
  • Mener les rencontres clients, les présentations et les négociations commerciales;
  • Préparer les propositions, les estimations et les ententes en collaboration avec les équipes produit et livraison;
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil stratégique dans la relation client et défendre ses intérêts à l'interne. Comprendre les objectifs stratégiques clients;
  • Établir une cadence de suivi avec les comptes clés (revues d'affaires trimestrielles (QBR), points de contact réguliers) et entretenir les relations à long terme;
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance de ton portefeuille (revenus, satisfaction, opportunités en cours) et rendre compte des résultats;
  • Collaborer avec le marketing pour aligner les efforts de génération de clientèle potentielle et la présence aux événements de l'industrie. Présenter, coordonner, et assister aux événement d’industrie avec les clients;
  • Collaborer sur une base régulière avec les équipes produit pour aligner les efforts de gestion de compte ainsi que d’identifier des opportunités d’affaires;
  • Gérer les tensions et les insatisfactions dans la relation client, en intervenant dès les premiers signaux et en menant les discussions difficiles jusqu'à une résolution claire, avec l'appui des équipes internes concernées.

Finalement, nous cherchons quelqu'un qui sait écouter un client avant de proposer, qui n'a pas peur d'aller cogner aux portes pour bâtir de nouvelles relations, et qui assure un suivi rigoureux sans qu'on ait à le lui rappeler. Territory Manager – Benelux & Nordics

Location: Remote — ideally based within the Benelux or Nordic region
Engagement: Independent Contractor or Employment
Reporting to: Vice President of Sales EMEA

Territory: Benelux and the NordicS

Compensation: 60/40 OTE split

About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a leader in infrastructure system software for AI. We offer an optimised operating system, orchestration, and management to service providers, SaaS companies, and the enterprise. Virtuozzo provides mainframe-like performance, reliability, and security while dramatically lowering overall cost and complexity. We combine deep engineering expertise with a relentless focus on performance, scalability, and innovation.

The Opportunity

Virtuozzo is looking for a Territory Manager to support new-business growth across the Benelux and Nordic regions.

Reporting to the Vice President of Sales EMEA, you will help build a strong pipeline of service-provider opportunities while developing productive relationships with distributors, MSPs, CSPs, hosting companies, resellers, and other technology partners.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone in the early or middle stages of their technology sales career who is ready to take on greater territory ownership. You do not need to arrive with an established network across the entire region. However, you should be proactive, commercially minded, comfortable opening new conversations, and motivated to develop your knowledge of cloud infrastructure.

Virtuozzo follows a partner-first sales model. You will engage directly with prospects while working with the appropriate partners to progress and close opportunities. You will receive support from senior Sales, Technical, Product, and Marketing colleagues throughout the sales cycle.

Your Responsibilities

Territory Development and New Business

  • Contribute to the regional go-to-market plan for the Benelux and Nordic markets.
  • Research and identify target accounts, partners, and new-business opportunities.
  • Build a pipeline of prospective MSP, CSP, hosting, and service-provider customers.
  • Conduct structured outbound prospecting and follow up on leads generated through partners, marketing activities, and events.
  • Qualify opportunities by understanding the prospect’s business needs, infrastructure environment, decision process, and commercial potential.
  • Coordinate opportunities through discovery, technical validation, commercial discussions, and partner-led closure.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and provide clear updates on deal progress, risks, and next steps.
  • Work towards agreed pipeline, new-logo, and revenue objectives.

Channel Development and Execution

  • Build and maintain relationships with distributors, MSPs, CSPs, resellers, hosting providers, and technology partners.
  • Help identify gaps in regional partner coverage and support the recruitment or activation of suitable partners.
  • Work with partners on joint account planning, prospecting, campaigns, and co-selling activities.
  • Help partners understand Virtuozzo’s value proposition and identify suitable customer opportunities.
  • Maintain alignment between Virtuozzo, the prospect, and the transacting partner throughout the sales process.
  • Follow Virtuozzo’s partner-first sales model while remaining accountable for progressing assigned opportunities.

Customer and Prospect Engagement

  • Engage with business owners, infrastructure leaders, technical teams, and other customer stakeholders.
  • Understand each prospect’s business model, infrastructure challenges, growth priorities, and purchasing requirements.
  • Introduce Virtuozzo’s capabilities across virtualisation, hyperconverged infrastructure, storage, and cloud orchestration.
  • Support conversations around infrastructure efficiency, scalability, total cost of ownership, and commercial value.
  • Coordinate demonstrations, workshops, trials, and proof-of-concept activities with Virtuozzo’s technical teams.
  • Bring senior commercial and technical colleagues into opportunities when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent communication with prospects and partners throughout the sales process.

Market Development and Regional Visibility

  • Help increase Virtuozzo’s visibility within the Benelux and Nordic service-provider communities.
  • Support regional partner campaigns, demand-generation activities, and events.
  • Represent Virtuozzo at relevant industry events, partner meetings, and channel forums.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and emerging customer requirements.
  • Share relevant regional feedback with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams.

The Experience You Bring

  • Approximately two to five years of experience in B2B technology sales, business development, channel sales, account management, or a related commercial role.
  • Experience generating new-business conversations and developing a sales pipeline.
  • Exposure to software, cloud services, IT infrastructure, managed services, hosting, telecommunications, or another technical B2B environment.
  • Some experience working with distributors, resellers, MSPs, CSPs, or other channel partners would be an advantage.
  • An interest in developing knowledge of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, storage, Kubernetes, and related technologies.
  • Confidence communicating with both commercial and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organisation, follow-up, and opportunity-management skills.
  • The ability to learn a technical product portfolio and communicate its business value clearly.
  • A proactive and persistent approach to prospecting and relationship development.
  • The ability to work independently within a remote, international organisation while asking for support when needed.
  • Availability to travel for important customer, partner, and industry meetings.

The Profile That Will Succeed

You are commercially curious, proactive, and motivated to build a career in cloud infrastructure sales. You may already have experience as a Business Development Manager, Account Executive, Channel Account Manager, or junior Territory Manager and are now looking for broader ownership.

jobs.title: AML Compliance Officer, Zimbabwe
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreYellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

Yellow Card Zimbabwe will operate as a virtual asset service provider (VASP) within the regulatory perimeter overseen by the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) at the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe and other relevant authorities. The entity is expected to process high transaction volumes and requires a locally based AML Compliance Officer to meet Zimbabwean regulatory requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for an AML Compliance Officer to serve as the local AML compliance lead and money laundering reporting officer for Yellow Card Zimbabwe. Reporting directly to the Group AMLCO & MLRO, who is based in Johannesburg, you will be the in-country subject matter expert on Zimbabwean AML law and supervisory expectations, build strong relationships with the FIU, other regulators, and banking and payment partners, and provide day-to-day compliance support in a high-volume operational environment. This role is ideal for an ambitious early-career AML professional with payments and crypto experience who thrives under pressure and wants to help build a regulated VASP from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

Zimbabwean AML Framework and Advisory

  • Serve as the in-house specialist on Zimbabwean AML law, including the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act [Chapter 9:24], the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime (Virtual Asset Service Providers Registration) Regulations, 2026 (S.I. 99 of 2026), and related FIU directives, guidance, and sanctions and counter-terrorist financing requirements.
  • Provide guidance and support to the Group MLRO on Zimbabwean AML obligations, FATF and ESAAMLG expectations, and the practical application of local requirements to a VASP business model.
  • Translate local regulatory developments into clear, actionable advice for product, operations, customer-facing, and leadership teams.

Regulator and Partner Engagement

  • Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with the FIU, the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, the Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe, banking and payment partners, and other key external stakeholders.
  • Act as the entity's resident compliance contact for registration, renewal, reporting, inspections, and information requests, ensuring responses are timely, accurate, and well evidenced.
  • Represent the Zimbabwean entity in routine regulator and partner interactions, in close coordination with the Group MLRO and external counsel where required.

AML Program Implementation

  • Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the entity's AML program, including policies, procedures, the institutional AML risk assessment, and the customer risk-rating methodology.
  • Ensure program controls reflect Zimbabwean requirements on customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, record keeping, ongoing monitoring, and internal reporting.
  • Maintain robust documentation that meets the evidentiary standards of the FIU, other regulators, banking partners, and internal and external auditors.

High-Volume Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

  • Review and dispose of large volumes of transaction monitoring alerts in a fast-paced environment, escalating unusual or suspicious activity in line with internal procedures and regulatory expectations.
  • Conduct enhanced due diligence on higher-risk customers, counterparties, and transactions involving fiat and digital assets, including on-chain analytics, source of funds, and source of wealth assessments.
  • Prepare and support the filing of suspicious transaction reports to the FIU in line with local requirements, in close coordination with the Group MLRO.

KYC, Sanctions, and Travel Rule

  • Support customer onboarding and periodic reviews to ensure compliance with Zimbabwean KYB, beneficial ownership, and PEP requirements.
  • Operate sanctions and PEP screening against UN, OFAC, EU, and local lists, and resolve potential matches with appropriate documentation.
  • Implement and operate Travel Rule processes for virtual asset transfers, including counterparty VASP due diligence and information-sharing workflows.

Training, Culture, and Internal Stakeholders

  • Deliver AML, sanctions, and crypto-specific risk training tailored to Zimbabwean requirements for local staff and relevant group functions.
  • Promote a strong compliance culture and act as a trusted point of contact for colleagues seeking AML guidance.
  • Contribute to policy updates and process improvements that keep the team aligned with current local expectations.

Reporting and Governance

  • Support the Group MLRO in preparing materials for the FIU, other regulators, internal and external audit, the Board, and relevant committees.
  • Track regulatory and supervisory developments in Zimbabwe, the ESAAMLG region, and the wider digital asset space, and help assess the impact on the business.
  • Maintain accurate management information and metrics that evidence the effectiveness of the Zimbabwean AML program.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in law, finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
  • One to three years of hands-on AML, financial crime, or compliance experience at a bank, financial institution, payment provider, remittance company or fintech regulated in Zimbabwe or a comparable jurisdiction.
  • Strong working knowledge of Zimbabwean AML laws and regulations, including the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act, the new VASP registration regime, FIU reporting obligations, and FATF standards as applied in Zimbabwe.
  • Direct experience working with crypto or digital assets, with a clear understanding of VASP-specific risks, blockchain analytics, wallet screening, and Travel Rule implementation.
  • ACAMS Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) certification is required.
  • Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Zimbabwe residency and the right to work in Zimbabwe.

Skills and Attributes

jobs.excerpt: If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us.
jobs.description:
If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us. At Metricool you will be able to do so with real ownership over how security and compliance get built into the product, not just audited after the fact.

You will have the possibility to work 100% remotely, working in a high-growth international B2B SaaS, in which all members love to create, work in teams, analyze and help Community Managers make their work easier.

Your mission is to become the dedicated owner of application, cloud and AI security at Metricool, relieving our Senior Developers and Leads from manual security reviews and building specialized security management across our core monolith (JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue), AWS infrastructure, AI-powered features and internal compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).

In this position, you will be able to make a wonderful contribution and impact in different areas:

As Senior Security Engineer,

  • Application & Platform Security:Harden Spring Security, JavaEE filters, CORS, anti-CSRF protections, SameSite/HttpOnly cookie flags, and strict CSP headers.

  • AI Security & Testing: Run threat modeling and vulnerability testing on our AI/LLM features, protecting against the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs: prompt injection, data poisoning, data leakage, insecure output handling, and API abuse.

  • Compliance & Auditing (ISO 27001 / SOC 2): Define, audit and collect technical evidence for compliance controls (access management, encryption at rest and in transit, incident logs), lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, and evaluate third-party vendor risk.

  • Infrastructure & Cloud Security:Configure AWS load balancers, Nginx, Tomcat, container security (Docker), and HTTPS enforcement.

  • Code Reviews & Audits:Run regular code reviews, secret-detection audits, and third-party dependency reviews (Maven, Node.js).

  • Build automated security checks (SAST/DAST/ZAP) into our CI/CD pipelines.

As a Team Member:

  • Cross-functional Alignment:Work closely with Senior Developers and Leads to bring security into the development process from the start, rather than bolting it on afterward.

  • Continuous Improvement:Document controls, evidence and runbooks so compliance stays audit-ready year-round, not just ahead of a renewal.

  • Culture of Excellence:Drive a security-first culture that embraces secure AI adoption without slowing down developer velocity.

Long story short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?

  • First month: Gain full context of the monolith architecture, the AWS stack and our current compliance posture.

  • First Quarter: CompleteAI feature threat modeling, execute security header hardening, and set up the ISO 27001/SOC 2 evidence collection matrix.

  • To the moon: Own platform security end to end, keep compliance continuous and seamless, and lead the secure adoption of new AI technologies.

Job requirements. You’ll be successful on your mission if you have:

  • The candidate must be located in Spain.

  • A senior profile, confident owning security end-to-end across application code, cloud infrastructure and compliance, not just reviewing it on paper.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in Spanish (mandatory) and English. A language proficiency check is part of the hiring process.

Hard skills:

  • JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue.js, Node.js, Docker, OWASP ZAP, AWS, Linux, MySQL, Maven, Git/Bitbucket.

  • AI & Security: Understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, AI data privacy, and secure API/prompt engineering.

  • Compliance Frameworks: Knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS controls, SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality), and vendor risk assessments.

Soft skills:

  • Hands-on mindset: comfortable writing and reviewing code, not a “paper compliance” auditor.

  • Pragmatic approach to security: applies controls without imposing heavy bureaucratic overhead on development speed.

  • Genuine curiosity about emerging risks, especially around GenAI/LLM adoption in software platforms.

  • Clear communicator, able to turn audit requirements into practical, developer-friendly processes.

Why will you fall in love with Metricool?

  • Truly Remote: Work from wherever you’re most productive. We provide the tools; you provide the talent.

  • 100% Flexible Schedule: We care about the work getting done, not the hours you’re sitting at the desk. You organize your own time so you can live your life, as long as you’re there to collaborate when the team needs you.

  • Health Insurance:We’ve got you covered so you can work with peace of mind.

  • Language Lessons: We’re an international team speaking English, Spanish, French, and German. We’ll help you learn a new language to help break down barriers and connect better with your colleagues.

  • The Epic Weekend: Once a year, we all get together in person to hang out, touch grass, and remind ourselves we’re not just avatars on Slack.

  • Salary:We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. For this position we estimate between 55,000€ and 65,000€ (annually).

  • Growth: We’re a fast-growing company. If you’re curious and take ownership, there’s no ceiling here.

What are the steps of the hiring process?

  • First interview (30 minutes)with Horten People & Culture: culture fit, compensation alignment, and language check.

  • Second interview (60 minutes) with Marcos Cacabelos:a deep dive on SAST/DAST/ZAP tools, AI testing scenarios, and ISO 27001/SOC 2 practical cases.

Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager
jobs.excerpt: About SafeRide HealthGetting to the doctor should never be the reason someone goes without care.
jobs.description:
About SafeRide Health

Getting to the doctor should never be the reason someone goes without care. SafeRide Health exists to remove that barrier. We are a technology and services company rebuilding non-emergency medical transportation, pairing our own technology with a national network of vetted transportation providers so that payers and health systems can get members to dialysis, chemotherapy, behavioral health, and primary care reliably and affordably.

It is a rare combination of things to work on: measurable, real-world impact on people who need it, wrapped inside a genuinely hard technology and logistics business. Every single trip involves a member, a clinical need, a provider, a network, a payer contract, and a cost curve. Getting all six right at the same time, at national scale, is the problem we get to work on.

We serve the largest Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and provider programs in the country. We are a Series C company at approximately $750M in annual run rate with 300+ employees, growing quickly and, unusually for this stage, meaningfully profitable. That last part matters more than it sounds: it means we can build for the long term rather than sprint toward the next raise, and it means the decisions you help make here have real money attached to them.

The industry is moving too. Benefit designs keep shifting, payers are under genuine cost pressure, and the tooling for running a national transportation network (routing, forecasting, automation, AI in the contact center) is far better than it was two years ago. Very little about how this business should be run is settled yet. That is the fun part.

The team you would join

Strategy & Operations is SafeRide's internal consulting team. We are who the company calls when a problem is ambiguous, cuts across several functions, or needs an answer that nobody currently owns.

In a given quarter that can mean rebuilding the economics of how we mix transportation modes, redesigning how the contact center forecasts and staffs itself, working out whether an AI tool actually solves the problem before anyone spends money building or buying it, working out why a client's margin bends the wrong way in month four, or standing up the operating model for a new line of business. The work sits where healthcare, logistics, and technology meet, which is not a combination you find in many jobs, and it comes with unusual access: this team sees the whole P&L and works directly with the leaders who own it.

One thing makes us different from an external consulting firm. Our clients are internal, so we do not hand over a deck and leave. We stay until the change is live, adopted, and visible in the number. A brilliant analysis nobody adopts is a failed project here, which means the job is as much about judgment, communication, and persistence as it is about analytical horsepower.

Increasingly, that work sits between Operations, Product, and Data Engineering. SafeRide is in an exciting growth phase, streamlining how the business runs and leaning into newer, faster technology, including AI, agentic tools, and better data infrastructure, and S&O is where operating needs get turned into clear product and data requirements. The people who thrive here are technically fluent operators: comfortable in the data, able to translate a messy operating problem into something Product and Engineering can build, and credible on both sides of that table.

How we work

We are fully remote and have been from the start, with the team distributed across the US. In practice that means asynchronous by default, written thinking over standing status meetings, and real autonomy over how and when you do your best work. What we ask in return is clarity: say what you are working on, say what you found, and say what you think should happen next.

The role

As a Senior Manager, you will be S&I's directly responsible individual (DRI) for a major part of SafeRide's AI transformation, working hand in hand with our AI team so that what we build together solves the right problems. That starts with the contact center, the backbone of how members get to care: what our agents actually do, where their time goes, and how the operation should run as AI takes on more of the work. Next comes billing and claims, where every completed trip has to become a clean, paid encounter.

Your job is the discovery and alignment that make that change work. You will map the core processes, their upstream and downstream dependencies, the stakeholders, and the impact, then turn it into a sized, prioritized roadmap that Operations, the AI team, and Product agree on. You stay with it through launch, until the results show up against the baseline and ownership sits with the operating team.

Alongside that, you will lead a small team, including a Manager, across a mix of S&I projects, and you will stay handson: building the model, sitting with the agents, writing the memo. This is a player-coach seat and the function's first manager-of-managers layer, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Insights, with real executive exposure and room to grow as the team does.

What you will own

  • Be the S&I DRI for contact center transformation: lead discovery on what agents do and where their time goes, and define how CSR operations should run as AI and automation take on more of the work.
  • Extend the same discovery to billing and claims: how a completed trip becomes a timely, complete encounter and a clean, paid claim, and where that breaks today.
  • Map core processes end to end, including systems, upstream and downstream dependencies, stakeholders, and failure points, and size the impact in cost, time, FTE, and member experience.
  • Turn discovery into a prioritized roadmap and clear requirements that the AI team, Product, and Data Engineering build against and operating leaders sign up to.
  • Build the business case before money is committed, and recommend against the AI investments that do not clear it.
  • Measure results against baseline after launch, and hand ownership to the operating teams so the change outlasts S&I's involvement.
  • Lead other S&I projects as priorities shift, from cost and network economics to program launches and data initiatives.
  • Manage and develop a small team, including a Manager: run 1:1s, give direct feedback, make staffing decisions, and hire.
  • Stay hands-on and credible in the detail: build the model, write the memo that gets the decision, and be the person Finance trusts on the numbers in your area.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Economics, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 7-9 years in management consulting, business operations, or product development, or a combination.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience managing and developing a team, including people who manage others or lead workstreams independently.
  • Executive presence with range: able to run a working session with the COO in the morning and a process review with the call center in the afternoon without losing effectiveness in either room.
  • Deep analytical and technical fluency (e.g., Excel, Python, SQL). You do not need to be the builder, but you should be comfortable in the data and able to reason about platforms, automation, and agentic AI tools (for example Claude or Claude Code), and credible on what is worth building. Reach for the analysis before you reach for the meeting.
  • A track record in ambiguous environments where the problem was not defined for you.
  • Strong business judgment, and an orientation toward durable operating change rather than one-time analysis.
  • Ability to operate as a player-coach, staying hands-on while leading through others.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading strategy or platform initiatives inside a product organization (product strategy, product operations, or an S&O function with real product or platform ownership), strongly preferred.
  • A technical background (a CS or engineering degree, or early-career experience building) alongside that leadership experience.
  • A consulting foundation is a real asset, not a requirement: MBB or equivalent, if it comes with meaningful operating or product experience after.
  • MBA, or a comparable achievement signal, a plus.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, contact center, billing or claims operations, logistics, transportation, marketplaces, or other regulated operating environments.

What the work is like

  • Be the DRI for a core piece of SafeRide's AI transformation, from discovery through measured results.
  • Work across Operations, Product, Data Engineering, and the AI team on the processes at the center of the business.
  • Build the next layer of S&O talent, against a bar that is the same for everyone. Compensation and benefits

We are remote-first and we pay competitively

  • Competitive salary, annual bonus opportunity, and equity
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous PTO, paid company holidays, and paid parental leave
  • Career development in a mission-driven company, with a published path for what comes next

If you want to own work that changes something real, on problems worth being hard, we would like to meet you.

Salary: $140,000 - 160,000

jobs.excerpt: T38Fax is seeking a talented Technical Support Engineer with experience troubleshooting SIP / VoIP / FoIP issues in a customer-facing role.
jobs.description:
T38Fax is seeking a talented Technical Support Engineer with experience troubleshooting SIP / VoIP / FoIP issues in a customer-facing role. We're excited to be scaling our customer support team to keep up with the rapid growth of our popular T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) service. In this junior-level role we don't require you to know much about T.38 FoIP or even fax at the outset -- just bring your networking and/or SIP protocol knowledge, and we'll teach you fax and FoIP.

First, a Word About Fax

Fans of John Oliver’s “How Is This Still A Thing” segments might be amused to learn that fax remains deeply entrenched in the way many companies transact their daily business. Indeed, it seems fax is still very much a thing! In its annual report on the fax industry, Business Research Insights reports that the global fax market size was 2.36 billion in 2023 and is projected to reach 4.25 billion by 2032 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of almost 7%. It’s especially surprising, then, that most modern VoIP/SIP and cloud-based phone companies neither support fax over SIP nor understand how they might do so (until we show them how easy it is). Our fax-approved SIP trunks are ready to go today and fill a vital need in a growing and underserved industry that shows no signs of slowing down for many years to come.

About You

As a Technical Support Engineer you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving customer issues related to SIP trunking, T.38 fax transmissions, call quality, and network configurations. You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and vendors to ensure seamless communication experiences. You are a proud, card-carrying tech-geek with a superhero’s penchant for helping others. You breathe all things engineering, innovation, and data. Logic is your friend, and you use it generously. Equipped with an entrepreneurial attitude, you are relentlessly energetic and excited by new challenges. If you aren’t multi-tasking, it means you are under-challenged. You don’t just capture packets, you use science (not superstition) to tame them.

Your Mission

This is absolutely not an IT help-desk role. We call our support team 'engineers' because of the highly technical nature of troubleshooting SIP and T.38 at industrial scale. You will:

  • Provide Tier 1 / Tier 2 support for FoIP and SIP-related technical issues via email, phone and case management system (Zendesk).
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot SIP signaling, call setup failures, one-way audio, jitter, latency, and packet loss.
  • Analyze SIP traces, PCAP captures, and logs using tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.
  • Support T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) implementations, troubleshooting failed fax transmissions and improving reliability.
  • Work with PBX systems (Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, etc.), VoIP gateways, and SBCs.
  • Assist customers with network configurations, NAT traversal and firewall rules.
  • Escalate complex issues to engineering teams and collaborate with vendors as needed.
  • Take ownership of reported customer issues and see problems through to resolution, ensuring proper recording and closure of all issues.
  • Write documentation, knowledge base articles and FAQs, and document troubleshooting steps, best practices and solutions in the company's knowledge base for use by both internal staff and customers.
  • Test interoperability of new VoIP/FoIP equipment and create user guides for various IP-PBX and SIP-compatible devices for use with our SIP Trunking service.

Qualifications

Expert-level support is a core component of our brand and is deeply ingrained in our culture. We look for a mix of the technical expertise, troubleshooting skills, and industry knowledge that will be needed to solve complex problems, including:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field, or combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs and firewall rules) and networking protocols, in particular VoIP/SIP.
  • Experience with fax and/or FoIP a plus.
  • Experience with Wireshark.
  • Experience with Asterisk, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, OpenSIPS, or cloud-based VoIP APIs (Twilio, Plivo, Telnyx, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating System.
  • Careful, methodical approach to troubleshooting complex technical issues.
  • Experience with help desk ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, etc.).
  • Excellent written and verbal communications including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to customers.
  • Excellent customer-facing skills.

Your Style

  • You have an unquenchable desire to learn

POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE: Compliance Analyst

STATUS: Regular, Full-time/Exempt

REPORTS TO: Director of Policy and Compliance

POSITION SUMMARY

The NRMP Policy and Compliance team promotes and enforces the policies and procedures that protect the integrity of the Matching Program. The Compliance Analyst engages in effective oversight of case management activities to ensure consistent application and adherence by constituents to the rules and regulations outlined in the NRMP’s Match Participation Agreements and related policies. The Compliance Analyst also supports the maintenance of accurate case management records and assists with constituent outreach efforts, mainly on matters related to promoting broad-based understanding of Match compliance.
Security and Privacy responsibilities are identified in the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP), which applies to all users, roles, and NRMP resources.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Duties that occupy a major portion of time and importance in the job)

Case Management

  • Process waiver reviews and violation investigations:
  • Manage and prioritize caseload, ensuring adherence with NRMP policy timelines
  • Correspond with all parties and collect all documentation for files; proactively identify/analyze gaps and follow up accordingly with parties to solicit additional information
    • Research/solicit feedback about policies of partner organizations when they contribute to understanding and processing of a case
    • Troubleshoot cases, as needed, with Director to ensure documentation is comprehensive and ready for executive leadership review
  • Prepare reports and documents and ensure accurate preparation of case files for panel review
  • Distribute reports to external parties. Maintain and/or update online systems to ensure accurate case log tracking
  • Interface with the NRMP’s case management system and matching software system

Records Management

  • Interface with the NRMP’s case management system and matching software system
  • Process intake forms; enter case data and information into electronic case management system in accordance with policy
  • Maintain accurate case log through prompt upload of transmittals, constituent statements, and support documentation as received
  • Update records in the NRMP’s matching software system to accurately reflect case activity

Inter-Departmental and Constituent Support/Engagement

  • Serve as primary point of contact for staff, Match participants, stakeholders, and other interested parties in responding to questions related to policy interpretation and compliance protocols
  • Assist in reviewing annual updates to Match Participation Agreements, policies, and Codes of Conduct
  • Work with Sr Compliance Analyst(s) on ad hoc projects as assigned, namely initiatives that increase policy awareness and understanding among staff and Match constituents

Miscellaneous

• Support the Director in annual review, revision, and/or creation of department process documentation and maps
• Support Operations team during peak periods and as directed

EDUCATION, QUALIFICATIONS, REQUIRED SKILLS

• Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a policy, social science, or health-related discipline or experience determined to be equivalent

• Three to five years of experience working in a compliance role and/or interpreting policy and regulating policy compliance, preferably in a medical or medical education-based organization

• Excellent oral and written communication skills; proven experience in report writing

• Excellent interpersonal and time-management skills

• Proven ability to safeguard sensitive, often confidential information

• Detailed-oriented, organized, and thorough

• Ability to problem-solve through logic and trial and error; ability and willingness to learn new software and applications

• Microsoft Office Suite

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Experience using FileVine or similar case management software (Clio, Zola, PracticePanther, etc.)

• Experience using online form software (Google Forms, JotForm, TypeForm, etc.)

INTERACTIONS

External:

• Frequent contact with NRMP Match participants, including teaching hospital officials, residency program directors, medical school student affairs deans, and applicants

• Infrequent contact with legal counsel

Internal:

• Serves as compliance liaison for staff in answering and/or interpreting broad-based policy questions.

ADA SPECIFICATIONS

This position is currently remote, but typically located in the Washington DC office, with occasional overnight travel. The role is primarily sedentary; may require some bending and lifting.

jobs.excerpt: About Positron AIPositron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference.
jobs.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip-to-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

As Positron scales, our engineering environment is evolving from a primarily on-prem footprint to a hybrid-cloud model. We are looking for a Senior or Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure and manage that transition. You will own identity and access management, cloud infrastructure for our developers, infrastructure as code, and the core developer tooling our hardware and software teams depend on every day. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you will define the foundations: how engineers authenticate, how infrastructure is provisioned and segmented, how secrets and artifacts are stored, and how we detect and respond to threats against our most critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

Identity and Access Management

  • Define, implement, and operate our identity platform, including Auth0 and role-based access control (RBAC) across internal systems and cloud environments.
  • Establish least-privilege access policies and lifecycle processes for users, service accounts, and machine identities.
  • Design and manage public key infrastructure (PKI), including certificate issuance, rotation, and revocation.

Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure

  • Lead the migration of on-prem workloads to a secure hybrid-cloud environment on GCP.
  • Build and maintain cloud infrastructure for developers using infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible.
  • Design and enforce network segmentation between on-prem, cloud, and critical infrastructure environments.

Developer Tooling and Platform Security

  • Deploy and maintain artifact storage and other core developer tooling with security built in from the start.
  • Own secrets management across environments, ensuring credentials and keys are stored, accessed, and rotated safely.

Detection and Response

  • Select, deploy, and operate a SIEM solution covering our critical infrastructure.
  • Build and lead incident response processes, from detection and triage through remediation and post-incident review.

Required Qualifications

  • Expertise in identity and access management, including SSO, RBAC, and identity platforms such as Auth0, Okta, or similar.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, including managed or proprietary Kubernetes distributions.
  • Hands-on experience building and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible.
  • Production experience with GCP, or with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work in GCP.
  • Proven experience deploying, tuning, and operating a SIEM solution.
  • Experience with PKI, including certificate management and lifecycle automation.
  • Demonstrated incident response experience, including leading investigations and remediation.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining artifact storage and secrets management systems.
  • Understanding of network segmentation and secure network design across on-prem and cloud environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Broader security engineering experience beyond infrastructure, such as application or product security.
  • Experience designing security architecture for organizations moving from on-prem to hybrid cloud.
  • Familiarity with endpoint detection and response (EDR) tooling and deployment.

Leveling and Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

What Success Looks Like

In your first three to six months, you will have defined and stood up our identity foundation, with Auth0 and RBAC in place across key systems. Developers will be provisioning cloud infrastructure through infrastructure as code, and the migration from on-prem to hybrid cloud will be well underway on a secure, segmented footing. A SIEM solution will be live and monitoring our critical infrastructure, giving the team real visibility and a clear path to detect and respond to threats.

Why Join Us?

  • Build the security and infrastructure foundations of a well-funded AI hardware company from the ground up, with the ownership to make lasting architectural decisions.
  • Protect the systems behind next-generation inference silicon, working alongside hardware and software engineers on some of the most important infrastructure in AI.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is Senior: $170,000 – $250,000, Principal: $250,000 - $325,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

  • Serve as the first point of contact for employee concerns. Conduct fair, well documented investigations and coach managers through conflict, corrective action and separations, escalating sensitive or complex matters to leadership and employment counsel.
  • Maintain job descriptions, titles and job levels. Gather salary benchmarks and prepare pay recommendations for review by Finance and leadership.

Measures of Success

Staff and managers complete assigned HR training on time and demonstrate understanding of policies and reporting channels. The handbook and training records are current, and identified knowledge gaps receive follow up. Accurate and timely HR records and employee changes. Consistent onboarding and offboarding. Managers follow documented performance practices. Employee concerns receive timely, appropriate follow through.
