jobs.title: 风控经理（金融合约产品）/ Risk Manager (Financial Contract Products)
jobs.excerpt: 【Job Responsibilities】• Lead the design of financial logic and core risk control models for perpetual contracts, including but not limited to the continuous iteration of the funding rate model, tiered margin system, Auto-Deleveraging (ADL), and forced liquidation logic, ensuring the system can withstand extreme unilateral market movements and severe volatility.
jobs.description:
【Job Responsibilities】

  • Lead the design of financial logic and core risk control models for perpetual contracts, including but not limited to the continuous iteration of the funding rate model, tiered margin system, Auto-Deleveraging (ADL), and forced liquidation logic, ensuring the system can withstand extreme unilateral market movements and severe volatility.
  • Establish and refine the daily risk monitoring framework, track funding rate fluctuations, user position exposure distribution, and order book liquidity depth in real-time, and promptly identify and alert on potential risks based on on-chain/off-chain data.
  • Coordinate the execution of risk control requirements, driving the full lifecycle management of risk control strategies from requirement analysis, development, and testing to launch and final acceptance, ensuring high-quality implementation.

【Job Requirements】

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in Crypto derivatives, risk management, or product design, with a profound understanding of the operational mechanisms of perpetual contracts.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills, coupled with strong logical thinking; outstanding cross-departmental collaboration and a proven ability to drive projects; highly responsible, maintaining a keen risk awareness tailored to the fast-paced Web3 market environment.
  • Prior experience with contract or risk control products at top-tier CEX/DEX is highly preferred.

【About Us】

Davion Labs is currently inviting a Risk Manager (Financial Contract Products) with a strong background in derivatives and exceptional risk model design capabilities to join the core team of ApeX Protocol.

Incubated by Davion Labs, ApeX Protocol is an industry-leading, innovative decentralized exchange (DEX) platform committed to providing users with an efficient, transparent, and secure cryptocurrency trading environment. Amidst the continuous explosive growth of Web3 technologies and the digital asset derivatives market, we are actively strengthening our underlying architecture, focusing on risk control mechanism innovation and trading experience upgrades. We aim to redefine the decentralized trading landscape through top-tier liquidation engines and a comprehensive product portfolio.

Our core product, ApeX Omni (v2), offers multi-chain liquidity, a flexible and user-centric design, and top-level security guarantees powered by zero-knowledge proofs. To build a solid "moat" for this top-tier, financial-grade business system and ensure the absolute safety of the platform's liquidity pools and user assets, we are continuously iterating and upgrading our core risk control framework.

As the Risk Manager (Financial Contract Products), you will be deeply involved in the construction and iteration of the underlying risk control logic for the ApeX protocol. You will play a decisive role in everything from the precise calibration of the perpetual contract funding rate model and the optimization of the tiered margin system, to the robust implementation of liquidation logic and auto-deleveraging (ADL) mechanisms under extreme market conditions. We look forward to you leveraging your extensive experience in derivative risk control and keen awareness of extreme market risks to collaborate closely with our R&D and quantitative teams. Together, we will safeguard the bottom line of trading security and build a resilient, efficient, and top-tier Web3 trading ecosystem.

【岗位职责】

  • 主导永续合约的金融逻辑与核心风控模型设计，包括但不限于资金费率模型、阶梯保证金制度、自动减仓 (ADL) 及强平清算逻辑的持续迭代，确保系统能抵御极端单边行情与剧烈波动。
  • 建立并完善日常风控监控体系，实时追踪资金费率波动、用户持仓敞口分布及盘口流动性深度，基于链上/链下数据及时识别并预警潜在风险。
  • 协调落实风险控制需求，推动风控策略从需求分析、开发测试到上线验收的全生命周期管理，确保高质量落地。

【任职要求】

  • 本科及以上学历，金融、数学、统计学、计算机等相关专业。
  • 具备 2 年以上 Crypto 衍生品或风控/产品设计经验，对永续合约的运行机制有较深的理解。
  • 具备出色的沟通协调能力，逻辑思维能力；优秀的跨部门协作与项目推动力；极具责任心，在快节奏的 Web3 市场环境中保持敏锐的风险嗅觉。
  • 头部 CEX/DEX 合约或风控产品经验者优先。

【关于我们】

Davion Labs现诚邀一位拥有深厚衍生品背景和卓越风控模型设计能力的风控经理（金融合约产品）加入ApeX Protocol核心团队。

ApeX Protocol 是由 Davion Labs 孵化的一家业内领先的创新型去中心化交易所 (DEX) 平台，致力于为用户提供高效、透明、安全的加密货币交易环境。随着 Web3 技术与数字资产衍生品市场的不断爆发，我们正积极夯实底层架构，专注于风控机制创新与交易体验升级，旨在通过顶尖的清算引擎与全面的产品组合，重新定义去中心化交易格局。

我们的核心产品 ApeX Omni (v2) 提供多链流动性、灵活且以用户为中心的设计，以及基于零知识证明的顶级安全保障。为了给这一顶级的金融级业务系统铸造坚实的“护城河”，保障平台资金池与用户的资产绝对安全，我们正在不断迭代和升级核心风控体系。

作为风控经理（金融合约产品），您将深度参与 ApeX 协议底层风控逻辑的构建与迭代。从永续合约资金费率模型的精算、阶梯保证金制度的优化，到极端行情下清算逻辑与自动减仓（ADL）机制的坚实落地，您都将发挥决定性的关键作用。我们期待您凭借丰富的衍生品风控经验、对市场极端风险的敏锐嗅觉，与研发及量化团队紧密协同，共同守护交易安全底线，打造坚实、高效的 Web3 顶级交易生态。

jobs.description:
JOB BRIEF

The Vertical Sales Manager – Embedded / IPC for the Transportation Sector is a strategic, overlay sales role responsible for driving new business growth across North, Central, and South America, with a primary focus on North America. Unlike traditional Regional Sales Managers, this role does not operate within a geographic territory but focuses on the Transportation sector, identifying, qualifying, and closing high-value Embedded Computing and Industrial PC (IPC) opportunities, typically exceeding $250K annually. The VS collaborates closely with Regional Sales Managers, Field Application Engineers, product management, and other cross-functional teams to deliver customized Embedded and IPC solutions for transportation OEMs, including rail, automotive, aerospace, and fleet management systems. This role is a key contributor to Axiomtek’s growth in the Transportation Embedded Computing and IPC market.

ROLE OBJECTIVE

The objective of the Vertical Sales Manager – Embedded / IPC for the Transportation Sector is to drive strategic revenue growth within transportation OEMs and industrial systems through proactive vertical-specific prospecting, consultative solution selling, and enterprise account development. The VS is expected to identify and secure new target accounts, lead complex design-in sales cycles, and promote Axiomtek’s full portfolio of Embedded and IPC hardware and integration services. Success in this role requires building strong relationships with engineering, R&D, and executive teams, managing long, consultative sales cycles, and collaborating across internal technical and sales resources to deliver tailored embedded solutions for transportation applications.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Drive new vertical-specific sales with a focus on high-value target accounts (>$250K annually).
  • Identify and qualify new opportunities through a mix of self-sourced efforts (cold calling, networking, data mining, trade shows, etc.) and provided leads.
  • Collaborate closely with Regional Sales Managers to ensure strategic alignment and effective opportunity handoff.
  • Serve as the lead point of contact for target accounts, orchestrating internal technical and product resources as needed.
  • Transition accounts from products to solutions when appropriate to capture full value-added opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the assigned vertical industry, including customer pain points, solution needs, and emerging trends.
  • Support marketing in vertical-aligned initiatives including content development, trade shows, and campaign support.
  • Participate in sales planning, forecasting, and execution of go-to-market strategies.
  • Maintain high-quality opportunity data in Salesforce and follow the internal sales process with diligence and accuracy.
  • Provide feedback to Product Management regarding market demands and alignment of products/services.
  • Leverage corporate resources such as systems engineers, application engineers, and product managers at strategic points in the sales cycle.
  • Ensure adherence to the company’s Quality Management System.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND PREFERRED ATTRIBUTES:

  • 5+ years B2B technical sales in Embedded Computing / IPC solutions, preferably with transportation OEMs.
  • Successful track record with high-value design-in opportunities and long, consultative sales cycles.
  • Strong ability to engage engineering, R&D, and executive teams to drive technical solutions.
  • Technical knowledge of embedded hardware/software platforms (SBCs, boards, CPUs, GPUs, I/O interfaces).
  • Skilled at building C-level relationships and navigating complex OEM buying groups.
  • CRM proficient (Salesforce) and comfortable with sales process tools (QCBD, PLM, KissFlow).
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of transportation/industrial standards (EN50155, ISO 26262, SAE) a plus.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

This is a nationwide position that requires occasional travel to our offices in Methuen, MA or City of Industry, CA, as needed.

BENEFITS:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) & Employer Matching
  • Company Paid Group Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Federal Holidays

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Description

TrueNAS is redefining enterprise storage by delivering proven data resilience, performance, and flexibility without the complexity or constraints of legacy solutions. As the most deployed storage platform in the world, TrueNAS already powers critical data storage infrastructure for businesses, research institutions, and government agencies across 140+ countries and millions of users. Our mission is simple: to become the most trusted name in data storage.

Originally founded in Silicon Valley in 2002 under the name iXsystems, TrueNAS is a profitable, independent company with a culture rooted in trust, curiosity, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Whether you work remotely or on-site, you’ll be part of a team that values collaboration and meaningful impact - where people come before profit, and bold ideas drive the future of data infrastructure.

If you’re ready to help shape the future of enterprise storage, we’d love to connect.

Position Overview:

TrueNAS is seeking a Sr. Director/VP of Global Channels to lead and scale our global partner ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, this is a highly strategic, revenue-carrying leadership role responsible for driving joint go-to-market (GTM) execution between TrueNAS’ field organization and our valued partners.

As the Sr. Director/VP of Global Channels you will own the end-to-end partner ecosystem, encompassing partner strategy, commercial management, and partner-enabled delivery. You will lead and mentor a dedicated team focused on developing repeatable co-sell motions, driving strategic account mapping, accelerating joint pipeline, and ensuring that partner-led customer opportunities progress seamlessly from initial identification through successful deployment.

This is a remote position in the United States or Europe.

Base Pay Range

The on-target-earnings for this position is $280,000 - $315,000. The applicable compensation range may vary based on the state and geographic region in which the candidate is hired. Please note that the provided range reflects the pay spectrum for positions within the same job category as the one to which this position belongs. The final offer will consider various factors, such as location, education, and prior experience, to ensure a comprehensive and fair compensation assessment.

TrueNAS offers a comprehensive package of benefits including, health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, paid time-off, 401(k), health and flexible spending accounts, stock purchase plan and more.

Expected Posting Timelines

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, a maximum of 90 days.

The Day-to-Day

The essential functions and responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following. Other duties may be assigned as needed.

  • Drive Ecosystem Strategy: Refine and execute TrueNAS’ global ecosystem strategy to materially impact pipeline generation and bookings contribution across distribution, value added reseller, consulting/referral and strategic technology alliance partnerships.
  • Lead a Global Team: Coach, develop, and lead a high-performing global ecosystem team responsible for executing TrueNAS’ partner go-to-market strategy, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Align Partner Capabilities: Ensure partner capacity, capabilities, and commitments perfectly align with TrueNAS’ broader business objectives.
  • Accelerate Revenue & Pipeline: Drive global partner-attached revenue by building scalable co-marketing, co-sell, and deployment motions across commercial verticals, Federal / SLED, and sovereign international deployments.
  • Optimize Territory Execution: Accelerate pipeline growth through strategic account mapping and close partnership with Sales leadership on territory and opportunity execution.
  • Manage Partner Health: Conduct executive business reviews with strategic partners to consistently assess revenue performance, pipeline health, delivery readiness, and joint business priorities.
  • Design Partner Programs: Launch and continually refine TrueNAS’ global partner program structure—including tiers, benefits, requirements, and incentives—to drive ecosystem health and revenue impact.
  • Oversee Enablement: Direct the development and execution of partner enablement and certification programs, ensuring curricula, certification paths, and evaluation mechanisms stay aligned with product updates and GTM priorities.

Education and Experience

We have identified the following programs, experience, and knowledge that have helped others find success in this role at TrueNAS. We understand, though, that knowledge comes from many forms of learning and experiences. Above all, we consider a person’s potential impact in the role and value their unique path to this point in their career.

  • Experienced Leader: 10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure and SaaS enterprise sales, partnerships, or GTM leadership with senior multi-region or multi-country responsibility.
  • Proven Track Record: A consistent history of delivering against and exceeding pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Industry Expertise: Direct experience within the storage infrastructure, storage/data management software, or related technology sectors.
  • Education & Mobility: Bachelor's degree required (advanced degree preferred). Willingness to travel internationally as needed to support global partnerships.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

iXsystems DBA TrueNAS, Inc provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants in all company facilities without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and intellectual disability, age, military status or status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer-related or HIV/AIDS-related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to the Chief of Staff to provide administrative, operational, and coordination support in a fast-paced work environment.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can work independently with minimal supervision, anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and ensure that day-to-day activities run smoothly. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong time management, discretion in handling confidential information, and the ability to stay organized while working remotely.

The successful candidate will play an important role in helping the Chief of Staff manage schedules, coordinate meetings, track priorities, organize information, and ensure that important tasks and follow-ups are completed on time.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Provide administrative and executive support to the Chief of Staff to ensure efficient day-to-day operations.

  2. Work independently with minimal supervision, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and make sound decisions within the scope of the role.

  3. Act as a representative of the Chief of Staff when authorized, communicating with internal and external stakeholders, coordinating requests, and following through on matters on their behalf.

  4. Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and schedules, including coordinating meeting arrangements and resolving scheduling conflicts.

  5. Manage emails, correspondence, and other business communications as needed.

  6. Prepare meeting agendas, take meeting minutes, and track action items to ensure timely follow-ups.

  9. Assist in planning, coordinating, and monitoring projects to ensure milestones, deliverables, and deadlines are met.

  11. Coordinate meetings, projects, and communications with internal and external stakeholders.

  12. Proactively anticipate the Chief of Staff’s needs, identify potential issues, and recommend solutions.

  13. Handle confidential information with professionalism, discretion, and integrity.

  14. Maintain task trackers and provide regular updates on pending items, priorities, and completed tasks.

  15. Perform other administrative, operational, and coordination tasks as required to support the Chief of Staff.

How to apply: Please apply online by completing our application and submitting a cover letter, resume, and reference list. The position will remain open until filled. The desired start date is 6/15/2026. Only applicants selected for interviews will be contacted. No telephone calls, please.

ABOUT THE CENTER

The Center for Biological Diversity, a national 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, believes the welfare of human beings is deeply linked to nature — to the existence of a vast diversity of wild animals, plants and people. Because diversity has intrinsic value, and because its loss impoverishes society, we work to secure a future for all species, great and small, hovering on the brink of extinction. We do so through science, law, activism and creative media, with a focus on protecting the lands, waters and climate that humans, other species and all communities need to survive and thrive.

We want those who come after us to inherit a world where the wild is still alive.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Content Producer plays an integral role in showcasing the Center’s work to save endangered species, wild places and public lands towards a goal of increasing both the size of our membership base and donations. The Content Producer will create high-quality video and graphics for web, social, email, and occasionally print newsletters, reports, invitations and other assets. The Content Producer influences the tone, messaging, and design aesthetic of a broad array of Center material, including paid ads, videos, landing pages, lightboxes, postcards, direct mail collateral and more.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Help in development and implementation of online campaigns to increase donor acquisition, sustainer growth, donor renewals and upgrades.
  • Working with the Lead Content Producer and Senior Online Membership Associate, help set creative and strategic direction of online and social acquisition and fundraising campaigns.
  • Produce visually stunning videos and graphics and write moving, powerful copy for deployment in digital ads, landing pages, lightboxes and other Center web properties, as well as postcards, invites and other fundraising letters and donor stewardship pieces.
  • Participate in reporting and analyzing metrics on performance across all channels and platforms, with a focus on membership growth, retention, upgrades and sustainer growth.
  • Ensure content is vetted, proofread and approved by Center program and communications staff.
  • Work with Digital team to identify and collaborate on fundraising opportunities, such as asks in the EEO and action alerts
  • With Acquisition team, help unify the Center’s voice and style across social platforms and other digital channels.
  • Design and work directly with vendors to produce print collateral such as quarterly newsletters, event postcard invitations, annual reports and other related collateral.
  • Assist in the weekly production of landing pages for email appeals and post-action landing pages.
  • Help maintain microsites featuring the Center’s accomplishments and ongoing work.
  • Identify opportunities and pilot experiments using new formats and/or platforms to improve fundraising success.
  • Stay informed of Center activities as well as news and conservations trends affecting our work in the media
  • Assist with other fundraising and Development duties as assigned.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • 3-5 years of experience in digital video and digital / print graphic design.
  • Deep knowledge of design techniques and comfort working on a variety of disciplines, including digital, web, social, email and print.
  • Fluency in Photoshop, Illustrator and Premier (or similar design software).
  • Ability to script, storyboard, edit and produce audio and video content.
  • Experience in a fundraising or advocacy environment.
  • Track record of developing creative content that engages diverse communities and deepens relationships with existing supporters.
  • Experience with digital ad platforms.
  • Excellent writing skills.
  • A knack for producing compelling, moving, inspiring stories.
  • Experience with reporting on performance of campaigns, including testing of variations.
  • Ability to deliver work products under deadlines with a commitment to high quality standards.
  • Track record of developing creative campaign content that deepens relationships with existing supporters and successfully recruits and attains new members and supporters.
  • Knowledge of the current digital landscape and emerging trends.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This job is carried out in a traditional office setting and requires long hours working at the computer. Occasional travel to the Tucson office is required and other travel opportunities may arise. Occasional work in off-hours during rapid response / news moments that can temporarily impact work schedule.

jobs.description:
INSIDE ROCKET DOCTOR:

Rocket Doctor is a digital health marketplace transforming how comprehensive care is delivered, bringing the most advanced doctor’s office directly into homes across North America. Rocket Doctor is a digital health marketplace transforming the way comprehensive care is delivered bringing the most advanced doctor’s office into homes across North America. We are a passionate group of medical doctors, technical experts, and patient care professionals who believe every person deserves access to high quality healthcare.

We are seeking a team member who is motivated to learn, grow, and innovate while making a meaningful impact. Rocket Doctor is one of the fastest growing digital health companies in Canada, with over 300 physicians nationwide and a rapidly expanding presence.

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

The Provincial Medical Lead (Nova Scotia) plays a key leadership role within the Atlantic Canada MD Leadership Team, working alongside the existing Leads to strengthen, expand, and optimize Rocket Doctor’s presence in the province.

This role focuses heavily on growing the Nova Scotia provider community, establishing clinical operations within the province, and supporting physicians as they enter practice on the platform. The Provincial Medical Lead will support recruitment efforts, build physician engagement, help shape provincial workflows, and ensure a high-quality experience for both patients and providers in Nova Scotia.

In addition to Nova Scotia-focused leadership, the Provincial Medical Lead participates in broader MD Lead initiatives to support cross-provincial alignment and company-wide growth

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES (NOVA SCOTIA-FOCUSED)

Grow and Strengthen Nova Scotia’s Physician Presence

  • Rocket Doctor is growing in Nova Scotia, and we're looking for a physician to lead it. As a Provincial Medical Lead, you will help build the province's physician community on our platform: recruiting and onboarding NS physicians, shaping clinical workflows that fit how medicine works in Nova Scotia, and making sure both patients and providers have a high-quality experience.
  • Nova Scotia’s primary care gap is well known, and thousands of residents are waiting for a regular provider. Virtual care is part of how the province closes that gap, and this role puts you in a position to shape it. You will be the clinical voice for Nova Scotia inside a national platform, with direct input into product, workflows, and how care gets delivered in the province.
  • Help build a strong provincial physician community and encourage ongoing clinical engagement.

Support Provincial Operations & Quality

  • Investigate and respond to patient, provider, or PCC-raised concerns related to Nova Scotia care.
  • Review and refine clinical workflows specific to Nova Scotia to improve efficiency, compliance, and physician ease of practice.
  • Maintain close communication with practicing Nova Scotia physicians, including active presence on Slack and participation in local meetings.

Strategic Specialty Leadership

  • Serve as a clinical leader supporting the growth of Nova Scotia’s virtual care presence.
  • Liaise with Nova Scotia health authorities, organizations, and partners as appropriate.
  • Provide input on Nova Scotia-specific product needs, regulatory considerations, and physician experience improvements.

MD LEAD RESPONSIBILITIES (CROSS-PROVINCIAL)

While the role is Nova Scotia-focused, the Provincial Medical Lead also participates in the MD Leads team:

  • Attend and contribute to MD Roundtable meetings.
  • Support initial onboarding of new physicians across provinces as needed.
  • Partner with the product and operations teams on improvement initiatives.
  • Provide troubleshooting support on emerging physician issues across all provinces.
  • Assist with communications and strategic updates for physicians and Rocket Doctor staff.
  • Help coordinate physician meetings and engagement events across Canada.

EXPECTATIONS:

  • Serve as a positive, solutions-focused representative of Rocket Doctor’s Nova Scotia medical leadership.
  • Maintain professionalism as outlined by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of the Nova Scotia medical landscape and virtual care environment.
  • Maintain clear records of recommendations and decisions.
  • Knowledge of Rocket Doctor’s EMR, platform extensions, and applicable privacy regulations in Canada and the United States (HIPAA, PHIPA, PIPEDA) is considered an asset.
  • Handle all confidential company and patient information with discretion.

COMPENSATION:

  • The position is estimated to be an average of 4 hours per week (negotiable) paid at $150 / hour. The dollar value of work will be paid via equity in the publicly traded parent company, which can be awarded to you personally or your corp, and deposited and traded within your investment / trading account.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Licensed to practise medicine in Nova Scotia;
  • Strong familiarity with the Nova Scotia healthcare system, workflows, and physician community.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving digital health environment.
  • Experience in medical leadership, administration, or business is an asset.

WORK / TRAVEL:

  • Fully remote within Canada.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

Vertica delivers a high-performance MPP columnar database engineered for large-scale analytics across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments with flexibility of cloud-native architecture. Our mission is to help organizations accelerate insight, reduce cost, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.
As a Presales Solutions Consultant, you will play a key role in demonstrating how the Vertica can simplify complex data challenges, optimize workloads, and meet the performance, governance, and sovereignty requirements of enterprises across South Korea.
You will partner closely with Account Executives, engage directly with customers, and guide them through technical evaluation, architecture design, and proof-of-concept success. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role suited to someone who enjoys solving real problems and shaping data platform strategies.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Establish trusted technical relationships with customers across your assigned Korea territory, working in tandem with Account Executives to deliver successful customer outcomes.
  • Act as a technical expert in large-scale analytics, showcasing how Vertica’s architecture, performance model, and hybrid capabilities solve customers’ most demanding workloads.
  • Lead solution design, POCs, demos, performance analysis, and cost optimization to support adoption of Vertica.
  • Produce reference architecture, best-practice guides, workshops, and technical enablement materials for both customers and internal teams.

  • Develop deep expertise as a technical or industry specialist (e.g., Financial Services, Telco, Public Sector, Retail/CPG, Manufacturing, or Data Platform Modernization).
  • Experience for the other players in the market (Teradata, Oracle, Netezza, Snowflake, Databricks or Hadoop)

What You Will Do (Responsibilities)

1. Technical Sales Leadership

  • Own technical discovery, requirements analysis, scoping, solution design, and POC execution.
  • Present architecture options clearly across audiences—from CTO/CIO stakeholders to data engineers and architects.

2. Architecture & Performance

  • Optimize analytical workloads through projection design, partitioning, resource management, Eon Mode scaling, and cost/performance tuning.
  • Design and validate migration strategies from legacy EDWs, cloud data warehouses, and Hadoop/Spark-based environments.

3. Platform Integration

  • Integrate Vertica with Kafka, Spark, DBT, Airflow, ETL, and BI/AI ecosystems.
  • Architect hybrid or multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, object storage (S3/GCS/ADLS), and Kubernetes-based operations via Vertica DB Operator.

4. Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Advise on RBAC, encryption, auditing, masking/tokenization, private networking, and data governance controls.
  • Support customers navigating Korean data sovereignty requirements, including APRA CPS-234, government frameworks, and regulated industry best practice.

5. Evangelism & Enablement

  • Deliver workshops, hands-on labs, performance deep dives, and industry-aligned solution briefs.
  • Support partner ecosystem enablement across SI, CSP, and ISV relationships.

What We Look For (Qualifications)

  • Strong experience engaging customers in technical sales or solution architecture roles, ideally in analytics, data platforms, or hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Ability to context-switch between business value conversations and deep technical discussions.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale SQL analytics, data modelling, workload optimization, and POC delivery.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Java, Scala, Bash, etc.).
  • Practical experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including network, object storage, security, and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Excellent documentation skills: architecture diagrams, POC reports, cost analysis, migration blueprints.
  • Ability to work independently across a geographically distributed team (APAC).
  • Full working rights in South Korea; English fluency required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vertica or similar platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Teradata, Exadata, Hadoop/Spark).
  • Familiarity with in-database machine learning (Vertica ML/VerticaPy) or enterprise ML pipelines.
  • Background in regulated industries such as banking, telco, government, health, or large-scale enterprise environments.

About Vertica

Vertica is a high-performance, distributed SQL analytics engine built for scale, speed, and efficiency. The platform supports broad deployment flexibility—on-premises, private cloud, hybrid, and major public clouds. With advanced compression, vectorized execution, Eon Mode compute-storage separation, and built-in machine learning, Vertica enables organizations to deliver high performance, cost-efficient analytics at petabyte scale.

We offer competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements, wellness programs, learning and certification support, and benefits aligned with the Korean market. Further details are provided during the recruitment process.

The company’s proprietary technology senses and measures neural responses to stimulation and automatically adjusts therapy based on real‑time neurophysiological feedback.

Saluda Medical’s first product, the Evoke® System, is designed to deliver known, consistent, and personalized spinal cord stimulation therapy by objectively measuring neural responses and maintaining therapy within a prescribed therapeutic window. Saluda Medical is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

At Saluda, we challenge boundaries. We innovate and think beyond the conventional. Our focus is to revolutionize the standard of care in neuromodulation to positively impact patient’s lives.

The Director of Market Access & Reimbursement Strategy will lead Saluda's U.S. market access, coverage, and reimbursement strategy, with direct ownership of the Smart Access Reimbursement program. This leader will ensure patients and providers have a clear, reliable path to therapy access from prior authorization through payment, while building the payer strategies, evidence narratives, and value-based contracting frameworks that position Saluda's closed-loop technology for long-term commercial success.

This is a high-visibility role reporting to the VP of Marketing, working cross-functionally with Sales, Clinical, Regulatory, and Finance, and engaging directly with payers, providers, and policy stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

Smart Access Reimbursement Program

  • Own, manage, and continuously improve the Smart Access Reimbursement program, including prior authorization support, appeals strategy, benefit investigation, and case escalation pathways
  • Define program KPIs (approval rates, turnaround times, denial overturn rates) and report performance to commercial leadership
  • Manage vendor and hub-services relationships supporting the program; ensure field teams and provider offices are trained and supported
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex access cases and emerging payer barriers

Payer & Reimbursement Strategy

  • Develop and execute national and regional payer strategies to establish, maintain, and expand coverage for SCS and closed-loop therapy
  • Monitor and shape coding, coverage, and payment dynamics (CPT/HCPCS, DRG/APC, physician fee schedule) across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels
  • Track and respond to CMS policy developments, including the Ambulatory Specialty Model (ASM) and other value-based initiatives affecting the chronic pain and neuromodulation space
  • Lead development of value-based and shared-risk contracting frameworks that leverage Evoke's objective ECAP data as a differentiator

Evidence & Value Communication

  • Lead the translation of clinical and real-world evidence into payer-facing value dossiers, objection handlers, and coverage advocacy materials
  • Support medical policy engagement, including responses to draft policies, technology assessments, and payer advisory interactions
  • Build and manage relationships with relevant medical societies (e.g., NANS, INS, ASPN, ASIPP) to advance coverage advocacy, coding initiatives, and clinical guideline development supporting SCS access
  • Equip Sales and field reimbursement resources with tools, training, and messaging to navigate access conversations confidently

Cross-Functional & Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Therapy Awareness teams to integrate access messaging into commercial campaigns and launch plans
  • Build and mentor market access talent as the function scales; manage direct reports and/or contracted field reimbursement resources as assigned
  • Represent Saluda with professional societies, coalitions, and industry groups on reimbursement and policy matters

What You’ll Bring:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree; advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MHA, JD) preferred
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in medical device market access, reimbursement, or payer strategy; neuromodulation, spine, or interventional pain experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success managing a reimbursement support / hub-services program, including vendor oversight and KPI management
  • Deep working knowledge of U.S. coding, coverage, and payment systems across sites of service (hospital outpatient, ASC, physician office)
  • Experience engaging payers directly on medical policy, coverage expansion, and contracting
  • Familiarity with CMS payment models and value-based care trends
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and executive communication skills

Preferred

  • Experience launching or defending coverage for a novel Class III device or breakthrough technology
  • Prior work on value-based or risk-sharing agreements using device-generated objective data
  • Established payer and specialty-society relationships in the pain management space

Competencies for Success:

  • Strategic and hands-on: comfortable setting payer strategy and personally driving a stuck prior auth to resolution
  • Data-driven storyteller: converts clinical evidence and program metrics into narratives that move payers and executives
  • Cross-functional connector: builds trust quickly across Sales, Clinical, and Finance
  • Bias for action: thrives in a growth-stage company where the playbook is still being written

Our Core Values:

  • People – Our first responsibility is to the patients we serve.
  • Integrity – Do the right thing
  • Pioneering – Lead Boldly, Change Lives, Disrupt the Status-Quo
  • Performance – Win together – Deliver with Excellence.

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

  • Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities

  • 90 days: Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation
  • 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.

Who You Are

jobs.title: ABAP Technical Lead
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote (EMEA region)Reports to: Senior Product ManagerTravel: Quarterly travel to Frankfurt or Hamburg, Germany About Stonebranch:Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA region)

Reports to: Senior Product Manager

Travel: Quarterly travel to Frankfurt or Hamburg, Germany

About Stonebranch:

Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.

Your Part in this Growth Story:

Stonebranch is searching for an ABAP Technical Lead to own the technical direction of BatchMan, our SAP-native workload automation product. We want someone who takes full accountability for a business-critical codebase and moves it forward without waiting to be told what to build next. BatchMan runs inside SAP as an add-on. It extends SAP's native job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation for more than 160 customers, ranging from long-established SAP enterprises to early technology adopters. The architecture decisions you make will shape how the product performs, evolves, and serves those customers for years to come.

This is a role built for where engineering is heading. We are transforming BatchMan development to an AI-first, specification-driven approach, and you'll lead that transformation. Using Claude Code as your primary AI agent, you'll write the technical specifications that drive development, then direct and verify AI-generated code with the senior judgment to catch what the AI gets wrong. That leaves your deepest focus for architecture and the hard technical decisions. On a codebase with more than 15 years of history, that judgment matters most. Knowing where classic ABAP and modern ABAP differ, and where the critical details hide, is what makes AI a force multiplier rather than a risk.

You'll join a small, focused team made up of an experienced fellow developer, AI agents, and the Senior Product Manager who owns the product. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. You will, however, make the high-level architecture decisions for BatchMan and set the engineering standards the codebase is built against. You'll also be the escalation point for our Customer Support team on complex technical issues, and you'll work directly with customers when an escalation calls for it. Because our customer base is largely German-speaking, business-fluent German is required.

Deep, hands-on ABAP expertise is essential. That includes experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on, not only customer-specific extensions. What sets you apart is ownership: the drive to make this product yours and keep it strong over the long term.

This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in EMEA, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany or our Honico office in Hamburg, Germany is required. This role reports directly to the Senior Product Manager.

Your Impact on the Organization:

Technical Ownership & Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture of BatchMan and make the high-level design decisions that set the product's direction within the SAP landscape
  • Establish and maintain the engineering standards, coding conventions, and best practices that the BatchMan codebase is built against
  • Maintain and modernize a codebase that spans classic ABAP4, ABAP OO, and Java-based agent components, keeping it stable for existing customers while the product continues to evolve
  • Translate product requirements into sound technical solutions, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

AI-First Development & Code Quality

  • Lead the transformation of BatchMan's development pipeline to an AI-first approach, with Claude Code as the primary AI agent
  • Write clear, detailed technical specifications that serve as the foundation for AI-driven development
  • Direct, review, and verify AI-generated ABAP and Java code, applying senior judgment to catch errors, enforce standards, and protect architectural integrity
  • Build the documentation, context, and conventions that let AI agents work effectively and safely within a mature SAP codebase
  • Take part in peer code review to hold the codebase to a consistent quality bar

Product Development & Performance

  • Design and build new capabilities that extend SAP background processing and job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation
  • Develop and maintain integrations through XBP/XMI, RFC, and web technologies (OData, REST) that connect BatchMan to the broader automation landscape
  • Optimize performance for high-volume job processing and large data volumes, including SQL tuning
  • Package and deliver releases through the SAP Transport System and Add-On Assembly Kit (AAK), so installations and upgrades run reliably across customer SAP environments

Customer Escalation & Collaboration

  • Serve as the technical escalation point for Customer Support, diagnosing and resolving complex issues beyond their scope
  • Engage directly with customers, in German or English, when an escalation requires hands-on technical involvement
  • Partner with the Senior Product Manager on roadmap feasibility, effort estimates, and technical trade-offs, and communicate technical direction clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Collaborate closely with the team's other developer and share knowledge so that critical product expertise is not held by a single person

What You Will Bring to the Team:

Education and Experience

  • Degree in computer science or a related field, or completed vocational IT training (e.g., Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung) with equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of professional experience in software development
  • 8+ years of hands-on ABAP development experience, including substantial work in classic procedural ABAP (ABAP4)
  • Proven experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on or product, not solely customer-specific extensions or module customizations
  • Track record of owning a technical area and making the architecture decisions that shape it

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level command of ABAP4 and ABAP OO, including Dynpro UI, ALV, and the SAP Control Framework
  • Deep knowledge of SAP background processing and job scheduling:
    • SM36/SM37 for job definition and monitoring
    • SM50/SM66 for active work process analysis
    • ST22 for dump analysis on failed job steps
  • Hands-on experience with the XBP (External Batch Processing) and XMI interfaces
  • RFC programming and debugging, including configuring RFC connections in SM59
  • Strong understanding of core ABAP concepts, including authorization objects, lock objects, and LUWs
  • SQL optimization for large data volumes
  • Working knowledge of the SAP Transport System
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) and a strong interest in building an AI-first, specification-driven development workflow; experience writing specifications that drive AI-generated code is a strong plus
  • This is a hands-on technical role: day-to-day work combines writing specifications, directing AI agents, and reviewing and verifying code, with direct ABAP development where it's needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience packaging and delivering add-ons with the SAP Add-On Assembly Kit (AAK)
  • Java development experience, particularly with agent- or service-based architectures, including:
    • File I/O and protocols such as SFTP and SSH
    • JKS keystore management and TLS/SSL configuration
    • Reading and debugging multithreaded Java service code (Windows service / Linux daemon)
  • Experience with web technologies and data formats, including OData, REST, XML, and JSON
  • SAP Basis knowledge, including authorization configuration
  • Background with workload automation or enterprise job scheduling products

Ownership & Collaboration

  • Strong architectural thinking, with the judgment to make sound technical decisions and the accountability to own the outcomes
  • A driver's mindset: self-directed, proactive, and able to move a product forward without handholding
  • A methodical troubleshooter, able to diagnose complex issues in customer SAP environments and bring them to resolution
  • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions
  • Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical direction and trade-offs to colleagues, customers, and non-technical stakeholders
  • A collaborative team player, comfortable working in a small, focused, international team
  • Business-fluent German (C1 minimum) and fluent English (C1 minimum), both written and verbal, are required. German is the team's primary working language, including code documentation, technical discussions, and customer support cases

Why You’ll Love Stonebranch:

At Stonebranch, you’ll be part of a team that’s passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making an impact in the world of IT automation. We believe great work starts with a great workplace – one that values people, supports growth, and celebrates success.

  • Collaborative Culture: Join an international team of experienced, high-performing professionals who value teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual success.
  • Growth & Development: Take advantage of continuous learning opportunities and professional development to advance your career.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Benefit from a flexible work environment with hybrid or remote options, designed to support balance and productivity.
  • Impact & Innovation: Be part of a high-growth company at the forefront of IT automation, where your contributions directly influence customer success and business outcomes.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with local market standards and employment regulations.
  • Community & Connection: Participate in regular team and company events that foster connection and a strong sense of belonging.

jobs.excerpt: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs.
jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW


The Senior Director, Clinical Quality and Regulatory provides enterprise leadership for LifeStance’s clinical quality, safety, incident management, regulatory readiness, and accreditation infrastructure within the Chief Medical Office. This role sets the strategy, operating model, standards, governance cadence, and accountability mechanisms for a nationally consistent quality function, while ensuring regional execution is aligned, measured, and sustained. The Executive Director translates clinical quality, patient safety, regulatory, and incident trends into enterprise priorities, actionable improvement strategies, and executive-ready insights for operational, clinical, compliance, and board-level stakeholders.


This is an executive leadership role with selective direct involvement in the highest-risk and highest-complexity work. The Senior Director maintains sufficient proximity to investigations, survey readiness, and regional execution to ensure credibility with clinicians and operators, while primarily focusing on strategy, standards, governance, escalation, and system-level improvement across the enterprise.

Consistent with LifeStance's values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach and develop regionally aligned Clinical Quality & Regulatory Managers, including hiring, onboarding, performance management and career development.
  • Assign and balance regional coverage, monitor workload against real incident volume, and protect the team's capacity for proactive work against reactive casework.
  • Build the capabilities the role requires, including analytic fluency, improvement methodology, regulatory literacy and influence without authority, through structured growth plans.
  • Run a standing team cadence of individual check-ins and a department meeting, and create connection points with adjacent Chief Medical Office team members and other cross departmental functions so the team does not operate in isolation.
  • Direct and mentor leaders in driving collaborative, cross-functional initiatives across Clinical Operations and Practice Operations to achieve strategic business and clinical objectives.
  • Serve as a key quality and risk partner to the Chief Operating Officer and Senior Clinical Operations leadership, leading the planning, communication, and implementation of enterprise-level quality, accreditation, and risk initiatives.

Quality & Safety Program Ownership

  • Provide enterprise leadership for clinical quality, patient safety, critical incident management, quality-of-care concerns, and regulatory readiness. Define and govern the standards, decision-making frameworks, escalation processes, and measurement strategies that support consistent clinical quality across the organization, while partnering with Clinical Operations, Practice Operations, and field leaders on implementation and execution.
  • Ensures timely execution and completion of incident reporting process and life cycle.
  • Maintains and refines the incident classification and reporting standards that make clinic and regional data comparable.
  • Consolidate regional findings into an enterprise view of themes, recurrence and risk, and prioritize which themes receive corrective action investment.
  • Oversee enterprise morbidity and mortality (M&M) rounds
  • Establish enterprise expectations for timely follow-through, corrective action validation, and sustained improvement, ensuring corrective actions are not closed until effectiveness has been re-measured and accountability is clear across clinical, operational, and regional leadership.

Regulatory, Accreditation & Survey Readiness

  • Provide enterprise leadership for accreditation surveys, state licensure reviews, and regulatory readiness across the multi-state footprint, including executive escalation, coordination of market responses, and oversight of plans of correction through validated closure.
  • Define processes and execution of chart audits related to medical necessity to support payor audits. Support countermeasures of payor audit outcomes.
  • Maintain ongoing survey readiness by ensuring required documentation, evidence and supporting materials are continuously organized and updated, creating a state of perpetual readiness
  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to establish, communicate and maintain clear operational boundaries between clinical documentation and medical necessity review activities, which within the scope of this team and billing integrity functions, which are managed separately
  • Track regulatory and accreditation change across a multi-state footprint and translate it into practical guidance for regional clinical and operational leaders.

Governance, Peer Review & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Prepare and present quality reporting to enterprise governance forums, including the Enterprise Quality Council and the Quality & Compliance Committee, and support board-level reporting.
  • Manage, standardize, and support the peer review process, including preparation of committee materials, presentation of relevant quality and safety data, tracking of follow-through, and maintenance of objective, confidential clinical evaluation practices tied to continuous safety improvement, in coordination with Clinical Quality and regulatory managers.
  • Secure and maintain sponsorship from regional vice presidents of operations and regional clinical/medical directors so the regional triad model functions as intended in every region.

Serve as the escalation point for managers, Direct Casework & Regional Ownership

  • Carry a defined region or portfolio directly, performing the same chart audit, investigation, trending and countermeasure work asked of the clinical quality managers.
  • Lead investigations of sentinel-level events, cases with significant legal or reputational exposure, and cross-regional patterns.
  • Cultivate and model effective cross-functional partnerships, establishing trusted relationships with regional leaders and stakeholders through consistent collaboration, responsiveness and operational support
  • Provide coverage for the quality team during leave, vacancy or surge without defaulting the work back onto the regions.

Data, Systems & Continuous Improvement

  • Define the reporting the Quality team produces and the cadence by which it is delivered, including regular cadence of review, and quarterly enterprise roll-up.
  • Partner with data analytics and technology teams to transition key workflows to sustainable, platform-based solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency and user experience
  • Apply continuous improvement methodology to the function's own workflows, including process mapping, root cause analysis and countermeasure design.
  • Represent clinical quality requirements in enterprise system work, including electronic health record transition and measurement-based care initiatives.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Master's degree in a behavioral health discipline, nursing, or a related clinical field.
  • Active, unrestricted clinical license (for example LCSW, LMFT, LPC, PsyD, PhD, APRN or PA) preferred but not required; equivalent behavioral health quality, regulatory or clinical operations experience will be considered.
  • Ten or more years in behavioral health service delivery, clinical quality, or clinical operations, including, including executive-level responsibility for quality strategy, regulatory oversight, performance improvement and organizational risk management across complex healthcare environment
  • Six or more years of leadership experience managing directors, managers and or cross-functional teams, with demonstrated success influencing executive stakeholders, leading large-scale quality transformation initiatives and developing leadership pipelines within growing healthcare organizations, with a track record of hiring, coaching and developing clinical or quality professionals.
  • Demonstrated success leading regulatory readiness, accreditation, state licensure, and payer audit activities related to clinical quality and documentation, including development and execution of corrective action plans that drive sustained compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and interpret quality data and to present findings credibly to executive and board-level audiences.
  • Willingness to carry selected direct casework alongside leadership responsibilities.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Senior Graphic Designer, you will join a fast-growing digital operations team within a dynamic beauty and hair-care brand expanding across LATAM. Operating as part of a high-output creative team, you will be responsible for producing consistent, performance-oriented visual content across paid advertising, organic social, email marketing,landing pages, and e-commerce touchpoints.

In this hands-on design role, you will take ownership of maintaining visual consistency across digital channels using established brand guidelines, reusable templates, and organized design systems. You will balance creative direction with production efficiency to deliver high-quality static, motion, and marketplace assets at speed.

Accountability

As a Senior Graphic Designer, your success will be defined by your ability to maintain visual brand consistency, maintain high creative production volume, minimize revision rounds, and produce effective assets that support digital performance goals.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Brand Identity & Visual Consistency

  • Maintain visual identity and standards across digital touchpoints, ensuring every asset remains recognizably aligned with brand guidelines.
  • Apply standardized typography, colors, layouts, imagery, and design treatments across all customer-facing materials.
  • Maintain, update, and manage brand style guides, reusable design templates, and organized asset libraries to streamline high-volume production.
    Partner with creative leadership to enforce visual standards and prevent brand dilution across channels.

Paid Advertising Creative Execution

  • Design high-converting static and motion advertisements for paid digital and social campaigns.
  • Produce weekly ad sets containing multiple creative variations, alternative layouts, and messaging treatments.
  • Translate campaign briefs and performance feedback into optimized visual concepts that improve creative effectiveness.
  • Deliver advertising assets rapidly to support high-velocity testing and campaign deadlines.

Social Media & Email Design

  • Design creative graphics and layouts for organic social media channels to engage target audiences.
  • Craft visually compelling email marketing designs and promotional templates that maintain lifecycle consistency.
  • Adapt visual concepts across different formats, aspect ratios, and campaign goals while collaborating with the broader creative team.

Landing Page & E-Commerce Visuals

  • Design visual assets for landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), and marketplace listings.
  • Create, optimize, and refresh product detail page imagery for DTC storefronts and sales platforms including Amazon and TikTok Shop.
  • Ensure product visuals clearly communicate key features, benefits, and usage instructions while aligning with visual identity standards.

Motion Graphics & Design Variations

  • Produce animated graphics, motion-based ad creatives, and dynamic visual treatments from static design briefs.
  • Develop multiple variations of top-performing creative assets to support ad iteration and prevent ad fatigue.
  • Implement automated resizing and efficient design workflows to maintain speed and visual quality across all output formats.

Colleagues

You will report directly to the Creative Director as your primary functional manager while collaborating closely with the Chief Marketing Officer and cross-functional creative partners, including video editors, copywriters, and performance marketers. At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area,paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Graphic Designer, your vertical strength will be DTC visual asset creation and template design systems, while your horizontal capabilities should span channel-specific creative optimization, motion design, and cross-functional campaign execution.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: Proven graphic design experience within DTC, e-commerce, beauty, hair-care, or consumer goods brands, with a strong portfolio showcasing multi-channel digital design.
  • Tools/Systems: Advanced proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and Canva; experience with AI-assisted design, image generation tools, and automated resizing workflows is preferred.
  • Analytics/Process: Strong background in executing creative briefs independently, managing design template libraries, and adapting visuals for e-commerce platforms like Amazon PDPs and TikTok Shop.
  • Mindset: High production speed, meticulous attention to visual detail, low revision requirements, and a collaborative approach to performance feedback.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Brand Consistency & Systems: How do you maintain and scale visual brand standards across channels using reusable template systems?
  • Paid Advertising Design: How do you design static and motion ad assets structured for digital conversion?
  • Multi-Channel Adaptation: How do you adapt design concepts across social media, email, PDPs, Amazon, and TikTok Shop listings?
  • Production Speed & Efficiency: How do you manage high-volume creative production and fast turnarounds with minimal revision rounds?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.
