Job Summary

CECO Environmental is a global leader in providing sustainable solutions for industrial air, water, and energy transition. Since 1966, we’ve been addressing the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our mission is to protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment, making a tangible impact across industries like renewable energy, semiconductor manufacturing, power generation, and water treatment. As a purpose-driven company, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and integrity, ensuring that every project we undertake creates lasting positive change. At CECO, you’ll be part of a growing, dynamic team committed to a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable future.

We are proud to share that CECO was named one of Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies for 2025 and that Forbes recognized CECO as one of America’s Most Successful Small‑Cap Companies for 2026, marking our third consecutive year on the Forbes list. CECO Environmental is a publicly traded company on the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE) under the ticker CECO, reflecting our strong growth, financial performance, and commitment to delivering value to shareholders.

As part of the CECO Environmental family of brands, Peerless Emissions Control plays a critical role in delivering specialized air solutions that protect both people and the environment. By joining our team, you’ll contribute to our shared mission of protecting global industrial operations and shaping the future of environmental stewardship.

The Structural Designer II is a mid‑level technical contributor responsible for producing accurate 3D models, drawings, and material take‑offs for heavy industrial equipment and hot exhaust ducting systems. This role is intended for a developing industrial designer who has moved beyond entry‑level drafting and is building depth in large‑scale, high‑temperature ducting and structural platework under the guidance of senior designers and engineers.

This position supports the design of hot exhaust and flue gas ducting systems associated with pollution control equipment located downstream of combustion turbines, boilers, and fired heaters, with increasing responsibility for design execution, coordination, and quality.

Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Prepare 3D CAD models, fabrication drawings, and material take‑offs for heavy industrial equipment and ducting systems.
  • Assist in the design of hot exhaust and flue gas ducting, including casings, transitions, and associated structural plate components.
  • Develop drawings for customer review, material procurement, and fabrication, following established design standards and templates.
  • Incorporate design input related to thermal expansion, operating temperature, and mechanical loading as directed by senior designers or engineers.
  • Coordinate ducting layouts and interfaces with associated equipment such as SCR reactors, baghouses, ESPs, dampers, and expansion joints, with guidance as needed.
  • Review project inputs for completeness and raise questions or discrepancies to senior designers or project engineers.
  • Perform geometric and material calculations (lengths, areas, volumes, weights, angles) to support drawing accuracy and material lists.
  • Revise drawings based on internal reviews, customer comments, and fabrication feedback.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary coordination with Engineering, Project Management, and Sales to support project execution.
  • Follow document control procedures for drawing issuance, revisions, and file management.

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate’s degree in Computer‑Aided Design, Drafting, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in industrial structural or mechanical design.
  • Experience producing industrial ductwork or plate structures, preferably in heavy industrial or process‑equipment environments.
  • Proficiency in 3D modeling and preparation of fabrication‑ready drawings.
  • Ability to perform basic geometric and material quantity calculations accurately.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Autodesk® Inventor or similar 3D mechanical design software.
  • Exposure to hot exhaust or flue gas ducting systems operating at elevated temperatures.
  • Familiarity with pollution control equipment such as SCRs, baghouses, or ESPs.
  • Basic understanding of thermal expansion concepts in large ducting or plate structures.
  • Knowledge of common industrial welding practices and fabrication constraints.
  • Ability to interpret P&IDs and coordinate ducting layouts with process requirements.
  • Travel Requirements: Estimated to be no more than 5% of working hours. Valid driver’s license required.

ADA Requirements:

Positions in this function typically require typing, sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.

  • Concentrated mental and/or visual attention. The work involves performing complex tasks to very close accuracy and quality specifications, or a high degree of hand and eye coordination for sustained periods.
  • The job is typically performed under comfortable working conditions; any disagreeable elements are generally absent during normal performance of job.
  • Compliance with company attendance standards.

Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers.

At CECO, our people are at the center of everything we do. Whether you’re a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring opportunities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with CECO.

CECO Environmental is a leading environmentally focused, diversified industrial company whose solutions protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment across the globe, serving a broad landscape of industrial air, industrial water and energy transition markets.

We serve these markets and our global customers through our key business segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions. Learn more about CECO by visiting About Us.

ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Technology Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
  • Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
  • Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
  • Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
  • Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio

Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security

  • Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
  • Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
  • Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
  • Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions

MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture

  • Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
  • Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
  • Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
  • Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
  • Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch

AI Enablement & Automation

  • Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
  • Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
  • Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
  • Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients

Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure

  • Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
  • Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
  • Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems

Client Engagement & Agency Growth

  • Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
  • Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
  • Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
  • Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
  • At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
  • Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
  • Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
  • Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
  • Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
  • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
  • Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
  • Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Director of Technology reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Technology department, encompassing CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration. The Director of Technology maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align platform technology and data infrastructure, and collaborates closely with the Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.

About Mission Underwriting Services

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

What We Offer:

  • 11 Paid Holidays

Purpose:

The Finance Data Analyst will serve as the primary analytical and data-process partner from the data team to the Finance team, ensuring that financial data from Mission's enterprise data warehouse (EDW) is accurate, complete, timely, and usable for accounting, reporting, and ad hoc analysis. This role will assume day-to-day responsibility for the existing finance ETL process while it remains in use, compare EDW output with this process, investigate and explain differences, and establish repeatable validations for premium, commissions, taxes, fees, payments, and other policy transaction data.

The ideal candidate combines insurance accounting knowledge with strong SQL and data analysis skills, sound judgment about whether financial results make sense, and the ability to translate Finance requirements into reliable data processes.

Essential Duties/Functions:

  • Assume day-to-day responsibility for running, monitoring, and troubleshooting the existing daily finance ETL accounting process while it remains in use, producing policy transactions and monetary amounts across premium, taxes, and fees.
  • Compare financial data produced by the EDW with the current finance ETL outputs; reconcile results at the appropriate policy, transaction, coverage, or other business grain.
  • Investigate variances and pinpoint root causes such as missing or duplicated transactions, timing differences, incorrect signs, mappings, joins, effective dates, transformation logic, or source-data defects.
  • Use significant SQL to query, validate, and transform policy, premium, commission, payment, tax, fee, and related financial data; develop reusable queries and process components.
  • Establish, document, and maintain automated validation rules, reconciliation checks, reasonableness tests, and exception reporting for financial data delivered from the EDW.
  • Provide Finance with accurate and timely recurring data, reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules for accounting, reporting, close, and operational needs.
  • Work closely with Finance as the primary business stakeholder to define financial metrics, transaction treatments, data definitions, accounting assumptions, and acceptance criteria for EDW outputs.
  • Partner with data engineers to trace source-to-target logic, recommend field-level changes, validate fixes, and support reliable production processes.
  • Build a strong working knowledge of the EDW data model, including the insurance policy lifecycle, transaction data, source systems, data layers, grains, and relationships needed for financial reporting.
  • Help define how paid data is sourced, ingested, modeled, validated, and made available in the EDW, including required history, timing, grain, and financial attributes.
  • Support portfolio / program health check reporting through data preparation, KPI reporting, and process improvements.
  • Perform ad hoc analyses for Finance; quantify business impacts, explain trends, and translate findings into clear takeaways.
  • Create process flows, SQL documentation, data dictionaries, reconciliation procedures, and issue logs to promote repeatability and shared understanding.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in finance data analysis, financial reporting, accounting analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical roles.
  • 2+ years of experience working with commercial or specialty insurance, including policy, premium, commission, paid, tax, fee, or other transaction data.
  • Working knowledge of insurance concepts, including premium and commission transactions, taxes, fees, and reconciliations.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins and aggregations, financial reconciliations, data validation, and development of reusable queries or processes.
  • Experience comparing data across systems or ETL processes and diagnosing the root causes of discrepancies.
  • Experience building or maintaining recurring reports, validation checks, or financial data controls using SQL, Excel, BI, or similar tools.
  • Strong critical thinking, attention to detail, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and financial results to Finance and Data stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting financial processes, planning, management reporting, or process automation.
  • Experience with enterprise data warehouses, relational or dimensional data models, or data pipeline development.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, PySpark, Python, Azure, or similar data engineering and development tools.
  • Experience with Power BI or other BI tools, and with ERP, general ledger, premium accounting, policy administration, or billing systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, data analytics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience; ability to travel up to 5% of the year.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Familiarity with insurance financial data domains, including policy transactions, premium, commission, paid data, taxes, fees, reconciliations, and downstream accounting or reporting.
  • Ability to evaluate financial results using business context, recognize unexpected patterns, distinguish expected timing or business differences from data defects, and assess materiality.
  • Strong relational database and data warehousing knowledge; able to use SQL effectively across normalized and denormalized schemas and multiple data grains.
  • Skilled in reconciliation, variance analysis, root cause analysis, and the design of validation checks, reasonableness tests, and exception reporting.
  • Proficiency in Excel to prepare recurring Finance reporting and support one-off analysis.
  • Comfortable collaborating with data engineers and business users to trace data flows, clarify assumptions, troubleshoot processes, and drive issues to resolution.
  • Able to document queries, financial definitions, accounting assumptions, reconciliation logic, process flows, and data-quality decisions for shared understanding.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and dependable when working with daily processes, recurring financial deliverables, and sensitive monetary data.

Working Conditions:

  • Requires a quiet work environment with regular sitting at a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Occasional walking and standing, and lifting of up to 10 lbs.
  • Regular use of hands and fingers.
  • Frequent talking or hearing.
  • Vision requirements: Close, distance, color, peripheral, focus and depth perception.

Additional Information

This is a remote position. Planned, in-office activities may be required on occasion (typically 2-4x per year).

You must live in the United States and be authorized to work in the United States without requirement of employmentsponsorship/visa.

Their systems include traditional servers running Nginx and PHP-FPM, cloud and Kubernetes platforms, virtualization and storage, and specialized Linux appliances and embedded devices. Some customers have modern, well-automated infrastructure; others have unusual, older, or heavily customized systems that still need to work reliably.

We're looking for a senior, client-facing Linux specialist who can navigate that variety. Someone with deep Linux fundamentals, strong networking knowledge, enough software literacy to investigate production applications, and the judgment to solve unfamiliar problems independently.

This isn't a role limited to following runbooks, patching servers, or escalating every issue that crosses the line between infrastructure and application code.

What Level 3 means here

Our levels describe capability and primary responsibilities, not rigid job boundaries. Everyone pitches in, whether that means routine maintenance or a difficult production incident.

A Level 3 specialist is someone we trust to own and resolve a wide range of complex production problems with minimal supervision. You can enter an unfamiliar customer environment, establish how its components fit together, collect evidence, reason from first principles, and drive an issue to resolution. You recognize when specialized assistance is needed and involve colleagues with a clear account of what you've already established.

Our Level 4 specialists are the people other specialists turn to for difficult technical guidance and mentoring. Our Level 5 specialists work at an exceptionally deep level, including designing or building new technologies and approaches. We generally grow Level 4 and Level 5 specialists internally, rather than hiring directly into those levels.

We're not expecting you to arrive knowing everything. We are expecting the foundation, independence, and curiosity from which that deeper expertise can develop.

Your technical foundation - required

These are baseline competencies, not a list of keywords to put on a resume. We expect you to understand the underlying concepts and apply them in production, even when you need to look up a particular command option or configuration directive.

Linux operating systems

  • Strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting across Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL/Rocky-style systems.
  • Understanding of processes, services, boot, permissions, authentication, filesystems, storage, memory, CPU, and I/O behaviour.
  • Ability to use logs, process inspection, system tracing, performance metrics, and other evidence to isolate failures.
  • Comfort investigating system behaviour beneath the level of a service restart or a copied troubleshooting procedure.

IP networking and internet protocols

  • Solid, immediately accessible knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, routing, switching fundamentals, DNS, NAT, firewalls, and common transport and application protocols.
  • Ability to investigate host and network connectivity with Linux networking tools and packet captures.
  • Understanding of how packets travel between applications, hosts, gateways, firewalls, and remote services, including how to locate failures along that path.
  • Experience diagnosing network behaviour rather than simply verifying whether a host answers ping.

Web and application infrastructure

  • Working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, web servers, reverse proxies, load balancers, and application runtimes.
  • Experience across many web stacks, from older application servers and long-lived PHP, Java, and similar platforms to current reverse proxies, language runtimes, and frameworks. Nginx, Apache, and PHP-FPM are common examples, not the limit of what you may encounter.
  • Understanding of how applications depend on databases, caches, message queues, local storage, external APIs, and network services.
  • Ability to investigate configuration limits, timeouts, request handling, application errors, resource exhaustion, and performance problems across the full request path.

Software literacy and automation

  • Confident shell scripting and useful experience with Python or another general-purpose programming language.
  • Ability to read unfamiliar application code, follow program flow, and interpret exceptions, stack traces, and logs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, common data formats, Git, and basic SQL.
  • Ability to build diagnostic tools or small automations, and make straightforward code or configuration fixes when appropriate.
  • Good judgment about testing, change safety, and avoiding unintended effects in production.

You do not need to be a full-time software developer. You do need to understand enough about software to help determine why it is failing. The fact that a Linux host is running does not, by itself, mean your troubleshooting is finished.

Production operations and reliability

  • Systematic troubleshooting: forming hypotheses, gathering evidence, isolating components, and verifying fixes.
  • Understanding of monitoring, alerting, logging, and interpreting reliability and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with high availability, capacity, backups, recovery, and common production failure modes.
  • Ability to plan and execute safe changes, with appropriate testing, communication, and rollback procedures.
  • Interest in root causes and reducing repeat incidents through better monitoring, automation, documentation, and design.

We value a Site Reliability Engineering mindset, even though this is not an engineering-titled position: restore service, understand the failure, and make the system more reliable afterward.

Breadth of infrastructure experience

You should have substantial practical experience in several of the areas below and enough general knowledge to become productive in others. We do not expect expert-level proficiency in every product we support.

  • Virtualization and storage: KVM, Proxmox, VMware, Xen/XCP-ng, LVM, RAID, NFS, iSCSI, ZFS, Ceph, or similar platforms.
  • Containers and orchestration: Docker, Podman, LXC/LXD, Kubernetes, or comparable tools; including workload, networking, and storage troubleshooting.
  • Cloud infrastructure: Practical production experience with at least one major provider, such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean, or OVHcloud, and a working grasp of cloud networking, compute, and storage principles.
  • Databases and data services: MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, or comparable systems; including availability, connectivity, basic queries, and common performance issues.
  • Automation and delivery: SaltStack, Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD systems, or other tools used to build and maintain repeatable infrastructure.

Specific technology experience matters, but strong transferable fundamentals and demonstrated problem-solving ability matter more.

You're good at

  • Walking into an unfamiliar environment and learning how it works without needing a step-by-step guide.
  • Solving technical problems with the customer's business priorities, risk, and uptime in mind.
  • Taking responsibility for an investigation and communicating progress clearly.
  • Building trust with customers through sound judgment, clear explanations, and honest communication.
  • Collaborating with colleagues, asking for help appropriately, and sharing what you've learned.
  • Following established processes while noticing where those processes can be improved.
  • Managing your work, documentation, commitments, and time effectively in a remote consulting environment.
  • Staying curious and continually expanding both the breadth and depth of your technical skills.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and resolve production incidents across Linux systems, networking, web applications, databases, containers, and infrastructure.
  • Respond to customer requests and system alerts, including incidents where the root cause is not immediately apparent.
  • Work with customer developers and technical teams to diagnose application and infrastructure issues.
  • Perform system maintenance, patching, health checks, deployments, migrations, and upgrades.
  • Onboard new customers, document their environments, and contribute to roadmaps for improving reliability and maintainability.
  • Develop scripts and automation that reduce recurring work, operational risk, or troubleshooting time.
  • Document technical findings, update customer assets and runbooks, and maintain accurate ticket and time records.
  • Participate in some scheduled after-hours customer maintenance when changes are best performed outside business hours.

Participation in our after-hours on-call rotation and incident response is optional, by invitation, and separately compensated. This is distinct from occasional scheduled maintenance work.

This role may not be the right fit if

  • Most of your Linux experience has been limited to following procedures, patching servers, and restarting services.
  • You are comfortable using tools but struggle to explain the computing or networking concepts behind them.
  • You routinely hand off production problems once they appear to involve application behaviour rather than the host operating system.
  • You need someone else to direct your investigation when you encounter an unfamiliar technology or failure.
  • You want to work exclusively in one narrow platform or product family.
  • You depend on documentation, search tools, or AI to supply fundamental concepts rather than using them to check details and accelerate work.

There is nothing wrong with being at an earlier stage of your career or choosing a narrow specialty. This role simply calls for an established, broad technical foundation.

Experience that would set you apart

  • Experience in Linux consulting, managed services, or other multi-customer environments.
  • Significant production SaaS experience, including observability, application performance, and high-availability operations.
  • Deep Kubernetes troubleshooting, complex virtualization, or distributed storage expertise.
  • Advanced routing, overlay networking, VPNs, or packet-level analysis.
  • Database replication, clustering, query optimization, or advanced performance tuning.
  • Software development experience beyond scripting, or contributions to open-source projects.
  • Low-level Linux experience involving kernel internals, eBPF, or specialized systems work.
  • Experience designing reliability improvements after difficult production incidents.

These are differentiators, not requirements to already be operating at our Level 4 or Level 5.

Experience and qualifications

  • Approximately five or more years of meaningful, hands-on Linux infrastructure experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability.
  • A record of independently investigating and resolving production problems.
  • Experience across multiple Linux-related infrastructure or application technologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for a customer-facing consulting role.

Degrees and certifications are welcome, but demonstrated knowledge and practical capability carry more weight than credentials alone.

Our interview process

The first interview includes people from both HR and Engineering. We move back and forth between technical questions and questions about how you work with other people, so you are not in one kind of conversation for the whole time.

We begin with a short technical screening to establish the foundational knowledge expected of a Level 3 specialist. We are not testing whether you have memorized every option in a manual. We are testing whether you already understand the essential concepts you would rely on when solving problems for our customers.

In everyday work, using documentation, search, source code, colleagues, and AI tools is normal. In this screening, we want to establish the technical foundation you bring without those aids.

After this first full interview, if we invite you back, the second interview is typically the final one.

Why join Crafty Penguins?

You'll work on an unusually broad mix of technologies and customer problems, alongside colleagues who enjoy difficult investigations and take pride in learning. You'll have autonomy, opportunities to grow into more specialized technical leadership, and a team willing to share knowledge.

We are a remote-first organization with flexible scheduling, a culture of continuous improvement and infrastructure to support experimentation and learning.

Our team is united by habits of building trust, looking at the bigger picture, leaning into challenges, and being better today than yesterday.

Location, compensation, and application

  • Location: Fully remote within Canada. Crafty Penguins is based in Lethbridge, Alberta.
  • Employment: Full-time, permanent.
  • Compensation: Estimated annualized total compensation of $90,000–$120,000 CAD following successful completion of the three-month probationary period, based on a 40h work week. Placement in the range depends on experience, demonstrated capability, and breadth of skills. The stated range is an annualized post-probation package, not necessarily first-year earnings.
  • Eligibility: The successful applicant must be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident of Canada.

Please submit your resume and cover letter, including the word Pepsi, and tell us briefly about a difficult production problem you personally investigated: what was happening, how you approached it, and what you discovered.

Due to application volume, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Salary: $90K to $120K

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. Life at Cars Commerce makes it easy when we share the ethos to be Open to All, encouraging open-minded communication because we know diverse thinking yields better outcomes. Position Summary

The Benefits Analyst is the day-to-day administrator of Cars.com U.S. and Canada benefits and leave programs, working within Total Rewards and reporting to the Senior Manager, Benefits. You will keep enrollments, deductions, vendor billing, and leaves accurate and compliant across Workday and our carriers. You will also be the first point of contact for employees, HR Business Partners, Payroll, and vendors on benefits and leave questions. This role is a strong fit for someone who likes detail, process, and getting people clear answers during sensitive moments such as births, medical events, and open enrollment.


Key Responsibilities

Benefits administration

  • Administer self-funded medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA/HSA, commuter, COBRA, and 401(k) programs for U.S. and Canadian employees, including enrollments, qualifying life events, terminations, and eligibility.
  • Configure and maintain benefits setup in Workday and partner with HRIS on releases and testing.
  • Lead the annual open enrollment cycle, including testing, employee support, and follow-up.
  • Generate and process accurate billing and invoices for self-funded heath and state leave plans, ensuring compliance with plan parameters and vendor specifications.
  • Monitor eligibility rules, including benefit eligibility for ACA, and support ACA compliance reporting and temporary-employee guidelines.
  • Support Canadian benefits administration alongside the U.S. programs, including carrier coordination and employee communications.
  • Manage monthly LOA commission calculations, partnering with Payroll to guarantee precise employee payouts and policy compliance.
  • Leverage AI tools and modern technologies to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and drive operational efficiency.
  • Champion the adoption of emerging technologies and AI tools to continuously improve team output and efficiency.

Leave of absence administration

  • Administer all leave programs, including FMLA, parental, caregiver, medical, military, and state paid leave, in partnership with our leave vendor.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, and Legal on leave cases and employee questions.

Vendor and financial management

  • Serve as day-to-day contact for carriers, vendors, and the benefits consultant.
  • Manage recurring vendor invoicing and funding approvals, and reconcile billing discrepancies.
  • Support annual renewals and vendor contract timelines.

Reporting and compliance

  • Pull and analyze benefits data, such as employer contribution reports, enrollment counts, and leave metrics, for Total Rewards leadership and Finance.
  • Support the 401(k) administration, annual audit, and investment committee.
  • Maintain process documentation.
  • Answer employee, HRBP, and manager questions with accuracy and discretion, protecting confidential medical and personal information.

Intranet content and communications calendar

  • Own and refresh benefits and leave content on the intranet, keeping it accurate, concise, and consistent in tone and structure.
  • Build and maintain a benefits communications calendar covering open enrollment, new-hire and life-event reminders, vendor programs, and policy changes.
  • Partner with the Internal Communications team to draft, review, and schedule employee emails, FAQs, benefits guides, and webinars.
  • Coordinate with vendors on co-branded or vendor-provided materials, and confirm that messaging matches plan details and U.S. and Canada differences before release.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3–6 years of experience administering employee benefits and/or leaves of absence.
  • Working knowledge of FMLA, ACA, COBRA, ERISA basics, and state paid leave and paid sick requirements. Continuously monitor, interpret, and maintain compliance with evolving federal, state, and local statutory leave laws and sick leave mandates.
  • Hands-on experience with an HRIS, with benefits configuration experience in Workday strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivots, and data reconciliation.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring deadlines, such as payroll cutoffs, invoice approvals, and enrollment windows.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with a service mindset and sound judgment handling confidential information.
  • Ability to work with multiple vendors, Payroll, HRBPs, and Legal at once.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency in using AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Copilot or role-specific AI platforms) to boost personal and team productivity.
  • Forward-thinking mindset with an eagerness to explore, evaluate, and adopt AI capabilities to refine business processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with U.S. and Canadian benefits, including group health, RRSP, or Canadian leave requirements.
  • Experience with leave vendor platforms and benefits consultants or brokers.
  • Experience supporting open enrollment, including employee communications.
  • Professional certification such as PHR, SHRM-CP, CEBS, or CLMS.

Tools and systems: Workday (Benefits and Absence), Google Workspace, Microsoft Office

This is a quota-carrying, full-cycle sales role. You will own enterprise deals from first outreach to signed contract - prospecting, discovery, demo, commercial negotiation, and close. If you thrive on winning, this is your seat.

About Wisor.AI

Wisor.AI is a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup revolutionising how freight forwarders sell, quote, and win business. Our AI-powered platform automates RFQ handling, rate management, and customer engagement — enabling freight forwarders to respond faster, smarter, and at scale. The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, hungry Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition across Europe. You will manage the full sales cycle end to end — from identifying and engaging target accounts to navigating complex procurement processes and closing multi-stakeholder enterprise deals.

This is not a role for someone who hands off to others at every stage. You will be in the room (or on the call), you will run the demo, you will negotiate the contract, and you will bring home the deal. You'll work closely with our VP of Sales, Marketing, and Product teams — but the pipeline and the quota are yours.

Pipeline Generation

  • Own your outbound pipeline - proactively identify, research, and engage enterprise freight forwarders across Europe
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline at 3–4x quota coverage through disciplined prospecting

  • Feed market intelligence back to Product and Marketing — you are on the front line and your insight matters

Remote Execution & Startup Drive

  • Travel to customer sites, trade shows, and industry events across Europe as needed
  • Operate effectively in a fast-moving startup — iterate quickly, handle ambiguity, and help build the playbook as you go

Must-Have Experience

  • 5 years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a focus on enterprise accounts

  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota - we will ask for numbers

Sales Skills & Methodology

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

  • Exceptional communicator in English — written, verbal, and in formal presentations; additional European language a strong advantage
  • Confident and credible in the room with C-level executives — you earn trust quickly
  • Clear and concise async communicator — you document your deals, update your CRM, and keep stakeholders informed without being chased

AI Orientation & Tech Fluency

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and the ability to articulate its business value to non-technical buyers
  • Comfortable running live product demos of AI-powered software with confidence and clarity
  • Data-driven approach to pipeline management — you live in your CRM and use data to priorities

Remote-Ready Qualities

Nice to Have

Are you a Scala Backend Engineer and a skilled problem-solver? Do you want to be a part of an innovative team that uses its technical skills to make a positive impact? Then this role could be for you!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

About BoxPower — Unlocking the Grid-Edge

BoxPower exists to solve the bottleneck of the energy transition: a distribution grid too constrained to connect new load, too fire-prone to keep stringing line through forests, too slow to keep up with demand. We operate the largest fleet of utility-owned microgrids in the country. We design, build, and run them alongside the planning software behind them — partnering with PG&E, SCE, NV Energy, tribal utilities, and developers to deliver speed to power where interconnection takes years, replace risky line extensions, and add capacity where the grid can't keep up.

About the Role

BoxPower is hiring a Vice President of Utility Sales to lead our largest business through its next stage of growth, after a record year of new utility contracts. You own BoxPower's utility accounts and the utility bookings number — the pipeline, the pursuits, the relationships and the team — across three applications sold to the same buyers: wildfire mitigation, remote power and resilience, and utility-procured distributed capacity. You report to the CEO, serve on the leadership team, and lead a team spanning utility sales, strategic accounts, project development and sales operations.

Utility business is won long before an RFP is issued. You know how a utility plans, funds, recovers and procures a distributed energy asset, and you use that to position BoxPower ahead of procurement — direct as prime and through the EPC, developer and channel partners that hold the utility contract. You lead from the front: you carry the largest pursuits yourself, coach the team on the rest, give clear and direct feedback, and hold yourself to the number.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline and Accounts

  • Own the utility pipeline: multi-year coverage across all three applications, reported monthly by stage, age and source.
  • Maintain an account plan for every target utility — investor-owned, cooperative, municipal and tribal — and position BoxPower ahead of procurement in resource and distribution plans, wildfire mitigation plans, rate cases, and non-wires or distributed capacity solicitations.

Pursuits and Bookings

  • Own the utility bookings number: lead complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits from pre-RFP positioning through proposal, award, negotiation, contracting and handoff to Delivery.
  • Turn projects into programs: master agreements, multi-site contracts, follow-on phases, services and O&M.
  • Set win pricing within approved margin frameworks, and build every proposal with Pre-Construction, Engineering and Delivery so it is technically sound, priced to win, and deliverable on schedule and at margin.
  • Open the distributed capacity market: program shortlists, awards, and cooperative and municipal pilots won on avoided-cost and deferral economics.

Forecast and CRM

  • Own the utility bookings forecast and its accuracy; keep HubSpot the system of record, with reporting that leadership and the Board can plan against.

Team and Company

  • Lead the utility sales team as a player-coach; propose the organization design, territories and compensation plan; hire against plan.
  • Champion BoxPower's standardized platform, route non-standard requests through the custom-scope process, and bring market and win/loss intelligence back to Product and Strategy.
  • Represent BoxPower at industry and regulatory forums (EEI, APPA, NRECA, state commissions and regional associations).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 12+ years selling to electric utilities, including 5+ years leading a team that carried a bookings or revenue target.
  • A record of personally originating and closing multi-million-dollar, multi-year utility contracts — equipment, turnkey projects, programs or framework agreements.
  • Working command of how utilities plan, fund and buy: integrated resource and distribution planning, wildfire mitigation plans, non-wires and DER procurement, rate cases and cost recovery, RFP and supplier qualification. Investor-owned utility experience required.
  • Experience selling capital projects — storage, microgrids, distributed generation or grid infrastructure — through a proposal, estimate and contract process, both direct and through EPC primes or developers.
  • Disciplined pipeline and forecast management in a CRM; executive presence with utility leadership, boards and commissions.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 25–50%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relationships with utilities in the Western US, Alaska and the Southwest, including public power and tribal utilities.
  • Experience selling standardized or productized energy systems rather than only custom-engineered scope.
  • Experience with distributed capacity, non-wires alternatives or wildfire mitigation programs, and with avoided-cost and deferral economics.
  • Familiarity with public funding programs for utility and tribal energy projects, and with project finance and tax credit structures.
  • Prior utility-side work in DER, grid planning, wildfire mitigation, procurement or regulatory affairs.
  • Experience leading a sales team through growth at a venture-backed company.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with security monitoring tools, incident response, and security frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II and NIST CSF.


This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates based anywhere in India, with a Monday-to-Friday work schedule. The role involves strengthening the organization's security posture, supporting compliance initiatives, identifying and mitigating security risks, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement effective security practices.


Key Responsibilities


1. Security Operations & Tooling

  • Monitor, tune, and triage security alerts across SIEM platforms, escalating confirmed incidents in accordance with established procedures and runbooks.
  • Manage the vulnerability management lifecycle, including scanning, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and management reporting.
  • Support endpoint security, email security, and network monitoring tools, identifying security gaps and recommending configuration improvements.
  • Conduct periodic threat-hunting activities and contribute to the development and enhancement of detection rules and incident response playbooks.
  • Participate in incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews.

2. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Support ongoing SOC 2 Type II compliance activities, including evidence collection, control testing, documentation, and coordination with external auditors.
  • Assist with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF) assessments by mapping existing controls to framework requirements, identifying gaps, and supporting remediation efforts.
  • Maintain and update information security policies, standards, and procedures in collaboration with senior team members.
  • Conduct periodic security risk assessments and document findings in the organization's risk register.
  • Track identified risks, control deficiencies, and remediation actions through to closure.

3. Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate with IT, Engineering, and business stakeholders to integrate security best practices into day-to-day operations.
  • Support security awareness initiatives and provide guidance to employees on information security policies and practices.
  • Prepare clear and concise reports on security metrics, vulnerability status, risk remediation, and compliance posture for management.
  • Communicate technical findings, security risks, and recommended corrective actions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience in information security, with exposure to both technical security operations and compliance functions.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent solutions.
  • Working knowledge of vulnerability management tools such as Tenable Nessus, , or Qualys.
  • Understanding of SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • Familiarity with common cyberattack techniques, threat detection methods, and defensive security controls. Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, CEH, CISM, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2 audits from preparation and evidence collection through audit completion.
  • Scripting or automation experience using Python or PowerShell for security tooling, analysis, and reporting.
  • Exposure to cloud security environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, ServiceNow GRC, Drata, or Vanta.

This is an end-to-end Amazon leadership role, not a PPC-only position: you’ll connect marketplace performance, advertising, operations, and reporting to profitable growth. You’ll initially work alongside the existing agency, independently evaluate performance, and lead a gradual handover with clear knowledge transfer. Expect to remain hands-on and operate independently during the initial phase, without immediate supporting hires.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

jobs.description:
ABOUT SITUATION PUBLISHING

Situation Publishing helps technology companies understand, reach and influence the people making the world's most important enterprise technology decisions.

Built around The Register and its global audience of technology professionals, we combine independent technology publishing, first-party audience intelligence, AI-powered content discovery and high-impact commercial programmes.

Our commercial offering spans brand, demand generation, content, research, digital experiences and executive engagement. Increasingly, these programmes are powered by the behavioural signals, audience insight and intelligence generated by our platforms.

We are evolving from a traditional technology media business into a technology audience and intelligence company, while retaining the editorial credibility, specialist expertise and scale that have made The Register one of the world's most influential enterprise technology publications.

We are entrepreneurial, ambitious and performance-led. Strong performers are given the opportunity to take ownership, develop quickly and help shape the next stage of the business.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a commercially ambitious Senior Account Director to join our North American team. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can build strategic client relationships, open new business and turn complex technology marketing challenges into meaningful commercial programmes.

You will work with a combination of major technology vendors, direct clients and media agencies, growing existing relationships while developing net-new accounts. The role requires much more than selling individual media products: we want someone who can understand a client's business, marketing and pipeline objectives and bring together the right combination of Situation Publishing capabilities to solve them.

You will sell across our portfolio, including brand advertising, demand generation, custom content, research, webcasts, executive events and emerging audience intelligence and AI-powered products such as The Register Intelligence.

Your primary territory will cover North America, with the opportunity to work with colleagues globally to develop international programmes and revenue.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and grow strategic relationships with major technology vendors, direct clients and media agencies.
  • Develop net-new business while expanding revenue within an existing portfolio of accounts.
  • Understand clients' marketing, pipeline and go-to-market challenges and translate them into integrated programmes across audience, intelligence, content, demand, brand and executive engagement.
  • Sell consultatively at senior level, moving conversations beyond individual media products toward larger, multi-product and longer-term partnerships.
  • Introduce clients to emerging Situation Publishing capabilities, including The Register Intelligence, first-party audience signals and new AI-powered commercial products.
  • Develop a strong understanding of enterprise technology markets and use that knowledge to create relevant commercial ideas for clients.
  • Present confidently to senior stakeholders and larger client or agency groups.
  • Own the complete commercial process: prospecting, discovery, proposal development, forecasting, negotiation, closing, delivery oversight, renewal and growth.
  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast, with clear ownership of revenue performance against target.
  • Work collaboratively with editorial, product, marketing, insights and campaign teams to create programmes that genuinely answer client problems.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • A proven track record of delivering revenue in a senior B2B sales role.
  • Experience selling complex, consultative solutions rather than relying solely on transactional media inventory.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology marketing and the challenges facing technology vendors, agencies and marketing leaders.
  • The ability to build credibility and relationships with senior client stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to structure proposals that balance client outcomes with profitable growth.
  • The ability to think strategically about technology marketing, audience behaviour and client growth - and translate that thinking into commercial opportunities.
  • Curiosity and a genuine interest in enterprise technology, AI, data, audience intelligence and how B2B technology buying is changing.
  • Experience in B2B media is valuable, but we are equally interested in strong candidates from intent/data, ABM, content syndication, research, martech or other complex technology-marketing businesses.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • You grow strategic accounts rather than simply renew existing activity.
  • You create net-new client relationships and convert them into meaningful revenue.
  • You are comfortable selling the established Situation Publishing portfolio while helping clients understand and adopt newer intelligence and AI-powered propositions.
  • You build larger, more integrated and longer-term partnerships by understanding what clients are actually trying to achieve.
  • You become a trusted commercial partner to your clients and a strong collaborator internally.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A talented, collaborative and ambitious environment with significant scope to learn, develop and influence the business.
  • The opportunity to sell established, globally recognised media brands alongside a growing portfolio of audience intelligence and AI-powered products.

• Remote work schedule.

• Uncapped commission structure.

Salary: 220k - 250k SGP
