Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Why Benchmark Gensuite?

jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.title: Chiropractic Virtual Assistant & Front Desk Coordinator (ChiroTouch EMR)
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are seeking an articulate, high-energy Chiropractic Virtual Assistant & Front Desk Coordinator with mandatory ChiroTouch EMR experience to manage our practice's inbound/outbound phone operations and general medical administration.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an articulate, high-energy Chiropractic Virtual Assistant & Front Desk Coordinator with mandatory ChiroTouch EMR experience to manage our practice's inbound/outbound phone operations and general medical administration.

In this position, your main priority is answering phone calls with exceptional clarity, scheduling patient appointments, and managing patient inquiries. When you are not on the phone, you will support the practice with general medical administrative workflows, patient communications, and record management directly within ChiroTouch.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Phone Management & Patient Scheduling

  • Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls using our Intermedia VOIP phone system.
  • Speak clearly, professionally, and warmly to answer patient questions, schedule care plans, confirm visits, and manage reschedules.
  • Perform proactive appointment reminder calls to minimize no-shows and keep clinic calendars full.

2. ChiroTouch EMR & Administrative Support

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records, intake forms, and schedules within ChiroTouch EMR.
  • Perform general medical administrative tasks during call downtime, including document organization, digital fax handling, and messaging.
  • Route patient inquiries, clinical notes, or care plan questions to providers in a timely manner.

3. Patient Communications & Practice Support

  • Provide attentive, empathetic support to chiropractic patients regarding appointment logistics, practice policies, and intake requirements.
  • Document every phone call, patient request, and calendar modification accurately in real time.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • EMR Mastery (Non-Negotiable): Hands-on proficiency and recent experience using ChiroTouch EMR.
  • Call Volume Experience: Strong, proven background managing high call volumes in a medical setting with exceptionally clear, professional spoken English.
  • Specialty Knowledge: Prior background working in Chiropractic practices or physical therapy/rehabilitation clinics.
  • Phone System Experience: Experience using Intermedia VOIP (or similar cloud-based phone platforms).
  • Skills: Strong multitasking ability, high attention to detail, and comfort managing administrative tasks between calls.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose: Supports the documentation and processing of appeals, disputes and reconsiderations to ensure they are in accordance with state and National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) requirements. Support the team to ensure appeals, disputes and reconsiderations are reviewed and processed timely.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT. Experience with the documentation and processing of No Surprises Act (NSA) Open Negotiation Requests (ONRs), Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR), and/or state healthcare payment disputes, preferred.

  • Performs data entry to support the tracking, logging, and processing of appeals, disputes and reconsiderations in accordance with established regulatory and accreditation guidelines and procedures
  • Prepares correspondence for appeals, disputes and reconsiderations and maintains documentation files
  • Reviews and investigates appeals, disputes and reconsiderations requests to determine applicable follow up
  • Conducts research needed to evaluate, process, and respond to appeals, disputes and reconsiderations to ensure a timely decision
  • Prepares case files including supporting documentation and determinations needed to review, process, and report the appeals, disputes and reconsiderations
  • Gathers appeals, disputes and reconsiderations data to track and report on trends and final outcomes to team including conducting outreach for an update on statuses, determinations, and explanations
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: Requires a High School diploma or GED. Requires 1 – 2 years of related experience. Knowledge of appeals, disputes and reconsiderations process preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC) $60K-$85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available FLSA Status: ExemptLocation: Daphne, ALSalary: 60K - 85K+Work from Home!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC) $60K-$85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Daphne, AL

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.title: College Admissions Counselor/Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Help Students Build Their Future! We’re looking for thoughtful, driven mentors to work closely with students navigating the U.
jobs.description:
Help Students Build Their Future!

We’re looking for thoughtful, driven mentors to work closely with students navigating the U.S. college and graduate admissions process. This is a highly relationship-driven role focused on long-term student development, strategic guidance, and meaningful mentorship (not just application review.)

You’ll have the opportunity to support students as they explore academic interests, strengthen extracurricular profiles, develop compelling personal narratives, and prepare competitive applications for top programs.

If you enjoy coaching, writing, education, and helping ambitious students grow in confidence and direction, this role offers the opportunity to make a lasting impact while working remotely with a flexible schedule.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build meaningful 1-on-1 relationships with students over months (and sometimes years!)
  • Guide students through college and graduate application strategy
  • Help students strengthen extracurricular, academic, and personal profiles
  • Edit essays and provide thoughtful feedback that encourages students’ authentic voice and independent writing skills
  • Brainstorm creative academic, leadership, research, and professional experiences aligned with students’ goals
  • Meet remotely with students and families
  • Collaborate with fellow mentors and senior team members to support student success
  • Manage a flexible caseload based on your availability and interests

Why People Enjoy This Role:

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible scheduling and caseload options
  • Opportunity to build meaningful mentoring relationships
  • Intellectually engaging and rewarding work
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Multiple engagement paths available, including part-time contract, part-time salaried, and potential full-time opportunities
  • Opportunity for long-term growth within the organization

You May Be a Great Fit If You:

  • Are an exceptional writer and communicator
  • Enjoy mentoring, coaching, or advising students
  • Have experience in education, admissions, academic advising, tutoring, consulting, or related fields
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree from a U.S. college or university
  • Have teaching, admissions, graduate school, or research experience (strongly valued but not required)
  • Are organized, empathetic, and able to build trust with students and families

The compensation for this role will generally fall within the range of $25 - $50 an hour, though compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on experience, expertise, availability, and level of engagement. We welcome open conversations throughout the hiring process and aim to align compensation with the strengths and impact each individual brings to the team.

Who Are We?

Founded in 2013 by law students from Harvard and Yale, InGenius Prep has grown into a global organization with team members and offices across the U.S., Canada, China, and beyond. We partner with students pursuing admission to U.S. colleges and graduate programs through highly personalized mentorship, long-term development, and strategic guidance. Our work extends far beyond applications, helping students build confidence, explore academic and professional interests, strengthen extracurricular profiles, and tell their stories authentically. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving organization that values intellectual curiosity, thoughtful mentorship, and meaningful student impact. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, grow their responsibilities, and help shape the future of the organization as we continue to expand.

Benefits:

InGenius Prep offers employees a competitive salary along with remote work flexibility, professional development and a fun, collaborative work environment.

What We Believe:

InGenius Prep is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Salary: $25 – $50 / hour

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Physical Security Systems & Services - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary Provides senior level support for Molina Physical Security enterprise applications.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Provides senior level support for Molina Physical Security enterprise applications. Responsible for executing and managing the applications that support physical security operations, emergency response, and health and safety across the Molina enterprise. Implements, supports and maintains Molina's business applications, analyzes system requirements and performs and/or coordinates system and regression testing for business applications.

Essential Job Duties

  • Collaborates with third parties and in-field contractors for ongoing support and maintenance of applications. Oversee system commissioning and troubleshooting. Provides real-time technical guidance and serves as subject matter expert to ensure consistent installation standards.
  • Program and configure security devices, including access control systems, and CCTV systems, intrusion detection and visitor management programs as designed and instructed by the Physical Security Governance Team.
  • Serves as a technical subject matter expert for Physical Security, supports the business with go-lives, operation, maintenance, and enhancements to physical security systems.
  • Meets with application owners/users to review upcoming trends, maintenance, system enhancements and support-related issues on a periodic basis.
  • Liaises with stakeholders to ensure system strategy alignment and continuous delivery of enhancements to support growing business operations.
  • Supports incident response and crisis management activities during disruptive events as needed.
  • Provides training and guidance to the user community on the use of related applications.
  • Provides guidance and assistance to service desk for issues involving applications.
  • Evaluates system requirements and coordinates regression testing for business applications.
  • Engages with the information technology (IT) infrastructure team for configurations and ongoing operations of applications.
  • Develops and maintains system documents, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and user training documents.
  • Collaborates with information technology (IT) business analysts on new system requirements and solutions based on those requirements.
  • Facilitates change management, training, and communication to the user community for applications.
  • Ensures that the technical service catalog is kept up-to-date for existing and new applications.
  • Provides regular status reports and develops metrics for business applications for reporting to leadership.
  • May be required to work outside of normal business hours (nights, evenings, and weekends) if supporting activities in other Timezones or responding to emergencies.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years experience in physical security services and at least 3 years of experience as a field technician, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Comprehensive understanding of practices, principles, processes and tools related to physical security, risk management, health and safety, and emergency response.
  • Business continuity/security systems/technology integration experience.
  • Ability to create, run and analyze queries.
  • Advanced data analysis and reporting experience.
  • Understanding the flow of data, business processes, technical interfaces that would be created or impacted.
  • Ability to meet and manage project delivery deadlines.
  • Critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize information and manage tasks and projects to support business needs.
  • Ability to flexibly accept dynamically changing priorities.
  • Strong project management experience/skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and ability to present information to internal/external stakeholders.
  • Microsoft Office suite (including advanced Excel), and applicable software program(s) proficiency.
  • Familiarity with Avigilon, Lenel, Mercury panels Acre/Feenix, Bosch intrusion panels.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical Certifications: Proficiency in security systems validated by manufacturer certifications (e.g., LenelS2, Genetec, Avigilon ACM, Bosch G-Series, Feenics, Axis, or AMAG Symmetry).
  • Infrastructure & Trade Expertise: Hands-on experience validated by industry certifications (e.g., BICSI Installer 2, CompTIA Network+, ALOA CRL, or NICET) to ensure expertise in cabling, network connectivity, and physical hardware integration.
  • Completion of an accredited trade school program in Electrical Systems, Low Voltage, or Security Systems Integration; alternatively, a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or IT/Networking is accepted. In all cases, extensive, hands-on field experience in panel-level installation and troubleshooting is required.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

Management reporting

Policy and process documentation

  • Review and approval of marketing incentive plans and proposals before passing them for approval to Financial Controller/ Managing Director
  • Update Delegations of Authority due to any changes in business requirements
  • Understand current processes and propose improvements
  • Prepare other processes and policy documents that the business might require on an as needed basis

Other key responsibilities

  • Update and analyse weekly and six monthly cash flow reports before submission to treasury and management

Background and experience

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience leading and managing a team that needs support and development
  • Computer literate & knowledge in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
  • Good communication and command of written and spoken Thai and English

jobs.title: Senior Podcast Showrunner/Producer
jobs.excerpt: Pink Elephant is a venture builder and investment company developing an ecosystem of progressive mental health solutions.
jobs.description:
Pink Elephant is a venture builder and investment company developing an ecosystem of progressive mental health solutions. Our portfolio combines media, diagnostics, e-commerce, telemedicine, and technology to make evidence-based therapies and holistic practices more accessible. We focus on Europe and other advanced markets, preparing infrastructure for the coming wave of psychedelic and mental health innovation.

States of Mind is our video-first media at the intersection of mental health and psychedelics. It runs two shows. Human Journeys is built for reach and tells lived stories. Process in Progress is built for authority: it documents the clinicians, facilitators, researchers, and regulators who are building the industry while it takes shape. Both shows follow one honesty rule: difficult and ambiguous stories go on air alongside the successes.

The Role

The Showrunner takes over Process in Progress end to end and answers for one thing above all: whether more people watch it. You decide what gets made, run the recordings, and own the numbers. Editing and production stay with our external editing agency, which you brief and whose cuts you accept or send back.

We are hiring a show-builder. The person we want has already made a recurring format accumulate a following, on whichever platforms the audience turned out to live. The mandate starts with one show and is designed to grow across the slate: you set the craft standards for both current shows now and lead future shows as we add them.

Psychedelic therapy and interventional psychiatry are becoming real medicine, unevenly and noisily, with genuine promise and genuine casualties. We think this transition needs media people can trust: rigorous about evidence, honest about failures and costs, and human about the people living through it and building it. We expect you to find this subject worth years of your curiosity.

Responsibilities: What You Will Drive

The show's audience outcome

  • Owning people per month and engaged share, measured in named platform fields (Apple Listeners, Spotify Audience, YouTube unique viewers);
  • Working against floor, target, and stretch goals, and changing the approach whenever the show falls below floor;
  • Following the audience wherever it accumulates. If growth lives in vertical social rather than long-form YouTube, the measurement fields change (IG Reach, Shorts viewers) and the ownership stays with you;
  • Sharing one bridge metric with distribution: followers and subscribers converted per episode across platforms. You create the moments that convert, distribution ships and places them. Channel health, total social following, and collabs remain distribution's numbers.

Pre-production and recording

  • Guest research and dossiers;
  • Episode scripts with the arc, key questions, and clip moments planned in advance;
  • Briefs for guests and co-hosts;
  • Running every recording as the showrunner. Clip moments are created in the room, the edit only finds what was already captured.

Growth loop

  • A packaging hypothesis for every episode (title, thumbnail, first 60 seconds, structure) and a review of what worked;
  • Clips as the main acquisition channel;
  • Reading retention curves, watch-through, and first-7-day performance, and carrying the conclusions into the next episode;
  • Killing formats that fail to move the numbers two episodes in a row.

Guests and partnerships

  • Keeping a pipeline of 8+ confirmed guests who are either broadly known (around 100K+ following) or known in the industry (10-15K+);
  • Bringing institutional representatives (clinics, associations, researchers, regulators) into every second episode. Guest invitations are our partnership motion;
  • Arranging audience cross-sharing with other shows;
  • Logging every contact in the shared partner tracker with a next step.

Distribution kit

  • Handing clips, quotes, talking points, and per-platform titles to distribution at least 2 days before release. A release without its kit counts as an unfinished task.

Craft standards across the slate

  • Building the production and packaging playbook that both shows run on, together with the Head of Media.

Experience: What You Bring

  • A show you grew, with proof: its name, the starting and ending numbers, and what you changed;
  • 3+ years producing recurring talk, interview, or documentary formats across platforms, including social video;
  • Fluency in packaging, CTR, retention curves, and clips as acquisition. You read YouTube, Spotify, and Apple analytics yourself;
  • Experience briefing external editors and accepting or rejecting a cut;
  • Daily, systematic use of AI across the production loop, from guest research to clip selection and retention analysis;
  • Strong plus: work in health, science, medicine, or finance, and a show launched from zero.

What We Don't Expect

  • A psychedelics background. Almost nobody with this skill set has one, and substance is held by co-hosts and the editorial check. We need curiosity and respect for the field;
  • Ownership of content substance. Medical and substantive wording sits with hosts, co-hosts, and editorial, and the honesty rule is fixed rather than something to optimize;
  • Editing or motion craft. You will not cut video, the external agency does.

Engagement Format

  • Remote, European time zones (UK/EU). We work as a distributed team across Europe. US-based candidates are considered only with reliable overlap with a European working day;
  • A long-term team role. We are hiring a permanent member of the team;
  • Finalists complete a paid test assignment first. After that we start either full-time from day one, or with a fractional first quarter (2-3 days per week, one show) that converts to full-time as the slate grows. We agree the start with the right person.
Salary: TBD

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well.

jobs.description:
Request for Proposals: Auditor

Our Story: MOBILIZE, ORGANIZE, VOTE AND EMPOWER

MOVE Texas is a nonpartisan, nonprofit, grassroots organization working to build power in underrepresented youth communities through civic engagement, leadership development, and issue advocacy. In 2013, MOVE was founded by a small group of dedicated students at the University of Texas at San Antonio to increase participation in local elections. Since then our work has gone statewide to become one of the most effective voter registration and engagement groups in the state. Our theory of change is simple: develop new leaders, educate voters and create space for the changes we need to make so that our state can be a place where all Texans can thrive. We believe that together we are transforming democracy in Texas and beyond.

MOVE Texas is a Texas-based organization focused on building the power of young people in our democracy. Our organizational structure includes two separate legal entities:

  • MOVE Texas Civic Fund (C3) – 501(c)(3)
  • MOVE Texas Action Fund (C4) – 501(c)(4)
  • Organizational Budget: $3.2 million combined budget, most of the money coming in is C3 money. MOVE Texas is C4 operating.
  • Finance Structure: Our Finance and Operations team manages accounting, payroll, accounts payable, budgeting, grant reporting, and financial compliance across both entities.

Deliverables

We are currently accepting proposals from audit firms that can support our organization with both historical and ongoing financial review and audit requirements.
We are looking for a firm that can help us evaluate the appropriate scope and sequencing of this work and develop a realistic timeline for bringing both entities fully current.

Our anticipated scope includes:

MOVE Texas Civic Fund (C3)

  • 2024 financial review
  • 2025 audit
  • 2026 audit
  • 2026 tax filings moving forward

MOVE Texas Action Fund (C4)

  • 2024 financial review
  • 2025 audit
  • 2026 audit
  • 2026 tax filings moving forward

Accounting Systems & Current Transition

MOVE Texas is currently transitioning its accounting infrastructure to Sage Intacct. As part of that process, we are transferring historical financial information and establishing integrations between Sage and our other financial and operational platforms.

Key systems include:

  • Sage Intacct – General ledger and accounting
  • Bill.com – Accounts payable
  • Divvy – Organizational credit cards and expense management
  • BambooHR – HR and payroll-related data
  • MIP – Legacy accounting system containing historical financial information

Bill.com has been connected to Sage Intacct, while additional integrations and historical data migration work remain in progress.

Organizational Considerations

Because MOVE Texas operates both a C3 and C4 entity, accurate allocation and documentation of shared expenses, payroll, intercompany activity, and grant-related expenditures are important components of our financial reporting.

We are seeking an audit partner that is comfortable working with:

  • Nonprofit organizations with affiliated C3/C4 entities
  • Federal and foundation grant funding
  • Cost allocations and intercompany activity
  • Accounting system transitions and historical data migration
  • Organizations working to strengthen financial processes while completing prior-year reviews and audits

Process:

Our goal is to establish a long-term relationship with an audit firm that can not only complete the required financial reviews and audits, but also communicate clearly with our internal finance team throughout the process. Proposals are only accepted through BambooHR.

The proposal should address the following:

  • Detail your firm’s experience in providing auditing services to nonprofits of a comparable size to MOVE Texas, and multi-entity nonprofits if applicable.
  • Why you believe you are the best partner for this project and what makes you different from your competitors
  • An overview of your approach, timeline, team and roles, use of technology and the communication process used by the firm to discuss issues MOVE Texas team.
  • Information and documentation needed from MOVE Texas
  • Minimum 3 year contract or multi-year pricing structure and estimated cost
  • Opportunities to establish an ongoing annual audit and tax filing relationship

  • Applications Accepted until Friday, October 30, 2026
  • You will be notified of the selection and any next steps the week of: November 4th
  • Contract Stat Date: Tuesday, November 10, 2026

About the role

team.blueis one of Europe's leading digital platform groups, operating across 17 countries with c.5,000 employees across multiple divisions. We are transforming our HR operating model - moving from a fragmented, locally-led function towards a data-driven, division-focused model built around three pillars: Centres of Excellence, Division High Impact HR, and HR Operations.

The HR Insights & Analytics Manager is a newly created role, sitting within the HR Centre of Excellence and reporting directly to the CHRO. This is a foundational hire: the person in this role will build the people analytics capability at team.blue from the ground up, turning disparate data across 17 countries and multiple HR systems into clear, actionable insight for divisional and group leadership.

This role is critical to the success of the new HR operating model. Without reliable, consistent and well-presented people data, we cannot hold divisions accountable, identify risks early, or make the case for the investments and changes we need to make. The right person will be as comfortable in a spreadsheet as in a boardroom.

What you will do

Build the foundations

  • Design and own the group-wide HR data and reporting framework, establishing consistent definitions, metrics and data standards across all divisions and countries

  • Lead the remediation of HiBob data quality - working closely with the HR Operations team to ensure clean, consistent input at source

  • Define and implement mandatory reporting standards across the business (headcount, attrition, vacancies, cost to plan, payroll accuracy)

  • Work with HR Systems and IT to ensure HiBob, Teamtailor, Culture Amp and other people systems are configured to support reliable analytics including the necessary integration work

Deliver insight to the divisions

  • Build and maintain division-level people dashboards, giving each divisional HR Director and CEO a clear, real-time view of their people metrics: headcount vs plan, attrition trends, open vacancies, time to hire, eNPS scores, performance distribution, and payroll cost

  • Identify patterns and anomalies in people data that carry business risk or opportunity - proactively bringing these to the CHRO and divisional HR Directors

  • Provide the analytical backbone for the annual salary review, merit cycle, and pay gap reporting processes

Enable strategic decision-making

  • Develop group-level workforce planning models that give senior leadership visibility over headcount trajectory, cost evolution and talent risk

  • Link people data to business performance metrics, helping divisional CEOs understand the relationship between engagement, attrition, and commercial outcomes

  • Support the governance framework with regular reporting for the HRLT and Division/HR QBRs

Drive the analytics agenda forward

  • Assess and develop AI and automation opportunities in people analytics — including predictive attrition modelling, hiring funnel analysis, and workforce cost simulation

  • Build internal capability over time, potentially developing a small analytics team as the function matures

  • Act as the internal expert and advocate for data-driven HR decision-making, challenging leaders where intuition is being used in place of evidence

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in people analytics, HR reporting, or workforce intelligence - ideally in a complex, multi-country or multi-entity environment

  • Proven track record of building HR analytics capabilities from an early stage - not just inheriting and running an established function

  • Experience working with HiBob or similar HRIS platforms; familiarity with engagement survey tools (Culture Amp preferred) and ATS platforms

  • Background in a company that has gone through structural transformation, M&A activity, or a shift from a decentralised to a more integrated operating model is a strong advantage

  • Experience presenting people data and insight to senior business leaders, including CEOs and board-level audiences

Skills and capabilities

  • Strong technical proficiency: advanced Excel/Google Sheets as a minimum; experience with BI tools (Power BI and Databricks, Zenlytic, Tableau or equivalent) strongly preferred; basic SQL or Python is an advantage

  • Ability to translate complex data into simple, visually clear narratives that non-HR audiences can act on

  • Strong business acumen — understands that people data exists to serve business outcomes, not HR process compliance

  • High attention to data quality and process rigour, with an instinct to fix root causes rather than patch outputs

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete data, making reasonable assumptions explicit and building in appropriate caveats

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to work across HR, Finance, divisional leadership and IT

Personal profile

  • Entrepreneurial and self-starting - this role requires building before running; it suits someone who is energised by creating something from scratch

  • Direct and confident communicator - able to push back on poor data practices and advocate for standards even when it creates short-term friction

  • Collaborative but opinionated - works well across a matrixed organisation but has a clear point of view on what good looks like

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, commercially-driven environment where priorities shift and speed matters

Location and reporting

  • Reports to: CHRO

  • Location: Flexible within Europe; regular travel to team.blue hub locations expected

  • Contract: 12 months, possibility to turn into permanent after

We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Product Manager AI

End-to-End AI Product Owner – Line of Business or Platform Aligned

Role Overview

The Product Manager / Product Owner – AI is responsible for end-to-end ownership of AI initiatives for a specific Line of Business or claims domain. This role partners directly with business stakeholders to define AI-enabled improvements to claims operations, cost control, and client service performance, and translates those objectives into structured, sprint-ready execution plans.

This role combines strategic initiative shaping with hands-on backlog ownership and daily collaboration with AI engineers and data scientists. It ensures that AI development is grounded in real operational pain points and that delivered solutions are practical, compliant, and measurable in impact.

Key Responsibilities

The Product Manager/Owner works directly with claims leadership, operational managers, and Business Transformation Leads to understand workflow bottlenecks, leakage drivers, customer friction points, regulatory risks, and client performance commitments. They translate these insights into clearly defined AI use cases with measurable operational objectives such as reduced claim cycle time, improved reserving accuracy, enhanced fraud detection rates, or improved document processing speed.

They decompose initiatives into epics and features that reflect real-world operational workflows, ensuring requirements account for system integrations, adjuster behavior, client reporting requirements, and compliance obligations. They collaborate with AI engineers and data scientists to validate feasibility, data availability, model explainability considerations, and downstream operational impact.

They own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring it remains prioritized according to business value and aligned with enterprise AI portfolio constraints. They prepare stories with detailed acceptance criteria that reflect actual claims scenarios and operational realities, not abstract technical requirements.

During sprint execution, they remain closely engaged with the delivery team, clarifying nuances of claims processes, regulatory rules, and client-specific variations. They validate that developed models, automation features, or decision-support tools function appropriately within the claims workflow and align with user expectations.

They communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to LOB stakeholders transparently, ensuring expectations are managed around sequencing and delivery timelines. Following deployment, they monitor adoption, operational metrics, and user feedback, adjusting backlog priorities based on real-world performance and measurable impact.

This role requires balancing operational urgency with disciplined backlog governance, particularly in environments where client escalations or regulatory deadlines may introduce pressure for rapid change.

Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in Product Management or Business-Technology roles within insurance, claims, or managed services
  • Strong understanding of claims operations, adjuster workflows, or insurance servicing models
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Ability to translate operational pain points into structured technical requirements
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills across business and technical audiences
