jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Internal Services Coordinator is a highly organized and detail-oriented individual contributor responsible for providing administrative, recruiting, training, compliance, and project support across the Internal Services Group.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Internal Services Coordinator is a highly organized and detail-oriented individual contributor responsible for providing administrative, recruiting, training, compliance, and project support across the Internal Services Group. This position serves as a central resource supporting Human Resources, Transportation, Supply Chain, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Risk Management, and Executive Leadership.

The Internal Services Coordinator plays a key role in recruiting administration, learning and development program management, driver compliance reporting, organizational reporting, project coordination, and cross-functional administrative support. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, initiative, professionalism, the ability to manage competing priorities, and a commitment to confidentiality.

Core Duties & Responsibilities

Recruiting Administration

  • Manage job postings across recruiting platforms including BambooHR, Indeed and other sourcing channels.
  • Coordinate candidate communications, interview scheduling, and hiring manager follow up.
  • Conduct applicant screening and initial qualification reviews.
  • Maintain applicant tracking records and recruiting metrics.
  • Support pre-employment activities including background checks, MVR reviews, and onboarding coordination.
  • Oversee I-9 documentation, EEO reporting and metrix.
  • Prepare recruitment reports and workforce planning updates.
  • Assist with recruiting campaigns, hiring events, and talent pipeline initiatives.
  • Manage new hire orientation scheduling and compliance.

Learning & Development Administration

  • Manage the company's Learning & Development platform.
  • Assign training programs and monitor completion status.
  • Generate training compliance reports for leadership.
  • Maintain employee learning records and certifications.
  • Support development initiatives, leadership training programs, and company learning campaigns.
  • Assist with administration of mandatory compliance training.

Driver Qualification & Compliance Support

  • Coordinate and maintain Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring processes.
  • Conduct biannual MVR reviews for applicable field personnel.
  • Track license expirations and driving record requirements.
  • Maintain driver qualification files and compliance documentation.
  • Assist with DOT-related administrative tracking and reporting.
  • Coordinate quarterly random D&A requirements.

Internal Services Administrative Support

Provide administrative support to:

  • Transportation Supervisor
  • Supply Chain Coordinator
  • HSE Manager
  • Director of Risk Management
  • Chief Operating Officer

Responsibilities may include:

  • Scheduling meetings and coordinating calendars.
  • Preparing reports, presentations, and meeting materials.
  • Maintaining records, logs, and departmental documentation.
  • Assisting with vendor communications and data collection.
  • Tracking departmental action items and project deliverables.
  • Supporting audits, compliance reviews, and operational initiatives.

Project Coordination

  • Assist in planning and coordinating special projects across the Internal Services Group.
  • Maintain project trackers and status updates.
  • Coordinate information gathering from multiple departments.
  • Follow up on deadlines, deliverables, and action items.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and process documentation.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare recurring reports for HR, Safety, Transportation, and Executive Leadership.
  • Compile workforce metrics, recruiting data, training compliance statistics, and operational reports.
  • Maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, and tracking tools.
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of organizational data.

General Responsibilities

  • Work safely and follow all company policies and procedures.
  • Champion EnerStar's Core Values.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding employee and company information.
  • Build collaborative relationships across departments.
  • Support organizational objectives and special assignments as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements

Education

  • Associate degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Project Management, or related field preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

Experience

  • 2+ years of administrative, HR, recruiting, project coordination, or business support experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple departments or leaders is an asset.
  • Experience with learning management systems or training platforms preferred.
  • Experience with BambooHR, BizLibrary, DISA, Novara Flex / KPA preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to prepare reports and analyze data.
  • Strong customer service mindset.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Product Marketing Manager

North - Remote (US)


Let’s go North, together.


Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.


Job Summary:

As a Product Marketing Manager, you are critical to the success of the product. You use your deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, merchant services, processing flows, and competitive landscape in order to create and communicate compelling product stories. You will integrate AI tools into your day-to-day workflow to streamline GTM execution, accelerate market research, draft customer-facing collateral, and scale GTM strategy. Our team is high profile and highly influential. This is a cross-functional role, and will work closely with Product Management, UX/UI, Engineering, Customer Service & Tech Support, Sales, and other internal teams throughout the discovery, delivery, and go-to-market process. You will ensure that appropriate multi-channel content, enablement tools, training, and messaging are developed to best position the product to both internal and external stakeholders.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and refine customer-centric product messaging, positioning, and value proposition designs tailored to merchant needs and buyer journeys.
  • Conduct continuous market and competitive intelligence to track industry trends, analyze competitive dynamics, and uncover product positioning opportunities.
  • Lead end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) execution and pilot programs, defining target personas and gathering qualitative and quantitative feedback to inform feature improvements prior to launch.
  • Collect, synthesize, and prioritize feedback and requests from merchants, sales partners, and internal organizations using modern AI prompting techniques.
  • Manage multi-channel product marketing activities and collateral for product launches, including app store assets, email campaigns, blog posts, social media, demo scripts, FAQs, and videos.
  • Partner with Sales to create high-impact sales enablement tools, such as pitch decks, one-pagers, and sell sheets that empower teams to win and retain business.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to build and maintain comprehensive support and training materials, including knowledge base articles.
  • Champion the merchant and customer perspective to ensure a stable, secure, and seamless payment processing experience

What We Need From You:

  • BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years experience in Product Marketing, preferably within financial services, fintech, payments, SaaS, or tech-enabled B2B environments.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, Gemini, CoPilot, Perplexity) to accelerate research, draft high-quality content, automate repetitive tasks, and scale GTM initiatives efficiently.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching products and executing GTM campaigns in complex, matrixed environments.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Must be a creative product thinker who connects daily marketing execution back to business goals and product strategy.
  • Exceptional communication skills to translate complex technical payment capabilities into clear, benefit-driven narratives.
  • Ability to navigate matrixed organizations, positively influence stakeholders, and align multi-departmental teams to keep GTM initiatives on schedule.
  • Deep understanding of payment ecosystems, merchant services, APIs, and payment infrastructure workflows.
  • Working knowledge of agile marketing processes, with the ability to leverage automation and AI prompting to double output without sacrificing quality.
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with ambiguity, staying ahead of evolving fintech and AI developments.

What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Education Assistance
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

Salary Range: $82,000-$112,000, 5% annual bonus

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.


Please note: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.


Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.

jobs.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft intelligenter Prozessautomatisierung
Du bist ein erfahrener Softwareentwickler, denkst gerne über einzelne Features hinaus und hast Lust, mit KI, Automatisierung und modernen Technologien echte Probleme zu lösen? Du möchtest nicht nur Anforderungen umsetzen, sondern selbst technische Lösungen gestalten und deine Erfahrung in ein interdisziplinäres Team einbringen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Rolle bei unsIn unserem Team Elbe arbeiten Menschen mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen und technischen Hintergründen gemeinsam daran, Geschäftsprozesse intelligenter, effizienter und zunehmend automatisiert zu gestalten.
Wir entwickeln Automatisierungen, verbinden bestehende Systeme, erschließen neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten für künstliche Intelligenz und schaffen Lösungen, die unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unseren Kunden die tägliche Arbeit erleichtern.
Dabei setzen wir auf einen pragmatischen Mix aus Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und klassischer Softwareentwicklung.
Als erfahrener Full-Stack Developer bringst du die technische Expertise mit, um unser Team auf das nächste Level zu heben. Du entwickelst selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt deine Teamkollegen dabei, technisch immer eigenständiger zu werden.

Das erwartet dich

  • Softwareentwicklung und Architektur: Du konzipierst und entwickelst eigenständig Anwendungen, Services, APIs und Integrationen – vom technischen Entwurf bis zum produktiven Betrieb.

  • Intelligente Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwickelst bestehende Automatisierungen weiter und setzt neue Lösungen um, beispielsweise mit n8n, APIs und individuell entwickelten Komponenten.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du integrierst KI-Modelle in bestehende Prozesse, entwickelst KI-gestützte Anwendungen und experimentierst mit neuen Technologien und Werkzeugen.

  • Systeme miteinander verbinden: Du sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Plattformen und Anwendungen zuverlässig miteinander kommunizieren und Daten sicher ausgetauscht werden.

  • Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du triffst fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und achtest auf Wartbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Qualität.

  • Wissen teilen und gemeinsam wachsen: Du unterstützt deine Kollegen bei technischen Herausforderungen, führst sie an professionelle Entwicklungspraktiken heran und etablierst gemeinsam mit ihnen nachhaltige Lösungen.

  • Eigenständig Lösungen schaffen: Du reduzierst technische Abhängigkeiten zu anderen Entwicklungsteams, indem du notwendige Komponenten selbst entwickelst und bestehende Schnittstellen sinnvoll nutzt.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Full-Stack-Umfeld.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner Softwarearchitekturen.

  • Erfahrung mit Backend-Technologien, APIs, Datenbanken und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme.

  • Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Technologien und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig umzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit Softwarequalität, Testing, Versionsverwaltung, CI/CD und dem Betrieb produktiver Anwendungen.

  • Interesse an KI-Technologien, LLMs, AI-assisted Development und Automatisierungsplattformen.

  • Die Fähigkeit, technische Herausforderungen pragmatisch zu lösen und dabei auch langfristige Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten.

  • Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, andere zu befähigen und gemeinsam technische Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Einstellung: Du musst nicht jedes Framework kennen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeiten kannst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Freude daran hast, in einem Team mit unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen zu arbeiten.
Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und reichen von kleinen Automatisierungen bis zu komplexeren technischen Lösungen.

Damit beschäftigst du dich beispielsweise:

  • Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und Datenverarbeitung, beispielsweise rund um Vermittler- und Vertragsdaten.

  • Entwicklung und Erweiterung von Schnittstellen zwischen unserer Maklerplattform Professional Works und externen Anwendungen.

  • KI-gestützte Verarbeitung und Auswertung von Gesprächstranskripten, einschließlich automatisierter Zusammenfassungen und Coaching-Ansätzen.

  • Integration von Kommunikations-, Support- und Marketingplattformen in automatisierte Workflows.

  • Entwicklung interner Werkzeuge für Reporting, Datenanalyse und operative Prozesse.

  • Technische Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung unserer Automatisierungslandschaft..

Dabei entscheidest du gemeinsam mit dem Team, wann eine bestehende Automatisierungsplattform die beste Lösung ist und wann individuell entwickelte Software den größeren Mehrwert bietet.

Warum diese Rolle besonders ist

  • Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassisches Entwicklungsteam, in dem ausschließlich Softwareentwickler sitzen und Tickets abarbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest mit Kollegen zusammen, die Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, Automatisierungen entwickeln, KI-Werkzeuge einsetzen und neue Ideen schnell ausprobieren.

  • Du ergänzt dieses Team um fundierte Softwareentwicklungs- und Architekturkompetenz.

  • Dein Erfolg zeigt sich deshalb nicht nur an dem Code, den du selbst schreibst, sondern auch daran, wie viel leistungsfähiger und eigenständiger das gesamte Team durch deine Arbeit wird.

  • Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Technologien mitzugestalten, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren und unmittelbar zu erleben, welchen Unterschied deine Lösungen im Unternehmen machen.

Benefits

  • Eine sympathische Unternehmenskultur mit reiner Duz-Kultur und einem freundschaftlichen Miteinander

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung und eine fundierte und individuelle Einarbeitung

  • Agiles Arbeiten und flache Hierarchien

  • Zahlreiche Mitarbeiter-Rabatte sowie Fahrtkostenzuschuss und bAV-Zuschuss

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Quavo is the industry leader in fraud and disputes management technology, offering the world’s only E2E cloud-based Disputes as a Service solution for issuing financial services organizations. Quavo is an organization of tenacious experts who are innovative and challenge complacency to continuously deliver cutting edge technology and AI. Our experts are passionate about delivering value in our solutions and empowering our client community to enhance and evolve industry standards in fraud and disputes management.

About the role:

As a Senior Account Executive focused on Tier 1 Banks and Credit Unions, you will own the full sales cycle for our largest and most strategic prospects and customers. You will engage C-suite and VP-level stakeholders across Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology, building the business case for QFD as a core infrastructure investment. This is a true enterprise sale—complex, consultative, and highly rewarding for closers who can run a rigorous MEDDPICC process: confirming Metrics with Economic Buyers, mapping Decision Criteria and Decision Process, developing strong Champions, implicating Pain, and outmaneuvering Competition across long procurement cycles and multi-stakeholder buying committees.

Responsibilities include:

Enterprise Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline (3-4x Quota) of Tier 1 banks ($50B+ assets) and large credit unions through outbound prospecting, referrals, channel partners, and industry events.
  • Map the full buying committee using MEDDPICC: identify the Economic Buyer as early as possible, intentionally recruit and develop a Champion inside the account, and document all influencers and blockers across Fraud Risk, Compliance, IT, and the C-suite.
  • Partner with Marketing and SDRs to convert inbound interest into qualified opportunities.

Consultative Solution Selling

  • Identify Pain by going beyond surface-level discovery to quantify the financial and operational cost of the status quo: dispute write-off rates, average handle time (AHT), compliance penalty exposure, and cardholder attrition tied to poor dispute experiences.

You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview:Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

In this role, you will support one of Arctiq’s clients in building an SRE Center of Excellence (CoE), working alongside other SRE leaders to establish standards, release discipline, and a consistent operating model across application teams.

With Dynatrace already in place, the focus is on improving application reliability throughout the release lifecycle. You will define reliability standards, embed them into pipelines and Dynatrace, and work with teams through release and on-call. The SRE team will own SLOs, production readiness, release gates, reliability practices, and incident follow-through, while the Observability CoE and Platform teams continue to own observability standards and agent deployment.

This is a 6-9 months contract opportunity (with potential extension).

Responsibilities:

  • Sit with two or three application teams in a wave. Leave behind templates they can run without you: tags, a small set of service-level objectives, synthetics, and a dashboard.
  • Start from a user journey (for example, sign-in through account summary), not from CPU. Choose a few service-level indicators, set a target and a time window, and track the error budget.
  • Build those objectives in Dynatrace and keep them as code, so non-production and production stay in step. Show compliance, burn rate, and status on a view an owner and an executive can both read.
  • Page on error-budget burn, not on every latency spike. Route alerts through the existing Dynatrace to ServiceNow path, with a runbook link in the payload.
  • Put production readiness in the delivery pipeline: a change is not ready for production until the synthetic passes, the reliability baseline has not regressed, and rollback has been tried. Prefer a blue-green release so the previous version can take traffic back.
  • Report the wave with DORA: how often the team ships, how long a change takes, how often it fails, and how fast it is restored. Tie that report to the error budget, not to a tool count.
  • Join the on-call rotation for the applications you embed with. During an incident, use Dynatrace and ServiceNow to find which journey is burning budget and which dependency is involved.
  • After a breach, run a blameless review and turn the outcome into a runbook or a backlog item. Do not leave the lesson in a slide.
  • Explain status in plain language: what was promised, what shipped, what is blocked, and what the next milestone is. App owners and leadership should not need a Dynatrace specialist to understand the update.
  • Lead the Center of Excellence with the other SRE leaders: one golden path, one set of standards, one way a wave is judged. Then carry that into the teams you embed with. Set the reliability bar, train a champion on each team, and hold the error-budget review when a target is missed. You do not wait to be told the next step.

What Success Looks Like:

This work is delivered in defined waves, with clear outcomes and ownership.

First 90 Days

  • Establish one production-ready “golden path” for a critical application, including the user journey, SLOs, Dynatrace visibility, ServiceNow alerting, and pipeline release checks.

Each Wave

  • Enable application teams to independently promote changes using the established SRE framework and templates.

Monthly

  • Review error budgets and SLO performance with application owners.
  • Report SLO compliance alongside key DORA metrics, including deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore.

Definition of Done

A wave is complete when the application team can measure whether the user journey is meeting its reliability target and safely roll back a failed release, not simply when a dashboard is in place.

Requirements:

  • Strong SRE and reliability engineering experience, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, production readiness, and DORA metrics.
  • Hands-on Dynatrace experience, including RUM, services, synthetics, SLOs, alerting, dashboards, and distributed tracing.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, GitLab or similar tools, Infrastructure as Code, release controls, and automated reliability checks.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, APIs, client-server architectures, and blue-green or similar deployment strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of change management, incident response, on-call practices, ServiceNow, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience embedding reliability practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle, from development through production.
  • Proven ability to lead engineers or SRE practices, establish standards, and drive adoption across application teams.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, application owners, and business stakeholders.
  • An outcome-focused approach with experience managing clear milestones, deliverables, ownership, and timelines.

What this role doesn't own:

  • Installing OneAgent, RUM, or ActiveGate. Platform owns installs.
  • ServiceNow CMDB build.
  • Copying an existing Kibana or Splunk estate into Dynatrace one-for-one. New reliability work is a short list of journeys and objectives.
  • Feature delivery. Application teams ship the product. The SRE makes the release safe to ship.

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

Care Specialists

US Commercial, Market Access – Remote

Pharvaris is a Nasdaq listed late-stage biotech company developing bradykinin B2 receptor antagonists for bradykinin-mediated angioedema (including hereditary angioedema), with offices in Switzerland (Zug), the Netherlands (Leiden) and the USA (greater Boston area). We aim at bringing new, more convenient options to people who suffer sudden and prolonged attacks of swelling in multiple areas of the body including the airway, which can be life-threatening.

We have a culture built on the core values of considering others care-fully, leading with trust, ensuring rigor and diversity of thought, and contributing freely. Our company is driven by individuals committed to developing breakthrough therapies which can have a real impact on people’s lives. If you are looking for a place where your work can have meaning, and you can make a difference – Pharvaris is the place for you!

We are excited to be building our commercial business infrastructure to prepare for our first commercial launch. We are actively recruiting for the Patient Services Team, and we are looking for dynamic and experienced Care Specialiststo join our team and report to the Lead, Care Specialists.

The Care Specialist will exercise independent judgment and sound business discretion in administering complex patient-access operations for an assigned geography. This role assesses patient, provider, payer, and reimbursement needs; determines appropriate access-support strategies, case actions, and escalation pathways for complex or non-routine matters; interprets and applies patient-services policies and payer requirements; and serves as a knowledgeable resource for patients, healthcare providers, partners, insurance companies, and internal stakeholders seeking access to Pharvaris products. The role also provides case-management oversight for an assigned caseload while identifying risks, trends, barriers, and opportunities for process improvement that may require escalation, management recommendation, or broader patient-support program improvements impacting launch readiness and ongoing program effectiveness.

Location:

Pharvaris has offices in Switzerland (Zug), the Netherlands (Leiden) and the U.S. (greater Boston area) and, at Pharvaris, we promote and enable a flexible, hybrid work-environment and support our talent to be home based and work virtually. Whilst this is a remote role, you must be located in the US with a preference to the geography you cover or East Coast /Boston area.

Responsibilities:

  • Independently assess patient and caregiver access needs and determine appropriate support strategies to facilitate timely access to therapy
  • Exercise discretion in overseeing and prioritizing assigned caseload activities, identifying access barriers, determining next steps, and advancing cases through required access processes
  • Interpret patient-services policies and payer requirements to guide complex benefits investigations, prior authorization and appeal support, and stakeholder communications
  • Maintain case documentation for the assigned geography and use case insights to identify reimbursement trends, access risks, and opportunities for process improvement
  • Oversee resolution of complex patient-access matters, evaluate reimbursement pathways, and determine appropriate escalation or resolution strategies within delegated authority
  • Serve as an internal reimbursement subject matter expert by guiding cross-functional partners on payer requirements, access barriers, and strategic case considerations
  • Provide ongoing adherence and compliance support to patients in alignment with program requirements and approved processes
  • Contribute insights and recommendations in patient services and commercial strategy meetings based on reimbursement trends, case escalations, and program performance
  • Lead special projects and recommend operational improvements that enhance patient-support program efficiency, compliance, scalability, and launch readiness
  • Serve as a compliance role model for the commercial organization and broader Pharvaris community by identifying compliance concerns and recommending appropriate improvements
  • Conduct all activities with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, including the U.S. Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, U.S. anti-kickback laws, and the PhRMA Code

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience in rare disease patient support services, access and reimbursement, or related biotech/pharmaceutical roles involving independent decision-making may be considered
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive case management experience required, including responsibility for evaluating complex patient-access matters, determining appropriate resolution pathways, and managing non-routine reimbursement issues; rare disease experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience supporting patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers in a call center, customer service, or patient support environment requiring professional judgment, prioritization, and effective issue resolution
  • Advanced experience supporting pharmacy and medical benefit investigations, prior authorizations, appeals, reimbursement processes, and case escalations requiring analysis of payer requirements and application of program guidelines
  • Strong understanding of commercial and government payer requirements, coverage policies, access pathways, and the ability to interpret and apply those requirements to complex patient-access situations
  • Ability to identify reimbursement trends, assess access risks, recommend process improvements, and communicate strategic insights to internal stakeholders and management
  • Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment, exercise discretion with sensitive patient and reimbursement information, and manage priorities across an assigned geography
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as business needs require

We are looking for someone that has:

  • Patient first mindset
  • Collaborative Influence & Relationship Agility
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
  • Creative thinker

Pharvaris is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this role is $110,000-$150,000 per year. Actual compensation will depend on various factors, including but not limited to depth of experience, skill set, overall performance, and education. Pharvaris believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package. Base salary is just one component of our competitive total rewards strategy. In addition to compensation, this role offers the unique opportunity to help build and shape an early-stage commercial organization, meaningful ownership through equity, workplace flexibility, and flexible time off. We encourage candidates who are motivated by the full opportunity and alignment with our mission to apply, even if their current compensation falls outside the stated range.

Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

Join our world class team of diligent problem solvers, innovators, fresh thinkers, and communicators who excite and inspire others.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year Position Requirement: Full-Time FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Milford, Massachusetts Salary:135K - 160K+Work from Home!
jobs.description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Milford, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $135,000 – $160,000 / year

jobs.title: Virtual Front Desk & Practice Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an exceptionally articulate, tech-savvy, and proactive Virtual Front Desk & Practice Operations Specialist with elite English communication skills to serve as a high-level Virtual Assistant and Client Account Specialist.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptionally articulate, tech-savvy, and proactive Virtual Front Desk & Practice Operations Specialist with elite English communication skills to serve as a high-level Virtual Assistant and Client Account Specialist. In this dynamic, hybrid role, you will split your time between direct patient engagement (50% call, scheduling, and texting volume) and practice operations support (account management for partner practices, founder assistance, and AI workflow refinement).

The ideal candidate is naturally smart, highly adaptable, and comfortable jumping between phone calls on RingCentral / Quo, managing patient tickets in a centralized Work Hub, navigating Nextech EHR, and managing administrative follow-ups (faxes, prior authorizations, medical records). Perfect, polished, and accent-neutral English is mandatory, while specific EMR experience is secondary to sheer technical agility and quick-learning capability.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Virtual Front Desk & Practice Operations Specialist
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Standard U.S. Practice Hours (Monday – Friday)
  • Core Systems:Nextech EHR, RingCentral / Quo, Centralized Work Hub Ticket Queue, Google Workspace / Microsoft 365
  • Role Breakdown: 50% Front Desk / Patient Communication & Administrative Support | 30% Practice Account Management | 20% Founder Executive Support

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. High-Touch Patient Engagement (Calls, Scheduling & Texting): Handle incoming/missed calls, book and reschedule appointments, perform text outreach, and manage delicate or escalated patient conversations with warmth and poise.
  2. Work Hub Queue Execution: Manage and resolve assigned tickets daily—processing fax requests, submitting prior authorizations, tracking medical records, and routing clinical items to practices.
  3. Account Management & Process Optimization: Conduct weekly call report reviews for partner practices, train/update AI knowledge bases ("Teach Teri"), write step-by-step SOPs, and assist practice leadership with calendar and administrative support.

Core Responsibilities

Patient Communication & Front Desk Operations (~50%)

  • Execute daily outbound and inbound calls via RingCentral/Quo to return missed calls, confirm appointments, follow up on no-shows, and deliver practice messages.
  • Book, reschedule, and optimize provider calendars within Nextech EHR or digital scheduling platforms.
  • Manage prescription refill requests, insurance eligibility checks, and form follow-ups, routing all clinical inquiries directly to practice staff.
  • Handle complex call scenarios, including de-escalating upset callers or answering tricky questions that require human intervention.
  • Conduct administrative workflows: fax and email providers/pharmacies, submit prior authorizations, and request, track, and attach medical records to patient charts.

Account Management & Practice Onboarding (~30%)

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for partner clinics—managing onboarding, conducting regular check-ins, and reviewing call quality metrics.
  • Review weekly call reports to spot trends, missed opportunities, or unaddressed patient inquiries.
  • Update practice knowledge bases ("Teach Teri") by gathering accurate responses from clinic staff to continuously improve automated systems.
  • Synthesize practice reports and marketing data into concise, actionable summaries for clinic leadership.

Executive Support & Workflow Improvement (~20%)

  • Support company leadership with calendar scheduling, inbox follow-ups, meeting notes, vendor coordination, and special research projects.
  • Log manual tasks meticulously, tracking task durations and requirements to draft clear, step-by-step SOP guides.
  • Report platform bugs and usability feedback to the product development team and test new features prior to live clinic rollouts.

Requirements

  • Elite English Communication: Native-level, flawless spoken and written English skills with a calm, warm, and highly professional tone over the phone and in writing.
  • U.S. Healthcare Background: 2+ years of direct experience supporting a U.S. medical practice (Front Desk, Patient Coordinator, Medical Assistant, Referral Coordinator, or Practice Manager).
  • Administrative Competency: Demonstrated experience handling core office workflows: scheduling, referrals, prior authorizations, medical records requests, insurance checks, and digital faxing.
  • Tech Smart & Adaptable: Exceptional digital literacy; able to pick up new software, EMRs, and AI tools rapidly without needing extensive technical hand-holding.
  • HIPAA Compliance: Comprehensive understanding of Protected Health Information (PHI) and strict adherence to HIPAA privacy protocols.
  • Remote Workspace: Private, quiet, HIPAA-compliant home office equipped with a high-performance computer (PC/Mac), high-speed internet, backup power/internet solutions, and a noise-canceling headset.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with specialized EMR/PM systems such as Nextech, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or ModMed.
  • Experience in Ophthalmology or other surgical/medical specialties.
  • Experience in account management, customer success, or as an Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff at a growing healthcare company.

  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers
  • Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation
  • Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions
  • Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes
  • Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices
  • Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery
  • Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features
  • Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities
  • Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact
  • Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • 45 days: Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.
  • 60 days: Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.
  • 90 days: Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation
  • 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.
  • 1 year: Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

Who You Are

  • 2-3 years experience in implementation, project delivery, business analysis, customer onboarding, training, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate requirements into clear plans, workflows, documentation, or customer enablement materials.
  • Comfort managing timelines, risks, competing priorities, and customer expectations.
  • Solid understanding of data migrations and integration models (APIs, webhooks, batch processing)
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong stakeholder management abilities
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Collaborative team player who can also operate independently
  • Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, professional services, GRC, compliance, HR, legal, investigations, or risk-related environment (an asset!)

Perks and Benefits

  • Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)
  • Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
  • Generous professional development budget
  • RRSP/ 401k matching program
  • Half-day Fridays in the summer
