jobs.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. Employment Type : Full-time

About Teletask

Teletask powers public sector communication. Government and public health agencies use our automated text, voice, and email outreach to reach the families they serve. Our largest footprint is WIC (Women, Infants & Children) nutrition programs, where Teletask messaging drives appointment attendance for over 6 million participants across 35+ US states.

Teletask is at an inflection point, and we are building operational infrastructure to match the product. Teletask is now looking for a Senior Contract & Billing Operations Specialist to act as the operational engine for our revenue cycle. In this role, you will oversee the critical quote-to-cash process, ensure that deals are legally compliant, and successfully submitted through procurement portals. You will work hand-in-hand with our Finance team, including on POs and checks, so that nothing between a signed deal and cash in the bank falls through the gap.

What You'll Actually Do

Manage Bids & Procurement Portals

  • Execute RFP and Bid Submissions: Submit RFP responses, proposals, and bids via enterprise and government e-procurement portals (like SAP Ariba and Proactis).
  • Package Compliance Docs: Ensure every submission is accurate and complete by attaching all required vendor and compliance documentation, including SOC 2 reports, W-9s, and sole-source justifications.

Navigate Legal & Compliance

  • Broker Insurance & Terms: Coordinate with insurance brokers to secure Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and collaborate with internal stakeholders to review statutory-language edits during contract negotiations.
  • Maintain the System of Record: Keep our compliance repositories organized by accurately saving executed BAAs, HIPAA documents, and government addendums directly into Zoho Books.

Enable the Sales-to-Delivery Handoff

  • Validate the Deal: Serve as the vital bridge between a signed contract and client success. You will promptly reconcile inbound Purchase Orders (POs) against finalized agreements.
  • Give the Green Light: Act as the final gatekeeper for order fulfillment, providing the official authorization to the Sales team to initiate the customer onboarding ticket once the received PO is matched to the contract in Zoho Books and all other financial requirements are met.
  • Reconcile Usage and Overages: Ahead of each renewal, pull current-period usage reports, check past payment standing, and calculate overages to reconcile against the new renewal term.
  • Support Renewal Execution: Give Sales the overage breakdowns it needs for the renewal conversation, update quote expiration dates, issue renewal invoices, and provision added message credits once the renewal is approved.
  • Invoice and Follow Up: Issue invoices accurately and on time, and follow up on open POs, unpaid invoices, and outstanding submissions until each one is closed out.
  • Work Hand-in-Hand with Finance: Partner directly with Finance on POs and checks, including matching payments to invoices and flagging exceptions, so the two teams run one connected process.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 - 7 years in Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Sales Finance, or Contract Administration, ideally in a B2B SaaS or technology environment
  • Strong analytical skills. You can audit platform utilization data, calculate billing overages, and reconcile an account without a template to follow
  • Sharp attention to detail. You are the person who catches the missing signature page before it costs a bid
  • Comfortable operating as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Implementation
  • Deep understanding of government procurement processes, regulations, and compliance requirements
  • Experience navigating government contract management systems, portals, and reporting requirements
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to navigate the unique challenges and requirements of government contracts
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (utilizing pivot tables and VLOOKUPs)

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of experience directly handling government contracts
  • Experience with Zoho Books, Zoho CRM, or similar mid-market platforms preferred
  • Public sector or public health contracting exposure (cooperative purchasing vehicles, state term contracts, or WIC programs) is an asset
  • Experience building or documenting a quote-to-cash process
  • Hands-on experience executing formal vendor bids through enterprise or government e-procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Proactis, or similar)
  • Working fluency with SOC 2, HIPAA, and BAAs, plus the confidence to review statutory contract language

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Develop proficiency with attention to detail in the quote-to-invoice process and accurately process real quotes and invoices with minimal supervision.
  • Decrease the previous month's backlog of PO and invoicing by 50%.
  • Produce clean overage calculations and renewal reconciliations for accounts.
  • Build a solid understanding of our SaaS product's features and billing implications.
  • Regularly assess your own understanding and comfort level with core processes and concepts.
  • Proactively seek out additional learning resources or training opportunities to fill knowledge gaps.
  • Keep a running list of questions and topics to review with the trainer during available sessions.

Who You'll Work With

You will report to Teletask's executive leadership team and sit at the center of the revenue cycle. You will own routine decisions and submissions, recognize when a matter genuinely needs to be escalated, and stand behind your decisions rather than routing every ambiguity upward. A given day might mean a submission in the morning, a statutory-language edit at noon, and a validate deal implementation in the afternoon. The team is small by design, so the process you build becomes the way Teletask operates.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of the revenue cycle end to end bids, compliance, contracts, and renewal billing in one seat rather than split across four
  • The chance to build process in a business where operational machinery, not product, is the growth constraint
  • An entrepreneurial, fully remote environment with high visibility and autonomy
  • Exposure to the Solen Software Group portfolio company network and operating model

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Engineering Project Coordinator

Engineering Administrator | Supervisor: Engineering Project Manager | Full-time | Fully Remote

Position Overview

The Engineering Project Coordinator independently executes routine administrative and permitting activities for CalSolar’s Engineering Department, freeing Design Managers and engineers to focus on technical design, quality, constructability, and project delivery. The position owns assigned administrative deliverables from intake through completion—not simply reminders and status tracking. This is a nontechnical engineering support role with defined boundaries for project management, client coordination, and engineering decisions.

Primary Responsibilities

Project Intake & Information Collection

  • Check project intake packages against established requirements; identify missing drawings, utility/service information, site photos, equipment information, forms, and other supporting documents.
  • Obtain missing administrative documentation from internal teams and designated external contacts, coordinating client requests through the assigned Project Manager.
  • Maintain an actionable missing-information log with owners, due dates, and timely escalation of unresolved blockers before scheduled design milestones.

Permitting & AHJ Coordination

  • Independently assemble and submit permit and resubmittal packages once engineering plans and technical responses have been approved; complete administrative applications, uploads, and required forms.
  • Track permit numbers, fees, submissions, plan-check status, comments, resubmittal dates, approvals, and permit issuance; follow up directly with AHJ administrative staff.
  • Route technical comments to the responsible engineer or Design Manager; track responses and assemble the final resubmission without interpreting codes or preparing technical responses.
  • Retrieve and distribute issued permits and approved/stamped plans, and archive them in the designated project folders.

Document Control & Administrative Deliverables

  • Maintain project folders, document naming, revision history, current plansets, superseded documents, calculations, correspondence, and approval records in accordance with existing standards.
  • Prepare, route, and file administrative forms, signatures, document packages, and project closeout records.
  • Complete assigned repetitive data-entry and document-routing tasks without requiring routine Design Manager supervision.

Schedule, Task & Meeting Support

  • Maintain accurate administrative task status, assignments, deadlines, and next steps in established systems (Salesforce, Scoop, Smartsheet, Slack, and related tools).
  • Follow up on administrative action items through closure; identify stalled items and escalate to the accountable project or engineering owner.
  • Provide targeted scheduling, agendas, meeting notes, and action-item tracking when requested; attend handoffs or recurring meetings only when administrative support adds clear value.
  • Generate routine status reports from existing systems rather than requiring Design Managers to prepare duplicate updates.

Department Support

  • Support engineering staff onboarding, access requests, training scheduling, document distribution, and other recurring administrative needs.
  • Coordinate administrative document/status requests with the Utility Interconnection team without owning interconnection applications.
  • Assist with administrative communication of assigned design/drafting tasks while leaving technical direction and resource decisions to engineering leadership.

Ownership & Role Boundaries

  • Engineering Project Manager: supervises this role and owns engineering schedule oversight, workload priorities, resource coordination, and escalations.
  • Design Managers / Design Engineers: own technical direction, design reviews, QC, code interpretation, consultant technical coordination, and approval of technical deliverables.
  • Assigned Project Manager: owns client coordination, scope management, commercial commitments, and overall project communication. The Coordinator routes external/client requests through the PM unless expressly delegated.
  • Engineering Project Coordinator: owns execution and timely completion of assigned administrative tasks; does not change technical priorities, commit engineering resources, or independently revise project schedules.
  • Interconnection team: owns utility interconnection applications. Significant scope, schedule, budget, or resource issues escalate to the appropriate manager.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2+ years in project coordination, administrative support, construction documentation, permitting, or engineering support; commercial solar PV/BESS experience preferred.
  • Experience coordinating California city, county, or fire-department permit applications strongly preferred.
  • Ability to navigate construction plan sets, including site plans, solar layouts, single-line diagrams, and plan-check comments, without performing technical review.
  • Strong ownership, organization, persistence, professional written/verbal communication, and ability to manage many concurrent administrative deliverables.
  • Proficiency with PDF and document-control workflows, preferably Bluebeam; comfort with Google Workspace, Salesforce, Scoop, Smartsheet, Slack, and similar systems.
  • Ability to follow existing procedures, recognize when technical input is needed, and escalate exceptions without creating unnecessary coordination layers.

Performance Expectations (Initial Targets)

Success is measured by completed administrative work and reduced Design Manager administrative burden, not by the volume of reminders or meetings. Initial targets will be calibrated against actual workload and baseline performance during the first 60–90 days.

  • Recover approximately 3–5 administrative hours per Design Manager per week, subject to baseline measurement.
  • Submit complete permit packages within one business day of technical approval when all prerequisites are available.
  • Provide weekly status updates for active permit applications; file received documents within one business day.
  • Close at least 90% of assigned administrative actions by their agreed deadlines; maintain visibility of exceptions.
  • Track missing project-intake documents and escalate blockers ahead of scheduled design starts.

CalSolar Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to a culture based on respect and performance.

Salary: $20-$29

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. About Diligent Pharma

Diligent Pharma is a trusted Quality and Compliance organization serving the clinical trial industry. We connect Trial Sponsors and pre-qualified Vendors through a secure, purpose-built platform that streamlines and accelerates vendor discovery, qualification, and management—delivering faster study start-up, greater efficiency, and stronger compliance for everyone involved.

Our innovative model and technology solve the decades-old problems that still plague our industry: vendor qualification is too slow and redundant. Sponsors continue to qualify vendors in silos, conducting the same audits repeatedly, while vendors must host those same audits time and time again. The result is an immense waste of time and resources across the ecosystem. Diligent Pharma breaks this dysfunction by serving as a truly independent third party that qualifies vendors once on behalf of multiple Sponsors—providing Sponsors with fast access to regulatory mapped qualification and the confidence to move their partnerships forward faster.

We’re on a mission to help deliver life-saving treatments to patients faster by accelerating the pace of clinical research.

The Opportunity

As Director, Client Partnerships, you will be a key revenue driver for Diligent Pharma, owning the full sales lifecycle from prospecting through close. You'll open doors with new pharmaceutical and CRO clients while deepening relationships within our existing account base. This is a consultative, solutions-oriented role for someone who thrives on building meaningful client partnerships and delivering measurable impact.

If you're energized by the challenge of building something significant in a fast-moving, innovative company — and you have a track record of winning in the clinical research space — we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Drive Revenue & Pipeline

  • Own and achieve your assigned sales quota with full accountability across the sales lifecycle — from opportunity identification through proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Build, manage, and accurately forecast a robust sales pipeline

Grow & Retain Client Relationships

Contribute to Company Growth

  • Collect and share competitive intelligence to inform sales strategy and go-to-market approaches
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, contracts, marketing, and technical teams to support deal execution and client success

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of sales or business development experience selling solutions or services to pharmaceutical companies and/or CROs

  • Understanding of the clinical trial market and competitive landscape
  • Experience with ClinOps
  • Experience as a consultative seller — you listen first, then craft solutions that genuinely address client needs
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and negotiation skills, including confidence in proactive outreach
  • Strong analytical thinking and opportunity qualification capabilities
  • Executive presence — comfortable engaging and influencing at all levels, including C-suite
  • The ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment
  • Bachelor's degree required

Why Diligent Pharma

At Diligent, we believe great work happens when people feel empowered, trusted, and supported. We are building a culture of ownership, growth and balance. The salary range for this position is $85,000-$120,000 plus uncapped commission. Being part of the Diligent team also includes benefits, such as:

  • Remote-first work environment with a collaborative, high-performance culture

jobs.description:
Buscamos un Trafficker Digital / Programmatic Trader especialista en CTV para integrarse al equipo de Mediam Group. Esta posición lidera la estrategia, implementación, optimización y análisis de campañas de televisión conectada, siendo responsable del ciclo completo de compra programática: desde la configuración en DSP hasta la resolución técnica en ad server y el reporte de resultados.

El perfil ideal cuenta con experiencia técnica sólida en el ecosistema programático de video y CTV, dominio de plataformas de demanda y oferta, y capacidad para traducir datos de performance en decisiones de optimización con impacto directo en resultados.

Ubicación: México

Modalidad: Remoto

Responsabilidades principales

1. Configuración, tráfico y ejecución de campañas CTV

  • Configurar, traficar y lanzar campañas de CTV en los principales DSPs del mercado, garantizando la correcta implementación de píxeles, creatividades y segmentaciones.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de especificaciones técnicas y lineamientos de calidad en cada activación.
  • Coordinar con los equipos de estrategia y cliente para garantizar alineación entre objetivos de negocio y configuración técnica de las campañas.

2. Gestión de inventario – PMPs y Programática Garantizada

  • Negociar, configurar y monitorear acuerdos privados (Private Marketplace – PMPs) y Programmatic Guaranteed con SSPs y publishers clave de CTV.
  • Administrar el pipeline de deals activos, asegurando disponibilidad de inventario y cumplimiento de compromisos de entrega.
  • Establecer y mantener relaciones técnicas con SSPs y publishers estratégicos del ecosistema CTV.

3. Ad Serving y control técnico

  • Administrar el ad server para asegurar la correcta entrega de piezas bajo protocolos VAST/VMAP, controlando latencia, discrepancias de datos y calidad de reproducción.
  • Diagnosticar y resolver problemas técnicos en la cadena de suministro (troubleshooting de tags, macros, píxeles y carga de creatividades).
  • Garantizar la integridad del flujo de ad serving de extremo a extremo.

4. Optimización continua y análisis de performance

  • Monitorear diariamente el rendimiento de las campañas basándose en KPIs críticos de CTV: VTR (Video Through Rate), Viewability, Cobertura/Frecuencia y CPM.
  • Desarrollar reportes de rendimiento e insights accionables para los equipos de estrategia y clientes, cruzando datos del DSP, SSP y Ad Server.
  • Identificar oportunidades de optimización de puja, segmentación e inventario para maximizar la eficiencia de cada campaña.

Requisitos técnicos

  • DSPs (Demand-Side): Experiencia avanzada en compra programática de video y CTV. Manejo de algoritmos de optimización de pujas y control de frecuencia cross-device. Herramientas: DV360, Amazon DSP, Activate DSP.
  • SSPs (Supply-Side): Configuración de deals (PMPs), troubleshooting en la cadena de suministro y relación con exclusivas de CTV. Herramientas: Magnite, PubMatic, Xandr, Google Ad Manager, Equativ.
  • Ad Servers: Dominio en alojamiento y distribución de piezas de video de alta calidad, manejo de tags, macros y protocolos VAST/VMAP. Herramientas: Innovid, CM360, Magnite, Springserver, Equativ.
  • Analítica y datos: Capacidad para cruzar datos de múltiples plataformas y construir reportes de performance con insights accionables.

Experiencia requerida

  • Experiencia en trading programático o trafficking digital, con foco en video y CTV.
  • Experiencia demostrable en configuración y optimización de campañas en al menos uno de los DSPs indicados.
  • Conocimiento práctico de protocolos de ad serving para video (VAST, VMAP) y resolución de discrepancias técnicas.
  • Deseable: experiencia en empresas del ecosistema CTV/AdTech (SSPs, publishers de streaming, plataformas de video digital).

Competencias clave

  • Orientación al detalle: Capacidad para gestionar configuraciones técnicas complejas con precisión y sin margen de error operativo.
  • Pensamiento analítico: Habilidad para interpretar datos de múltiples fuentes, identificar patrones de performance y tomar decisiones de optimización basadas en evidencia.
  • Resolución de problemas: Capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver problemas técnicos en tiempo real bajo presión operativa.
  • Proactividad: Iniciativa para anticipar riesgos de entrega, proponer mejoras en procesos y actuar sin necesidad de escalar cada decisión.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

En Mediam Group estamos redefiniendo el ecosistema de CTV a nivel global. Somos representantes oficiales de ViX en más de 14 países de Latinoamérica y operamos en la vanguardia del inventario programático premium para marcas líderes de la región.

  • Trabajar en la frontera del ecosistema CTV y programático en LATAM, con acceso a las plataformas y partners más relevantes de la industria.
  • Nuestra cultura corporativa se sustenta en valores como el accountability, la productividad, la mejora continua y la innovación.
  • Somos un equipo internacional que se fortalece en la diversidad, se apoya y crece en unidad.
  • Compensación competitiva con planes reales de crecimiento profesional.

Nos comprometemos contigo a llevar un proceso de atracción, selección y evaluación transparente, alineado a la igualdad de oportunidades.

jobs.description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $115k - $135k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Commerce City, Colorado

Salary:

115K - 135K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

Salary: $115,000 – $135,000 / year

jobs.description:

With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.

Job Title:

Corporate Events Manager

Company:

Prologis

A day in the life

The Corporate Events Manager leads the strategy, design and delivery of a portfolio of high-touch experiences for clients, brokers, executives and employees. The portfolio includes destination programs, executive meetings, retreats, sports hospitality and other signature events with complex travel, production and guest service requirements.

This person partners with business and marketing leaders to define objectives, audiences, messaging and measures of success, then translates that direction into distinctive experiences that strengthen relationships and support business priorities. As an individual contributor, the role leads agencies, vendors and cross-functional teams while remaining hands-on through planning and onsite execution.

Key responsibilities include:


Event Strategy and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Lead event strategy for assigned programs from the initial brief through post-event analysis, ensuring each program supports defined marketing and business objectives.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to senior stakeholders. Help clarify goals, target audiences, messaging, program format and the role each event should play within a broader business or relationship strategy. Align partners across Marketing, regional teams, executive offices, Sales, Communications, Legal, Security and Procurement.
  • Develop a clear plan of record for each program, including objectives, audience, narrative, experience principles, success measures, scope, decision rights and key milestones.
  • Advise stakeholders on feasibility, investment level and tradeoffs. Recommend changes when the proposed format, timing or spend does not support the stated objective.

Experience Design and Production

  • Shape the creative direction and guest journey for programs with high production value and white-glove service, from invitation and arrival through departure and follow-up.
  • Translate the event strategy into an integrated experience across content, destination, venue, hospitality, travel, entertainment, gifting, branding, production and onsite service.
  • Manage end-to-end planning and delivery, including RFPs, site selection, contracts, room blocks, food and beverage, audiovisual production, transportation, registration, communications, staffing, run of show and contingency planning.
  • Maintain clear project plans, roles and approval points. Anticipate the needs of executives and guests, resolve issues calmly and protect the guest experience when plans change.

Budget, Vendor and Risk Leadership

  • Develop and manage budgets for individual events. Build cost models, prioritize spend, evaluate alternatives and recommend where investment will have the greatest effect on the guest experience and business outcome.
  • Manage approved budgets, forecasts, commitments, change orders, invoices and final reconciliation with a high degree of accuracy and transparency.
  • Lead venue, hotel, agency, production, destination management and other vendor partners. Set expectations, evaluate performance, negotiate terms and hold partners accountable for quality, cost and service.
  • Identify operational, contractual, financial, reputational and guest-safety risks early. Develop contingency plans, escalate decisions when needed and ensure programs follow company policies and brand standards.

Measurement and Portfolio Improvement

  • Define success measures with stakeholders before planning begins. Establish practical methods to evaluate attendance, engagement, relationship value, satisfaction and contribution to business objectives.
  • Lead post-event reviews and present concise findings, budget results and recommendations. Use attendee feedback and performance data to provide recommendations that inform future event planning and investment.
  • Track hospitality, travel, event technology and production trends. Introduce useful ideas and contribute to team standards that improve consistency across the event portfolio.
  • Demonstrate financial success and comprehension of applicable real estate market/submarket

Building blocks for success


Required:

  • Six or more years of corporate events, experiential marketing, hospitality or related experience, with a record of leading complex, multi-day programs for executive or client audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop event strategy, connect programs to business and marketing priorities and advise senior stakeholders.
  • Experience designing premium guest experiences that require high service standards, detailed travel coordination and complex onsite production.
  • Strong financial judgment, including budget development, forecasting, scenario planning, contract negotiation, expense management and reconciliation.
  • Experience leading agencies, production partners, venues and cross-functional teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset who takes initiative, works independently and follows through on commitments.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders, influence decisions and bring stakeholders along.
  • Strong project leadership, organization, attention to detail and calm problem-solving in a fast-paced environment with concurrent programs, compressed timelines and demanding live events.
  • Working knowledge of hotel and venue contracts, food and beverage, audiovisual production, guest travel, registration, event technology and onsite operations.
  • Ability to travel frequently and work outside standard business hours when required by the event schedule.
  • Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

Preferred:

  • Experience with destination programs, executive retreats, sports hospitality, luxury hospitality or comparable high-touch events.
  • B2B or commercial real estate experience.
  • Experience with Bizzabo or a comparable event platform, Salesforce and Wrike.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. CMP, CMM or related industry certification is a plus.

Hiring Salary Range of: $108,000 - $122,000 . Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

People First

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here.

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. jobs.description:
Sobre Nosotros:

En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible. Lo hacemos a través de nuestras membresías de salud, que integran:

  • Atención clínica enfocada en la prevención
  • Cobertura médica de gastos mayores
  • Programas de bienestar y comunidad

Somos la primera empresa en México que protege a personas adultas mayores, desde los 50 hasta los 84 años. Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas, haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna.

Sobre el puesto:

Como Guía Koltin, eres la primera persona de Koltin con la que habla un futuro miembro. Contactas a personas que ya mostraron interés, entiendes qué necesitan ellas y su familia, y las acompañas hasta elegir la membresía correcta y cerrar la venta: cobro y firma.

Para nosotros, una buena venta es una que el miembro entiende, usa y renueva. No buscamos a quien venda a toda costa, sino a quien asesora de verdad.

A quién buscamos:

Buscamos a alguien que no necesita que estén detrás de ella para dar resultados: que se toma su cartera como propia, cuida a cada persona con la que habla y siempre está buscando cómo hacerlo mejor.

  • Empática:Escucha antes de hablar y entiende lo que de verdad le preocupa a una persona y a su familia.
  • Organizada y estructurada: Tiene su agenda, su pipeline y sus pendientes bajo control; nada se le pasa.
  • Autónoma: Sabe qué tiene que hacer y lo hace, sin que nadie tenga que estar detrás. Siempre vas a tener acompañamiento, pero esperamos ownership.
  • Da seguimiento:Cierra los círculos que abre, con clientes y con su equipo.
  • Ambiciosa: Le gustan los retos y las metas, y siempre busca ir más allá de lo que se le pide.
  • Se adapta al cambio:En una empresa que crece rápido, los cambios le parecen oportunidades y no obstáculos.
  • Proactiva y de mejora continua: Ve lo que se puede hacer mejor y llega con propuestas a la mesa.

Lo que harás:

  • Contactar y dar seguimiento a tus leads por teléfono y WhatsApp, con disciplina en cada etapa del funnel.
  • Asesorar de forma consultiva: explicar la membresía con claridad y ayudar a elegir según necesidades, presupuesto y momento de vida.
  • Cerrar la venta (cobro y firma) y pasar al miembro al equipo de post-venta con toda la información en orden.
  • Registrar tu actividad en el CRM y cuidar la calidad de cada venta.
  • Compartir con tu equipo lo que funciona y proponer mejoras al proceso.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia en ventas o atención a clientes.
  • Tener disponibilidad para trabajar de forma remota (para esta modalidad se excluyen los estados de CDMX, Edo. Mex, GDL y MTY)
  • Disponibilidad de tiempo completo e ingreso el primer lunes del mes de tu generación.
  • Uso de computadora, WhatsApp y herramientas digitales; experiencia con un CRM (HubSpot u otro) es un plus.

🎓 Acceso a herramientas y beneficios para tu crecimiento profesional, como cursos, talleres, libros, etc
💊 Asistencia médica privada por videollamada (médico general, nutriólogo y psicólogo) ilimitado para ti y 3 familiares

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavours.

Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility and multidisciplinarity. We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team player, who likes to share knowledge and is open to learn from others. We embrace problem solvers, those who aren't afraid to experiment and fail and are ready to create something new.

JOB DESCRIPTION

ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process.

When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule “show, don’t tell”. In what comes to interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The NARRATIVE DESIGNER must think in actions and interactions. As interactive storytellers, we invite the audience to take actions and immerse their body within a story. Therefore, it is very important to take the medium into account and consider the user’s body when designing a VR experience.

The ND's job is to make sure the interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the particularities of each project.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:

  • Working within the team, the Narrative Designer conceives, creates and advocates appropriate narrative features, as well as writes narrative content and ensures it is embraced by the final product;
  • Bring out documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotions curve, beat sheet, synopsis, mind map, screenplay and any other similar tool;
  • Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, events. Together with the Production Design team and the creative director, bring out worldbuilding systems;
  • Collaborate with the Development team to create real time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience;
  • In collaboration with the Game Design team and the Creative Director, define the flow of events inside the experience; follow the implementation of dialogues, animations, audios, events timings, props etc;
  • Create a functional documentation and make sure the entire team and stakeholders are constantly irrigated by the narrative elements;
  • Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive, from the user’s point of view; follow and report user tests;
  • Produce texts summarizing the narrative content for distribution purposes (festival registrations, pitch decks);
  • Create a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.

MUST HAVE:

  • Exceptional writing ability;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English languages;
  • Willingness to observe, absorb and modify their own work on behalf of each project;
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact, both verbal and written, with team members of different disciplines;
  • Previous experience in narrative content creation teams;
  • Constantly looking for learning new skills and increasing their repertoire;
  • Always giving and receiving constructive and creative feedback;
  • Fully understanding and experience creating narrative structures, plots beats, emotional progress and all elements of classical storytelling;
  • Willingness to find the balance between narrative, interaction and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, and ability in the integration of story and interactions/game-play into the final product;
  • Passion for Movies, TV, Visual Arts, Litterature, Theater, great stories in general, independently of their media;
  • Previous scriptwriting for film, TV or games;
  • Technical or Bachelor of Arts, Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Be open to learning new methods and frameworks.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Be familiar with Google G Suite, and screenwriting softwares;
  • Previous knowledge or experience with VR and AR content is desirable;
  • Experience in writing at a studio or production company, or equivalent writing experience in a role at an established content producer;
  • Video Games industry experience is a plus;
  • A passion for Virtual Reality

jobs.excerpt: About the Team/RoleWe are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Principal Data Scientist with deep payments expertise to help define and build the next generation of intelligent payment products.
jobs.description:
About the Team/Role

We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Principal Data Scientist with deep payments expertise to help define and build the next generation of intelligent payment products. This individual will combine hands-on data science, machine learning, payment-domain expertise, and strong product instincts to identify high-value opportunities hidden within corporate payments data and turn them into production-ready intelligence. This is not a traditional analytics or reporting role. The successful candidate will start with ambiguous business problems, explore data, form hypotheses, build models and signals, and partner with Product and Engineering to turn insights into scalable capabilities. The role offers near-greenfield opportunity and end-to-end ownership within Corporate Payments, with a focus on revenue growth and measurable business value.


The initial focus includes exploring opportunities such as BIN routing optimization, where small improvements across high transaction volumes may create significant net benefit, as well as supplier onboarding, customer acquisition, and identifying suppliers that already accept card payments and could be connected to WEX customers. Over time, this work can help establish a trusted intelligence foundation for future AI agents and agentic payment experiences.


What You’ll Do:

  • Discover high-value payment opportunities by combining deep payments knowledge with exploratory data science and machine learning.
  • Use corporate payments data to identify opportunities for revenue growth, improved payment economics, supplier onboarding, and new customer acquisition; identify additional data that could unlock further analysis.
  • Build intelligent payment data products that move beyond dashboards to predictions, recommendations, optimization, and decisioning.
  • Develop models and signals related to merchant and supplier behavior, payment acceptance, authorization performance, BIN/interchange optimization, payment routing, fraud/risk, and payment economics.
  • Create connected intelligence across customers, suppliers, merchants, transactions, payment methods, networks, and other payment entities.
  • Identify patterns in large-scale transaction data that can improve acceptance, payment performance, revenue, and margin; form hypotheses and prove value with rigorous analysis.
  • Prototype quickly using Python, SQL, machine learning, and modern data platforms to demonstrate value before scaling solutions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to productionize models, signals, and decisioning capabilities.
  • Design experimentation and measurement frameworks to demonstrate the incremental business value of models and recommendations.
  • Help define the semantic and contextual intelligence needed for future payments AI agents and agentic experiences.
  • Act as a thought partner to Payments leadership, proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for fully defined requirements.
  • Mentor data analysts and collaborate with data scientists across the broader organization, sharing practices and raising the technical and data-science bar.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in data science or a related quantitative discipline, including hands-on work building production machine-learning, predictive, optimization, or decisioning solutions.
  • Deep subject-matter expertise in payments, credit cards, payment transactions, or payment infrastructure. Strong domain understanding is essential; technical ability alone is not sufficient.
  • Experience in several relevant areas such as authorization, acceptance, interchange, BINs, merchant behavior, payment routing, fraud/risk, transaction economics, settlement, or payment-network dynamics.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working with large-scale transactional datasets. Able to move between exploratory analysis, feature engineering, modeling, experimentation, and productionization.
  • Ability to understand not only what happened in payment data, but why it happened and what the business could do differently.
  • A builder and entrepreneurial mindset: able to independently identify an opportunity, explore data, test a hypothesis, prototype a solution, and develop a business case without requiring a fully defined roadmap.
  • Strong product instincts and judgment to distinguish technically interesting work from work that creates measurable business value.
  • Ability to work directly with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Risk, and business leaders and to communicate clearly and succinctly with director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Customer empathy, proactive collaboration and sharing of learnings, accountability to lead by example, and willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively.
  • Established technical leadership and a collaborative approach to mentoring others while remaining open to learning from peers.

Nice to Have:

  • Advanced degree (master’s degree or above) in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Economics, or another quantitative discipline. Equivalent depth demonstrated through experience may be considered on a case by case basis.
  • Experience with R and modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks. Python and SQL are required; SAS alone is not sufficient.
  • Experience at a major card network, card company, payment processor, transaction-focused fintech, or financial institution.
  • Curiosity about GenAI and agentic systems and interest in designing intelligence that can ultimately be consumed by AI agents.

Why This Role Matters

Corporate Payments has an opportunity to unlock meaningful revenue and net benefit from data that has recently become available. This role will lead the discovery and validation of those opportunities, including payment-routing and interchange economics, supplier connectivity, and customer growth. The successful candidate will have the autonomy to build a portfolio of high-value work, influence business decisions with evidence, and help establish scalable intelligence capabilities for future payment products and agentic experiences. As the portfolio grows, there may be an opportunity to build a supporting team over time; direct people management is not part of the initial role, and continued individual-contributor growth is also supported.


The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $215,000.00 - $243,800.00

jobs.excerpt: Organization ProfileEvery year, millions of people around the world go missing as a result of conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, irregular migration, and other causes.
jobs.description:
Organization Profile

Every year, millions of people around the world go missing as a result of conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, irregular migration, and other causes. This is a complex global challenge that can be tackled effectively through cross-cutting programs that address a variety of difficult, interconnected issues.

The International Commission on Missing Persons (ICMP) is a treaty-based intergovernmental organization with Headquarters in The Hague, the Netherlands. Its mandate is to secure the cooperation of governments and others in locating missing persons from conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, migration and other causes and to assist them in doing so. To learn more about ICMP click here.

Purpose of the role

ICMP is seeking to establish a roster of Senior Legal Experts in Administrative Law to provide, on a needs basis, strategic and high-level legal advice on matters relating to the administration and management of the organization. The consultancy will support the Head of the Legal Unit and Principal Legal Advisor in overseeing complex legal issues related to internal governance, personnel policies, institutional risk management, and staff grievances. The consultancy may also involve strengthening ICMP’s internal legal and policy framework in line with best practices in international administrative law.

Key Deliverables

In coordination with, and under the oversight of, the Head of Legal Unit and Principal Legal Advisor, the Legal Expert will, when required:

  • Provide legal advice and analysis on complex matters relating to internal governance, institutional policies, and organizational compliance.
  • Support the review, interpretation, and development of personnel policies, procedures, and administrative frameworks to ensure alignment with applicable laws, regulations, and organizational standards.
  • Assist in identifying, assessing, and managing legal risks associated with institutional operations, governance, and human resources matters.
  • Conduct legal research and prepare opinions, memoranda, briefing notes, and other legal documents on issues related to governance, employment, and institutional risk.
  • Advise on staff appeals of administrative decisions, disciplinary matters, workplace disputes, and other employment-related issues, ensuring adherence to due process and organizational policies.
  • Review and draft legal documents, policies, guidelines, and internal governance instruments as required.
  • Support the handling of sensitive and complex legal matters, including investigations, dispute resolution, and conflict management, where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure legal considerations are integrated into organizational decision-making and policy implementation.
  • Monitor developments in relevant legal and regulatory frameworks and provide recommendations on their implications for the organization.
  • Prepare legal reports, presentations, and briefing materials for senior management and governance bodies, as required.
  • Contribute to strengthening institutional governance and legal compliance by identifying opportunities for policy and process improvements.
  • Perform any other legal advisory and support functions assigned by the Head of Legal and Principal Legal Advisor that are consistent with the scope of the consultancy.

Qualifications

  • Advanced university degree (Masters or equivalent) in Law.
  • Admission to practice law in a national jurisdiction.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressively responsible legal experience, with significant practical and advisory experience in the international administrative and employment law.
  • Previous experience working in or advising an international or intergovernmental organization.
  • Expert knowledge of international administrative jurisprudence and practice experience with legal proceedings before international administrative tribunals or dispute resolution bodies.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English; additional language skills (e.g., Arabic, French) are an asset.
  • Exceptional analytical, drafting, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to advise senior leadership and manage sensitive legal matters with discretion and sound judgment.

Duration

Subject to the timing of the recruitment process, the duration of the consultancy roster is envisaged to be for a two-year period, from 1 September 2026 to 1 September 2028.

Other conditions

The consultant must:

  • Be available to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, when required to respond to urgent or time-sensitive legal matters, investigations, or organizational priorities.
  • Be able to undertake duty travel to The Hague and other locations, as required, to provide in-person legal support, attend meetings, participate in hearings or consultations, and engage with key stakeholders
  • While this is a remote position, the consultant must be eligible to travel to and enter the Netherlands without requiring sponsorship or other immigration support from ICMP. The consultant will be responsible for obtaining and maintaining any required visas, permits, or travel authorizations.

Compensation

This is a fixed-term, part-time consultancy. The consultancy duration and working schedule will be discussed and agreed upon with the relevant consultant. Remuneration will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.

PLEASE NOTE: All applications must be submitted in English. ICMP does not accept applications in any other language.

Deadline for Applications: Ongoing.

ICMP is committed to maintaining an environment of mutual respect, where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants. ICMP believes that diversity and inclusion among our staff are critical to our success as a global organization, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented individuals from a thoroughly diverse range of candidates. ICMP is proud to be part of the International Gender Champions network.

ICMP may cancel this recruitment without notice or may decide to offer a position with different duties and/or contract length.

ICMP does not request payment during any stage of the selection process.

45K - 65K+

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SOFASCORESofascore is a sports-tech company created with one goal in mind – giving sports enthusiasts a deeper understanding of the game.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SOFASCORE

Sofascore is a sports-tech company created with one goal in mind – giving sports enthusiasts a deeper understanding of the game.

Our platform is the leading provider of advanced sports insights. From the biggest derbies to amateur matches, every game counts - that’s why we have the largest data coverage with 20,000+ tournaments across 25 sports. This comes easy with Torneo, our very own tournament management software for lower leagues.

The global recognition of the Sofascore Rating, along with the Player of the Season award for the highest-rated players, positioned us as the authority in evaluating player performance.

The Sofascore team counts more than 300 experts in 20 teams, primarily playing at our home court in Croatia, but we also have talents showing their skills worldwide.

More about the company /// More about the platform

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Sofascore, we build products used by tens of millions of people worldwide, turning large volumes of sports and user data into meaningful experiences.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI Team and work on real-world ML problems across recommender systems and personalized feeds, semantic search, sentiment analysis, NLP, LLM-powered applications, and other machine learning use cases, potentially including computer vision.

This is an engineering-focused ML role. We are looking for someone who goes beyond experimenting with models in notebooks: someone who can take an ambiguous product or business problem, understand the data behind it, choose an appropriate approach, and turn it into a well-engineered ML solution.

You do not need to have worked on every type of problem we solve. What matters is a strong foundation in machine learning and software engineering, hands-on experience with modern ML and LLM systems, and the ability to think critically about which approach is appropriate for a given problem.

You will work on both new and existing ML systems and collaborate closely with engineers, analysts, and product teams. At Sofascore's scale, technical decisions have real consequences: scalability, latency, reliability, computational cost, and maintainability all matter alongside model quality.

We prefer candidates who are able to complete the onboarding process from our Zagreb office. Following successful completion of the onboarding process, the role can be performed fully remotely.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning solutions for real product problems used by tens of millions of users worldwide
  • Work on a broad range of ML use cases, including recommender systems, personalized feeds, semantic search, sentiment analysis, NLP, LLM-powered applications, classical machine learning problems, and potentially computer vision
  • Take ownership of ML problems end-to-end: from understanding the business problem and exploring the data to selecting an approach, building and evaluating models, and collaborating on their integration into our systems
  • Develop new ML solutions while also improving and maintaining existing systems
  • Build LLM-powered solutions and contribute to the design of retrieval-augmented generation and other modern NLP systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-quality Python code following sound software engineering practices
  • Work with large datasets using Python and SQL, and build reliable data and model workflows
  • Evaluate models rigorously, select meaningful metrics, identify issues such as overfitting and data leakage, and understand the trade-offs behind different modelling approaches
  • Collaborate with product managers, analysts, software engineers, and other stakeholders to translate product and business needs into well-defined ML problems
  • Critically evaluate proposed solutions and choose the right level of complexity for the problem, whether that means a simple heuristic, classical ML, deep learning, a recommender system, or an LLM-based approach
  • Stay current with developments in machine learning and LLMs, while applying new techniques where they provide meaningful value rather than complexity for its own sake

What you bring to the team

  • 2+ years of professional industry experience in a Machine Learning or closely related engineering role
  • A Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or another relevant technical or quantitative field
  • Strong foundations in machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model selection, feature engineering, regularization, validation, hyperparameter optimization, and appropriate evaluation methodologies
  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning methods and architectures, including transformers
  • Hands-on professional experience working with LLMs, combined with a solid understanding of how they work beyond the API level, including transformer architecture, attention, tokenization, context windows, inference, and fine-tuning approaches
  • Understanding of RAG systems and key concepts such as embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation
  • Strong Python programming skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable, testable, production-quality code
  • Hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or similar
  • Good practical knowledge of SQL and experience independently working with large datasets
  • Practical experience with Docker and containerized development
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills: you should be comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying limitations in data or proposed approaches, and explaining why a particular solution is appropriate
  • Ability to work independently on ML problems, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership from problem definition through implementation and evaluation
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, analytics, and product teams

What sets you apart

You do not need to have all of the following. These are additional strengths that would make your experience particularly relevant to the problems we work on:

  • Experience building recommender systems, ranking systems, or personalization solutions
  • Practical experience designing and implementing RAG systems, including more advanced retrieval, reranking, or evaluation approaches
  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs, working with open-source language models, optimizing inference, or serving models at scale
  • Experience taking ML systems into production and working across the broader ML lifecycle, including training, experiment tracking, deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring, and retraining
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration
  • Experience designing or operating large-scale, consumer-facing ML systems, particularly where scalability, latency, reliability, and computational cost are important engineering considerations
  • Experience with cloud platforms and cloud-based ML infrastructure
  • Experience with A/B testing or measuring the impact of ML models on real product and business metrics
  • Experience with modern NLP methods beyond LLM applications or with computer vision
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, sharing technical knowledge, or contributing to engineering standards
  • Research or applied innovation experience

What we offer

  • The opportunity to work with a cutting-edge sports platform impacting millions worldwide
  • Family benefits package
  • Education - internal and through international conferences and workshops
  • Top-quality equipment and budget for a mobile phone
  • Paid package of general physical examination once a year
  • Sofascore Canteen (lunch options)
  • Sofascore Bar (coffee and drinks on us)
  • Numerous other benefits that we would verbally communicate to you
