The Baldwin Group, a nationwide Registered Investment Advisor, is seeking an Advisor to join our Financial Services team. As a Wealth Management Financial Advisor, you will build and deepen client relationships, deliver comprehensive planning, and manage portfolios using Baldwin’s integrated advice platform. You’ll collaborate across practice groups to protect assets, optimize incomes, and help clients achieve long-term financial outcomes.

The Financial Wealth Advisor is responsible for providing clients with sound advice regarding their financial planning and investments. Responsibilities include meeting with clients to establish their needs and obtain financial statements, using financial statements and legislation to develop financial plans to maximize profitability or reduce debts and researching investment opportunities for clients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: ​

  • Grow and manage a client book through qualified leads, referrals, and proactive outreach, leveraging Baldwin’s holistic asset protection platform for efficient client acquisition and closing.
  • Assist in developing comprehensive financial plans focused on goals such as wealth accumulation, retirement readiness, education funding, risk management, tax-aware strategies, and estate considerations.
  • Help with portfolio construction and monitoring, including gathering data, updating performance and allocation reports, and organizing recommendations aligned with client goals, risk profiles, and time horizons.
  • Participate in client meetings and review cycles, taking notes, preparing summaries, and ensuring timely completion of agreed-upon action items to reinforce trust and retention.
  • Respond to routine client inquiries related to accounts, statements, transfers, administrative requests, and basic planning questions, escalating complex issues appropriately and ensuring professional, timely follow-up.
  • Learn and effectively use Baldwin’s planning, CRM, and investment platforms to support client onboarding, account maintenance, reporting, and business development activities.
  • Coordinate with internal specialists across wealth, retirement, and insurance to help deliver integrated solutions that protect assets, optimize income, and support long-term financial outcomes for clients.
  • Maintain accurate and organized client files, meeting notes, and compliance documentation, following internal policies, regulatory requirements, and fiduciary standards.
  • Proactively build foundational knowledge of investments, capital markets, tax considerations, and planning strategies, staying current on changes that impact clients’ financial plans.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Proficient with MS Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. ​Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain basic investment and financial planning concepts in clear, practical language.
  • Service-oriented mindset with an outgoing, professional demeanor and a strong drive for sales support, business development, and relationship management in a client-facing environment.
  • Foundational understanding of investment principles, asset allocation, risk/return tradeoffs, and personal financial planning concepts, with the desire to deepen expertise in advanced wealth strategies.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort working with data and reports (e.g., performance reports, statements, allocations) and translating information into clear summaries or talking points for advisors and clients.
  • Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, and willingness to learn from senior team members and accept coaching and feedback.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting or a related field preferred.

  • Series 65 or 66 and state Life & Health Insurance License may be required or obtained within 90 days.
  • Demonstrated experience in customer service, sales support, or relationship management, ideally in a professional or financial services environment, with a track record of supporting revenue growth and client retention.

OTHER:

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multi-task, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Occasional travel may be required for client meetings and internal training or events.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is looking for an experienced and driven Contracts Administration Advisor to support our Federal/Civilian Services portfolio to join our dynamic and growing Contracts team. This is a high-impact role where you'll manage a diverse portfolio of government contracts, serve as a trusted advisor to program teams, and play a key part in ensuring mission success from contract award through closeout. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and want your work to matter — this is the opportunity for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a diverse portfolio of contracts across various types, complexities, and sizes — with strong ability to identify and advise program teams on contract cost and performance risk
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships internally and externally — acting as a collaborative team leader who resolves issues quickly and streamlines processes
  • Serve as the go-to contractual expert for Project Managers, providing clear guidance on requirements and helping teams navigate challenges with confidence
  • Partner closely with internal program teams and/or customers to tackle highly complex challenges and deliver creative, effective solutions
  • Advise program team and organizational leadership of contractual rights and obligations; with strong ability to develop and communicate holistic assessments of contract terms/conditions, associated implications and identify/articulate changes
  • Monitor program performance for conformance to original proposal and maintains continual reviews to ensure that all terms and conditions are met and that the contract is in accordance with legal requirements, customer specifications, and government regulations.
  • Draft and/or revise contract letters (e.g., letters of concern), change agreements and contract performance responses (e.g., self-assessments/rebuttals)
  • Execute, facilitate, and/or support effective: program change management behaviors and customer conflict resolution
  • Contribute to proposal efforts by assisting with price/cost proposals and narratives
  • Analyze, draft, and negotiate a wide range of agreements including Teaming Agreements, NDAs, MOUs, MOAs, and other binding instruments
  • Prepare and disseminate information throughout the organization regarding contract status, compliance, modification, deviation, negotiation, and termination.
  • Lead contract start-up and closeout processes, ensuring smooth transitions at every stage of the contract lifecycle
  • Champion sound business principles that support departmental and divisional goals

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field and 8+ years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree with 6+ years of experience; or 12+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Flexibility to support periodic travel to attend on-site meetings at Peraton facilities and/or customer sites
  • Self-starter mentality with strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently and in a team-based environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with both internal and external management, strong research and analysis, and critical thinking skills
  • Hands-on experience and working application knowledge of Government contracts and subcontracts under FAR, DFARS, and applicable agency supplements
  • Demonstrated experience responding to customer solicitations, participating in proposal and pre-award strategy and review meetings, conducting negotiations, and drafting/finalizing contracts
  • Working knowledge of relationship between, and development of, basis of estimates (BOE), work breakdown structure (WBS) and cost and pricing principles
  • Proficiency in compliance with, and implementation of, corporate and contract management requirements--with disciplined adherence to policies and procedures
  • Experience executing contract closeout — including finalizing outstanding issues, issuing final modifications and invoices, and coordinating contractor performance evaluations
  • Must be a US Citizen

Preferred:

  • Preference is a candidate residing in the Northern Virginia / Maryland / Washington, DC area
  • Deep knowledge of contract types, terms, and conditions
  • Familiarity with the basics of commercial contracting frameworks/terms and conditions; with experience negotiating/managing FAR Part 12 contracts, OTAs etc.
  • Experience administering Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC) vehicles
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) tools and familiarity with use of contracts management system/tools
  • Familiarity with use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing contracts management support
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance is a plus

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.description:
Voor onze projecten binnen Integrale Oplossingen en Energy Hubs zoeken we een Werkvoorbereider die wil bijdragen aan het First Time Right opleveren van onze projecten. In deze rol ben je de spil in het proces: je beoordeelt binnengekomen projecten, verzorgt de complete werkvoorbereiding en werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers, uitvoerders, leveranciers en netbeheerders. Een functie met duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden, korte lijnen en ruimte om je rol zelf vorm te geven.

Dit is Joulz

Bij Joulz werken we elke dag aan betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige energieoplossingen voor organisaties die door móéten kunnen. In een sector die continu in beweging is, maken wij complexiteit helder en nemen we verantwoordelijkheid: voor onze klanten én voor elkaar. We willen elk bedrijf meenemen in de energietransitie, met oplossingen die van die transitie geen knelpunt maken maar een kans.

Wat werken bij Joulz typeert?
Een combinatie van vakmanschap, vertrouwen en ontwikkelkracht. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, mee te denken en jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. We werken samen in een informele, professionele sfeer waar betrokkenheid vanzelfsprekend is en waar ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. We houden van een can-do-mentaliteit, we kijken naar elkaar om en we vieren successen.

Bij Joulz bouw je niet alleen aan slimme energie-infrastructuur, maar ook aan je eigen groei én aan die van het team. Zo brengen we samen Nederland vooruit. Vandaag én morgen.

Waar jij impact maakt

Wat jij straks mogelijk maakt voor collega’s, klanten en projecten.

In deze rol:

  • Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de complete werkvoorbereiding van onze nieuwbouwprojecten binnen Integrale Oplossingen en Energy Hubs

  • Zorg je dat elk project First Time Right wordt opgeleverd, als steun en toeverlaat van onze projectmanagers en uitvoerders

  • Draag je zorg voor een goede projectadministratie, gestructureerd bijgehouden conform de gemaakte procesafspraken en werkinstructies

  • Draag je bij aan werkgroepen en werkoverleggen over (veiligheids)processen en werkafspraken, en toon je initiatief in het doen van verbetervoorstellen

Dit pak jij concreet op

De taken waar je écht je dag mee vult.

  • Je beoordeelt binnengekomen projecten op compleetheid conform het afgesproken proces en schakelt met de collega’s van sales als er knel- of verbeterpunten zijn

  • Je verzorgt de complete werkvoorbereiding voor nieuwbouwprojecten en werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers en uitvoerders om een goed eindresultaat te bereiken

  • Je zorgt voor de juiste producten op het juiste moment op de juiste plaats, door tijdig voorraden te checken en de juiste assets en materialen te reserveren of bestellen

  • Je houdt de projectplanning bij, signaleert afwijkingen en bespreekt die met het projectteam of collega’s in de keten, of escaleert tijdig richting management

  • Je werkt nauw samen met leveranciers, onderaannemers en netbeheerders en gaat op locatie schouwen als de situatie daarom vraagt

Met wie je schakelt (en waarom dat werkt)

Welke collega’s je om je heen hebt en hoe jullie samen resultaat maken.

Je werkt samen met projectmanagers, uitvoerders, collega’s van sales en collega’s in de keten, en daarbuiten met leveranciers, onderaannemers en netbeheerders. Binnen Joulz geloven we in samen doen, elkaar helpen en duidelijke communicatie.

Wat jij van ons mag verwachten

Voorwaarden, vrijheid en ontwikkelkansen.

Jij maakt impact, wij belonen jou met:

  • Elke maand € 3.535,77 – € 4.881,51 bruto te zien op je loonstrook (inschaling afhankelijk van ervaring en opleidingsniveau)

  • Een bedrijfswagen, met de optie tot privégebruik

  • 24% Persoonlijk Budget vrij te besteden (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld)! Wil jij elke maand een extra bedrag boven op jouw salaris? Dat haal je uit dit budget. Of koop je liever vrijheid door extra verlofuren van dit budget aan te schaffen? Of… wacht je tot einde van het jaar en geef je jezelf een eindejaarscadeau door alles uit te laten betalen in december? De keuze is aan jou!

  • Arbeidsmarkttoeslag: € 200,= Bruto per maand

  • 24,5 verlofdagen

  • Een flinke bijdrage aan jouw pensioenpremie bij ABP; Joulz betaalt 70%!

En dit hoort er ook nog bij!

  • Jaarlijks kun je € 700,- besteden aan jouw vitale en mentale gezondheid vanuit het duurzaam inzetbaarheidsbudget — bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement, de aanschaf van fitnessapparatuur of een coach

  • Dagelijks vers fruit op kantoor

Zullen we kennismaken?

Solliciteren, contact en de volgende stap.

Enthousiast? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer via de onderstaande button. Heb je eerst nog een vraag over de functie of werken bij Joulz? Neem gerust contact op met Jesse Middleton – Recruiter via 06 – 15 00 13 75 of .

Requirements

Skills, mindset en hoe jij graag samenwerkt.

Je bent een organisatorisch talent met een assertieve houding en een can-do-mentaliteit. Je weet wat er nodig is om een project tot een goed resultaat te brengen, neemt initiatief en schakelt snel, ook onder tijdsdruk. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk, nauwkeurig en een teamspeler, en denk je graag mee over oplossingen waar onze klant écht iets aan heeft.

  • Aantoonbaar mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Kennis en ervaring van projectmanagement

  • Tenminste 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een technische of operationele omgeving

  • Kennis en ervaring met Microsoft Project

  • Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics is een pré

  • Affiniteit met duurzame energie en de energietransitie is een pré

jobs.excerpt: Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.
jobs.description:
Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.

Chez Thirdbridge, nous créons des applications et des solutions logicielles sur mesure depuis plus d'une décennie. Au-delà du code, nous sommes fiers de réunir des passionné·es de technologie au cœur d'une culture inégalable avec qui nous imaginons des expériences numériques que les utilisateurs aiment pour de vrai.

Le·la PM/PO IA sera responsable de coordonner les projets. En travaillant conjointement avec les équipes de design et de développement, il·elle combinera ses compétences en gestion de produit et de projets agiles pour livrer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins clients, et qui se testent avant même d'être construites.

Les principales responsabilités

  • Recevoir, évaluer et gérer les demandes clients en assurant un constant alignement avec la stratégie produit;
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil dans la relation client;
  • Prototyper rapidement des idées produit avec des outils d'IA générative pour valider des hypothèses avant d'impliquer les équipes de développement;
  • Utiliser l'IA activement au quotidien : générer du code fonctionnel, rédiger des specs, créer des maquettes, automatiser des tâches;
  • Conseil stratégique en transformation numérique et IA. Diagnostiquer la maturité d'un client, cartographier son écosystème et livrer une feuille de route de transformation priorisée.
  • Organiser et animer des ateliers avec le client et l’équipe: Mener des entrevues et synthétiser les constats en présentations claires pour des décideurs.
  • Mettre en place des objectifs mesurables, analyser les données et les KPIs et assurer une rétroaction à l'équipe;
  • Gérer les budgets et les échéanciers liés aux projets et prendre les décisions adéquates lorsqu'ils sont impactés;
  • Gérer et prioriser le backlog produit et design en collaboration avec le chef d'équipe (rédaction d'epics,user stories, etc.);
  • Superviser le processus d'assurance qualité tout en y participant activement;
  • Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie du produit, de la conception à la livraison et à la maintenance;
  • Garantir un alignement constant entre les livrables et la vision produit.

Finalement, nous cherchons quelqu'un qui n'attend pas que tout soit parfait pour tester une idée, quelqu'un qui prototype avant de planifier et propose des solutions proactives plutôt que réactives. Quelqu’un qui a du goût et de l’expérience avec des clients mais qui est aussi technique. Tu relèveras de la Directrice produit.

Le profil recherché

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets et/ou gestion de produits numériques;
  • Expérience pertinente dans le domaine du développement logiciel;
  • Habileté à gérer des budgets, des ressources et des échéanciers;
  • Familiarité avec la méthodologieScrumet les pratiques agiles;
  • Bonne connaissance de nos outils de gestion (ex. Jira, Harvest, Forecast, etc.);
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication pour assurer la collaboration et l'alignement entre les clients et les équipes;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit;
  • Tu utilises activement l'IA dans ton travail;
  • Tu es à l'aise avec le vibe coding : tu sais diriger un agent de développement IA pour produire des prototypes fonctionnels rapidement, et tu comprends ce que tu génères assez pour en valider la qualité;
  • Tu connais bien les concepts de base du design UX/UI et de l'outil Figma;

Un gros plus si :

  • Tu as une expertise en stratégie numérique et analyse des données(analytics);
  • Tu as une connaissance de l'industrie du commerce de détail, des programmes de fidélisation, des stratégies marketing propres à cette industrie et de la ludification de produits numériques;
  • Tu as un intérêt marqué pour les applications transactionnelles et l'expérience client en contexte de vente au détail.

Les avantages de travailler avec nous

  • Une culture d'entreprise inégalable : c'est notre plus grande priorité et notre plus grande force;
  • Ambiance décontractée : on travaille pour vivre et non l'inverse;
  • Cinq semaines de vacances rémunérées;
  • Congés de maladie illimités;
  • Assurance collective et télémédecine;
  • Programme de REER collectif;
  • Compte mieux-être pour tes dépenses personnelles;
  • Activités sociales et deteam building;
  • Budget annuel de formation;
  • Horaire flexible : on travaille généralement de jour, mais l'horaire est adaptable et toutes les rencontres sont virtuelles. Où que tu sois, on te livre un laptop et te voilà prêt·e pour ta première journée !

En passant, notre processus de recrutement est simple et rapide :

  1. Entretien virtuel pour apprendre à se connaître;
  2. Entretien virtuel axé sur les compétences techniques;
  3. Test technique;
  4. Offre d'emploi.

Rendez-vous sur nos réseaux sociaux pour en voir plus :

  • Instagram
  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn

Le poste t'intéresse ? Soumets ta candidature et viens échanger avec nous !

Chez Thirdbridge, on croit à l'équité, à la diversité et à l'inclusion. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi, sans tenir compte de la race, de la couleur, de la religion, du sexe, de l'identité ou de l'expression sexuelle, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'origine nationale, de la génétique, du handicap, de l'âge ou du statut d'ancien combattant. Si tu as un handicap, n'hésite pas à nous dire comment nous pourrions adapter le processus d'entrevue pour mieux te convenir. Il nous fera plaisir de t'accommoder. Nous recevons un grand nombre de candidatures et afin de mieux gérer le processus, nous contacterons uniquement les personnes sélectionnées pour la suite. Si ton profil correspond à ce que nous recherchons, tu entendras bientôt parler de nous !

  • Competitive Compensation: A rewarding package tailored to your experience.

  • Shared Purpose:Working with passionate people who live our values every day — connecting, innovating, curating, and leading the way together.

Job Description

Position Overview

At TransPerfect, linguists are vital to our operations. Your language proficiency and subject matter expertise will ensure our deliverables meet the highest standards before reaching clients. Working closely with your manager and Project Managers, you will translate and proofread documents for a diverse client base in the Life Science industries.

This is a client-facing Language Lead position. In addition to linguistic work, the Language Lead is responsible for quality management and for coordinating a team of linguists.

This is a remote freelance position open to candidates worldwide.

We are currently expanding our pool of freelance linguists who can translate:

From English into Simplified Chinese (China) for:

  • CTD Quality

  • CTD Non-Clinical

  • CTD Clinical

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Quality Management

  • Act as a client-facing linguistic point of contact, representing TransPerfect with professionalism.

  • Review and investigate client complaints and quality-related issues, determine root causes, and provide timely, well-documented responses and corrective actions.

  • Maintain language quality standards across projects and accounts.

  • Manage language assets, including translation memories (TMs), glossaries, and style guides, ensuring they are accurate, consistent, and up to date.

Project & Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Project Managers to understand project requirements, scope, timelines, and client expectations.

  • Gather and relay client feedback, and incorporate it into ongoing and future work.

  • Manage and guide a group of linguists, including assigning work, providing feedback, and ensuring adherence to client requirements and quality standards.

Linguistic Delivery

  • Translate and proofread Life Science documents, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with client and regulatory terminology.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience Required

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Simplified Chinese (China).

  • Expertise in one or more of the specified fields.

  • Strong attention to detail, including spelling and grammar accuracy.

  • Ability to maintain professionalism and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

  • Strong client communication skills, with the ability to handle complaints and feedback diplomatically and constructively.

  • Ability to manage, mentor, and give clear feedback to other linguists.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to collaborate with Project Managers and cross-functional teams.

Job Requirements

Applicants must meet at least ONE of the following criteria:

  • Hold a degree in Translation, Linguistics, Language Studies, or an equivalent program with significant translation training from a recognized university;

  • Have 2 years of professional translation experience plus a college degree;

  • Have 5 years of professional translation experience without a college degree; OR

  • Possess a translation competence certificate issued by an appropriate government authority.

  • Prior experience in a lead, reviewer, or quality management role, including handling client feedback or complaints.

Important Information

  • Applicants will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement.

  • Free translation and MTPE assessments will be administered to evaluate skills.

  • If your profile matches these requirements, please apply directly by submitting your most recent CV.

  • In your CV, please clearly outline: a) Your relevant experience in translation and proofreading, and any experience in quality management, client communication, or team leadership; b) Your best per-word rate for translation and hourly rate for MTPE services (in USD).

Only candidates who meet all requirements will be contacted.

By applying, you acknowledge and accept TransPerfect's Privacy Policy:

Candidates MUST also fulfil any ONE of the following requirements:

  • A Degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant translation training, from a recognized institution of higher education;

  • 2 years of translation experience and a college degree;

Senior Technical Writer

Position Summary

The Senior Technical Writer supports projects that produce requirements documentation, solution design documentation, and operating model documentation for technical programs. This role is responsible for translating complex technical decisions — including architecture and system diagrams — into clear, well-organized, and accurate documentation.

The Senior Technical Writer works as part of a team to draft, format, and assemble documentation deliverables, maintain version control of documentation, and ensure consistency and quality across artifacts. This role goes beyond editing or transcription: the Senior Technical Writer must be able to read and understand architecture and technical diagrams well enough to update existing diagrams and produce new ones using standard diagramming conventions.

Success in this role requires strong technical acumen, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to work closely with technical stakeholders to accurately capture and document decisions. This position requires demonstrated technical writing ability and the capacity to understand and document technical concepts, diagrams, and architecture. Candidates will be asked to submit a writing sample and a diagram-based work sample as part of the application process.

Key Functions

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, DevSecOps Engineers, Cybersecurity teams, and Database Administrators to understand complex technical solutions for Salesforce and AWS development, test, and other environments in the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Produce and maintain requirements documentation supporting solution design and technical decision-making.
  • Draft and assemble solution design documentation, including narrative content, diagrams, and supporting artifacts.
  • Produce and maintain operating model documentation.
  • Create, update, and revise architecture and technical diagrams, applying standard shapes, connectors, and diagramming conventions consistently.
  • Translate technical decisions and discussions into clear, well-organized documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Format, assemble, and finalize documentation deliverables for internal and client review.
  • Maintain version control of documentation in Confluence or an equivalent content management platform.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma and 7 years of relevant experience in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • Required: submission of a writing sample demonstrating the ability to translate technical material into clear, well-organized documentation.

  • Sufficient technical acumen to understand software, infrastructure, or systems concepts well enough to document them accurately — this is not a purely administrative or transcription-focused role.

  • Coursework, certification, or prior experience in technical writing, information design, or a related discipline.

  • Salary: $60,200–$80,200 annually, commensurate with experience

jobs.description:
CTS seeks a Cost Analyst Subject Matter Expert to provide technical expertise to the Evaluations, Assessments, Studies, Services, and Support (EASSS) contract. This contract supports NASA Headquarters Science Mission Directorate (SMD) and facilitates NASA’s pursuit of the most noteworthy approaches for missions, payloads, spacecraft, instruments, and research that help answer the big questions in Earth and Space science. Located at LaRC, the NASA’s Science Office for Mission Assessments (SOMA) helps SMD select and manage missions, spacecraft, and instruments. To accomplish this, SOMA manages and provides oversight of evaluations, assessments, and studies for SMD and other NASA organizations. These include evaluation of proposals received in response to NASA Announcements of Opportunity, NASA Research Announcements, Cooperative Agreement Notices, and Broad Agency Announcements, as well as highly specialized studies and assessments, such as life cycle and independent cost estimates, schedule assessments, and risk analyses. CTS supports SOMA via the EASSS contract by providing subject matter experts who will apply their expertise to complex proposal evaluations, management and technical assessments, and advanced studies through the EASSS contract.

CTS’s subject matter experts need not be local to the program office near NASA Langley Research Center in Hampton, VA. We seek individuals who bring significant Technical, Management and Cost expertise in missions, payloads, spacecraft and instruments relevant to NASA’s mission. The work is performed remotely with less than 10% travel occurring periodically for some during the assignment to bring the geographically distributed teams together for workshops to finalize results.

The Cost Analyst must have at least five (5) years of experience in estimating and analyzing space mission cost utilizing parametric models. Must be proficient in the use of aerospace industry standard cost analysis tools. Many cost estimating models exist, as is the case with the estimating methodologies, no single cost model can be used for all purposes. Estimating models can vary significantly in terms of data availability and automation. The knowledge of some of the following tools is greatly desired:

  • SEER (especially SEER-H)

  • Trueplanning
  • Project Cost Estimating Capability (PCEC)

  • NASA Air Force Cost Model (NAFCOM)

  • NASA Instrument Cost Model (NICM)

  • Technology Cost & Schedule Estimation (TCASE)

  • Schedule Management & Relationship Tool (SMART)

  • Phasing Model

  • One NASA Cost Engineering (ONCE) database

  • REDSTAR database

  • Polaris

  • Argo

  • Automated Cost Estimating Integrated Tools (ACEIT)

  • CO$TAT

  • Joint Analysis of Cost and Schedule (JACS)

    • PRICE cost models

Education: Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Finance, Engineering, or other directly related field.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.

This role is open to REMOTE work.

Job Mission

As a member of the Information Security Team, the Senior Vulnerability Management & SOAR Engineer will lead and mature the organization's enterprise Vulnerability Management Program, protecting applications, infrastructure, cloud services, endpoints, containers, and technology platforms from current and emerging threats. This role serves as the primary technical authority for vulnerability discovery, validation, prioritization, remediation coordination, exception management, and security automation.
The position partners closely with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, DevOps, Architecture, Security Operations, and Technology teams to continuously reduce cyber risk through effective vulnerability lifecycle management and operational excellence. Drive accountability across technical teams, improve vulnerability remediation processes, and leverage automation and SOAR technologies to scale program effectiveness, reporting, and risk reduction efforts.
This individual contributor role requires both deep technical expertise and strong program ownership, balancing hands-on vulnerability operations with strategic leadership to continuously strengthen the organization's security posture.
Role Allocation: 90% Vulnerability Management | 10 % SOAR Engineering & Security
Note: Off-hour support and travel may be required.
Major Accountabilities
Vulnerability Management & Risk Reduction
• Own and continuously mature the enterprise Vulnerability Management Program across on-premises, cloud, containerized, endpoint, network, embedded, and application environments.
• Manage the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, including discovery, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, exception management, verification, and reporting.
• Operate and optimize vulnerability assessment technologies to ensure comprehensive asset coverage and accurate risk visibility.
• Correlate and prioritize findings from vulnerability scanners, application security tools, cloud and container security platforms, attack surface management solutions, and threat intelligence sources.
• Apply risk-based methodologies leveraging CVSS, CISA KEV, exploitability, asset criticality, exposure, and business impact to identify and prioritize the most significant threats.
• Integrate vulnerability management processes with CI/CD pipelines and software delivery workflows to identify and address security weaknesses earlier in the development lifecycle.
• Partner with asset management teams to improve asset inventory accuracy, security coverage, and risk visibility across the enterprise.
Remediation Leadership & Governance
• Coordinate and drive remediation efforts across technical teams to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established service-level objectives and/or sensitivity.
• Lead response activities for critical vulnerabilities, zero-day threats, and actively exploited CVEs
• Manage vulnerability exceptions, compensating controls, risk acceptance processes, and periodic exception reviews.
• Develop and maintain vulnerability management policies, standards, procedures, runbooks, and reporting frameworks.
• Create executive and operational metrics measuring risk reduction, remediation, performance, vulnerability trends, asset coverage, SLA adherence, and MTTR.
• Support audits, compliance assessments, and risk management activities through accurate documentation and evidence collection.
• Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and industry best practices to continuously improve program effectiveness.
SOAR Engineering & Security Automation (10%)
• Design, develop, and maintain SOAR playbooks that automate vulnerability intake, triage, enrichment, ticket creation, remediation tracking, exception handling, and reporting.
• Develop integrations between vulnerability management platforms, SOAR, SIEM, ITSM, CMDB, DevOps, and collaboration platforms.
• Build scripts, APIs, and automated workflows using technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, and REST APIs to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
• Measure automation effectiveness and recommend technology enhancements that strengthen vulnerability management and security operations capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Vulnerability Management, Security Operations, Security Engineering, Cybersecurity Risk Management, or related security disciplines.
    • 3+ years of directly managing or owning enterprise vulnerability management programs in hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
    • Experience administering enterprise vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, or equivalent solutions.
    • Strong expertise in vulnerability assessment, credentialed scanning, vulnerability validation, risk prioritization, and remediation management.
    • Deep understanding of CVE, CVSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, threat intelligence, attack surface management, and risk scoring methodologies.
    • Experience with cloud platforms and cloud security technologies including Azure, AWS, or GCP.
    • Experience managing vulnerabilities across cloud-native, containerized, and modern application environments.
    • Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
    • Experience building security automations using Microsoft Sentinel, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, Tines, or similar platforms.
    • Familiarity with application security concepts
    • Experience developing metrics, KPIs, dashboards, remediation SLAs, and executive reporting for vulnerability management programs.
    • Strong understanding of operating systems, network infrastructure, software development processes, and enterprise technology environments.
    • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, CMMC, or similar regulatory requirements is preferred.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.
    • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CySA+, Security+, GSEC, GCSA, OSCP, GIAC certifications, or equivalent experience are preferred.
Boston, MA Headquarters - (NB) Only Pay Range: $104,500.00 - $130,000.00 - $155,500.00 Annual (actual base pay varying based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, internal equity, geographic location, and more.)


Regular Associate Benefits

Our products are only as good as the people we hire, so we make sure to hire the best and treat them accordingly. New Balance offers a comprehensive traditional benefits package including three options for medical insurance as well as dental, vision, life insurance and 401K. We also proudly offer a slate of more nontraditional perks – opportunities like online learning and development courses, tuition reimbursement, $100 monthly student loan support and various mentorship programs – that encourage our associates to grow personally as they develop professionally. You’ll also enjoy a yearly $1,000 lifestyle reimbursement, 4 weeks of vacations, 12 holidays and generous parental leave, because work-life balance is more than just a buzzword – it’s part of our culture.

Temporary associates are provided three options for medical insurance as well as dental and vision insurance and an associate discount.

Part time associates are provided 401k, short term disability, a yearly $300 lifestyle reimbursement and an associate discount.

Flexible Work Schedule

For decades we have fostered a unique culture founded on our values with a particular focus on in-person teamwork and collaboration. Our North American hybrid model encourages rich in-person experiences, showcasing our commitment to teamwork and connection, while maintaining flexibility for associates. New Balance Associates currently work in office three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Our offices are fully open, and amenities are available across our North American office locations. To continue our focus on hybrid work we have introduced “Work from Anywhere” (WFA) for four weeks per calendar year. This model will help us enhance our culture while continuing to maintain elements of flexibility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

New Balance provides equal opportunities for all current and prospective associates to ensure that employment, training, compensation, transfer, promotion and other terms, conditions and privileges of employment are provided without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, handicap, genetic information and/or status as an Armed Forces service medal veteran, recently separated veteran, qualified disabled veteran or other protected veteran, or any other protected status.

We’re a digital health platform on a mission to improve access to evidence-based care across Australia. The Opportunity

As our patient community and health programs continue to grow, we’re looking for Australian-registered doctors currently practising in Australia to join our multidisciplinary clinical team on a flexible contractor basis.

This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful patient care through an established digital health platform, supported by strong clinical governance, clear treatment pathways and experienced operational and clinical teams.

Working remotely, you’ll consult with new and existing patients, assess their clinical needs and support them throughout their treatment journey. Depending on your experience, interests and our patient needs, you may work across one or more of our healthcare programs.

jobs.description:
MCM Technology has spent 20+ years building the intelligent operations readiness platform trusted by public safety agencies nationwide. What started as a small family business building software for two-way radio dealerships has grown into a connected, AI-enabled platform used by 300+ agencies across the country, managing more than $5 billion in assets.

MCM helps law enforcement, fire, EMS, and government and communications agencies track assets, manage certifications, and stay audit-ready, giving agencies real-time visibility, automated workflows, and predictive intelligence so their teams can stay focused on the field instead of chasing paperwork. MCM's platform covers asset tracking, maintenance and inspections, certification and training, evidence, and fleet management, all built by a team that develops and supports the product in-house.

MCM's mission is to help agencies know not just what they own, but what's at risk before anything goes wrong, building software that works as hard as the people who depend on it.

About the Role

MCM Technology is looking to hire a Partner Channel Manager to build, grow, and manage a network of reseller and strategic partners that extend MCM's reach across the public safety market. This role owns the full partner lifecycle: recruiting and onboarding new partners, enabling and training their sales teams, opening senior-level and engineering relationships that deepen a partnership over time, and establishing the cooperative purchasing vehicles that make MCM easier for agencies to buy. This role does not carry an individual sales quota. MCM's direct sales team closes the business. This role is measured on its contribution to partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and on the partnership milestones that create it. This is a full-time, remote role with up to 40% travel, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer.

What We Value in You

  • You understand the public safety market: law enforcement, fire, EMS, radio and communications, and can speak credibly to its buyers and influencers.
  • You're a relationship builder who knows how to motivate a partner's sales team to prioritize and sell your solution alongside their own.
  • You have a "can do" attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines.
  • You're never tired of learning and are always looking for ways to grow personally and professionally.
  • You're both an effective communicator and an eager listener.
  • You want to be an active part of helping our team continue to be at the forefront of how we serve public safety. You bring your energy and expertise to the table every day. We are stronger working together as a team.

What You'll Be Doing

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished, seasoned Lead Product Manager to define and drive the strategy for Netwrix Auditor - the compliance audit and security-investigation backbone of Netwrix Security. In this role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and go-to-market execution for the highest CSAT rated product in the company's portfolio, and its migration to a true multi-tenant SaaS offering.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise with strong knowledge of data security posture management, compliance auditing and regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, SOC 2), plus fluency in the SIEM, SOAR, and SOC technologies (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow, and similar) that security operations and compliance teams rely on every day. You will act as the voice of the customer, ensuring Netwrix Auditor delivers curated, audit-ready evidence for compliance teams and near real-time alerting with rapid, interactive forensic investigation for SecOps analysts — activity, access, and configuration-change auditing across Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, file servers, databases, and cloud infrastructure, with advance DSPM capabilities in support of that mission.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define the vision and long-term strategy for Netwrix Auditor, aligned with company priorities and the compliance-audit and security-operations market.
  • Own the product roadmap, including backlog prioritization and release planning, closing on-premises-to-SaaS parity gaps that unlock migration of the Auditor installed base.

Market & Customer Insights

  • Own the Auditor’s GTM strategy and partnership strategy with the Data Security solution suite, driving Auditor attach on cross-portfolio opportunities, and brief industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester) to sharpen Auditor’s competitive and category positioning.
  • Conduct ongoing discovery with internal auditors, compliance officers, and SecOps/SOC analysts to identify requirements for audit evidence, framework mapping, and investigation workflows.
  • Track the competitive and analyst landscape (Gartner, Forrester, and others) across compliance auditing and SIEM/SOAR-adjacent categories to inform positioning.

Product Execution

  • Partner with engineering to deliver curated, audit-ready compliance capabilities mapped to frameworks such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, and SOC 2, alongside real-time alerting, rapid forensic investigation, behavioral analytics (UEBA), and AI-driven threat detection and response capabilities.
  • Ensure deep integration with SIEM, SOAR, and SOC ecosystems (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow) for alert export, extended schema, and workflow/action orchestration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales and Customer Success on the Auditor-to-1Secure SaaS migration motion, protecting and growing the largest single renewal base in the portfolio.
  • Define and monitor product success metrics, including renewal rate, audit-preparation time reduction, investigation mean time to resolution, and SaaS conversion rate.

Innovation

  • Champion AI-driven investigation and compliance-reporting automation, including anomaly and threat-pattern detection layered onto activity and change data.
  • Ensure Netwrix Auditor's DSPM capability dovetail into the broader Netwrix DSPM story, and the 1Secure SaaS platform vision, while deepening the product's compliance and SIEM/SOAR/SOC story, and laying the groundwork for advance Threat-Detection capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4 years in cybersecurity, data security, threat detection & response, security-investigation products, compliance auditing, IT audit, or SIEM/SOAR/SOC solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of DSPM, Data Access Governance, or adjacent domains (DLP, IGA, compliance automation, risk management).
  • Strong knowledge of compliance frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, SOC 2) and how audit-ready reporting and evidence are built and maintained.
  • Deep familiarity with SIEM, SOAR, and SOC technologies and integration patterns (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow) — alerting, schema/export design, and workflow/action orchestration.
  • Demonstrated success migrating or modernizing a mature on-premises product into a true multi-tenant SaaS offering while protecting a large, high-renewing customer base.
  • Comfortable owning a true multi-tenant SaaS product and the operating cadence — continuous delivery, telemetry-driven prioritization — that comes with it.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

 

Our Values

At Netwrix, our values guide every action:

  • Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
  • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
  • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
  • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
  • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
  • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
  • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

  • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
  • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed

  • Rédiger des plans d’action liés au suivi des non-conformités et à l’amélioration continue.

Le candidat sera évalué lors d’un entretien, organisé via Teams ou en présentiel.

L’échange portera sur le parcours, l’expérience, les compétences techniques et comportementales, ainsi que l’adéquation avec la mission.

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. jobs.title: Web Developer, Artificial Intelligence Assisted Development
jobs.excerpt: Rockstar is recruiting for a growing technology company that helps businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization.
jobs.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a growing technology company that helps businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization. The company builds high-performance websites and develops tools that help businesses compete across traditional search engines and artificial intelligence platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging search experiences. They are a dynamic team focused on delivering top-notch technology and design.

About the Company

They're a growing technology company helping businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization.

They build high-performance websites and develop tools that help businesses compete across traditional search engines and artificial intelligence platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging search experiences.

They're looking for a talented Web Developer with strong coding fundamentals who embraces artificial intelligence assisted development and can take ownership of website deployments, ongoing maintenance, and improvements across their growing portfolio of customer websites.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, part-time position for an experienced developer who knows how to write, understand, and troubleshoot code independently while using modern artificial intelligence tools to work more efficiently.

Cursor is a central part of their development workflow, and the developer will be encouraged to use it extensively to accelerate development. However, this is a coding position, not a prompt-only development role. Candidates must have a strong foundation in traditional web development and be capable of writing, reviewing, debugging, and modifying code without relying entirely on artificial intelligence.

The developer should understand how websites are structured, how the underlying code works, and how to identify and correct problems when artificial intelligence generated solutions are incomplete or incorrect.

The developer will work directly with the company's co-founders, with technical oversight from their Chief Technology Officer, who is also a co-founder. Primary responsibilities will focus on deploying new customer websites, maintaining existing websites, implementing updates, and resolving technical issues.

This role is focused on customer-facing website development and management rather than building or modifying the company's internal backend systems.

They're looking for someone who produces clean, professional code, communicates clearly, responds quickly, and can independently manage multiple website projects.

What You'll Do

  • Build, deploy, maintain, and improve customer websites using Cursor, GitHub, Netlify, and other modern development tools.
  • Write, review, debug, and maintain website code, using Cursor to accelerate development while ensuring all code meets professional standards.
  • Independently identify and resolve coding issues, including problems that cannot be solved through artificial intelligence generated suggestions alone.
  • Manage GitHub repositories, including creating and managing branches, committing changes, reviewing differences, resolving merge conflicts, and managing pull requests.
  • Handle website deployments through Netlify, including configuration, domain management, deployment troubleshooting, and hosting maintenance.
  • Implement website updates, new pages, design adjustments, integrations, and ongoing customer requests.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve website functionality issues, broken integrations, deployment errors, and performance problems.
  • Follow web security best practices, including secure configuration, dependency management, access controls, and protection of sensitive information.
  • Maintain clean, organized, well-structured, and professional code across customer projects.
  • Collaborate with the company's leadership to prioritize customer requests, meet deadlines, and maintain high standards of quality.
  • Ensure websites are responsive, fast, accessible, and compatible across modern browsers and devices.
  • Manage technical aspects of website launches, including domain configuration, redirects, forms, and third-party integrations.
  • Review and validate artificial intelligence generated code before deployment to ensure accuracy, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Respond promptly to technical requests, communicate project status clearly, and proactively identify potential issues.

What You'll Need

  • Strong professional experience in website development, including the ability to write and troubleshoot code independently.
  • Solid proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand website architecture, code structure, application logic, and development best practices.
  • Experience using Cursor or similar artificial intelligence assisted development environments to improve coding efficiency.
  • Strong proficiency with GitHub, including repository management, branching strategies, pull requests, merging, conflict resolution, and version control.
  • Hands-on experience with Netlify for website hosting, deployments, domain management, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to independently review, debug, modify, and improve code generated through artificial intelligence tools.
  • Strong understanding of website security principles and best practices.
  • Experience integrating website forms, analytics platforms, tracking scripts, and third-party services.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently and implement reliable solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to writing clean, professional, maintainable code.
  • Excellent communication skills, fast response times, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Astro Static Site Generator and static website architecture.
  • Familiarity with search engine optimization best practices, including technical website performance, structured data, redirects, and metadata.
  • Experience working with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.
  • Experience with custom domains, domain name system configuration, secure connections, and website migrations.
  • Experience managing multiple customer websites simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with modern website performance optimization and Core Web Vitals.

Technology Stack

The company operates on a modern website development stack, including:

  • Cursor for artificial intelligence assisted development and code editing.
  • GitHub for version control, repository management, and collaboration.
  • Netlify for website hosting, deployment, and domain management.
  • Astro Static Site Generator for building fast, high-performance websites.
  • Internal tools for website management, reporting, and customer operations.

Experience with Cursor, GitHub, and Netlify is especially important. Familiarity with Astro is a strong advantage, although they're open to candidates with experience in similar modern frameworks who can learn their environment quickly.

What They're Looking For

They want a developer who combines strong coding skills with an artificial intelligence forward approach to development.

The ideal candidate is a capable web developer first and an effective user of artificial intelligence development tools second. The candidate should know how to code without Cursor, but recognize how tools like Cursor can make them significantly faster and more productive.

They're not looking for someone whose development experience is limited to prompting artificial intelligence tools and accepting the resulting code. The candidate must be able to understand what is being built, evaluate the quality of the code, identify potential problems, and make technical decisions independently.

The candidate should be comfortable taking a customer website request from initial requirements through development, testing, and production deployment with minimal oversight.

Responsiveness and reliability are particularly important. They work with a growing number of customers, and they need someone who communicates quickly, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in delivering clean, dependable work.

The developer will work closely with the company's co-founders, receive technical guidance from their Chief Technology Officer, and play an important role in delivering and maintaining the websites that power their customers' businesses.

Schedule

  • Hours: 20 to 30 hours per week
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Flexibility: Flexible scheduling, with an expectation of strong availability, prompt communication, and timely completion of customer requests

Join a collaborative, fast-paced E&S/S team where your leadership can shape solutions others can’t offer and grow your career with us!



Job Description Summary

Are you a leader who can create, develop and manage a strategy and plan that meets customer service and business goals? As a Director, Brokerage Excess, you will be responsible for the operating results of the assigned territory or region for the Excess Casualty line of business. This includes responsibility for monitoring all aspects of financial management of the assigned territory or region, influencing and managing relationships with brokers, program managers, and other producer channels, including exploring opportunities to drive more business. In this role, it’s essential to monitor trends and manage product issues within the territory or region for all assigned products. You will have the opportunities to participate in the development or revision of territorial or regional strategic plans and objectives. We will also count on you to contribute to the development of territory or region business strategy, execution of the business plan and attainment of goals and financial metrics as outlined in the business plan.

Job Description

  • Risk Selection: proactively identify new market opportunities and help to drive through cross-functional product development processes. Participate in developing appetite guidelines for assigned territory and guidelines that apply to various risks. Proficiently write the most complex accounts independently. Granted expanded Letter of Authority.

  • Technical Underwriting: analyze exposure to loss, develop adequate premium, determine appropriate endorsements and exclusions. Proficient in policy terms/conditions, ability to manuscript coverage forms and understand the implications this will have on claims. Comprehensive understanding of catastrophe modeling. Mentor others with common and complex coverage forms. Analyze and interpret forms/coverages from other carriers and make appropriate recommendations to leader. Effectively relay marketing visit outcomes to manager and team and provides recommendations. Mentor others on concepts and skills for successful marketing visits. Take more-junior underwriters along for marketing visits and provides feedback to manager. Identify need for and help coordinate in-market receptions.

  • Territory Management: Analyze premium and losses of assigned brokers. Assess quality of broker submissions. Proactively take steps to maintain the book of business (rate, losses, coverage, appetite, etc.) within assigned territory. Examine and understand the underlying factors that are driving trends within the territory and broker performance. Identify the need for and drive broker management conversations (in conjunction with leaders). Recommend solutions to territory management issues. Provide feedback to management regarding strengths and opportunities around team performance.

  • Team Development: Find opportunities to develop the skills of others within the division. Demonstrate leadership qualities by consistently showing positive impact on and offering constructive feedback to team members. Act as substitute in lieu of manager for meetings or other ad hoc responsibilities. Contribute to higher-impact projects and initiatives throughout organization.

  • Production: Handle submissions of appropriate volume and efficiency, achieve premium and loss ratio goal. Help others on the team to meet their individual production goals.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Ability to communicate effectively, verbally, and in writing, inter personally with individuals and groups via telephone, fax, e-mail and in person. Ability to work with the wholesale/general agency distribution system. Ability to analyze complex problems and develop innovative creative solutions. Exceptional negotiation and communication skills and techniques. Ability to set work priorities that strategically align with departmental objectives. If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
