Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are BH Management, LLC is a people-first multifamily owner and operator that grew from a small startup into one of the nation's largest commercial real estate companies.
jobs.description:
Who We Are


BH Management, LLC is a people-first multifamily owner and operator that grew from a small startup into one of the nation's largest commercial real estate companies. Founded in 1993, BH is celebrated for its simple commitment to doing business the right way and investing in its team. Today, BH manages over 100,000 units, employs over 2,800 people, owns its processes in-house, and is praised by Fortune Magazine as the “Best Workplace for Women,” “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplaces for Diversity.” Powered by innovation and a can-do attitude, BH improves daily, striving to construct a smarter way to live, invest, manage, and grow.


BH is passionate about setting the standard in the multifamily industry. We are a welcoming band of go-getters who think big, sweat the details, and take our work (but never ourselves) too seriously. We set our sights high, own our mistakes, and turn lemons into lemonade. We are incredibly proud of where we’ve come and are ready to tackle what’s next. Come join us!

Job Summary:


Underwriter – Multifamily Housing will evaluate investment opportunities through financial modeling, market research, due diligence, and risk analysis. The role uses approved AI, automation, and data tools to improve the speed and quality of underwriting while independently validating all assumptions, calculations, and conclusions. Success requires strong real estate judgment, analytical rigor, data integrity, and clear, decision-ready recommendations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Underwriting and valuation - Build, maintain, and audit acquisition models for multifamily investments, including value add, core/core-plus, and other strategies as applicable. Analyze unlevered and levered returns, IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash return, cap rates, yield on cost, debt-service coverage, breakeven occupancy, and exit scenarios.

  • Operating analysis - Normalize trailing operating statements; reconcile rent rolls to property level revenue; evaluate occupancy, loss-to-lease, concessions, bad debt, delinquency, other income, payroll, repairs and maintenance, utilities, taxes, insurance, management fees, and replacement reserves.
  • Business plan assessment - Evaluate renovation scope, rent premiums, unit turn timing, lease up assumptions, operating efficiencies, capital requirements, and execution constraints. Translate the business plan into phased cash flows and measurable underwriting assumptions.
  • Scenario and downside analysis - Build base, upside, and downside cases; stress test rent growth, occupancy, collections, expense inflation, renovation pace, interest rates, financing proceeds, cap rates, and exit timing. Identify the variables most likely to impair returns or liquidity.
  • Market and competitive intelligence - Assess submarket supply and demand, deliveries, absorption, rent and occupancy trends, concessions, comparable properties, employment drivers, demographics, taxes, insurance conditions, and regulatory or physical risks relevant to the investment thesis.
  • Debt and capital structure - Evaluate agency, bank, bridge, and other financing alternatives as applicable, including proceeds, pricing, amortization, interest-only periods, reserves, covenants, prepayment provisions, extension terms, and refinance risk.
  • Due diligence - Support financial, operational, physical, environmental, legal, tax, insurance, and third-party diligence. Maintain an assumption and issue log, resolve data discrepancies, quantify identified risks, and update the underwriting as findings emerge.
  • Investment communication - Prepare concise investment memoranda, approval materials, model outputs, and presentations that explain the thesis, key assumptions, sensitivities, risks, mitigants, and recommended decisions. Respond clearly to investment committee and leadership questions.
  • Cross-functional partnership - Partner with Acquisitions, Capital Markets, Asset Management, Property Operations, Construction, Accounting, Legal, Risk, and other internal stakeholders to ensure assumptions reflect executable operating plans and current financing conditions.
  • Post-close learning - Compare original underwriting with actual operating performance, document variance drivers, and incorporate lessons learned into assumptions, templates, screening criteria, and future investment decisions.
  • Data and process discipline - Maintain organized deal files, version control, comparable databases, assumption libraries, and pipeline records. Improve templates, controls, and repeatable workflows without weakening review standards.

AI, Automation, and Data Expectations


  • AI-enabled workflow - Use approved AI and automation tools to assist with offering memorandum review, rent roll and T-12 extraction, data normalization, comparable property research, issue spotting, first pass scenario generation, and drafting of investment narratives.
  • Validation - Reconcile AI-assisted outputs to source documents and approved models; verify formulas, mappings, citations, assumptions, and conclusions before use.
  • Prompting and workflow design - Create clear, reusable instructions, templates, and quality checks that improve the consistency and speed of analytical workflows. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work while preserving appropriate review and approval controls.
  • Data governance and confidentiality - Use approved systems and follow company requirements for handling confidential, proprietary, personal, lender, broker, and transaction data.
  • Analytical fluency - Work effectively with structured and unstructured data and use modern reporting and visualization tools to identify patterns, exceptions, and decision relevant insights.
  • Continuous learning - Stay current on evolving AI capabilities, multifamily data sources, modeling practices, and underwriting risks; test new methods thoughtfully and recommend practical improvements.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, real estate, economics, accounting, business, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience in lieu of education.
  • 2-5 years of experience in multifamily underwriting, acquisitions, commercial real estate, real estate private equity, lending, valuation, asset management, or investment analysis.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling capability, including cash-flow modeling, sensitivity analysis, data validation, model auditing, and clear documentation of assumptions.
  • Strong command of multifamily operating statements, rent rolls, property valuation, investment return metrics, debt sizing, and capital structure analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate incomplete or inconsistent information, ask effective diligence questions, and distinguish facts, estimates, assumptions, and judgment.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted tools responsibly and to validate outputs against source data, approved methodologies, and investment standards.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex analysis in a concise, decision oriented format.
  • High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Institutional multifamily acquisition, lending, valuation, or investment-management experience.
  • Experience with value-add underwriting, renovation programs, property-level operating models, and post-acquisition variance analysis.
  • Exposure to Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, HUD/FHA, bank, life company, CMBS, bridge, or debt-fund financing, as relevant to the investment strategy.
  • Experience with real estate and analytics platforms such as CoStar, Yardi, RealPage, ARGUS Enterprise, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable tools.
  • Experience improving underwriting workflows through AI, data extraction, automation, standardized templates, or low-code tools.
  • CCIM, CFA, CPA, MAI, graduate real estate/finance degree, or other relevant designation.

Our posted compensation reflects the cost of talent across multiple US geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Why Semble:Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare?
jobs.description:
Why Semble:

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare?

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, lucky to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK or France. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

About the Team

We're guided by one core question: how do we help our colleagues reduce cognitive load and get more done? Whether that's building tools to make operating code in production easier, running foundational shared services, or educating engineers on AWS and Kubernetes, our work has a direct multiplier effect on the rest of the business. We work closely with security and Implementation teams to make sure our infrastructure decisions serve the wider organisation's goals.

The Platform team exists to make the whole engineering organisation more effective. We're responsible for:

  • Developer Productivity and Experience, including the tooling engineers rely on every day;
  • Developer Enablement and Engagement, helping teams self-serve and grow their skills
  • Cloud Infrastructure, spanning AWS, Kubernetes (EKS) and MongoDB Cloud
  • Agentic platform enablement, workflows and automation
  • Infrastructure as Code, primarily through Terraform
  • Modern CI/CD, using GitOps patterns and tools such as ArgoCD

The Role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll be a driving force behind the evolution of Semble's engineering platform and the day-to-day experience of every engineer who builds on top of it. You'll champion infrastructure best practices, shape team goals, and influence the wider engineering roadmap. Just as importantly, you'll obsess over friction: the small (and large) things that slow engineers down, and how to remove them through better tooling, clearer paths, and stronger enablement.

This is a senior, high-trust role: you'll be expected to make sound architectural judgement calls, mentor other engineers, and represent the Platform team's priorities in cross-functional conversations, all while keeping empathy for the end-user (your fellow engineers) at the centre of what you build.

In One Year, You'll Know You Were Successful If You...

Developer productivity and enablement

  • Reduced the barrier for every engineer to build, ship, and operate their own code in production, measured through faster lead time for changes and fewer hand-offs
  • Built or improved self-service tooling and "golden paths" (e.g. project templates, standard CI/CD pipelines, scaffolding tools) so teams can spin up new services without needing Platform's direct involvement
  • Improved onboarding for new engineers, shrinking the time it takes someone to make their first meaningful production contribution
  • Ran or contributed to developer experience initiatives such as office hours, internal workshops, or "lunch and learn" sessions to build AWS/Kubernetes/CI-CD literacy across the wider engineering org
  • Wrote and maintained clear, discoverable documentation and runbooks, treating docs as a product with the same quality bar as code
  • Gathered and acted on developer experience signals (e.g. surveys, feedback loops, usage metrics on internal tools) to prioritise the roadmap based on real pain points, not assumptions
  • Partnered with engineering teams to understand their workflows first-hand (shadowing, pairing, dogfooding your own tools) rather than building in isolation
  • Brought innovative ideas to the team and contributed meaningfully to the Platform roadmap, balancing infrastructure evolution with tooling and enablement work
  • Established objective measures of "done" and documented assumptions clearly, so both infrastructure and tooling initiatives had transparent success criteria
  • Contributed to observability as code initiatives, both inside the team and across engineering

Infrastructure & reliability

  • Provided a highly available and performant platform, including our AWS, Kubernetes (EKS) and MongoDB Cloud infrastructure
  • Hardened production systems, improving uptime, graceful degradation, and automated recovery
  • Modernised our CI/CD pipelines leveraging GitOps practices (e.g. ArgoCD), making deployments faster, safer and more transparent
  • Evolved our Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code, improving consistency, reusability, and safety of infrastructure changes
  • Established or improved SLAs/SLOs for core platform infrastructure
  • Worked with Security to raise our compliance and security posture without adding unnecessary burden on other engineering teams
  • Identified and delivered infrastructure cost-saving opportunities

A Background Like This Helps

Developer productivity & enablement

  • A solid background in software engineering (3-5 years), ideally having spent meaningful time as a product/application engineer before moving into platform work, giving you real empathy for the developer experience you're building for and the judgement to design tools and systems that fit naturally into developer workflows.
  • Experience building or contributing to internal developer platforms, portals, or self-service tooling (e.g. Backstage, custom CLIs, service catalogues)
  • A track record of designing "paved roads" or golden paths that make the right way the easy way for other engineers
  • Experience improving CI/CD pipelines not just for reliability, but for speed and developer feedback loops (e.g. reducing build/deploy times, improving local dev environments)
  • Comfort running enablement activities: writing documentation, running training sessions, pairing with other teams, or acting as an internal advocate for good engineering practices
  • Experience using developer experience metrics or frameworks (e.g. DORA metrics, SPACE framework, internal DevEx surveys) to guide prioritisation
  • A genuine interest in developer experience: you get satisfaction from removing friction for other engineers, not just from the infrastructure itself
  • Worked with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog

General

  • Proficiency in at least one of: Go, Python, Typescript, or strong shell scripting skills
  • Strong communication skills and comfort influencing technical direction across teams
  • A desire to keep learning, we'll help you grow further

Infrastructure & cloud

  • Deep understanding of core AWS services including IAM, S3, EC2, EKS, RDS, Lambda.
  • Experience running, maintaining and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters (EKS) in a production, multi-tenant environment
  • Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and configuration/deployment tooling such as Helm
  • Hands-on experience with modern GitOps CI/CD tooling (Argo CD, Flux, or similar)
  • Experience with MongoDB or similar managed database platforms
  • Experience monitoring and operating production systems (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience operating within a standards-compliant environment (e.g. ISO 27001)

What you’ll get in return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!
  • Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays +bank holidays +3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) - that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Private Health Insurance – covering physical and mental health, as well as dental and optical!
  • Hybrid & flexible work environment – work from anywhere in the UK, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.
  • Get the tech you need -
    You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to set up your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team – our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument - with a roof terrace, weekly animations, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices (barista coffee, tea, fruit, happy hours and activities...).

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and all walks of life, including any typically underrepresented groups in the technology industry. We also encourage applications from disabled and neurodiverse candidates, so if there are any adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process, please do let us know.

OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Conversion & Creative Strategist Reporting To: VP of Growth / FounderJob SummaryThe Conversion & Creative Strategist at Triquetra Health is responsible for owning the messaging, positioning, and conversion strategy behind Triquetra’s product catalog across Amazon, Shopify, paid media, and other digital channels.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Conversion & Creative Strategist

Reporting To: VP of Growth / Founder

Job Summary

The Conversion & Creative Strategist at Triquetra Health is responsible for owning the messaging, positioning, and conversion strategy behind Triquetra’s product catalog across Amazon, Shopify, paid media, and other digital channels.

This role exists to bridge the gap between science and conversion—translating complex product mechanisms into clear, persuasive messaging that resonates with real buyers and drives measurable business results.

As the owner of the strategic argument behind every product, the Conversion & Creative Strategist develops positioning frameworks, messaging architecture, conversion hypotheses, and testing strategies that improve customer understanding and increase conversion performance. This role works closely with design, paid media, content, and leadership teams to ensure product messaging remains clear, consistent, and performance-driven across every customer touchpoint.

This is not a design role. The primary responsibility is owning what we say, why it matters, and how it converts.

Duties & Responsibilities

Messaging Strategy & Positioning

  • Own the positioning and messaging architecture for Triquetra’s hero products and product lines across all major channels
  • Develop clear, compelling product narratives that translate complex health and wellness science into customer-first messaging
  • Ensure consistency of messaging across Amazon listings, Shopify product pages, landing pages, paid ads, and creative assets
  • Refine value propositions, core claims, product angles, and differentiators to improve buyer trust and conversion

Conversion Optimization & Testing Strategy

  • Build and manage a structured conversion testing framework across product pages, landing pages, and marketplace listings
  • Develop hypotheses based on performance data, customer behavior, and competitor insights
  • Prioritize testing opportunities based on expected impact, business goals, and channel performance
  • Continuously analyze conversion metrics, test results, and funnel performance to identify growth opportunities
  • Translate winning concepts into repeatable conversion strategies across product categories

Creative Strategy & Brief Development

  • Convert product insights, performance data, and competitive intelligence into actionable creative briefs
  • Provide strategic direction for designers, video editors, UGC creators, and content partners
  • Ensure briefs clearly define target audience, messaging angle, objections, emotional drivers, and desired conversion outcome
  • Collaborate with creative teams to improve execution quality and performance alignment

Competitive Intelligence & Market Analysis

  • Conduct ongoing analysis of competitor product pages, listings, funnels, creative strategies, and conversion tactics
  • Monitor trends in supplements, wellness, ecommerce, and DTC marketing
  • Build and maintain a structured swipe file and competitor intelligence system
  • Translate competitor learnings into actionable testing opportunities and strategic recommendations

Performance Analysis & Growth Insights

  • Measure and evaluate the effectiveness of messaging, campaigns, and creative concepts using key performance metrics
  • Identify which messaging angles drive stronger engagement, click-through rates, and conversion
  • Build feedback loops that continuously improve positioning and creative performance
  • Partner with leadership and growth teams to support data-driven decision making

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with design, paid media, ecommerce, product, and leadership teams to ensure strategic alignment
  • Support launch planning for new products, promotions, and campaigns with strong conversion-focused messaging
  • Contribute to strategic discussions around customer acquisition, retention, and brand growth
  • Perform additional duties as required to support business growth and evolving priorities

Process Development & Scalability

  • Build scalable frameworks and systems to support messaging consistency across 100+ SKUs
  • Develop SOPs, templates, and workflows for briefing, testing, and performance review processes
  • Help establish best practices for conversion strategy and creative performance across the organization
  • Support the long-term development of Triquetra’s conversion and creative strategy function

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Conversion Optimization (CRO), Ecommerce Growth, Performance Marketing, Copywriting, or Creative Strategy
  • Proven experience driving measurable conversion improvements across e-commerce or DTC brands
  • Strong copywriting and messaging strategy skills with a deep understanding of customer psychology
  • Experience translating technical, scientific, or complex products into simple, persuasive messaging
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and generate actionable insights
  • Experience running structured A/B testing and conversion optimization initiatives
  • Strong project management and prioritization skills in fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in supplements, wellness, healthcare, or consumer packaged goods (CPG)
  • Experience with Amazon marketplace optimization and listing conversion strategy
  • Experience in DTC e-commerce brands with multi-channel sales environments
  • Familiarity with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, Google Analytics, heat mapping tools, and testing platforms
  • Experience working with creative teams, UGC creators, and paid media teams

Key Success Indicators

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improvement in product page and listing conversion rates
  • Increase in revenue driven by messaging and conversion optimization initiatives
  • Improved consistency and clarity of messaging across channels
  • Quality and effectiveness of testing frameworks and creative briefs
  • Speed and quality of strategic insights delivered to the business

What Success Looks Like

A successful Conversion & Creative Strategist at Triquetra Health is someone who can quickly identify why messaging is not converting, develop stronger positioning, and build systems that consistently improve performance across channels.

This person combines strategic thinking, customer psychology, analytical rigor, and hands-on execution to turn product science into persuasive messaging that drives measurable growth.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination.   • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We are builders, and our managers build too. Leaders here write code, ship pull requests and review their team’s work every week, all the way up to the Head of Engineering. A manager owns a team’s outcomes from the first conversation to production: what ships, how well it works, and how the people who build it grow.

We build with AI as the default, and our managers lead it by doing it. You stay current on how the best teams engineer with AI, try new tools and practices in your own work first, and bring to your team the ones that earn their place.

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager you lead a product engineering team that works directly on the workflows our clinics run every day. You also take real work in the codebase: features, fixes and the hard reviews. Senior engineers follow you because they have seen your code.

Delivery

Building with AI, and leading by example

  • Review the team’s pull requests and teach through them, holding AI-drafted work to the same bar as any other.

  • We are quietly confident and openly humble, being tenacious in our quest to perform and inspire others with our thirst for excellence.

  • We are steadfast in our pursuit to better our company, our colleagues, and ourselves. When we hire, we only hire people who bleed our principles and who will hopefully be our replacement one day.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Adoreal has become aware of fraudulent job offers being sent by people falsely claiming to represent us. To protect yourself:

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

jobs.description:
Risk Model Engineer — Pipeline Integrity (Transmission)

Location: Remote (US or Canada)
Department: Insights (AI/ML)
Reports to: Data Science Team Lead

Risk Model Engineer – Oil & Gas Transmission

Opportunity

If you want your work to make infrastructure smarter, safer, and more resilient, you’ll thrive here.

Irth Solutions builds advanced technology that empowers the people who keep our lights on, water running, and pipelines flowing. Our tools enhance the safety, reliability, and efficiency of critical infrastructure and the field technicians, engineers, and analysts who operate it.

We’re building a new AI-driven threat and risk management platform for pipeline asset integrity, and we’re looking for a Risk Model Engineer to own the transmission risk models that power its analytical layer.

Operators already run our probabilistic threat models in production today. You’ll migrate these models to our new platform, validate them against existing implementations, extend coverage across the transmission threat landscape, and help build Irth’s own model library. Your work will produce risk assessments and reliability calculations that pipeline operators can explain, defend, and support under regulatory scrutiny.

The work spans physics-based probabilistic models and machine learning, with a focus on producing results that are technically sound, explainable, and defensible.

Practical experience in North American oil and gas transmission is our top priority. We encourage strong industry candidates to apply even if their modeling experience is less extensive. We’re hiring two engineers and will balance the team’s strengths, with one potentially bringing deeper industry expertise and the other deeper modeling expertise.

Location: Remote within the United States or Canada, with working hours within approximately four hours of Central Time.

What You’ll Do

  • Migrate existing probabilistic model code to the new risk management platform and validate results against the current production implementation.
  • Integrate model inputs from diverse datasets across Irth’s product offerings.
  • Extend threat coverage across transmission pipeline integrity domains, including corrosion, cracking, third-party damage, outside forces, and other relevant threats.
  • Design and build time-series, anomaly detection, and geospatial models using inspection, sensor, maintenance, and related data.
  • Implement industry-standard probabilistic risk models within the analytical layer and support customer-driven model development on the platform.
  • Develop, evaluate, and present robust sensitivity analyses for all model offerings.
  • Validate model outputs against customer data, known outcomes, and applicable regulatory expectations.
  • Partner daily with ML Ops and data engineering teams, who own productionization, while you own the model methodology, content, validation, and supporting evidence.

What Will Help You Succeed

We don’t expect one candidate to bring every skill or experience listed. Practical North American oil and gas transmission experience is our highest priority. We’re looking for a combination of industry knowledge, quantitative modeling expertise, and sound engineering judgment across the two hires.

  • Transmission pipeline integrity: Experience with pipeline integrity management, threat identification, risk assessment, and integrity mitigation or remediation prioritization.
  • Threat and failure mechanisms: Familiarity with transmission pipeline threats such as external and internal corrosion, cracking, third-party damage, and other relevant threats.
  • Probabilistic risk modeling: Experience developing, implementing, migrating, or validating probabilistic models used to assess pipeline integrity or asset risk.
  • Inspection and operational data: Familiarity with in-line inspection (ILI), pipeline inspection records, sensor data, maintenance histories, or related operational datasets.
  • Reliability and sensitivity analysis: Experience evaluating model assumptions, uncertainty, sensitivity, and the impact of risk factors on model outputs.
  • Regulatory and customer-facing work: Experience supporting regulatory reviews, integrity assessments, audits, or customer decisions with clear, defensible technical evidence.
  • Machine learning and analytics: Experience applying machine learning to physical asset data, including time-series analysis, anomaly detection, classification, survival analysis, or related methods.
  • Geospatial analysis: Experience with spatial data, GIS tools, or geospatial risk assessment.
  • Python and software engineering: Sound engineering practices, including testing, code review, reproducibility, and disciplined use of AI coding assistants.
  • Real-world data and model judgment: Comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data and the ability to distinguish a defensible, validated model from one that simply produces a number.

You don’t need to check every box. Candidates with deep transmission industry experience or strong quantitative modeling expertise are encouraged to apply, particularly if they bring working familiarity with the other area.

Why This Role Matters

Your work will help pipeline operators better understand threats, quantify risk, and make defensible integrity management decisions. You’ll contribute to the evolution of models already used in production while helping establish the analytical foundation of a new AI-driven platform.

You’ll work at the intersection of pipeline engineering, probabilistic risk, machine learning, and software development, with a direct impact on the safety and reliability of critical energy infrastructure.

Work Location

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States or Canada, with working hours that overlap within approximately four hours of Central Time.

Requirements

What Will Help You Succeed

We don’t expect a single candidate to bring all of the experience listed below. North American oil and gas transmission experience is our highest priority. We’re hiring two engineers and will balance the team’s strengths across industry expertise and quantitative modeling. Candidates with deep practical industry experience or strong risk modeling expertise are encouraged to apply, provided they have working familiarity with the other area.

  • Transmission pipeline integrity and regulation: Experience with North American oil and gas transmission integrity management, including applicable standards and regulations such as ASME B31.8S, 49 CFR 192, CSA Z662, or equivalents.
  • Fitness-for-service and failure mechanisms: Familiarity with fitness-for-service and remaining-strength assessments, corrosion growth modeling, or fracture mechanics.
  • In-line inspection (ILI) data: Experience working with ILI vendor data formats, data alignment, anomaly classification, and feature disposition.
  • Consequence and location analysis: Experience with high-consequence areas, class-location analysis, or related pipeline risk assessment requirements.
  • Regulatory and audit support: Experience preparing technical documentation and validation evidence for regulatory review, audits, or other formal assessments.
  • Quantitative risk and reliability modeling: Experience building or validating risk, reliability, or failure models for physical infrastructure. Pipeline experience is ideal, but relevant experience with rail, structural, water, or utility assets can transfer well.
  • Probabilistic methods and uncertainty: Familiarity with Monte Carlo simulation, structural reliability, uncertainty quantification, or related probabilistic methods.
  • Machine learning and physical asset data: Experience applying machine learning to time-series, survival, anomaly detection, or classification problems involving physical asset data. Experience training and validating models on sparse, imbalanced failure events is particularly valuable. We’re especially interested in candidates who are strong in either machine learning or pipeline integrity and have working familiarity with the other.
  • Geospatial analysis: Experience with ArcGIS, PostGIS, linear referencing, or geospatial risk assessment.
  • Python and software engineering: Sound engineering practices, including testing, code review, reproducibility, and disciplined use of AI coding assistants.
  • Real-world data and model judgment: Comfort working with incomplete, inconsistent, and imperfect data, along with the judgment to distinguish a defensible, validated model from one that simply produces a number.

You don’t need to check every box. We value sound technical judgment, practical industry knowledge, and the ability to build or validate models whose results can be explained and defended. We’re particularly interested in candidates who bring deep transmission expertise or strong quantitative modeling skills and can collaborate effectively across both domains.

jobs.description:
About the job Head of Accounting

RMA Group is a multi-sector organization with more than 9,000 employees and an operational presence in 17 countries. For 40 years, we have developed enduring partnerships to support the needs of our clients, underpinned by the core values of Innovation, Integrity and Endurance. Through its various businesses including RMA Automotive, Global Fleet Sales, Comin Asia and Express Food Group (EFG), RMA Group has established itself as the partner of choice for leading automotive, equipment, engineering services, and food brands in Southeast Asia and beyond.

Overview and purpose of the role

The Head of Accounting leads the day-to-day accounting operations of the business. The role ensures accurate and timely financial records, reliable inventory records and valuation, strong internal controls, and full compliance with statutory, tax and Group reporting requirements. It owns the general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, payroll accounting, fixed assets, inventory accounting and control, tax filings and the month-end and year-end close. It also builds a high-performing accounting team that supports the wider finance organisation across RMAC Group's divisions.

﻿﻿Key responsibilities:
1. Accounting Operations
  • Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, fixed asset registers and inventory accounting.
  • Ensure the month-end and year-end close is accurate, complete and on time, with a published closing calendar and clear cut-off rules.
  • Review journal entries, accruals, prepayments and provisions, and approve non-routine entries.
  • Oversee revenue recognition, warranty and after-sales accounting, and the accounting for related-party and intercompany transactions.
2. Inventory Accounting and Control
  • Oversee inventory records for vehicles, spare parts, accessories and workshop stock across all locations.
  • Ensure accurate and timely recording of stock receipts, issues, transfers, returns and adjustments, with correct cut-off at period end.
  • Oversee the costing of inventory, including landed cost (freight, import duty, clearing and other direct costs), and ensure costs are correctly capitalised.
  • Ensure inventory is valued in line with accounting standards at the lower of cost and net realisable value, and review provisions for slow-moving, obsolete and damaged stock.
  • Plan and supervise periodic and year-end physical stock counts and cycle counts, investigate variances and approve adjustments within delegated authority.
  • Reconcile the inventory subledger to the general ledger every month, including goods received not invoiced, goods in transit and consignment or demo stock.
  • Monitor stock levels, ageing and turnover, and report slow-moving stock and excess inventory to management.
  • Ensure inventory controls are in place over warehouse access, stock movements, vehicle identification numbers and the safeguarding of stock.
  • Ensure three-way matching between purchase orders, goods receipts and supplier invoices so inventory and payables are recorded correctly.
  • Provide inventory data and analysis to support purchasing, pricing, gross profit review and working capital management.
3. Financial Reporting
  • Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules in line with applicable accounting standards (CIFRS) and RMA Group policies.
  • Provide accurate trial balances and accounting data to the Finance Manager and finance analysts for management reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
  • Prepare Group reporting submissions, intercompany confirmations and consolidation inputs, including elimination schedules and intercompany stock profit adjustments where applicable.
4. Reconciliations and Data Integrity
  • Review all balance sheet reconciliations (bank, AR, AP, inventory, fixed assets, intercompany, accruals) and resolve discrepancies promptly.
  • Ensure supplier statements are reconciled regularly and customer balances are confirmed and followed up.
  • Maintain the integrity of the chart of accounts, item master data, costing data and subledgers.
5. Tax and Statutory Compliance
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (VAT, withholding tax, tax on income, salary tax, prepayment of tax) and other regulatory submissions.
  • Ensure import duties and taxes on inventory are correctly calculated, recorded and supported by customs documents.
  • Ensure payroll deductions and contributions, including NSSF, are correctly accounted for and remitted.
  • Monitor changes in tax law and regulation and update accounting practices accordingly.
  • Support tax audits and correspondence with the General Department of Taxation and other government bodies.
6. Internal Controls and Compliance
  • Design, implement and monitor internal controls over accounting and inventory transactions, including segregation of duties and approval limits.
  • Establish and maintain accounting policies, procedures and SOPs, and ensure compliance with company, Group and local requirements.
  • Strengthen the AP workflow (invoice receipt, three-way matching, approval, payment scheduling) so suppliers are paid accurately and on time.
  • Ensure proper document retention and audit trails.
7. Audit Coordination
  • Act as the primary contact for internal and external auditors.
  • Coordinate auditor attendance at stock counts and provide inventory valuation and provision workings.
  • Prepare audit schedules and supporting documents, respond to queries, and track the resolution of audit findings and management letter points.
8. Accounting Systems and Process Improvement
  • Maintain and improve accounting systems, templates and workflows.
  • Work with the IT department on Odoo accounting and inventory configuration (including costing methods, stock valuation and warehouse workflows), raising clear fix, improvement and new-development requests, and testing the results before release.
  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting processes and shorten the close.
9. Team Leadership and Development
  • Supervise, train, coach and develop accounting staff, including those handling inventory.
  • Allocate workload, set deadlines and review the quality of team output.
  • Plan team coverage and cross-training so critical tasks never depend on one person.
10. Support to Finance Management
  • Support budgeting, forecasting and management reporting with timely and accurate accounting and inventory data.
  • Partner with the Finance Manager and CFO on ad hoc financial analysis and special projects.
11. Cost Control and Efficiency
  • Monitor accounting-related costs and inventory losses and write-offs, and identify efficiency gains.
  • Promote best practice to improve the accuracy and turnaround time of accounting deliverables.
HR Responsibilities
  • Support the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures affecting the accounting team, including onboarding, performance management and training plans.
  • Prepare HR-related reports for the accounting function as the company requires.
  • Report functionally to the Finance Manager and CFO on accounting team matters.
Financial Responsibilities
  • Assist the Finance Manager and CFO in preparing the annual accounting budget and monitor departmental expenditure.
  • Review and approve routine accounting expenditure proposals and inventory adjustments within delegated authority, ensuring compliance with Group and legal requirements.
Background and experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field. ACCA, CPA or equivalent is preferred.
  • Minimum 5 to 7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or team-lead role.
  • Proven experience managing full-cycle accounting operations and the month-end and year-end close.
  • Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, costing, stock counts and inventory controls.
  • Experience in automotive, distribution, trading or a similar multi-entity group environment is an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and reporting standards (CIFRS, IFRS, including inventory standards), Cambodian tax regulations and statutory obligations.
  • Understanding of internal control systems, segregation of duties and audit procedures.
  • Knowledge of payroll accounting, fixed assets, inventory costing and valuation, and intercompany and consolidation accounting.
  • Proficiency in ERP and accounting software (Odoo preferred, including its inventory module) and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong supervisory, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting and inventory matters to non-finance colleagues.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Strategic thinking
  • Sound decision making
  • Mentoring, coaching and performance management
  • Flexibility and the ability to work under closing pressure
  • High integrity and confidentiality

If you're interested, please send your CV to:

  • Email:
  • Telegram HR Contact Person:
  • Contact HR at: 070 790 890

﻿RMA Group is an equal opportunity employer, with a diverse group of colleagues globally representing different cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs. Our values of Innovation, Integrity and Endurance are embedded in what we do, and we welcome applicants who are committed to respecting diversity of thought, and in living our values on a day-to-day basis.

About APTNEXUS

Since our founding 2012, APTNEXUS has empowered federal agencies and commercial enterprises to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape. As a quality-driven small business, we specialize in the seamless delivery of IT modernization and elite cybersecurity solutions. We help our clients modernize and fortify their technology stacks —ensuring their most critical data and assets remain resilient, optimized, and secure in an evolving threat environment.

Clearance:

Ability to obtain and maintain a Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for our Department of Treasury customer. Candidates must reside in, and perform all work from, the continental United States or its outlying territories.

Location:

Remote (United States)

Full-time, remote. Must be available during core business hours (Eastern Time) to support scheduled audit activities. Travel to audited organization sites may be required on occasion, with advance notice.

Salary Range:

$115,000 to $140,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Position Overview:

AptNexus is seeking a Senior IT Security Auditor to perform cybersecurity compliance audits for our Department of Treasury customer. The program audits federal, state, and local government organizations that receive sensitive federal data, evaluating their information systems against security requirements tailored from NIST SP 800-53. In this role, you will plan and conduct audits of technical and management controls, perform hands-on configuration testing across operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud services, and mainframe platforms, and deliver clear, defensible findings to customer personnel and the audited organizations. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented self-starter who combines disciplined audit practice with genuine technical depth.

  • Develop audit schedules and recommend auditor assignments that cover every in-scope technology while minimizing conflicts.
  • Perform hands-on technical control testing using automated scanning tools and manual configuration review against NIST SP 800-53 controls, CIS Benchmarks, and DISA STIGs.
  • Evaluate management controls through interviews with system administrators and examination of policies, procedures, and system artifacts.
  • Present audit scope and data flows at opening conferences, and present technical findings at closing conferences.
  • Provide daily written status updates during audits, including progress, outstanding work, potential critical findings, scope changes, and concerns.
  • Document test results and prepare preliminary findings, final audit report sections, and corrective action recommendations with risk-based remediation timelines.

  • Review the work of other auditors for accuracy and consistency, and provide technical guidance on complex testing and findings.
  • Educate audited organizations on applicable security requirements and recommended approaches to remediation.

  • Hands-on experience testing and validating security configurations on Windows, Linux, UNIX, and macOS systems; virtualization and container platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift); databases; and network devices such as firewalls, routers, switches, VPN, wireless, VoIP, and SAN/NAS storage.

  • Working knowledge of encryption technologies and standards, including TLS, VPN, and FIPS 140 validated cryptography.

  • Exceptional technical writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, well-supported, and defensible audit findings.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Word skills; experience developing or using VBA macros is preferred.
  • Detail-oriented self-starter who takes ownership of assignments, manages competing priorities, and drives work to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Certification:
    • Must have at least one of the following certifications:
      • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) (preferred)
      • CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)
      • GIAC Systems and Network Auditor (GSNA)
  • Polished written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present findings to senior officials at audited organizations.

Who are we?

Applied AI for liquidity.

Corporate finance teams still manage cash by hand — stitching together spreadsheets, bank portals and ERP data across Treasury, AR and AP. Most treasury tools stop at visibility: a dashboard someone still has to read, interpret and act on.

Nilus goes further. We're building an agentic workforce for treasury — AI agents that reconcile cash, forecast liquidity and automate finance ops across every bank and ERP, in one connected system for Treasury, AR and AP.

We're a Series A company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Felicis, Perpetual Growth and Better Tomorrow Ventures, led by a team of ex-fintech pros transforming the finance function.

The role

Nilus is hiring an FDE to sit between our customers and our product. You'll work directly with treasury and finance teams to understand how they really run cash. You'll turn that into solutions on the Nilus platform and bring what you learn back to Product and R&D so it shapes what we build next.

This role is for someone who understands treasury and thinks like a product person. You know how cash positioning, forecasting, bank reconciliation and payments fit together. You're just as comfortable designing a workflow with a customer's treasurer as you are writing requirements with a product manager.

You'll be customer-facing across the lifecycle: early solution design, rollout, adoption and expansion. You'll also be one of the strongest voices of the customer inside the company.

What you'll do

  • Run deep discovery with customers and prospects to map their treasury workflows, data sources and banking setup, and design how Nilus solves them.
  • Own solution design for new customers, from scoping integrations and bank connectivity to configuring forecasting, reconciliation and reporting to fit their processes.
  • Design and refine the agent workflows customers run on Nilus, and turn customer-specific solutions into repeatable product patterns.
  • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, and work with Product and R&D (Tel Aviv) on prioritization, specs and validation.
  • Run beta and early-access programs for new features: pick design partners, collect feedback, and confirm the feature solves the problem before general release.
  • Support pre-sales when deals need product depth: solution workshops, technical deep dives and tailored demos alongside Sales.
  • Partner with Customer Success on rollouts and adoption, and spot expansion opportunities based on how customers use the product.
  • Create solution guides, use-case libraries and enablement content for Sales, CS and Marketing.
  • Track how treasury teams, TMS platforms and competitors are evolving, and feed that into product strategy.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in corporate treasury, treasury consulting, or an FDE / product / solutions role at a fintech or TMS company
  • Hands-on product experience, such as product management, product operations, or solutions work closely tied to a product roadmap
  • Strong grasp of cash management workflows, banking data structures (BAI2, MT940, APIs) and reconciliation processes
  • Familiarity with SaaS-based treasury management (TMS) or cash management platforms
  • Proven customer-facing experience with finance and treasury leaders, from analysts to CFOs
  • Comfortable with APIs, data mapping and system integrations (you won't be coding, but you'll design and scope the solution)

Success isn't about sending the most messages. It's about building trust, creating a pipeline of relevant opportunities, and making relationships compound over time.

  • Excellent organization, CRM discipline, and follow-through.

  • Persistence without pressure, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to qualify genuine opportunities.

  • A proactive mindset: you can research new audiences, test sourcing channels, and build processes without waiting for a playbook.

  • Comfort working independently in a lean, fast-moving environment.

Private equity expertise is a plus, not a prerequisite. You should already speak the language of business and finance, though.

  • Work closely with senior leadership in a lean team, without layers of management.

  • Progress from managing outreach and follow-ups to leading sponsor relationships and owning a meaningful part of the origination process.

You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline. You can speak credibly with a grower in the greenhouse, challenge an internal team on a missed commitment, and then give management a concise, evidence-based view of risk and opportunity. You do not wait for customer dissatisfaction to become visible: you create clarity early, align stakeholders and follow through until the outcome is achieved.

Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.

At Salted, we believe the future of restaurants doesn’t look anything like what we see today. The most successful brands will focus primarily on delivery and take-out - and use technology to nurture deep customer relationships that exist outside four walls.
