About the Role

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Growth Marketing Manager will manage the growth engine at Salted. You will think holistically about both top-line sales and bottom-line profitability across our entire portfolio of brands, with a focus on our flagship brand, moonbowls.

You're someone who loves to experiment, track performance, and figure out why things work (or why they didn't). This role sits at the intersection of marketplace management, direct-to-consumer (DTC) digital funnel optimization, retention marketing, and strategic growth opportunities. You will wear many hats, collaborate across teams (from Brand to Ops to Culinary), and adapt quickly as we scale from 40+ to 100+ locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Third-Party Marketplace Growth & Multivariate Testing: Work directly with the CEO to design and execute multivariate tests across major delivery platforms (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Optimize store presentation, menu architecture, photos, promotions, and ad placement to drive maximum conversion, order frequency, net profitability.
  • Web & Funnel Optimization: Own and optimize conversion funnels across brand websites, primarily moonbowls. Run continuous A/B tests on landing pages, checkout flows, and user experience to improve conversion rates and average order value (AOV).
  • Retention & Lifecycle Marketing: Partner closely with our Head of Brand Marketing to build, test, and scale automated drip campaigns across email and SMS. Focus on key metrics like retention, customer lifetime value (LTV), repeat order frequency, and win-backs.
  • Holistic Funnel Strategy: Treat every customer touchpoint—from digital ads to our physical storefronts to packaging —as part of a unified growth engine.
  • Data & Analytics Mastery: Analyze channel performance, customer cohorts, menu conversion metrics, and promotional margins. Uncover trends, diagnose funnel leaks, and translate data into actionable growth initiatives.
  • White Space & Market Expansion: Collaborate with Culinary and Operations teams to advise on market opportunities and menu expansion based on consumer demand trends and performance data.
  • Scale & Cascade: Develop growth playbooks for moonbowls and cascade winning frameworks across our portfolio of brands.
  • Salted-Operated Locations: Maximize the customer experience and growth potential at our physical storefronts. Work cross-functionally to optimize the pickup experience, in-store branding, and hospitality touchpoints to turn one-time pickup customers into recurring first-party digital orderers.
  • Catering Growth & Acquisition Funnel: Treat catering as a primary top-of-funnel acquisition channel. Collaborate with our Business Development team to test campaigns that convert high-value corporate/group catering clients into loyal customer accounts.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on growth experience in DTC, food-tech, delivery platform marketing, or e-commerce.
  • Data-driven & obsessed with economics: You care about customer frequency, net margins and net payouts - not just top-line vanity metrics.
  • AI-proficiency: You are comfortable using AI to solve problems and are constantly looking for ways to accelerate great work - without sacrificing accuracy and authenticity.
  • Marketing stack experience: Hands-on experience with web analytics tools, A/B testing platforms, and lifecycle marketing platforms
  • Scrappy & adaptable: Comfortable moving between high-level strategic growth planning and rolling up your sleeves to execute day-to-day optimizations.

  • LA-based: Ideally based in LA (although not a requirement).

• Work with a team that’s transforming the restaurant industry

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Operations Technology & Automation, reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer, to own the automation, technology, and AI integration into our customer facing teams. This is a pivotal role to chart the automation and AI integration course of a rapidly scaling $100 million+ marketplace, focused on improving quality of our customer experience, while directly driving revenue and increasing efficiency within our 1,000+ customer-facing agent population.

This role will own the roadmap on which automation and AI integration to prioritize, having autonomy to choose third parties, prioritize experiments, and leveraging our dedicated Operations engineers. Success is measured in incremental revenue, cost-to-serve, improved customer experience, and faster response and handle times — not in features shipped.

What You’ll Own

Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Build and maintain a rolling 12-month roadmap for Operations tooling, automation, and AI features, prioritized by risk-adjusted ROI - working closely with our fast-paced engineering team (including dedicated Ops engineers), as well as the broader Operations Org, and Strategy team.

Specs & Delivery

  • Write the product specs: problem statement, current state, target state, user flows, requirements, edge cases, success metrics, and rollout plan.
  • Act as the owner for each initiative end-to-end — from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurement - within a rigorous fast-paced AB testing environment.

AI Integration and Tooling

  • Be the leader integrating AI into the company, including making the buy vs. build decisions, and managing relationships and pilots with key vendors.
  • Leverage the relationships with Hubspot, Aircall, and smaller third parties to evaluate and integrate AI solutions - or decide to build in-house with our engineering team.
  • Translate operational pain points and revenue opportunities into a prioritized backlog for tooling improvements with clear hypotheses and success metrics.

Measurement & Operating Rhythm

  • Weekly reporting on KPIs - which you will define based on specific project focus areas, e.g., sales automation might prioritize conversion rate on leads or touch to connect ratio, care AI integration would show costs saved / improved handling time / increased customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain a tight feedback loop with frontline reps and managers — shadow shifts, sit in on calls, ship, iterate.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.description:
An English posting will follow.

Développeur full-stack senior

Lieu : Montréal (Québec), en mode hybride, ou à distance dans le même fuseau horaire

Type d’emploi : Temps plein

Niveau d’expérience : Senior

Rémunération : 120 000 $ à 145 000 $ CA

À propos de nous

Jeux Face à Face est la principale entreprise canadienne de jeux de cartes à collectionner offrant une gamme complète de services. Nous achetons et vendons des produits de jeux de cartes à collectionner, exploitons des magasins de détail et une plateforme de commerce électronique, et organisons des événements d’envergure partout au Canada dans le cadre du F2F Tour.

La technologie soutient presque tous les aspects de nos activités, notamment notre boutique en ligne, nos systèmes de point de vente, nos outils d’évaluation et de tarification des cartes, nos activités événementielles ainsi que les intégrations qui relient ces systèmes.

Nous sommes une petite ou moyenne entreprise en pleine évolution, dotée d’une culture pragmatique et axée sur l’action. Nous avons historiquement beaucoup fait appel à des partenaires de développement externes et investissons maintenant afin de renforcer notre expertise interne en développement logiciel.

Aperçu du poste

Nous recherchons une personne expérimentée en développement full-stack qui prendra en charge nos applications existantes et créera de nouveaux systèmes pour soutenir nos activités de commerce électronique et de vente au détail.

Vous travaillerez sur des applications destinées à la clientèle et sur des outils internes, au moyen d’une pile technologique principalement composée de TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React/Svelte, Shopify et PostgreSQL. Vous travaillerez également sur les intégrations reliant Shopify, NetSuite, notre catalogue de produits, notre infrastructure de recherche et d’autres systèmes d’entreprise.

Il s’agit d’un rôle concret offrant une grande autonomie. Vous devez être à l’aise de prendre en charge des bases de code que vous ne connaissez pas, de travailler avec une documentation imparfaite ou incomplète, de prendre des décisions pragmatiques en matière d’architecture et d’expliquer les compromis techniques à des parties prenantes non techniques.

En tant que l’une des premières personnes embauchées au sein de notre équipe interne de développement logiciel, vous aurez également l’occasion de contribuer à l’établissement de nos pratiques de développement et d’influencer l’orientation technique de nos systèmes.

Vos responsabilités

  • Développer et maintenir notre vitrine Shopify, nos applications personnalisées, nos extensions de point de vente, nos extensions d’interface utilisateur et nos Shopify Functions.
  • Créer et maintenir des applications Web internes qui soutiennent l’évaluation et la tarification des cartes, les événements et les activités de vente au détail.
  • Développer des intégrations entre Shopify, Oracle NetSuite, notre catalogue de produits, notre infrastructure de recherche et d’autres systèmes d’entreprise.
  • Créer et maintenir des pipelines de données et des utilitaires assurant la circulation fiable des données sur les prix, les stocks et le catalogue.
  • Prendre en charge les applications existantes développées par des agences et des prestataires externes.
  • Analyser des bases de code inconnues, résoudre des problèmes en production et mettre en œuvre des améliorations concrètes.
  • Contribuer à l’audit, à la documentation et à la consolidation de nos applications et intégrations existantes.
  • Prendre des décisions en matière d’architecture et de mise en œuvre en tenant compte de la maintenabilité, de la performance et des besoins de l’entreprise.
  • Travailler directement avec les parties prenantes internes afin de comprendre les problèmes opérationnels et de les traduire en solutions techniques.
  • Contribuer à établir des normes pragmatiques en matière de développement, de tests, de documentation, de déploiement et de qualité du code à mesure que nous renforçons nos capacités internes de développement.

Expérience requise

  • Au moins cinq ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, y compris la prise en charge de systèmes de production à un niveau senior.
  • Solides compétences en TypeScript et JavaScript, tant en développement frontal qu’en développement dorsal.
  • Expérience en production avec React et/ou Svelte/SvelteKit.
  • Expérience en développement dorsal avec Node.js à l’aide d’Express, de Fastify ou de cadres similaires.
  • Expérience en développement Shopify, notamment avec les applications, les thèmes et/ou les intégrations d’API.
  • Expérience avec PostgreSQL et des outils modernes d’accès aux données tels que Prisma ou Drizzle.
  • Expérience dans la création et l’intégration d’API REST et GraphQL.
  • Capacité à prendre en charge de façon autonome des bases de code inconnues, à diagnostiquer les problèmes et à prendre des décisions techniques judicieuses.
  • Capacité à expliquer clairement les décisions et les compromis techniques à des parties prenantes non techniques.
  • Aisance à travailler avec de grands volumes de données essentielles aux activités de commerce électronique et de vente au détail.

Atouts

  • Expérience avec Shopify Polaris, App Bridge et l’écosystème élargi des applications Shopify.
  • Expérience avec PHP/Laravel.
  • Expérience avec NetSuite SuiteScript ou avec l’intégration d’autres systèmes ERP.
  • Expérience avec OpenSearch, Elasticsearch ou une infrastructure de recherche similaire.
  • Expérience avec un système de gestion de l’information produit (PIM), particulièrement Akeneo.
  • Expérience dans le transfert des activités de développement d’une agence externe vers une équipe interne.
  • Expérience comme unique développeur ou développeuse, ou comme membre intégré d’une équipe, avec d’importantes responsabilités.
  • Expérience en tests automatisés avec des outils tels que Vitest, Playwright ou PHPUnit.
  • Expérience en création de scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des jeux de cartes à collectionner.

Lieu et exigences de travail

Poste à distance ou en mode hybride, basé au Canada.
La personne doit résider au Canada et être légalement autorisée à y travailler.
La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour les communications quotidiennes avec nos équipes de l’Ontario, des États-Unis et de l’Europe ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires externes.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un rôle clé assorti d’importantes responsabilités à l’égard de nos applications et de notre orientation technique.

Senior Full-Stack Developer

Location: Montreal, Quebec (Hybrid) or remote in that time zone

About Us

Face to Face Games is Canada’s leading full-service trading card game company. We buy and sell trading card game products, operate retail locations, run e-commerce operations, and organize large-scale events across Canada through the F2F Tour.

Technology supports nearly every part of our business, including our e-commerce storefront, point-of-sale systems, card appraisal and pricing tools, event operations, and the integrations that connect them.

We are a fast-moving small to midsized company with a practical, hands-on culture. We have historically relied heavily on external development partners and are now investing in bringing more software development expertise in-house.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an experienced full-stack developer to take ownership of existing applications and build new systems supporting our e-commerce and retail operations.

You’ll work across customer-facing and internal applications, with a stack centered around TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React/Svelte, Shopify, and PostgreSQL. You’ll also work with integrations connecting Shopify, NetSuite, our product catalog, search infrastructure, and other business systems.

This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy. You should be comfortable taking over unfamiliar codebases, working through imperfect or incomplete documentation, making practical architecture decisions, and communicating technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

As one of our first in-house software development hires, you’ll also have an opportunity to help establish our development practices and influence the technical direction of our systems.

What You’ll Do

Develop and maintain our Shopify storefront, custom apps, POS extensions, UI extensions, and Shopify Functions.
Build and maintain internal web applications supporting card appraisal, pricing, events, and retail operations.
Develop integrations between Shopify, Oracle NetSuite, our product catalog, search infrastructure, and other business systems.
Build and maintain data pipelines and utilities that keep pricing, inventory, and catalog data flowing reliably.
Take ownership of existing applications developed by external agencies and contractors.
Investigate unfamiliar codebases, troubleshoot production issues, and implement practical improvements.
Help audit, document, and consolidate our existing applications and integrations.
Make architecture and implementation decisions with consideration for maintainability, performance, and business requirements.
Work directly with internal stakeholders to understand operational problems and translate them into technical solutions.
Help establish practical standards for development, testing, documentation, deployment, and code quality as we expand our internal development capabilities.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including senior-level ownership of production systems.
  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript skills across both frontend and backend development.
  • Production experience with React and/or Svelte/SvelteKit.
  • Node.js backend development experience using Express, Fastify, or similar frameworks.
  • Shopify development experience, including apps, themes, and/or API integrations.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and modern data-access tooling such as Prisma or Drizzle.
  • Experience building and integrating REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Ability to independently take ownership of unfamiliar codebases, diagnose problems, and make sound technical decisions.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfort working with high-volume, business-critical e-commerce and retail data.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Shopify Polaris, App Bridge, and the broader Shopify app ecosystem.
  • PHP/Laravel experience.
  • NetSuite SuiteScript or other ERP integration experience.
  • OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or similar search infrastructure experience.
  • PIM experience, particularly Akeneo.
  • Experience transitioning development from an external agency to an internal team.
  • Experience working as a solo or embedded developer with significant ownership.
  • Automated testing experience using tools such as Vitest, Playwright, or PHPUnit.
  • Python scripting experience.
  • Familiarity with trading card games.

Location & Work Requirements

Remote or hybrid role based in Canada.

Physical presence in Canada and legal eligibility to work in Canada are required.
English fluency is required for daily communication with our Ontario, US, and European teams and external partners.

What We Offer

  • A foundational role with significant ownership over our applications and technical direction.
  • The opportunity to modernize and unify production systems that directly support our day-to-day business.
  • A structured transition period with our current development agency.
  • A collaborative, practical, and fast-moving work environment.
  • Flexible daily schedule within Monday–Friday core hours.
  • Remote or hybrid work arrangement.
  • Health and dental benefits.
  • Group RRSP with employer contribution match.
  • Employee discount.
  • The opportunity to help shape our development practices and future technology team.

Face to Face Games is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

jobs.excerpt: Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal.  We’re a growth marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands.
jobs.description:
Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal.

We’re a growth marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands.

We believe scale isn’t about bigger budgets but smarter decisions. Our team has helped brands across the globe generate over $1 billion in revenue by combining sharp strategy, bold creativity, and hands-on execution.

We’re designed for the digital era, where everything evolves at the speed of light. Our work evolves alongside it, adapting to the industries, platforms, and audiences we help grow.

We partner with some of the world’s fastest-growing brands, from disruptive startups to global household names, to turn marketing spend into measurable business growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-time Business Development Manager who can turn great work into consistent growth.

You’ll take qualified opportunities and turn them into long-term client relationships, leading conversations from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close. You’ll speak directly with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers, digging into how their businesses actually grow and where Acceler8 can make a meaningful difference.

This is a senior, sales-focused role for someone who understands growth marketing beyond the campaign level. You’ll connect paid media, creative, conversion, retention, and measurement to the commercial realities of a business, then translate those opportunities into a compelling reason to work with Acceler8.

You’ll support the top of funnel through prospecting and lead generation, as well as Acceler8’s founders and leadership team on high-value opportunities, proposals, pricing, and closing strategy.

As a Business Development Manager, you will:

  • Take ownership of qualified opportunities, leading the sales process from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Lead thoughtful discovery conversations with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers to understand their business objectives, growth constraints, marketing challenges, and commercial priorities
  • Look beyond individual campaigns to understand the broader business, including customer acquisition, retention, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, channel mix, and profitability
  • Identify where Acceler8 can create meaningful value across paid media, creative strategy, measurement, conversion, channel expansion, or broader growth strategy
  • Navigate conversations with prospects who may already have an internal marketing team or agency partner, building a credible case for why a different approach may drive stronger results
  • Develop and present tailored proposals that connect Acceler8’s services directly to the prospect’s business goals and growth opportunities
  • Partner closely with our Growth Development Representative on lead quality, Ideal Customer Profile refinement, prospect insights, and opportunities moving through the pipeline
  • Collaborate with Acceler8’s leadership team on sales strategy, pricing, proposals, and high-value opportunities
  • Maintain disciplined CRM management and accurate visibility across opportunities, conversion, expected revenue, and pipeline health
  • Use HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Workspace, and other sales and prospecting tools to research opportunities and maintain an organized sales process
  • Represent Acceler8 at conferences, dinners, networking events, and other opportunities to build relationships and strengthen our presence in the market

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5-10 years of experience in business development or sales, including at least 3 years working within a media, advertising, performance marketing, ecommerce, or growth-focused agency environment
  • Have sold marketing or agency services and understand how DTC and ecommerce businesses grow, not simply how individual advertising campaigns are managed
  • Can confidently discuss metrics such as revenue, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, retention, and contribution margin, and understand how they connect to the economics of a business
  • Understand how paid media fits into a broader growth strategy spanning creative, conversion, retention, promotions, merchandising, CRM, organic channels, marketplaces, and other acquisition channels
  • Can look at a business, ask intelligent questions, identify potential growth constraints, and translate those challenges into opportunities Acceler8 may be able to solve
  • Are a strong consultative seller who can build credibility with founders and senior marketing leaders without relying on a scripted pitch
  • Are comfortable selling into organizations that may already have an agency or internal marketing team and navigating the complexity involved in making a change
  • Have experience using a modern sales stack, including CRM, lead sourcing, enrichment, LinkedIn prospecting, and pipeline reporting
  • Have a builder’s mindset and are comfortable being hands-on across research, discovery, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, and closing
  • Are curious, strategic, tenacious, and organized, and care about winning the right clients and building relationships that last
  • Live in the US (we’re a remote-first team)

Why Acceler8 Labs?

We built Acceler8 to bridge the gap between agencies and brands, replacing complexity with clarity and collaboration.

Our model is rooted in three pillars: Fuel (media), Spark (creative), and Insight (analytics), each designed to move faster, think smarter, and deliver measurable impact.

Here you’ll have the room to experiment, fail fast, and learn even faster. Your ideas won’t get lost in a Slack thread. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, curiosity, and craftsmanship.

We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves.

We offer:

  • Remote workdays so you can design a schedule that works for your rhythm
  • Comprehensive benefits to make sure you and your family are supported, healthy, and cared for
  • Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title
  • Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work
  • The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you

If you’re ready to join a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LCSW/LMFT/LMHC) 60K-75K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Grand Prairie, TX

Salary:

60K - 75K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Texas is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and/or Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $75,000 / year

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Group Head of Learning & Development, Communications and Partnership Engagement to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will be responsible for leading on EMED Group’s strategy for learning and organisational development, internal and external communications, partnership engagement and social values, ensuring these areas are aligned to operational and strategic priorities to support the capability, leadership culture and social impact needed to deliver exceptional patient care, operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual car allowance
  • Performance related bonus
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop, lead and implement the Group Learning & Development Strategy, aligned to EMED’s People Strategy, organisational objectives and future capability requirements.
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer, Executive Leadership Team, senior leaders and operational leaders to identify capability gaps and design learning solutions that support business priorities.
  • Design and oversee leadership and management development programmes for Managers, including the Manager Acceleration Programme and associated pathways.
  • Lead succession planning and talent development activity in partnership with HR Business Partners and senior leaders, ensuring learning supports future leadership pipelines.
  • Work collaboratively with the Training team, clinical, quality, governance, safeguarding, information governance, health and safety and operational colleagues to ensure learning responsibilities are clearly defined and support safe, compliant and high-quality patient care.
  • Maximise effective use of the Apprenticeship Levy and develop apprenticeship pathways that support frontline colleagues, managers and senior leaders.
  • Promote professional qualifications and structured development routes that enhance capability, retention and career progression.
  • Lead the development and effective delivery of internal communications channels that connect colleagues with corporate news, organisational priorities, celebrations, successes and key messages across EMED Group.
  • Work with senior leaders, operational teams and enabling functions to ensure internal communications support engagement, change, culture, colleague voice and shared organisational identity.
  • Provide leadership for internal social value activity delivered through the EMED Foundation, ensuring activity is aligned to EMED’s organisational values, community impact objectives and wider people strategy.
  • Support the leadership of EMED Foundation activity via the Trustees to deliver campaigns, colleague involvement and associated governance to ensure social value initiatives are visible, meaningful and connected to local and national priorities.
  • Work in conjunction with the Talent Resourcing team to identify and develop social value, employability, outreach and partnership activity that supports attraction, resourcing, community engagement and inclusive workforce development.
  • Build effective internal and external partnerships that support the delivery of social value commitments, including charitable relationships, community stakeholders, education partners and resourcing-related initiatives.
  • Develop opportunities to embed lived experience within colleague learning and induction, including investment in a patient-focused video that helps colleagues understand the experience of being a dialysis patient. This should include scoping an outline budget for partners to work within and ensuring the content supports empathy, awareness and patient-centred practice.
  • Work with charitable and social value partners to strengthen EMED’s external value proposition, including exploring how partner insight and content can support social value development within bids, particularly where increased weighting may be expected in future commissioning and procurement processes.
  • Planning, prioritisation, budget awareness and strategic leadership of the Learning & Development function, with potential future responsibility for team leadership as the function evolves.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Communication with Impact – articulates strategy to influence stakeholders, communicates decisively during uncertainty, inspires confidence and ensures ownership and clarity when delivering messages across teams, stakeholders, external partners and the wider business.
  • Agile Thinking – adjusts long-term plans and organisational strategies in response to changing needs, promotes collaboration across teams and proactively manages risks through experimentation, learning and innovation.
  • Delivering Results – aligns team efforts with organisational objectives, establishes clear metrics, integrates financial understanding into decision making and adapts strategies using insight to deliver commercial and operational impact.
  • Encouraging Ownership and Teamwork – empowers team members by assigning responsibility based on strengths, breaks down silos, promotes shared accountability and actively mentors others to strengthen capability.
  • Customer Focussed – ensures the organisation understands and responds to evolving customer, patient and service user needs, integrating their perspectives into strategic decision making and cross-functional delivery.
  • Delivering Clarity of Vision – develops and communicates a compelling vision for learning and organisational capability, aligning it with EMED’s strategic priorities, future workforce needs and long-term objectives.
  • Investing in Talent – actively leads succession planning, develops talent pipelines, establishes mentoring and sponsorship approaches and invests in leadership development to strengthen organisational capability.
  • Leading with Influence – engages and influences key stakeholders at a strategic level, builds credibility as a thought leader, and leads learning, engagement, social value and change initiatives that secure support for transformation and long-term success.
  • Leading Change – communicates the case for change, builds confidence through uncertainty, addresses resistance constructively and fosters a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK

Professional Member of Council

Professional Members of Council

Closing Date: 20 November 2026

Professional Member Non-Executive Director (Member of Council)

Council, together with its delegated bodies, is responsible for the strategic direction, governance, and oversight of The Welding Institute group of companies. Day to day operations is managed by the Chief Executive Officer and Executive Board.

All eligible Professional Members of The Welding Institute are invited to apply for a position on Council.

To be eligible, you must be a Professional Member of The Welding Institute.

Applications for this role must consist of a CV and a covering letter outlining why you wish to apply for the role and how you believe you can add value to Council. Candidates should ensure their application provides evidence against the assessment criteria below, as applications will be scored against these areas.

Assessment Criteria

Applications will be assessed against the following criteria:

  • Evidence of an understanding of the role and work of The Welding Institute
  • Evidence of committee, board, governance or voluntary leadership experience
  • Demonstrates an understanding of Diversity and Inclusion principles
  • Provides evidence of personal contribution to, or impact on, Diversity and Inclusion initiatives
  • Evidence of strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Evidence of negotiation, influencing and diplomatic skills, or potential to develop these capabilities
  • Evidence of analytical capability and/or relevant technical knowledge and skills
  • Evidence of creativity, innovation and problem-solving skills, or potential to develop these capabilities

Kindly note that interviews are planned to take place w/c 11 January 2027.

The TWI Group is a leading global, membership based, independent research and technology organisation specialising in materials, joining, and structural integrity technologies. Our purpose is to support industry by providing independent technical advice and by developing the next generation of experts to address future challenges.

As a non-profit distributing organisation, all surplus is reinvested into research, people, facilities, and equipment to further enhance the value delivered to our members.

Council, comprising Non-Executive Directors, plays a key role in supporting effective governance through collaboration with the Chief Executive and Executive Board, ensuring robust oversight and informed decision making across the organisation.

We are seeking to appoint new Professional Member Non-Executive Directors to join Council and contribute to its boards and committees in line with their skills and experience, with at least one Member of Professional Board to become a Council Member.

Candidates will ideally have senior management or board level experience, a strong understanding of corporate governance, and the ability to provide constructive challenge and scrutiny of organisational performance. As part of our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we welcome applications from aspiring board members to support their development.

We particularly encourage applications from individuals within our existing volunteer network, recognising the valuable contribution they make to the organisation. Please note that additional eligibility criteria apply. For example, current employees, former employees, and previous Council members may not be eligible to apply. These criteria are in place to ensure fairness and transparency in the selection process.

We welcome applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and especially encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. This is a non-remunerated role requiring a time commitment of up to eight days per annum. Reasonable expenses will be reimbursed for attendance at meetings.

Declaration of Interests

To support transparency and good governance, candidates who are shortlisted for interview will be required to complete a Declaration of Interests form prior to interview. Any declared interests will be reviewed in accordance with The Welding Institute's governance processes and will not necessarily preclude an individual from appointment, but must be disclosed to ensure any actual, potential or perceived conflicts of interest can be appropriately managed.

To learn more about the organisation please visit our website, The Welding Institute - About Us

Security requirements: This position will require a BPSS check which TWI will carry out.

Travel: Council-related activities typically require around 8 days of engagement per year, which may include attending meetings in Cambridge. While these meetings can be joined remotely, we encourage in-person attendance where possible to support collaboration. Please note that the overall time commitment may vary depending on individual involvement in Council responsibilities beyond formal meetings.

About us: TWI Ltd is a world expert in engineering, materials and joining technologies with significant property assets. We provide industry with advice and know-how in design, fabrication, failure analysis and prevention.

Diversity statement: TWI Ltd is committed to treating everyone fairly and to being an inclusive organisation. Our aim is to create an environment where our people can reach their full potential. We put Equality, Diversity and Inclusion at the heart of our people practices to attract, develop and retain the best talent.

Inclusion: We recognise that it’s the differences of our people that gives us our competitive edge and enables us to maintain our world leading reputation. This is why we are committed to ensuring there is diversity across every level of our organisation; representative of the Members and societies we serve. We have made Inclusion our number one corporate value to demonstrate our commitment to ensure it is at the core of everything we do at TWI.

This is a government-supported scheme that supports organisations like TWI to make the most of the talents that people with disability can bring to our workplace. The scheme helps us recruit and retain great people; draw from the widest possible pool of talent; secure high-quality employees who are skilled, loyal and hardworking; and improve employee morale and commitment by demonstrating that we treat all our people fairly.

Artificial Intelligence: At TWI, we want you to know that your application is in good hands. We do not use AI tools or automated systems to review or sift through applications. We are committed to creating a culture that recognises and respects the differences between people while valuing the contribution everyone makes to TWI.

The diversity of our staff and students makes a positive and important contribution to our continuing success.

TWI offers a comprehensive training programme, incorporating both in-house and external courses to support staff development.

TWI Values:

Our six values provide a point of reference for the way we expect our people to operate and behave.

  • Inclusion: Valuing the contribution from every individual, creating value for our customers
  • Teamwork: Building effective working relationships, we accomplish more together

Firma jest wspierana przez fundusz private equity i znajduje się w fazie intensywnego wzrostu.

Opis stanowiska

Poszukiwany jest doświadczony Full‑Stack Developer, który odegra kluczową rolę w zespole R&D. Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie odpowiedzialna za prowadzenie rozwoju funkcjonalności end‑to‑end, modernizację architektury systemu oraz aktywny udział w migracji do chmury publicznej. To rola dla inżyniera, który potrafi łączyć głęboką wiedzę techniczną z umiejętnością samodzielnego podejmowania decyzji i prowadzenia inicjatyw technologicznych. Praca w pełni zdalna (home office).

Zakres obowiązków

  • Prowadzenie pełnego cyklu tworzenia funkcjonalności — od koncepcji, przez projekt techniczny, po wdrożenie produkcyjne.

  • Rozwój frontendu w Angularze oraz backendu w C#/.NET.

  • Udział w modernizacji architektury systemu, w tym: unowocześnianie monolitu, konteneryzacja usług, migracja do AWS.

  • Budowanie i utrzymywanie pipeline’ów CI/CD oraz automatyzacji procesów wdrożeniowych.

  • Projektowanie skalowalnych usług backendowych i responsywnych interfejsów użytkownika.

  • Dbanie o jakość kodu, testy i bezpieczeństwo.

  • Przekładanie wymagań produktowych na gotowe rozwiązania techniczne.

  • Praca z relacyjnymi bazami danych i optymalizacja zapytań.

  • Mentoring mniej doświadczonych inżynierów i promowanie dobrych praktyk w zespole.

Wymagania

  • Wykształcenie wyższe kierunkowe (informatyka, inżynieria) lub równoważne doświadczenie zdobyte w jednostkach technologicznych.

  • Minimum 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w programowaniu.

  • Udokumentowane prowadzenie złożonych funkcjonalności od strony technicznej — od projektu po wdrożenie.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość C# i .NET / .NET Core.

  • Zaawansowana znajomość Angulara i TypeScript.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z chmurą publiczną (preferowany AWS).

  • Praktyczna znajomość CI/CD (np. GitHub Actions, Jenkins) oraz konteneryzacji (Docker).

  • Doświadczenie z narzędziami IaC (Terraform lub CloudFormation).

  • Proaktywność, samodzielność i umiejętność brania odpowiedzialności za złożone problemy.

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość bibliotek do zarządzania stanem (np. NgRx).

  • Doświadczenie z Angular Material.

  • Zaawansowana znajomość narzędzi testowych (Jasmine, Karma, Playwright, NUnit, xUnit).

Co oferujemy

  • Pracę w przyjaznym, współpracującym środowisku, w którym innowacje są realnie wdrażane.

  • Konkurencyjne wynagrodzenie i atrakcyjny pakiet benefitów.

  • Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego i wpływu na kierunek rozwoju produktu.

  • Pracę w pełni zdalną (home office) z elastycznym podejściem do organizacji pracy.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Success requires a bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), demonstrated experience in software quality assurance and test engineering, hands-on experience validating AI-generated code and prototypes, familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and quality gates, strong analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication.

Key Functions

  • Design and implement AI-enabled solutions for customer modernization use cases, developing and integrating AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows.
  • Establish and enforce a quality assurance framework — test plans, acceptance criteria, and regression suites — for validating AI-generated code, skills, and agents before they are promoted through the innovation pipeline.
  • Guide the development of reusable AI skills and agents for customer modernization tasks, with particular emphasis on automated testing, security scanning, data sensitivity, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to create and orchestrate long-running, multi-agent workflows, ensuring reliability, observability, and recoverability in production environments.
  • Support creation of the innovation pipeline that moves AI-generated (“vibe-coded”) prototypes from sandbox concepts into secure, enterprise-grade applications.
  • Support Value Engineers’ efforts by reviewing and quality-checking prototype outputs for accuracy, reliability, and adherence to standards prior to pipeline promotion.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in software quality assurance, test engineering, or a related discipline, including test plan design and defect management.
  • Hands-on experience testing or validating AI-generated code, prototypes, or “vibe-coded” solutions for accuracy and reliability.
  • Experience with automated testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium) across web and enterprise applications.
  • Experience with one or more of the following: Salesforce, AWS (including Lambda and Redshift), Java, or PostgreSQL, or a comparable enterprise technology stack.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.

  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice.

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking: Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas: Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking: #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.
