  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding.

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

The Mission

As the Product Manager CTV, you own Connected TV (CTV) monetization on Meetscale, our SSP (Supply-Side Platform). You define every rule of the CTV channel: how publisher inventory enters Meetscale, how it is auctioned, and how its yield is optimized. You report to the VP Product.

Your mission: make Meetscale the reference platform to sell our publishers’ CTV inventory, and sell every impression at its true value.

Your key responsibilities

1. Meetscale CTV Vision & Roadmap

  • Build and own the Meetscale CTV roadmap from Sparteo’s strategic objectives, on both revenue and margin.

  • Understand the needs of CTV publishers and buyers, and challenge every request before it goes on the roadmap.

  • Drive product success: set the channel KPIs, track progress against objectives, and adjust the roadmap based on results.

2. Maximize CTV Inventory

  • Make CTV inventory activation on Meetscale simple and fast.

  • Guarantee the quality and relevance of the traffic.

  • Make sure Meetscale and its partners can monetize the inventory: supply chain (schain), consent, compliance with buyer requirements.

  • Protect the inventory and the buyers: fraud, invalid traffic, malicious or unwanted ads.

3. Auction & Yield Optimization

  • Own the CTV specifics of the auction in the Meetscale SSP: ad pod construction, VAST compliance, bid request enrichment.

  • Identify auction optimization opportunities and validate them with A/B tests.

  • Control the cost of every bid request, so that revenue growth also improves margin.

  • Grow CTV demand, working closely with the Demand team to activate new partners.

4. Delivery & Impact

  • Drive delivery with engineering, from design to production.

  • Prepare the adoption of every release: train and equip the Supply, Sales and Customer Success teams, and support activation with publishers.

  • Measure the real impact of every release. Success is measured in revenue, not in features shipped.

Your profile for this job

We are looking for a CTV monetization expert with concrete results. You did not build a viewing experience: you sold CTV inventory and grew its revenue.

  • Product & CTV Monetization Expertise: 5+ years of product management in ad tech, with concrete, measurable results on sell-side CTV monetization (SSP, ad server, exchange). You have owned a product from roadmap to delivery.

  • Programmatic Mastery: OpenRTB, VAST and VMAP, ad pods, Prebid Server, floor prices, supply path, schain, app-ads.txt and sellers.json.

  • Ownership: You organize an ambiguous scope from objectives alone, and you are the sole owner of the result.

  • Impact-Driven: You track what you ship, monitor the results, and use data as the basis for every decision.

  • AI Every Day: You use an AI assistant such as Claude every day, and you have already built skills and agentic workflows in your PM work.

  • Technical Literacy: You do not code, but you speak engineering’s language.

  • Communication: You make complex topics accessible. Fluent English; French is a plus.

Your mindset to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively, building on what works and questioning what can be improved.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • ⚡ You’re looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 🗣️ English work environment: English is our working language across teams and countries.

  • 🤖 AI at your fingertips: Claude is made available to every team member.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🎯 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and regular performance feedback sessions.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive health coverage: We provide a robust health insurance plan, ensuring you are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. · CEU reimbursement

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. · Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. jobs.description:
The Legal Content Manager, Content Intern and Fellow Program, is part of ILAO’s Content Team. Our Legal Content Managers work independently and as a team to keep the legal information on ILAO's website accurate, relevant to our diverse audiences, and easy to use.

This Legal Content Manager position includes:

  • Producing and maintaining legal content within a team-wide content plan,
  • Leading our Content Intern and Fellow (CIF) program, which offers paid and sponsored internships for law students and recent graduates, as well as volunteer opportunities coordinated with law schools,
  • Staying informed about the legal issues facing lower-income families and communities in Illinois, and
  • Contributing to team projects that use technology to improve how people find and use legal information.

The Legal Content Manager, Volunteer Programs, is part of ILAO’s Content Team. Our Legal Content Managers work independently and as a team to keep the legal information on ILAO's website accurate, relevant to our diverse audiences, and easy to use.

Illinois Legal Aid Online (ILAO) is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse staff. Working with great people with a wide variety of lived experiences brings us closer to meeting our vision of a society where all people can get justice. Because our services and products - like the law - are for everyone, we believe in including everyone. We strongly and enthusiastically encourage people of color, individuals who identify within and beyond the LGBTQIA+ spectrum, women, and people with disabilities to apply.

ILAO is primarily remote, with periodic, in-person meetings. We welcome applications from across Illinois.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Content publication and maintenance 55%

  • Own and maintain a content portfolio in designated legal areas, exercising independent judgment while collaborating with other editors on shared content, editorial governance, and group projects. Contribute to and follow collective decisions regarding content structure, style, scope, and standards.
  • Research, draft, edit, and publish legal information in assigned areas, following ILAO's content standards, style guide, and review processes.
  • Complete content projects on schedule, including legal research, drafting, structural editing, plain-language review, proofreading, and publishing.
  • Monitor changes in the law, external resources, and feedback from internal and external stakeholders, to determine content impact..
  • Collaborate with the Product and Community Engagement Teams to inform the development of effective models, interfaces, and methods for delivering legal information.
  • Assist as needed with all aspects of maintaining content in accordance with ILAO’s style guide and review processes.
  • With the rest of the Content Team, continuously improve content quality assurance and prioritization processes.
  • Use relevant data, including Google Analytics, user feedback, and ILAO dashboards to help prioritize updates in subject areas of responsibility.
  • Supervise law students as assigned.
  • Serve on at least one designated Illinois Supreme Court Access to Justice Commission’s Forms Subcommittees advising on form design and plain language.

Supervise interns and fellows 35%

  • Lead, recruit, and manage the Content Intern and Fellow (CIF) Program in accordance with Content Team priorities and staffing needs.
  • Collect, maintain, and report on program data as required by ILAO records retention and program evaluation practices. metrics and standard reports for evaluating the success of our summer intern and fellows program.
  • Collaborate with funders and law school partners on creating, filling, and supervising law student opportunities.
  • Provide constructive feedback on legal research, drafting, editing, proofreading, and professionalism to law students as appropriate and ensure feedback from other Content Team members is implemented in student work.
  • Ensure interns and fellows are supported, acknowledged, appreciated, and feel included in the mission of the organization and legal aid community.
  • Support Content Team members in developing, assigning, and supervising law student projects.
  • Network and build relationships with others in the legal profession, especially with the Public Interest Law Initiative, law schools, and the legal aid community.

Other activities 10%

  • Participate in staff meetings and other organizational meetings.
  • Participate in organizational ARDEI activities.
  • Participate in fundraising activities, such as making thank you calls, signing letters, working in-person events, reviewing grant proposals, and contributing to grant reports as required.
  • Other activities as assigned.

Education/Experience

  • Law degree (J.D.) and admission to the Illinois bar required
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant legal practice or related legal experience, such as a judicial clerkship or work in legal aid, government, or a nonprofit legal organization. Illinois experience preferred.
  • Experience turning complicated legal concepts into clear, actionable resources
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with close attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience teaching writing, public speaking, legal research, journalism, or other editorial skills, including law review or moot court board roles, teaching assistantships, and supervisory positions,
  • Demonstrated ability to manage assigned work to deadlines, adjust when priorities change, and keep a supervisor informed about workload and progress.
  • Ability to work within established standards, processes, and decisions owned by others, including raising concerns through appropriate channels.
  • Ability to work in a shared content environment where colleagues across teams may review, revise, or contribute to assigned content, while maintaining clear communication and consistent standards.
  • Ability to give and receive constructive feedback, resolve editorial disagreements respectfully, and evaluate proposed changes based on legal accuracy, clarity, and user needs.
  • Ability to work effectively with legal content, product, and community engagement colleagues to improve how people find, understand, and use legal information.
  • Understanding of how AI and other technologies can improve access to justice and support content creation, review, maintenance, and delivery, with attention to their limitations and the need for human judgment.
  • Willingness to learn new tools, test new approaches, and use feedback and results to improve workflows while maintaining legal accuracy and content quality.

Preference given to candidates with

  • Experience serving clients or working with courts, legal aid organizations, or community partners in Illinois communities outside Cook County, particularly in Central or Southern Illinois
  • Experience as a pro bono volunteer or participant in legal aid clinics
  • Experience in criminal law, traffic, family law or general legal aid practice preferred
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken Spanish, including the ability to write, translate, and edit clear, accurate, and natural Spanish. Familiarity with Mexican Spanish preferred.
  • Participation in a law journal, moot court, or other collaborative writing and editing projects as a law student or licensed attorney
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar constituent-management platforms
  • Experience working in web-based content management systems
  • Experience with Jira, Slack, GSuite or Microsoft Office

Deadline to Apply: Friday, October 30, 2026

Salary: The salary range for this position is 72,000-80,000, which reflects 2-15 years of legal experience. Bilingual Spanish staff receive an additional stipend.

Benefits: ILAO offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, health and dependent care flex spending account; 15 paid days off and 15 holidays in the first calendar year of employment; and, 403(b) retirement plan, to which ILAO contributes a required 1% of salary monthly. ILAO has a flexible workplace policy that supports remote work, wellness and work-life balance.

About ILAO

At ILAO, we believe in justice. We believe the law is for everyone. We know, however, that not everyone is equal in the eyes of the legal system. Race and culture, language, education, location, time, disability, and income are enormous barriers to using the law to get justice.

For more than 25 years, Illinois Legal Aid Online (ILAO) has simplified the law so that people can seek justice and resolve their problems, especially those from historically oppressed communities and groups. Through innovation, we make the law understandable and accessible.

We believe that, with the right knowledge and guidance, people can be their own best advocates. We mobilize people with plain-language, 24/7 tools - in three languages - so families can understand and assert their legal rights. ILAO helps people, who are unable to find or afford attorneys, overcome the barriers that keep them from getting justice.

Illinois Legal Aid Online (ILAO) is open to all. Working with and helping people with a wide variety of lived experiences brings us closer to meeting our ideal of a society where all people can get justice. Because our services and products—like the law—are for everyone, we believe in including everyone. We know that justice is scarcest for those who need it most. People with intersectionalities of historically oppressed identities face the greatest barriers to justice. ILAO seeks to break these barriers. ILAO believes that, equipped with the right tools, opportunities, and connections, people can shift the power differentials and use the law to get justice.

Inclusion, equity, and diversity are key in our work to champion opportunities, equality, and justice for those who need it most. As a community and individuals, we honor and respect differences, practice equity, and support the professional development and wellness of our colleagues.

ILAO's free programs provide essential legal services and support 24/7/365 to the people of Illinois, focused on individuals and families from historically oppressed populations and communities who face the greatest barriers to justice.

Job Description:

Most M&A roles stop at the closing dinner or start after the ink is dry. At Vertex, you will bridge both.


We are seeking an execution-focused Director, Corporate Development & M&A Integration, to connect acquisition strategy and transaction execution directly to post-merger value creation. As Vertex accelerates its global cloud and AI-enabled compliance expansion, you will ensure every acquisition—from high-velocity capability tuck-ins to regional e-invoicing and platform expansions—delivers on its investment thesis, protects customer and talent retention, and drives durable recurring revenue growth.


At Vertex, we help businesses navigate the complexity of global indirect tax and compliance with confidence. Since 1978, we have combined deep tax expertise with enterprise software to support the full transaction lifecycle—from tax determination and e-invoicing to reporting, filing, and audit defense. Today, more than 60% of the Fortune 500 trust Vertex to manage their global compliance needs. By connecting tax domain leadership, cloud technology, and responsibly applied AI, we help enterprises reduce friction, gain visibility, and transact and grow globally.


The Opportunity

Sitting at the intersection of corporate development and our Integration Management Office (IMO), the Director, Corporate Development & M&A Integration leads end-to-end deal execution and post-acquisition integration across the full transaction lifecycle.


Partnering closely with the Chief Strategy Officer, CSO organization, Corporate Development leadership, and cross-functional executives, you will evaluate market adjacencies, build investment business cases, orchestrate cross-functional due diligence, and translate diligence findings directly into Day 1 readiness and 100-day value-capture plans. Success in this role requires a collaborative leader who builds immediate credibility with C-suite and functional stakeholders, influences without relying on formal line authority, and balances public-company governance with the operational agility needed to integrate founder-led and international software teams.


What You Will Do


Corporate Development & Transaction Execution

  • Partnering with executive leadership and product/regional strategy leads to shape Vertex's inorganic growth roadmap, map market adjacencies (including global e-invoicing, AI-enabled compliance, and ERP ecosystem extensions), and maintain a prioritized M&A target pipeline.
  • Lead target origination and cultivate relationships with investment banks, M&A advisors, growth equity sponsors, and founder-led software businesses.
  • Direct complex SaaS financial modeling, DCF and market-multiple valuations, ARR/cohort retention analyses, cost-to-achieve estimates, and accretive/dilutive scenarios to support executive and Board recommendations.
  • Support Letters of Intent (LOIs), transaction structuring (including working capital, earnouts, holdbacks, and key-talent retention mechanics), and definitive agreement negotiations alongside senior Corporate Development, Legal, and Tax leaders.
  • Orchestrate end-to-end due diligence across Product & Engineering, Tax Content, Cybersecurity & Data Privacy, Commercial/GTM, Finance, HR, and Legal—translating diligence findings directly into a binding pre-close integration charter prior to signing.

M&A Integration & Value Realization

  • Design deal-specific integration strategies matched to each transaction archetype—protecting acquired engineering and product velocity on capability tuck-ins while integrating commercial, security, and compliance foundations.
  • Build, standardize, and continuously refine Vertex's IMO playbooks, templates, RAID logs, dependency maps, and post-mortem feedback loops.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through pre-close Day 1 readiness (entity close, payroll/benefits continuity, customer assurances, and security baselines) as well as disciplined Day 30, Day 100, and Day 365 execution plans.
  • Align paired Vertex and acquired-company workstream leads across Product & Platform, Tax Content & Regulatory, Cloud/Security & Data, Customer & GTM, People & Culture, and Back Office & Legal, enforcing capacity guardrails that protect core delivery roadmaps.
  • Partner with FP&A and business owners to govern a single, auditable synergy and value-creation ledger tracking cross-sell ARR, gross and net revenue retention (GRR/NRR), integration budgets, and run-rate EBITDA impact.
  • Partner with Customer Success and People leaders to run customer retention guardrails and key-person retention programs ahead of milestone and cliff dates, executing structured handoffs to business-as-usual (BAU) owners by Day 180–365.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead weekly IMO governance reviews and prepare concise, decision-oriented materials for the Executive Integration Steering Committee, Executive Leadership Team, Board of Directors, and investor communications.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability against milestones and SLAs, resolving operational dependencies laterally and escalating threshold commercial or resource trade-offs requiring executive authority.
  • Apply AI, analytics, and workflow automation to accelerate market screening, virtual data room (VDR) diligence extraction, synergy tracking, and real-time integration health reporting.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Strategy, or a related analytical discipline required; MBA, CFA, or advanced degree strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience across corporate development, M&A integration leadership, investment banking, private equity, management or strategy consulting, and/or corporate strategy—including at least 4+ years operating inside or directly advising enterprise B2B SaaS, cloud software, FinTech, or compliance technology businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple acquisitions and full-lifecycle post-merger integration programs from valuation and due diligence through Day 1–365 synergy realization.
  • Proven track record of developing investment theses and presenting financial analyses and strategic business cases to C-suite executives and Board stakeholders.
  • Experience integrating founder-led or cross-border technology teams into a public-company environment while protecting customer continuity and critical talent retention.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Advanced proficiency in corporate finance, three-statement and DCF valuation modeling, SaaS unit economics (ARR, NRR/GRR, Rule of 40), purchase-accounting interfaces, and synergy ledger governance.
  • Working fluency in enterprise cloud software integration patterns, including API architectures, ERP ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday), SOC 2 cybersecurity baselines, SOX/ITGC controls, and cross-border data privacy frameworks.
  • Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders across matrixed functions without relying on direct authority.
  • Demonstrated change-management leadership balanced with disciplined operational execution, sound prioritization, and attention to detail in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging VDR platforms, portfolio tracking suites, BI dashboards, and AI-enabled diligence and integration tools.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

In addition, as a part of our total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role-specific sales commission/bonus, and/or equity grants.

Remote (Canada) · Full-time (40 hrs/week) · Term: January 4 - April 22, 2027

About Flexspring

Everything connects. That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) built for one of the thornier problems in enterprise software: getting HR systems to actually talk to each other. We link payroll, recruiting, benefits, and HRIS platforms API-to-API so data moves between them cleanly and in near real-time, with no manual re-entry anywhere. The results back it up - 3,000+ integrations delivered, 800+ clients including Fortune 500 companies, ADP Marketplace Platinum Partner, and named HR Data Integration Experts of the Year 2025. And we do it all as a remote-first team spread across Canada and beyond.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Developer Co-op to join our R&D team - and we'll be upfront about what that means.

This is real experience, in the fullest sense. No throwaway side project, no busywork to fill the term - from your first weeks you'll work on our actual product, as a real part of the team, shipping features that real customers depend on. Many of our co-ops go on to join us full-time after graduation.

You'll work mainly in a Java-based stack, and you'll quickly find that integration work is half code, half business reasoning - every feature exists because a real company needs its HR data to move without breaking. If you like building things that ship, and you tend to ask "what is this really for?" before writing a line of code, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Building and improving features in Flexspring's product - and understanding the customer problem each one solves
  • Writing backend and full stack code in Java and JavaScript
  • Working with APIs and the data flowing between HR systems, where getting the small details right is the whole job
  • Using modern tooling, AI included, to work efficiently - and reviewing what it produces with a careful eye before it ships
  • Writing and running tests so you know your work holds up before it reaches a customer
  • Collaborating with experienced developers through code reviews and team discussions

What We're Looking For

  • Strong analytical thinking. You like connecting the work in front of you to the reason it matters - the why, the outcome, the customer on the other end. Seeing the full picture is more satisfying to you than just closing a ticket.
  • A thoughtful approach to new tools. You enjoy picking up unfamiliar technology, including AI tools, and using it to work faster and smarter. You also know that generating output is only the start - the real value is in reviewing it, catching what's off, and being able to stand behind the result.
  • You've already completed minimum one co-op term or have some relevant professional work experience - this won't be your first time in a real work environment
  • You're currently studying Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • A solid foundation in Java and JavaScript
  • Some exposure to Spring and JUnit (school projects absolutely count)
  • You've worked with or learned about APIs
  • You're curious, motivated, and enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with REST APIs, React, GraphQL, Groovy, JMS, or SOAP
  • Interest in integration platforms (iPaaS) and how systems connect
  • Curiosity about how large systems talk to each other - and what happens when they don't

What You'll Walk Away With

  • Real, hands-on experience shipping to a production platform that real customers rely on
  • Mentorship from senior developers who'll invest in how you think, not just the code you write
  • A working understanding of how HR data actually moves between enterprise systems
  • Real practice using AI and modern dev tooling the way strong engineers do - fast, but with judgment
  • Competitive co-op pay
  • Flexible hours in a remote-first environment
  • A strong chance to grow into a full-time role after graduation

Medical billers spend much of their day managing repetitive RCM tasks—correcting claims, following up on claims, posting payments, reconciling deposits, chasing denials and putting together appeals. For a billing company, that manual work is most of the cost of doing business.

As a Product Manager overseeing the Revenue Cycle Management automation at CollaborateMD, EverHealth’s premier enterprise billing system, you are responsible for improving how billers work claim submission, AR follow-up, and payment posting. Your work directly supports EverHealth’s goal of reducing the amount of hands-on work it takes to get claims paid.

This is an individual contributor role working on our CollaborateMD product team.


The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between technical teams, business stakeholders, and onshore and offshore RCM users to deliver efficient, trustworthy, and user-friendly RCM automations that improve operational efficiency.


Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, outcomes, and roadmap for RCM automation

  • Ensure solutions are scalable and extensible across products. Define clear success metrics and hold yourself accountable for results.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years of product management experience.
  • Proven ability to own a complex, workflow-driven product area and deliver measurable outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Fewer manual interactions are required per claim.

Where: The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks:

jobs.description:
Position Summary

At Proximity Learning, we believe every student deserves access to exceptional literacy instruction and academic support, no matter where they learn. As a Virtual Reading Specialist / Certified Academic Language Therapist (CALT), you will deliver comprehensive, research-based reading intervention and specialized support to students in a fully remote environment, meeting them where they are and making a real difference in their academic growth, decoding skills, and reading confidence. You will work side by side with special education teams, teachers, and families through the power of virtual platforms while bringing evidence-based practices and genuine care to every student you serve. If you are passionate about breaking down barriers to learning and want to do meaningful work from anywhere, this role was made for you.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Deliver live, interactive one-on-one virtual reading intervention sessions tailored to student-specific learning goals and IEP objectives.
  • Utilize explicit, systematic, structured, and multi-sensory teaching strategies (such as Orton-Gillingham or CALT methods) to address decoding, encoding, fluency, and reading comprehension.
  • Conduct informal reading assessments and progress monitoring via telehealth-compatible platforms and tools to evaluate literacy growth.
  • Write clear, thorough, and compliant progress reports within required district and state timelines. Participate in virtual IEP, 504, and eligibility meetings as part of the multidisciplinary team, presenting literacy findings and recommendations to families and educators as needed.
  • Develop and monitor individual intervention plans in direct collaboration with classroom teachers and special education support staff.
  • Consult with teachers, parents/guardians, and administrators on effective strategies to support student literacy in the virtual classroom environment.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential documentation in compliance with FERPA, HIPAA, and applicable state special education regulations.
  • Collaborate with the ESS/PLI team and district partners to ensure continuity of services and smooth case management. Stay current on best practices in structured literacy, telehealth service delivery, and applicable state/federal regulations.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Special Education, Reading Education, or related field from an accredited program.
  • Valid state credential/license as a Reading Specialist or Certified Academic Language Therapist (CALT) credential in New Mexico.
  • Strong working knowledge of IDEA, Section 504, FERPA, and state-specific special education regulations.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, professional intervention and progress reports.
  • Comfort and proficiency with virtual platforms (video conferencing, electronic IEP systems, digital reading tools).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage student caseloads and competing deadlines efficiently.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a private, confidential workspace for telehealth and instructional services.

Work Environment & Technology

This is a fully remote position. Employees must provide their own dedicated workspace that ensures privacy and confidentiality for student assessments and counseling sessions. PLI provides access to required platforms, assessment licenses, and technical support. Standard working hours align with the school day(s) of assigned district(s), with occasional flexibility required for IEP meetings or family consultations outside standard hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and credentials.
  • Ongoing professional development and support from a collaborative clinical team.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on students across multiple districts and communities.
Salary: $60 per hour

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. · Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

*Because this position is in the Bargaining Unit, some fees may be required depending on where the candidate lives as a condition of employment.

How to apply: Please apply online by completing our application and submitting a cover letter, resume, references, and a writing sample. The position will remain open until filled with applications reviewed on a rolling basis. The desired start date is 11/2/26. Only applicants selected for interviews will be contacted. No telephone calls please.

ABOUT THE CENTER
The Center for Biological Diversity, a national 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, believes the welfare of human beings is deeply linked to nature — to the existence of a vast diversity of wild animals, plants and people. Because diversity has intrinsic value, and because its loss impoverishes society, we work to secure a future for all species, great and small, hovering on the brink of extinction. We do so through science, law, activism and creative media, with a focus on protecting the lands, waters and climate that humans, other species and all communities need to survive and thrive.

We want those who come after us to inherit a world where the wild is still alive.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Campaigner will use their skills to plan, execute, and win strategic campaigns that advance our policy goals. An integral part of the position will be to build power with allies and the public to influence decision-makers on critical issues. Key aspects of this work include building and maintaining strong coalitions, organizing protests and other creative pressure tactics, research and writing science and policy-based documents, and developing and implementing other bold initiatives to grow and mobilize support. The Campaigner will be working closely with a dedicated and passionate group of scientists, lawyers, organizers and media professionals within and outside of the Center. The successful candidate will have excellent interpersonal and facilitation skills, strong research skills, as well as oral and written communication skills with an ability to work collaboratively while also taking initiative to move work forward.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Craft and execute campaign plans that advance the program’s strategic priorities, including legal, policy, and organizing initiatives;
  • Develop and run winning national, regional, state, and local-level campaigns that produce positive change;
  • Consult and coordinate with program staff on campaigns to advance our goals;
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships and coalitions with local communities, as well as state, national, and international organizations;
  • Organize meetings, facilitate difficult conversations, and lead from behind to maximize the engagement and sense of shared ownership;
  • Effectively communicate with the media, decision-makers, the public, allies and opinion leaders through writing, outreach and public speaking;
  • Organize and promote participation in hearings, protests, and other events;
  • Lobby and meet with policy makers;
  • Create compelling written campaign materials, ranging from comment letters and policy briefings to op-eds, action alerts, and digital organizing pieces;
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • 3+ years of campaign experience
  • Proven experience in creating and implementing winning, strategic outreach, education and/or advocacy campaigns
  • Demonstrate sound judgment in allocation resources and choice of tactics to have maximum impact
  • Exceptional written and verbal communications skills
  • Demonstrated skill in leading processes that represent our values and produce results, and flexibility to adapt and respond to changing circumstances
  • Ability to balance multiple tasks and deadlines in a busy environment
  • Experience working effectively within coalitions, including honoring best practices and competence in justice, equity, diversity, accessibility and inclusion
  • Ability to work 40+ hours per week

WORKING CONDITIONS

Periodic travel required, evening or weekend work may be required at times due to project deadlines. Frequently requires long hours on video calls, and periodically may require attending in-person events, actions, and meetings outside the office. Typical work schedule is Monday-Friday. Requires the use of typical office equipment including copiers, printers, etc.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

45K - 65K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!
