jobs.excerpt: About the teamAt Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience.
jobs.description:
About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Connecticut. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $12.00 - $25.00 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Connecticut.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: REMOTE Sales Manager
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USOur client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies. For more than 20 years, the company has worked with business owners to improve growth, profitability, leadership, systems, and ultimately create businesses that can thrive without depending entirely on the owner.

They are seeking an experienced, hands-on Sales Leader to lead, rebuild, and scale our sales organization.

This is not a role for someone who has only managed sales teams from a distance. They are looking for a true player-coach: someone who has personally been a successful high-ticket salesperson, knows how to coach and develop salespeople, has built outbound-generated pipeline, and has successfully improved an underperforming sales organization.

Why Join US

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact, not simply maintain an existing sales organization.

You'll inherit a company with an established brand, proven coaching programs, existing sales infrastructure, a substantial prospect database, and a history of strong sales performance—but you'll also have the autonomy to rebuild and improve the sales engine.

The right person will have significant influence over how the sales organization evolves and meaningful upside as the company grows.

If you're a proven sales leader who still understands what it takes to personally win business—and you enjoy building teams, fixing problems, and creating predictable revenue—we'd like to talk.

Compensation: $60,000–$100,000 base/guaranteed compensation + uncapped performance compensation
Expected Year-One Earnings:Approximately $150,000–$200,000 based on performance

The Opportunity

The sales organization currently includes:

  • A team of outbound setters responsible for proactively generating qualified sales appointments.

  • An Enrollment Director responsible for conducting consultative sales conversations and enrolling business owners into coaching programs.

  • An Account Management function responsible for client relationships, retention, referrals, and expansion opportunities.

The foundation is already in place, including CRM, dialing technology, sales scripts, an existing database, and a functioning outbound process.

The next Sales Leader will own improving, scaling, and managing the system.

Initially, your biggest priorities will be scaling the outbound setter team and improving closing performance. Over time, you will also develop additional revenue opportunities through referrals, past-client reactivation, previous qualified prospects, events, and other proactive sales strategies.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale the Sales Team

Manage, coach, train, and develop the company's sales organization, including outbound setters and Enrollment Directors.

Recruit and onboard additional sales talent as the organization grows.

Establish clear expectations, activity standards, KPIs, accountability, and performance management.

Make difficult personnel decisions when necessary and continuously upgrade the strength of the sales organization.

Build a Predictable Outbound Sales Engine

Scale the existing outbound setter organization to consistently generate qualified sales conversations.

Create a sales organization that can generate its own pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound marketing.

Continuously improve prospecting strategies, scripts, lead management, follow-up, reactivation, and referral generation.

Work closely with leadership and marketing to maximize the company's house database, outbound lists, inbound opportunities, events, referrals, and other lead sources.

Coach High-Ticket Sales

Review sales conversations and identify opportunities to improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, emotional engagement, and closing.

Coach Enrollment Directors through recorded calls, role-playing, scripting, and ongoing feedback.

Initially serve as a backup closer when necessary.

The long-term goal is not for the Sales Leader to compete with the sales team for deals, but this person must be capable of stepping into a sales conversation, successfully closing business, and demonstrating what great selling looks like.

Drive Sales Performance

Analyze activity, appointments, conversion rates, enrollments, pipeline, and revenue.

Use data to identify performance gaps and translate those insights into specific coaching, process, staffing, and sales strategies.

Build a disciplined sales culture focused on accountability and measurable results.

Initial Success Measures

Within approximately the first 2–4 months, we expect the Sales Leader to:

  • Evaluate the existing sales organization.

  • Scale and strengthen the outbound setter team.

  • Build toward approximately 6–8 productive part-time setters.

  • Generate at least 20–30 held qualified sales appointments per month.

  • Evaluate current closing performance and determine the appropriate coaching or personnel strategy.

  • Begin moving qualified close rates toward a minimum 25% target.

After stabilizing the core sales organization, the Sales Leader will expand into referrals, client reactivation, previous qualified opportunities, events, and other self-generated revenue strategies.

What We're Looking For

1. Experience With a Comparable Sales Model

You have meaningful experience with a sales process where appointments are generated and then handed to a closer for a consultative sales conversation.

Ideally, you have sold high-ticket services or programs directly to small and midsized business owners through phone or Zoom conversations.

2. You Have Personally Been a Successful Salesperson

You didn't begin your career managing salespeople—you learned how to sell.

You can discuss your personal sales results, close rates, average deal sizes, quotas, and performance.

You understand how to conduct discovery, uncover business and emotional pain, handle objections, and confidently ask for the business.

3. You Know How to Generate Business Without Depending on Marketing

You have led teams that generated meaningful pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold and warm outreach, database reactivation, referrals, or similar proactive strategies.

You appreciate inbound leads, but don't depend on them to succeed.

4. You've Successfully Rebuilt a Sales Team

You have at least five years of relevant sales leadership experience, ideally 10+.

More importantly, you've inherited an underperforming sales team or sales function and materially improved it.

You can clearly explain:

  • What performance looked like when you arrived.

  • What wasn't working.

  • What you changed.

  • Who you hired, coached, or replaced.

  • How you changed process or accountability.

  • The measurable results that followed.

5. You're a High-Accountability Leader
You're self-directed, organized, and comfortable operating with autonomy.

You communicate clearly, do what you say you're going to do, and take ownership when something isn't working.

You're comfortable making difficult decisions and don't need someone else continually motivating or managing you.

jobs.excerpt: About the ClientOur client is one of the nation's largest performance marketing organizations specializing in real estate lead generation.
jobs.description:
About the Client

Our client is one of the nation's largest performance marketing organizations specializing in real estate lead generation. With more than $20 million in annual paid media spend, the company has built its success through data-driven decision making, relentless testing, and scalable customer acquisition strategies. Every marketing dollar is invested into growing their own business, making performance, efficiency, and ROI the driving force behind every campaign. As they continue to expand, they are seeking a highly experienced Director of Paid Media to lead and scale their acquisition engine while building world-class paid media and creative operations. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located within the United States.Job Summary

The Director of Paid Media is a senior leadership role for a highly hands-on marketing operator who enjoys being deeply involved in both strategy and execution. This individual will oversee more than $20 million in annual paid media spend across Meta, Connected TV (CTV), Paid Search, Native, Display, and emerging acquisition channels while leading the company's creative performance strategy.

This role goes well beyond media buying. The Director will oversee the creative team responsible for ad content, messaging, editing, production, testing, and campaign execution, ensuring every creative asset is built with performance and measurable ROI in mind while maintaining quality and increasing spend. They will develop scalable systems for experimentation, optimization, reporting, and forecasting while continuously identifying opportunities to improve lead quality, reduce acquisition costs, and increase return on ad spend.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience within high-volume lead generation organizations—particularly companies that invest significant marketing dollars into generating their own customers rather than managing campaigns for outside clients or agencies. They are equally comfortable analyzing campaign performance, directing creative strategy, building operational processes, and personally working inside advertising platforms to drive results.

What We Offer

  • $160k - $175k Base Salary

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities = On-Target-Earnings (OTE) of $200k+

  • Fully remote position (U.S.-based)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid Time Off and company holidays

  • 401(k) with company match (if applicable)

  • Executive-level ownership of a $20M+ annual paid media budget

  • Opportunity to build and lead a best-in-class performance marketing organization

  • Collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven culture

  • Significant career growth with direct executive visibility

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of a $20M+ annual paid media budget across Meta, CTV, Paid Search, Native, Display, and emerging channels.

  • Remain highly hands-on within advertising platforms, personally monitoring campaign performance and driving optimization efforts.

  • Lead and mentor the creative team responsible for ad copy, video production, graphic design, editing, messaging, and campaign execution.

  • Ensure all creative initiatives are driven by measurable performance, testing frameworks, and return on investment.

  • Build structured experimentation programs that continuously improve creative performance, lead quality, and customer acquisition costs.

  • Develop scalable marketing systems for campaign launches, QA, reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and operational excellence.

  • Partner cross-functionally with executive leadership to align paid media strategy with overall business objectives.

  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting that clearly communicate campaign performance, business impact, and future growth opportunities.

  • Identify new acquisition channels, audience opportunities, and scaling strategies while maintaining profitability and efficiency.

jobs.excerpt: Outbound Sales RepresentativeAbout ClientOur client is a premium pay-per-lead company that generates high-quality, inbound motivated seller leads for real estate investors and repair and replacement leads for roofing companies nationwide.
jobs.description:
Outbound Sales Representative

About Client

Our client is a premium pay-per-lead company that generates high-quality, inbound motivated seller leads for real estate investors and repair and replacement leads for roofing companies nationwide. The company is ambitious, results-driven, and focused on building a high-performance team where accountability, competition, professional growth, and personal development are highly valued. They are looking for motivated individuals who are passionate about sales, enjoy helping growing businesses succeed, and want the opportunity to increase their income while building a long-term career.

Job Summary

The Outbound Sales Representative will be responsible for generating new roofing customers through outbound calling, prospecting, and targeted sales activity. This role will focus on selling premium lead solutions to roofing companies, managing prospects through the sales pipeline, achieving monthly revenue targets, and building strong relationships with customers. The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, comfortable overcoming objections, highly self-motivated, and driven to exceed sales goals. Success in this role requires consistent daily activity, strong CRM discipline, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: 50,000 annually.

  • Uncapped Performance Commission: Earnings increase as sales production increases.

  • Commission Structure: Commission is calculated based on qualifying Sales Volume and Net Roofing Revenue, less the monthly base pay threshold.

  • Illustrative Commission Rate: The current compensation plan provides a 7.5% example based on the existing $3,500 standard roofing sale structure; the actual assigned rate is established in the individual offer agreement.

  • On-Target Earnings: Approximately $78,000 annually based on the current role structure for year one. That said, commissions are uncapped and top performers can earn more.

  • 401(k): Retirement plan with company match.

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Remote Position: Work remotely while selling to roofing companies nationwide.

  • Growth-Oriented Culture: High-performance environment focused on helping team members grow professionally and personally.

  • Meaningful Upside: High performers have the opportunity to significantly increase earnings as production scales.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct high-volume outbound calls to roofing companies and qualified prospects nationwide.

  • Generate new business through assigned call lists, individual prospecting, and proactive hunting.

  • Sell premium lead-generation solutions by clearly communicating the company's value proposition and product offerings.

  • Achieve and consistently exceed monthly sales and revenue targets.

  • Drive new customer acquisition while maintaining responsibility for customer deposit amounts and overall sales volume.

  • Maintain a minimum of 3 hours of daily talk time and consistently meet established activity expectations.

  • Identify customer needs, overcome objections, negotiate solutions, and build trust throughout the sales process.

  • Demonstrate product value through phone calls, email, text, online demonstrations, and presentations.

  • Accurately document prospect and customer activity, sales information, and pipeline progress within the CRM.

  • Provide an effective handoff to Onboarding and Customer Success while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of commission-based sales experience.

  • 2+ years of CRM management experience, preferably within real estate, lead generation, roofing, or a related sales environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to quickly build rapport.

  • Confident, consultative approach to selling with strong objection-handling and negotiation skills.

  • Highly self-motivated, accountable, and comfortable working independently.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Organized and disciplined, with the ability to effectively manage multiple prospects and sales activities.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment and committed to continuous improvement.

  • Able to spend extended periods on the phone using a headset, with access to a reliable high-speed internet connection.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Diese Stelle kannst du remote bei uns ausführen.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Marketing bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von Kampagnen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Content für unsere Website, LinkedIn und weitere Kommunikationskanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Themen verständlich, professionell und zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet werden.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Broschüren, Grafiken und weiteren Marketingmaterialien und achtest dabei auf eine saubere Umsetzung unseres Corporate Designs.

  • Du wertest Marketing Kennzahlen aus, bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich auf und hilfst dabei, unsere Aktivitäten datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei der Erstellung von Erlösberechnungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Du bereitest Kundendaten, Projektinformationen sowie Angebots- und Präsentationsunterlagen strukturiert für Vertrieb, Partner und Management auf.

jobs.excerpt: About the teamAt Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience.
jobs.description:
About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Arkansas​. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Arkansas.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


For US applicants: Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Qualified applicants will be considered in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USWe are a high-growth education company dedicated to helping aspiring law students achieve their LSAT goals and gain admission to top law schools.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

We are a high-growth education company dedicated to helping aspiring law students achieve their LSAT goals and gain admission to top law schools. Backed by over 300 five-star reviews and a network of 170+ elite LSAT tutors, we deliver proven, results-driven tutoring programs that consistently move the needle for our students.

Our mission is straightforward: pair every student with the right tutor, the right strategy, and the right support system to maximize their success. Our sales team drives revenue, and our appointment setters are the engine that keeps the pipeline full of qualified, ready-to-buy prospects.

We are a fully remote company, and so is this role. Work from anywhere while being part of a team that is scaling fast and making a real impact in the lives of future lawyers.

JOB SUMMARY

This is a remote Sales Closerrole built for a high-performing sales professional who knows how to run a strong sales conversation, uncover client needs, handle objections, and confidently close warm, pre-qualified leads

You will not be responsible for cold calling, prospecting, or generating your own leads. Your calendar is filled with qualified inbound prospects who have already expressed interest in our tutoring services.

Your primary responsibility is simple: show up prepared, run an effective consultation, and close the right clients.
You will conduct 1:1 virtual sales consultations with prospective clients, understand their goals and challenges, determine the right tutoring solution, present the appropriate offer, and guide them through the enrollment process.

Most deals are designed to close on the initial call, with occasional follow-up required.
This is a high-earning opportunity for a confident, driven closer who thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Top performers consistently reach six figures through a combination of base salary and uncapped commission.

If you know how to control a sales conversation, build trust quickly, uncover the real reason someone is looking for help, overcome objections, and ask for the sale, this role is built for you

What we Offer

Base Salary:$50,000 annually (paid weekly)

On-Target Earnings: $100,000 – $120,000+

Commission Structure:

  • Uncapped commission paid monthly

  • High volume of inbound, pre-qualified leads

  • Top performers can scale earnings significantly based on volume and close rate

Additional Benefits:

  • Fully remote work environment

  • No prospecting or cold outreach required

  • Dedicated appointment setter to manage your calendar

  • Clear path for internal promotion into sales leadership

Work Schedule & Flexibility:

  • Full-time position

  • Schedule: Sunday–Thursday, with Friday and Saturday off

  • Hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time (PT) (with scheduled break)

  • Optional additional hours available for increased earning potential

Operational Expectations:

  • Conduct multiple daily sales calls via Google Meet with warm leads Maintain a high close rate through effective consultative selling

  • Follow up with select prospects to secure deals when needed

  • Collect payments and finalize client enrollment

  • Transition closed clients to the fulfillment team for tutor matching

  • Stay organized and manage pipeline effectively

  • Participate in ongoing training and performance coaching

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct structured, consultative sales calls with prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and align them with the appropriate tutoring solution Confidently present pricing and handle objections

  • Close deals and collect payment during or shortly after the call

  • Ensure a smooth handoff to the client success and tutoring teams

  • Maintain accurate tracking of sales activity and performance metrics

  • Continuously improve sales approach through training and feedback Represent the company with professionalism and integrity

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven sales experience, preferably in a consultative or high-ticket environment Experience in law or a strong LSAT background is a major plus.

  • Strong closing ability with a track record of hitting or exceeding targets

  • Confidence and presence in virtual sales conversations

  • High mental resilience and ability to handle rejection without losing momentum

  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset with a focus on results

  • Excellent communication and rapport-building skills

  • Strong organizational and time management abilities

  • Ability to manage multiple calls and opportunities simultaneously

  • Self-motivated with a high level of accountability

About the role

  • Contribute TA approach and past-performance narrative to proposals when naming is authorized

Engagement

This is a project-based, remote engagement. It is contingent on contract award and final staffing approval, and no assignment is guaranteed. We will ask your permission before including your name or résumé in any proposal.

How to apply

Send your résumé and a short summary of the 21st CCLC or OST technical assistance you have delivered (organization, year, your role).

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years in afterschool / OST programs, with direct experience supporting 21st CCLC grantees (state agency, TA center, intermediary or evaluator)
  • Experience delivering training or TA to multiple sites or subgrantees, not only running a single program
  • Working knowledge of Title IV, Part B requirements, grantee monitoring and federal reporting
  • Clear writer and facilitator who can turn findings into usable improvement plans
  • Comfortable as an independent consultant on a project basis

Nice to have

  • State education agency or statewide afterschool network experience
  • Program evaluation experience
  • Utah or Mountain West experience

jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to be a big part of something big? At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience.
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

The CRM Product Specialist is a quota-carrying, new-business hunter responsible for driving net new logo acquisition across DP360's Commercial Truck, Marine, Equipment and Recreational vertical markets. This is a full-cycle sales role; from prospecting and pipeline generation through discovery, demonstration, negotiation and close — selling DP360's operational software suite including CRM and Conversational AI solutions to dealership groups and operators.

Working in concert with SDR support, channel and referral partnerships and self-sourced outbound activity, the Product Specialist owns revenue growth in their assigned territory. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role modeled after best-in-class SaaS acquisition motions seen at large enterprise SaaS companies — structured for reps who thrive in complex, consultative sales environments and are energized by building new customer relationships.

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

  • Execute a balanced prospecting motion across self-sourced outbound, SDR qualified inbound, and channel/referral-sourced leads.

  • Build and maintain a minimum 3x pipeline coverage ratio against quota at all times.

  • Develop territory and account-level prospecting plans targeting Commercial (powersports, RV, marine, construction equipment) and Recreational verticals.

  • Leverage referral networks within the broader Trader Interactive ecosystem to identify cross-sell and co-sell opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDR team to refine messaging, qualify inbound interest and convert MQLs to SQLs efficiently.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial discovery call through signed contract, typically 60-120 days depending on deal complexity.

  • Conduct compelling discovery sessions to understand dealership workflow, technology gaps and performance objectives.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations of DP360 CRM and Conversational AI tools to dealership operators, GMs, and ownership groups.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with economic buyers, champions and end users within prospect accounts.

  • Develop and deliver ROI-based business cases and proposals aligned to each prospect's operational metrics and KPIs.

  • Manage deal progression in CRM with accurate forecasting, stage discipline and pipeline hygiene at all times.

Channel & Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and nurture relationships with referral partners, OEM contacts and adjacent Trader Interactive business units to drive inbound deal flow.

  • Coordinate with channel partners on joint pipeline reviews, co-selling motions and shared account strategies.

  • Act as a DP360 brand ambassador at industry events, dealer associations and trade shows within target verticals.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with the CRM Performance Manager (Customer Success) to ensure smooth post-sale handoff and maximize early customer engagement.

  • Feed competitive intelligence, objection patterns and prospect feedback to Product, Marketing, Marketplace Sales and Leadership teams on a structured basis.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives including beta launches, product releases and vertical-specific marketing campaigns.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine ICP targeting, messaging and campaign effectiveness based on field insights.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent role.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistent quota attainment at or above 100%.

  • Experience selling operational or vertical SaaS solutions to SMB and mid-market customers ($15K–$75K ACV).

  • Strong command of consultative selling methodologies (Challenger or equivalent).

  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting in addition to working inbound and partner-referred leads.

  • Excellent discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills with comfort presenting to C-suite and ownership-level buyers.

  • Data-literate and CRM-disciplined — experience maintaining accurate pipeline in Salesforce, HubSpot or equivalent.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling into automotive, powersports, RV, marine, or equipment dealership verticals.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, dealership management systems (DMS), or Conversational AI/messaging products.

  • Background selling within a SaaS portfolio (e.g., Coupa, Anaplan, DealerSocket, VinSolutions, vAuto).

  • Experience working in a channel-assisted or partner co-sell sales environment.

  • Comfort with product-led growth motions and shorter, transactional deal cycles alongside complex enterprise sales.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

jobs.title: Freelance Corporate Facilitator — Leadership & Management
jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Freelance Outdoor Fotograf*in (Projekt- oder Stundenbasis)
jobs.excerpt: In einer Welt, in der Bilder immer perfekter werden und manchmal kaum noch erkennbar ist, was echt und was KI-generiert ist, möchten wir bewusst auf das setzen, was man nicht künstlich erzeugen kann: echte Momente.
jobs.description:
In einer Welt, in der Bilder immer perfekter werden und manchmal kaum noch erkennbar ist, was echt und was KI-generiert ist, möchten wir bewusst auf das setzen, was man nicht künstlich erzeugen kann: echte Momente.

Das Licht an einem frühen Morgen in den Bergen. Dreckige Wanderschuhe nach einem langen Tag draussen. Ein ehrliches Lachen. Wind, Regen, Sonne und all die kleinen ungeplanten Momente dazwischen.

Wir glauben: Die Verbindung zwischen Mensch und Natur kann man nicht faken.

Deshalb bauen wir ein Netzwerk aus Fotograf*innen, Studierenden, jungen Talenten und kreativen Outdoor-Menschen auf, die gemeinsam mit uns die Bildwelt von NIKIN gestalten.

Du musst dafür kein riesiges Portfolio und keine jahrelange Erfahrung als professionelle*r Fotograf*in mitbringen. Entscheidend ist, dass du fotografieren kannst, ein Auge für echte Momente hast und unseren Outdoor Lifestyle fühlst.

Dein Impact bei uns

Als Teil unseres Photography Networks kannst du auf zwei Arten mit NIKIN zusammenarbeiten:

Wir briefen dich.
Für Kampagnen, neue Produkte oder bestimmte Content-Bedürfnisse kommen wir mit konkreten Projekten auf unser Netzwerk zu. Du erhältst ein Briefing und setzt dieses selbstständig in deiner Region und mit deinem eigenen kreativen Blick um.

Du pitchst uns deine Idee.
Du hast eine Idee für eine Fotostory, kennst eine besondere Person oder hast einen Outdoor-Trip geplant, bei dem NIKIN perfekt reinpassen würde? Dann komm auf uns zu.

Schick uns deine Idee, erzähl uns kurz, was du vorhast, welchen Content du produzieren möchtest und welches Budget du dafür benötigst. Wenn die Idee zu NIKIN und unserer aktuellen Planung passt, geben wir dir grünes Licht.

So möchten wir Content schaffen, der nicht nur für eine Kampagne inszeniert wird, sondern dort entsteht, wo echte Geschichten draussen passieren.

Was du bei uns machst

Du…

  • produzierst authentischen Foto-Content für NIKIN Kampagnen, Social Media, Website und weitere Kanäle

  • setzt unsere Produkte draussen in der Natur und in echten Situationen in Szene

  • interpretierst unsere Briefings mit deinem eigenen fotografischen Stil

  • bringst eigene Ideen, Locations, Menschen und Geschichten ein

  • organisierst deine Shootings weitgehend selbstständig – von Location und Timing bis zu passenden Personen vor der Kamera

  • findest Menschen, die authentisch zu unserer Bildwelt passen – Modelerfahrung ist dabei kein Muss

  • fotografierst mit professionellem Equipment und bearbeitest deine Bilder selbstständig

  • lieferst uns eine professionelle und qualitativ hochwertige Bildauswahl

Besonders spannend finden wir Content, der nicht nur schön aussieht, sondern eine Geschichte erzählt. Wenn daraus eine Story entsteht, die zu dir und NIKIN passt, sind beispielsweise auch gemeinsame Collab Posts auf Social Media möglich.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

Du…

  • fotografierst leidenschaftlich gerne – egal, ob du Fotografie studierst, dir alles selbst beigebracht hast oder bereits professionell arbeitest

  • beherrschst eine Spiegelreflex- oder spiegellose Systemkamera sicher

  • kannst mit einem professionellen Bildbearbeitungstool umgehen

  • hast ein gutes Auge für Licht, Komposition, Menschen und echte Momente

  • fühlst dich draussen wohl und bist selbst gerne in der Natur unterwegs

  • kannst Shootings selbstständig organisieren und passende Personen dafür finden

  • arbeitest zuverlässig und kannst dich an Briefings, Abmachungen und Deadlines halten

  • verstehst unsere Marke und kannst NIKIN visuell auf deine eigene Art interpretieren

Wichtig: Die von dir produzierten und von NIKIN vergüteten Bilder sollen wir zeitlich und medial unbeschränkt für unsere Kommunikation und unser Marketing nutzen können. Die genauen Nutzungsrechte werden vor der Zusammenarbeit transparent vereinbart.

Wie die Zusammenarbeit funktioniert

Du wirst Teil unseres NIKIN Photography Networks. Das bedeutet nicht zwingend regelmässige Einsätze oder eine fixe Anzahl Stunden.

Wenn wir ein passendes Projekt haben, können wir direkt auf dich zukommen. Gleichzeitig kannst du jederzeit eigene Ideen bei uns einreichen.

Vor jedem Projekt definieren wir gemeinsam den Umfang, die erwarteten Deliverables und das Budget. Je nach Projekt kann die Vergütung auf Stundenbasis oder als fixes Projektbudget vereinbart werden.

Bei eigenen Projektideen schickst du uns direkt eine Budgetvorstellung mit. Wir prüfen den Pitch und geben dir vor der Umsetzung ein Go – oder sagen transparent ab, wenn das Projekt gerade nicht zu unserer Planung passt.

So wissen beide Seiten vor dem Start, was erwartet wird und welches Budget zur Verfügung steht.

Was du bei uns findest

bezahlte Fotoaufträge auf Stunden- oder Projektbasis

die Freiheit, eigene Ideen und Fotostorys bei NIKIN zu pitchen

echte Kampagnen und Content Produktionen, die du auch für dein Portfolio nutzen kannst

die Chance, deine Bilder einem breiten Publikum zu zeigen

Markierung als Fotograf*in, wenn deine Bilder auf unserem Instagram Kanal veröffentlicht werden

die Möglichkeit für gemeinsame Collab Posts, wenn Bild, Story und Kanal dazu passen

Mitarbeitendenrabatt auf NIKIN Produkte

Einladungen zu ausgewählten NIKIN Team Events

ein kreatives Netzwerk rund um Outdoor, Fotografie und Natur

und hoffentlich ziemlich viele gute Gründe, mit deiner Kamera nach draussen zu gehen 🌲

Wenn du für ein Shooting eigene Models organisierst, vergüten wir diese grundsätzlich mit je CHF 100.– pro Halbtag plus CHF 50.– NIKIN Gutschein pro Person, sofern im jeweiligen Projekt nichts anderes vereinbart wurde.

So bewirbst du dich

Uns interessiert weniger dein perfekter Lebenslauf und mehr, wie du die Welt siehst.

Schick uns:

ein paar Worte über dich und warum du Teil unseres Photography Networks werden möchtest

deine Antwort auf die Frage: «Wie sieht für dich die perfekte NIKIN Bildwelt aus?»

drei bis fünf deiner Bilder, die deiner Meinung nach bereits heute zu NIKIN passen würden – und kurz weshalb

dein Portfolio oder weitere Arbeitsbeispiele

falls vorhanden deinen Instagram Account oder eine andere Plattform, auf der wir mehr von deiner Arbeit sehen können

deinen Wohnort bzw. die Regionen, in denen du hauptsächlich fotografieren möchtest

Und keine Sorge: Wir suchen nicht nur ausgebildete Profis.

Wenn du eine Kamera hast, dein Handwerk beherrschst und beim Lesen dieser Ausschreibung bereits drei Orte, Menschen oder Geschichten im Kopf hast, die du gerne für NIKIN fotografieren würdest, dann möchten wir von dir hören.

Vielleicht entsteht unsere nächste Kampagne ja aus deiner Idee.

Together for Nature. Tree by Tree.

jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer (L2) - for Voice Trust: helping ensure Twilio’s Voice customers have reliable voice communication with their customers that ensure their customers will answer their calls.

About the job

This position is needed to add to our Voice Connectivity Trust team to enable Twilio to better support our customers using Voice in their solutions. As a Software Engineer on this team you will participate in all phases of the software development life cycle which includes requirements gathering with Product Managers, technical design, estimations, sprint planning, coding, testing, deployments and on-call support. This engineer will own, operate and maintain their teams’ services in a distributed production environment, employing Agile methodologies to continuously deliver value to customers.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be an owner: Design and implement real-time services with high throughput and low latency requirements, verify, deploy and operationalize them
  • Wear the customer's shoes: Work closely with stakeholders to understand customer needs and, devise and deliver, simple, robust and scalable solutions
  • Write it down: Be comfortable expressing thoughts and ideas as detailed prose and use it as an effective means to collaborate with leads, architects and cross functional teams
  • Be bold: Embrace the challenge of scaling a complex distributed platform with points of presence globally, each one concerned with high availability, high reliability, high throughput, low latency, and media fidelity
  • Draw the owl: Figure out novel ways of solving customer problems for the Voice channel

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in a large scale, distributed applications environment on JVM based technologies
  • Experience building RESTful services, API design and event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands on experience with cloud infrastructures such as AWS, GCP, OpenStack or Azure
  • Excellent written communication skills - essential for effective AI prompting and for creating clear technical documentation (with or without AI assistance)
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability
  • Strong Java fundamentals with the ability to architect, review, and debug code whether written by you, teammates, or AI agents
  • Demonstrated proficiency working with AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) - you should be able to describe your workflows and show examples
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field
  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals not limited to data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems
  • Able to work well in a team setting and both highly motivated and motivating

Desired:

  • Experience with on-call rotations, incident response, monitoring/alerting tools (Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana)
  • Can demonstrate how you effectively use AI to deliver value efficiently
  • Experience scaling data tiers employing a variety of SQL/NoSQL database and caching technologies
  • Hands on experience scaling production backend systems, with the proven ability to design and develop horizontally-scalable, resilient and performing-under-load systems
  • Knowledge and experience working with SIP protocol
  • Knowledge and experience working with Stir/Shaken protocol

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time.
