jobs.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Help Desk Specialist to be the first point of contact for users of a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them.

You will provide both Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, diagnosing and resolving issues directly, from access and account problems to errors inside complex, role-based regulatory workflows, and escalating to engineering only when a fix requires a code or infrastructure change. You will also be the team's early-warning system: spotting patterns in tickets that point to defects, escalating outages immediately, and feeding what users experience back to the engineering team. As new capabilities are released on the modernized platform, you will support users through each change, so we're looking for an experienced support professional who can work independently across both a legacy system and a new one.

This role is technical and service-oriented. You will work closely with our engineers, trainers, and change enablement lead, and with client stakeholders who depend on fast, accurate support.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

User Support & Issue Resolution

  • Serve as the first point of contact for agency and oversight office users by web, phone, and email, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and resolving technical, access, account, and process issues directly whenever possible.

  • Triage, categorize, and log every incident and service request in Zendesk, including requestor, description, time logged, and time to resolve.

  • Meet contractual service levels: an initial tailored response to 95% of tickets within 3 business hours, and resolution or escalation of 98% within 1 business day.

  • Handle user access and authorization requests, login issues, and questions about workflows, roles, and system status.

  • Investigate complex issues using application logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools, and escalate those that need engineering support with clear reproduction steps, root-cause findings, and user impact.

Monitoring, Escalation & Reporting

  • Monitor incoming tickets for patterns that suggest widespread issues or defects, and flag systemic problems to the engineering team.

  • Report outages and serious issues immediately to the technical team by phone and email, especially those affecting public availability, system performance, or data integrity.

  • Produce weekly and ad hoc help desk reports covering ticket volume, response and resolution times by priority, and trends.

  • Feed recurring user pain points into the product backlog as inputs for future fixes and enhancements.

User Enablement & Release Support

  • Create and update targeted help content, including online tips, FAQs, and user guide updates.

  • Support training materials and workshops in partnership with the training and change enablement leads.

  • Support users through each new release on the modernized platform, answering questions and capturing early feedback.

  • Help maintain help desk procedures, ticket categories, and knowledge base content as systems change.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • At least 4 years of experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for enterprise-level web applications, including complex, workflow-driven or role-based systems.

  • Demonstrated experience resolving issues independently through Tier 2 troubleshooting, and knowing when and how to escalate to engineering teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management), including ticket categorization, workflow configuration, and reporting.

  • Experience consistently meeting defined service-level agreements for response and resolution times.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and application log analysis to investigate and diagnose user-reported issues.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across user access and permissions, browser, application, and integration issues, with the ability to document root causes and reproduction steps for engineers.

  • Experience analyzing support data to identify trends and systemic defects, and turning findings into clear reports and recommendations.

  • Experience writing user-facing help content, FAQs, or knowledge base articles.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a patient, professional approach to supporting users of varied technical backgrounds, including senior government stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A+ certification.

  • Experience supporting federal agency users or a federal help desk.

  • Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking, the Unified Agenda, or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections.

  • Experience supporting applications built on Java and Oracle, or similar enterprise technology stacks.

  • Experience supporting users through a system migration or the rollout of a new platform.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for user-facing content.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.

Send your CV to []. In a few lines, tell us two things:

One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business. What it did, and what it saved.

One time you caught something before it shipped that nobody else had noticed.

Please also include a short voice note, around 60 seconds, introducing yourself and telling us what you'd want to know before writing your first email for us.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our partner company, a healthcare technology platform used by clinics to manage scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and more.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our partner company, a healthcare technology platform used by clinics to manage scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and more. In this role, you will ship features end to end, own production health, and build AI-powered capabilities that help clinic staff work smarter. The ideal candidate is passionate about writing clean, secure, and performant code, enjoys working directly with stakeholders, and is eager to raise the engineering bar for the whole team.

Excited? Let’s see what it takes 💛

What you will do:

  • Ship features end to end in Django/DRF, PostgreSQL, and React/TypeScript, covering scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and reports;
  • Maintain the Playwright end-to-end test suite for both API and UI, keeping it green with the help of AI agents;
  • Build AI features, including an MCP server that gives AI agents per-user access to the platform and a staff assistant on AWS Bedrock with EU data residency;
  • Plan and ship releases, including scoping, QA sign-off, migration and deploy order, feature flags, and rollback;
  • Own production health across ECS services, RDS, Celery workers, and the real-time server, leading the fix and the post-mortem when something breaks;
  • Build and maintain the integrations clinics depend on: UAE health exchanges, Stripe, SMS, WhatsApp, email, imaging and 3D scans, and country-specific tax and invoicing rules;
  • Keep each clinic's data isolated and safe through multi-tenant access control, roles and permissions, and audit trails;
  • Keep the product fast by fixing N+1 queries, tuning slow endpoints and reports, and writing migrations that are safe on live data;
  • Work directly with stakeholders and clinics to clarify requests, demo completed work, and turn support tickets into root-cause fixes;
  • Mentor a middle developer and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, Jenkins pipelines, and Terraform.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 5+ years of proven experience with Python/Django and PostgreSQL;
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly ECS and RDS;
  • Confidence working with React;
  • Practical experience building products with AI/LLMs;
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, Bitbucket, and Jira;
  • Fluent English (B2 or higher), both written and spoken;
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to lead incident resolution, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and mentor others.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with healthcare or clinical workflows;
  • Experience with integrations with government or healthcare systems.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Fixed schedule: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UAE time (GMT+4);
  • Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely;
  • Inclusive and international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Supportive management focused on your growth and long-term collaboration.

The IT Operations Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for enterprise technology services supporting mission-critical programs, grants management, volunteer service initiatives, disaster response activities, and agency business operations. This role oversees day-to-day IT operations while serving as a senior technical advisor responsible for cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity coordination, change management, operational governance, and modernization initiatives.

The position requires a blend of leadership, technical expertise, project management, and stakeholder engagement to ensure secure, reliable, and compliant technology services.


Key Responsibilities

IT Operations Leadership

  • Direct and coordinate daily IT service delivery across infrastructure, cloud services, enterprise applications, identity management, and end-user support.
  • Establish operational priorities, resource allocations, and service delivery expectations.
  • Lead operational reviews and status meetings while monitoring project and program performance.
  • Ensure operational activities align with strategic goals and mission requirements.
  • Serve as escalation point for operational issues, outages, and service disruptions.

Cloud and Infrastructure Management

  • Provide leadership for Microsoft Azure and cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, networking, platform services, storage, databases, and identity services.
  • Coordinate environment provisioning, production releases, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Ensure solutions comply with federal security and architecture requirements.

Enterprise Applications and Business Systems

  • Support operational management of enterprise applications including:
    • ServiceNow
    • Azure DevOps
    • Microsoft 365
    • Custom mission support applications
  • Review application onboarding requests and operational impacts.
  • Coordinate application lifecycle management and production support activities.
  • Support governance decisions regarding application hosting and enterprise integration strategies.

Change, Release, and Governance Management

  • Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities and operational governance processes.
  • Review technical change requests for risk, compliance, operational impact, and implementation readiness.
  • Coordinate stakeholders, technical teams, and agency leadership during change planning and execution.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, implementation plans, testing procedures, and rollback strategies.
  • Promote successful change adoption across the organization.

Cybersecurity and Compliance

  • Partner with agency cybersecurity teams to maintain a secure and compliant operating environment.
  • Support Security Impact Assessments (SIAs), Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, and audit responses.
  • Evaluate operational risks associated with new applications, integrations, and cloud services.
  • Ensure compliance with federal security requirements, FISMA controls, and agency governance policies.
  • Participate in incident response and security remediation activities.

Program Support and Disaster Response Technology

  • Support technology platforms that enable client’s programs and mission operations.
  • Coordinate IT services supporting disaster services initiatives and emergency response capabilities.
  • Ensure operational readiness of systems that support program delivery and field activities.
  • Collaborate with program offices to align technology investments with agency priorities.

Vendor, Contractor, and Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor technical staff, contractors, and service providers.
  • Coordinate work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity, networking, and application support teams.
  • Support workforce planning, onboarding, performance management, and training initiatives.
  • Foster collaboration and accountability among cross-functional teams.

Strategic Planning and Modernization

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation and process improvement.
  • Lead modernization initiatives involving cloud adoption, security enhancement, and service transformation.
  • Provide recommendations to leadership on technology investments and operational improvements.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices for agency adoption.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive IT experience.
  • 3+ years in operational leadership, management, or supervisory roles.
  • Experience supporting federal government information systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise with:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Microsoft 365
    • Identity and Access Management
    • ServiceNow
    • Cloud Operations
    • Enterprise Application Support
    • Change Management
  • Experience leading cross-functional operational teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal civilian agencies.
  • Experience managing Azure cloud environments and DevOps pipelines.
  • Knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks and compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Services, Grants Management, Volunteer Programs, or Mission Support systems.
  • ITIL, PMP, Microsoft Azure, CISSP, or related certifications.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Virtual Property Manager to oversee day-to-day operations across a growing residential real estate portfolio. You will be the operational point of contact for tenants, vendors, and contractors — managing maintenance coordination, rent collection follow-ups, leasing support, move-ins and move-outs, and all the documentation and communication that keeps a multi-property portfolio running cleanly.

This role has a hard language requirement. You must be fully fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken. A significant portion of tenant and vendor communication happens in Spanish and there is no workaround for this. If you are highly organized, genuinely bilingual, comfortable handling difficult conversations professionally, and take pride in keeping operations tight across multiple moving parts, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US Pacific Time business hours
  • Work directly with ownership on a growing residential portfolio with real operational ownership
  • Stable, long-term role with clear responsibilities and room to grow as the portfolio scales

What You'll Work On

Tenant Communication and Support

  • Respond to tenant inquiries via phone, text, email, and WhatsApp in both English and Spanish
  • Handle difficult tenant conversations professionally and with a solutions-first approach
  • Communicate with Section 8 and Housing Authority representatives as needed
  • Assist with leasing coordination and tenant screening

Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

  • Coordinate maintenance requests and follow up with vendors and contractors through to resolution
  • Track open work orders and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Help source and manage vendors for repairs and renovations
  • Escalate urgent property issues quickly and keep ownership informed

Leasing and Turnover Operations

  • Coordinate move-ins, move-outs, inspections, and unit turnovers
  • Assist with rent collection and payment follow-ups
  • Maintain organized property records, leases, invoices, and tenant documentation

Systems, Reporting, and Automation

  • Keep property management software, spreadsheets, and internal systems accurate and up to date
  • Support ownership with operational reporting and administrative tasks
  • Apply a fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting including tracking income, expenses, intercompany transactions, and financial activity across multiple LLCs and properties
  • Use AI tools and automation platforms to improve efficiency and streamline recurring workflows

What You Bring

  • Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken — this is a non-negotiable requirement
  • Prior experience in property management, real estate operations, or a closely related role
  • Fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting and tracking financial activity across multiple properties or business entities
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple open items simultaneously without dropping the ball
  • Excellent communication and follow-through across phone, text, email, and messaging platforms
  • Comfortable handling difficult tenant conversations professionally and calmly
  • Experience coordinating maintenance vendors and contractors
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment
  • Available to work during US Pacific Time business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with DoorLoop, Buildium, or similar property management software
  • Experience working with Section 8 or affordable housing programs
  • Experience managing remote vendors or contractors across multiple properties
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Airtable, or ClickUp
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve workflows and reporting

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in both English and Spanish, describing your property management or real estate operations experience, and walking through how you handle a maintenance coordination issue or difficult tenant conversation end to end

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are bilingual, highly organized, and want to own the operations of a growing residential portfolio with real accountability and direct access to ownership, this role gives you the structure and the trust to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer with strong experience in test automation, API and web testing, and modern quality engineering practices. The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in QA Automation and Software Engineering with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI-assisted development workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation architectures and frameworks.
  • Define and execute automated testing strategies for web applications and REST APIs.
  • Develop and maintain effective automated regression testing strategies.
  • Implement BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) practices.
  • Design and execute performance testing.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, particularly within Azure DevOps environments.
  • Develop automated tests using Playwright, Selenium, Karate, Gatling, or similar technologies.
  • Collaborate with development and engineering teams to establish quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Apply quality engineering practices to solutions incorporating Large Language Models, AI Agents, and Agentic Workflows.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and validation of AI-generated outputs and AI-assisted development processes.
  • Continuously improve testing processes, automation coverage, and quality practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in test automation architecture and automation strategies.
  • Solid experience with API and Web Testing.
  • Experience with BDD and regression testing strategies.
  • Experience with Performance Testing.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps.
  • Solid experience with one or more automation technologies such as Playwright, Selenium, Karate, Gatling, or similar tools.
  • Programming experience with Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar languages.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs.
  • Experience with Git and version-control workflows.
  • English proficiency: B2 level or higher.

AI & Emerging Technology Experience

Practical experience or working knowledge in one or more of the following areas is highly valuable:

  • Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • AI Agents and Agentic Workflows
  • Prompt Engineering and Context Engineering
  • Tool Calling and AI Orchestration
  • Specification-Driven Development
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Evaluation and validation of AI-generated outputs

jobs.description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment. Come help us raise it.

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love. Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

You in? Keep on reading.

A hands-on technical artist who owns the path from finished 2D art and animation to working assets in Unity. They build the tools, standards, and validation that make handoffs reliable, keep templates and IP reskins fast, and help the team adopt AI-assisted workflows where they genuinely help.

The role

As Technical Artist, you will own the tooling and standards behind this journey. You'll work directly with discipline leads and Engineering to cut manual work, catch integration errors early, and make sure assets look and behave in playable builds as intended.

What you'll own

  • Evaluate the art and animation pipeline and technical stack, identify visual or creative requirements that existing workflows cannot support, and propose practical solutions or alternatives that align with production constraints.

  • Build and maintain tools: Write practical scripts, exporters, importers, and validation checks that remove repetitive work.

  • Define asset standards: Set conventions for structure, naming, export settings, versioning, and "ready for implementation" criteria.

  • Own Unity asset setup: Define how visual assets and animations are integrated efficiently in Unity, including prefabs, reusable configurations, and animation integration.

  • Validate in builds: Check that assets look and behave correctly on device, and diagnose visual defects, integration issues, and mobile performance problems.

  • Keep the pipeline healthy: Find bottlenecks, trace recurring issues to their root cause, and fix them across Art, Animation, Design, and Engineering.

  • Enable reuse: Structure assets, rigs, animations, and setups so they carry across games, levels, and IP reskins with minimal rework.

  • Evolve the workflow: Evaluate new tools and pipeline changes, including our exploration of a move from Adobe Animate to Spine, and help teams adopt them.

  • Introduce AI-assisted workflows: Identify where AI tools can safely speed up production, pilot them with the team, set guardrails for quality and licensed-IP use, and document what works.

  • Document and support: Write clear documentation, train colleagues, and make tools usable by people with different levels of technical confidence.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience integrating 2D art and animation into Unity for shipped or production-ready games.

  • Experience with node-based shader editors (e.g., Amplify Shader Editor, Shader Graph), including creating custom shaders and effects tailored to the creative needs of each project.

  • Solid understanding of Unity’s different render pipelines, including their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use cases.

  • A solid grasp of 2D asset and animation pipelines, such as preparing layered art (e.g. PSD or Animate files) for export, sprite or skeletal animation, and atlas packing.

  • Scripting ability to automate real production problems. We care more about how you solve them than which language you use. C# for Unity editor tooling is most relevant, and Python or similar for external automation is welcome. If you're strong in one, you can learn the other.

  • Practical troubleshooting skills: reproducing issues, isolating causes, and fixing them at the source.

  • An understanding of mobile performance constraints such as app size and download, memory, draw calls, texture sizes, and animation cost.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as coding assistants, to build or speed up production tools, with sound judgment about when output needs human review.

  • The ability to work with artists, animators, designers, and engineers, and to explain technical decisions to non-technical colleagues.

  • Comfort writing documentation and teaching others.

Nice to have skills

  • Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Animate workflows.

  • Asset localization experience: Text baked into art, font and glyph coverage, per-locale asset variants, and how they're packaged are TA problems.

  • Version control workflows for art assets.

  • Experience building small AI-assisted tools or automations that non-technical colleagues use day to day.

  • Experience in games for children, or with licensed IP and brand-approval constraints.

  • Experience with templated or reskinnable game systems.

  • High experience with Spine or another skeletal 2D animation tool.

English is a must:We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication, especially in asynchronous and long-form formats, is key to collaborating successfully.

Life at Lingokids

📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

🏡 Remote-Friendly: Work from where you’re most productive, home or our offices in Madrid, anywhere within a 2-hour difference from Spain (GMT+1). The choice is yours!

📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee, integrating them directly into your payroll.

🩺 Health Insurance: Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

🎉 Company events: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

Passion matters more than perfection

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack Software Engineer — Ecosystem Experience

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software.

Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

You’ll join our Ecosystem Experience team — the group that connects Semble to the wider healthcare ecosystem: labs, pharmacies, partner APIs, webhooks, and Semble Connect, our automation platform built on Workato.

We work closely with Product, Business, and external partners, and we ship in a large TypeScript monorepo used across the company.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact — We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration — We are in it together.
  • Human touch — We care deeply

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU, with occasional travel to our London or Paris offices, within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What You Will Be Doing

As a senior engineer on Ecosystem Experience, you’ll own problems end to end — from partner discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and production reliability.

We expect you to operate with a high degree of autonomy and to raise the technical bar for the team.

  • Lead the design and delivery of integrations that move clinical and operational data safely between Semble and external systems, including REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, HL7, SFTP, and iPaaS/automation flows.
  • Work across the stack in our Yarn/Nx TypeScript monorepo: React on the frontend, Node.js services and domain modules on the backend, GraphQL (internal and public APIs), and MongoDB.
  • Take ambiguous partner specs and product goals and turn them into clear technical designs, sequenced delivery plans, and clinically safe, testable solutions.
  • Make sound architectural trade-offs — simplicity vs flexibility, build vs buy, speed vs long-term maintainability — and document the decisions so others can follow them.
  • Own production outcomes: monitoring and alerting (e.g. Datadog), incident diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and durable fixes — not just shipping features.
  • Improve reliability and operability: failure handling, retries, idempotency, credentials/secrets, multi-tenant config, and safe rollouts across many production environments.
  • Contribute to Semble Connect and related automation — provisioning, connections, recipe/webhook patterns, and the product surfaces that expose them to practices.
  • Set a high quality bar through design reviews, thorough code reviews, automated tests (unit, integration, e2e), and pragmatic CI/CD improvements.
  • Mentor and unstick teammates; give clear feedback; help more junior engineers grow without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Influence the Ecosystem Experience roadmap and technical standards — surfacing risks early, proposing better approaches, and aligning stakeholders when requirements conflict.

What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for a senior fullstack engineer who enjoys messy real-world integrations as much as clean product UI — someone comfortable reading a partner OpenAPI spec in the morning and shipping a resilient production path by the afternoon.

You should already be operating at a senior level: driving work independently, elevating those around you, and thinking beyond the ticket in front of you.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years' professional experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript, including substantial time operating as a senior / staff-of-one on complex features.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js backends and APIs (REST and/or GraphQL).
  • Proven experience integrating with third-party systems — APIs, webhooks, auth flows, retries, idempotency, credentials/secrets.
  • Ability to design systems, not just implement tickets: break down large problems, define interfaces/contracts, and leave codebases easier to change than you found them.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity — clarifying requirements, challenging weak specs, and driving decisions when information is incomplete.
  • A production ownership mindset: debugging complex issues across services, reading logs/metrics traces, and preventing the same incident twice.
  • Solid automated testing habits (unit/integration/e2e) and comfort with CI/CD; you know when to add coverage and when not to over-engineer.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB or similar) and cloud-hosted applications (AWS preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication — RFCs/tech notes, partner discussions, and clear updates for Product and other engineers.
  • Collaborative leadership without needing formal authority: mentoring, reviewing thoughtfully, and aligning people around a plan.
  • Security and privacy awareness appropriate for handling sensitive healthcare data — least privilege, secrets hygiene, safe logging.
  • Comfort using AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without lowering the quality bar.

Strong Pluses

  • Healthcare, HL7/FHIR, lab/pharmacy, or other regulated-domain integrations.
  • iPaaS / automation platforms (Workato or similar).
  • Design systems / component libraries, and large monorepo experience.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / CDK), observability (Datadog or similar), and multi-tenant SaaS.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across multiple engineers or workstreams.
  • Playwright or Cypress e2e experience.
  • Bilingual English–French.

What You’ll Get in Return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: improving healthcare!
  • £70,000–90,000 package, based on your experience and the value you can bring.
  • Autonomy and ownership — we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays + bank holidays + 3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) — that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Comprehensive health & wellbeing support — including private health insurance, and mental health support and free therapy sessions through Oliva.
  • Hybrid & flexible work environment — work from anywhere in the UK, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.
  • Get the tech you need — You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to setup your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team — our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument — with a roof terrace, weekly activities, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices — barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities...

A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • You'll be part of Foundant’s product engineering team responsible for development activities along with their ongoing production environments care and feeding to take on their hardest technical problems, and you’ll deliver high-quality working code — not just direction. This is a hands-on role at every level of seniority it carries.
  • You'll own architectural decisions at both the application and service level, making calls that hold up under real production load and remain understandable to the engineers who inherit them.
  • You'll diagnose systemic and architectural issues that cross component and service boundaries, including the ambiguous ones where the cause isn't in any single team code.
  • You’ll see the big picture and work proactively to resolve integration issues or coordinate across team boundaries.
  • You’ll put AI-assisted development and agentic tooling to work in your daily engineering, shortening the path from idea to production-ready code and getting valuable improvements into clients’ hands sooner.
  • Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time at a principal, staff, or equivalent senior individual contributor level as a hands-on developer.
  • Demonstrated mastery of architectural patterns and the judgment to know which apply in a given context, at both the application and service level.
  • Proven expertise in Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with a track record of building and shipping production software.
  • Extensive full-stack development experience building scalable RESTful applications with React and Java/Spring Boot backend.
  • Advanced proficiency working with large scale relational database management systems (RDBMS).
  • Experience working with analytical systems and databases processing large volume of data.
  • Proficient with AI assisted development practices and tooling.
  • Proven experience developing cloud-based SaaS applications; experience working with AWS is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience owning production services, including reliability, performance, and incident response.
  • Professional experience using AI-assisted development tools in production work. Foundant uses Claude Code; deep expertise with a comparable tool is acceptable.
  • Extensive experience diagnosing and debugging complex technical issues across multiple components and services, including the use of debugging and profiling tools.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:
  • Adaptive Achievement: Moves between unfamiliar codebases, domains, and problem spaces without losing momentum, and delivers high-quality solutions under shifting priorities and incomplete context.
  • Productive Collaboration: Leads engineers through complex initiatives by influence rather than authority — entering a team as a guest, earning trust quickly, and articulating direction clearly enough that the team can carry it forward without you.
  • Service Orientation: Treats internal engineering teams as clients, and understands that the reliability of a shared service is ultimately felt by the foundations and nonprofits depending on our software to do their work.
  • Business Insight: Weighs the blast radius of shared-service decisions across every product and client, balancing technical elegance against what actually advances the business and the communities we serve.
  • Active Learning: Builds working depth in unfamiliar stacks quickly, and applies rigorous judgment to AI-generated code — knowing when to lean on it, when to scrutinize it, and how to help colleagues do the same.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

jobs.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Position Summary

The Lead Software Engineer leads the design, development, and delivery of the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role defines the front-end architecture and technical strategy for a React and Next.js (TypeScript) application that consumes Pydantic AI agents over the AG-UI protocol and ensures the agent-to-human handoff is fast, accessible, secure, and auditable.

This individual provides technical leadership and mentorship to a team of front-end engineers, sets the standards others follow, and partners with architecture, agent, platform, design-system, and product teams to prioritize work and deliver on schedule. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of the agent-to-human handoff experience, ensuring alignment with business goals, product requirements, and regulatory decision timeframes.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the front-end engineering team, fostering a collaborative and productive development environment.
  • Oversee the full front-end development lifecycle, from initial concept to production deployment and ongoing maintenance.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, clinical stakeholders, and other engineers to prioritize work, set timelines, and deliver features on schedule.

Front-End Architecture and Standards

  • Define and implement the React and Next.js architecture, including Server and Client Component boundaries, an opt-in caching standard, and read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.
  • Establish the self-hosting standard for Next.js as containers on AKS, avoiding hosting-specific features that limit portability.
  • Define the backend-for-frontend (BFF) pattern and the integration approach for .NET (C#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication.
  • Partner with design-system owners on a technology-agnostic design token layer and a single Material-based theme across component libraries (e.g., KendoReact, MUI).
  • Own npm supply-chain controls, including SBOM generation, pinned lockfiles, dependency allow-lists, and scanning through GitHub Actions, CodeQL, Dependabot, and JFrog Xray.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, accessibility requirements, and security guidelines.
  • Plan and lead framework and library upgrades, including annual Next.js major-version migrations.

Agentic User Experience

  • Architect streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG-UI protocol.
  • Define the AG-UI event contract with the agent team, including shared state, frontend tools, and human-in-the-loop approval interrupts raised by Pydantic AI tools that require approval.
  • Design human-in-the-loop patterns that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations with structured rationale that supports the audit trail.
  • Establish patterns for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including resumable streams, retries, timeouts, and clear status for the reviewer.
  • Lead delivery of data-heavy screens, including large sortable and filterable grids, PDF and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards.
  • Ensure WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 conformance across the application, including support for independent accessibility conformance reviews.
  • Instrument the front end with OpenTelemetry to trace the agent-to-human handoff end to end.

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, engineering playbooks, and AI-assisted development patterns to benefit the broader engineering organization.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, keeping PHI out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including 4+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • 2+ years of experience leading teams of 3+ software engineers.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Next.js, including Server and Client Components, server-side rendering, streaming, and caching.
  • Experience building AI or agent-driven user interfaces (e.g., Vercel AI SDK, assistant-ui, CopilotKit, AG-UI) or equivalent streaming, real-time interfaces using Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
  • Experience designing and delivering data-heavy enterprise screens, such as large grids, document viewers, rich-text editors, and multi-step workflows, using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI.
  • Proven experience with the backend-for-frontend pattern and integrating front ends with services written in other languages, such as .NET (C#) and Python (FastAPI).
  • Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect.
  • Demonstrated expertise delivering applications that meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508.
  • Experience with front-end testing using Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS preferred), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience applying npm supply-chain security practices, such as SBOMs, lockfile policy, and dependency scanning.
  • Strong, daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to lead and mentor a team of engineers.
  • Experience in Agile development methodologies and working in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges and make critical decisions under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Python and Pydantic AI, including agent tool approval and the AG-UI and Vercel AI SDK adapters.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval, override, and audit workflows.
  • Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus.
  • Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers.

• Experience with C# and .NET.

  • Experience with design systems and design tokens, including Material Design.
  • Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications.
  • Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
jobs.excerpt: About Onfleet Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully.
jobs.description:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.
  • Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.
  • Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.
  • Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.
  • Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.
  • Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.
  • Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.
  • Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required):

  • 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.
  • 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.
  • You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.
  • Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.
  • Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.
  • A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.
  • Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.
  • A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have:

  • Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.
  • TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
  • Rust, or another statically typed language.
  • Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.
  • Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.
  • Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.
  • Test-driven development (TDD).
  • AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

  • Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.
  • The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.
  • Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

About Indiegraf

Indiegraf is a mission-driven technology company built by and for independent local media leaders. We serve large and small digital media, newspapers, radio stations and public media across the Americas, in both English and Spanish, with a special focus on underserved communities. We are a privately-held company, incorporated in Canada and the U.S., majority-owned by employees and impact investors who believe the future of local news is independent.

Our mission is to defend independent journalism by reducing reliance on any single funder, revenue stream, audience platform or government, so local media can dictate their own future.

Our vision is a world where every community is served by a resilient, sovereign news outlet—transforming local civic information from a fragile endeavour to a thriving pillar of democracy.

jobs.excerpt: Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era.
jobs.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You'll Love This Role

Cribl Stream provides users a new level of observability, intelligence and control over their real-time data. Some may say our greatest accomplishment thus far is having our software deployed in some of the largest organizations in the world processing 100s of TB to PB of IT & Security data. Others may attribute that to our massive amount of goat gifs that we’ve harvested from the Internet. It’s difficult to know for sure.

As an Integrations Engineer at Cribl, you will build the software components that enable us to collect and send data between closed and open source systems. This role is equal parts research and development. If you enjoy diving deep into new technologies, understanding how they work, collaborating with other talented engineers, and slinging code to bind them together, this role might be the right one for you. In this role, you will join a team of skilled engineers committed to shipping the highest quality software and ensuring our customers’ satisfaction. This is a fully remote role and Cribl is a remote first company. Our culture embraces the diversity of team members spread all across the globe.

As An Active Member Of Our Team You Will...

  • Develop features that integrate Cribl’s data stream processing engine with data systems such as Splunk, Elastic Search, Kafka, AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage.
  • Rapidly develop subject matter expertise in a diverse set of 3rd party technologies by provisioning, building, and configuring all systems and/or accounts necessary to facilitate the R&D process.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain clear, concise, and robust code that produces the desired outcomes for our customers.
  • Develop expert level knowledge of software development using NodeJS and TypeScript (and sometimes even C++!), and be willing to become exposed to and work with Node internals from time to time.
  • Ensure product features are working as expected by creating robust test plans paired with comprehensive automated tests and writing integration tests.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, UX designers, and business teams to translate feature specifications into implementable code.
  • Work closely with peers on your team by providing feedback on feature design and code reviews.
  • Contribute and be involved in a weekly 24/7 support on call rotation.
  • Initiative and drive to help the greater team, even if it's outside your job description.
  • Evangelize our innovation and engage our users by contributing to internal and external community, documentation, and blogs related to the products that you help develop.
  • This position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties.


If You've Got It - We Want It

  • Demonstrated experience integrating with third party applications, libraries, and APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with using and developing REST APIs.
  • Experience interacting with and building on cloud based platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.
  • Experience with authorization and authentication standards such as Oauth2, OpenID Connect, LDAP and SAML is a plus.
  • Comfort with significant research and discovery before coding begins.
  • Demonstrated ability to build robust systems in the face of uncertainty.
  • Experience with Agile processes and rapid iterative development.
  • Strong sense of ownership with focus on high quality and high performing deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written; ability to explain complex technical topics to both internal and external stakeholders with ease and in remote/distributed environments.
  • Insatiable curiosity – one of our core values is a tenet to being a great engineer at Cribl. Be willing and eager to learn new technologies and products built by other companies.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$115,000—$150,000 CAD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

    • Release readiness

    • Agile sprint planning

  • Build reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions to support business decision-making

  • Mentor junior team members and set standards for quality and best practice

🧠 Knowledge & Experience Required

  • 5+ years Salesforce experience, ideally within a consultancy or multi-client delivery environment
  • Proven experience delivering end-to-end Salesforce implementations, not just incremental enhancements
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Salesforce Flow (essential)
    • Data modelling and relational data structures
    • Security and sharing models
  • Experience across:
    • Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
    • Additional exposure to Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or Industry Clouds is beneficial
  • Exposure to Media Cloud or other Industry Clouds is highly advantageous
  • Working knowledge or practical experience with Agentforce / AI-driven Salesforce capabilities is a strong plus
  • Strong experience with:
    • Integrations and AppExchange tools (e.g. document generation, e-signature, telephony, marketing platforms)
    • Data migration and ETL tools (Data Loader, Workbench, etc.)
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with DevOps practices (Jira, Git, CI/CD, SFDX)
  • Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in Salesforce delivery is essential, including:
    • AI-assisted metadata configuration
    • Automation design and debugging
    • Documentation and testing acceleration
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences

🎯 Strong Differentiators

  • Experience in a Salesforce consultancy / partner environment
  • Certifications:
    • Salesforce Administrator (required)
    • Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder
    • Consultant certifications (Sales, Service, Experience, etc.)
  • Experience with:
    • Media, advertising, or industry-specific implementations
    • AI-enabled Salesforce features (Agentforce, Einstein, automation augmentation)
    • Field Service, Omni-Channel, or Service operations
    • Marketing automation (Marketing Cloud / Account Engagement)
    • Data/analytics tools (e.g. Tableau)

  • Have delivered complex implementations (e.g. case management, service operations, media workflows, or marketing automation)

🌍 Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge Salesforce capabilities, including:
    • Media Cloud (complex, industry-specific implementations)

  • Be part of a consultancy that treats AI as a core delivery capability

  • You are adaptable and resilient where you thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift; you’re comfortable working on multiple projects at once and can adjust to changing demands

We offer a flexible and rewarding work environment, including:

  • Work-life flexibility
  • Comprehensive benefits package

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION
